title: Inverse-Time Investigation Team (Mobius)
author: Zhang Xiaomao
synopsis:
The Inverse Time Investigation Team is composed of elite criminal police, cutting-edge scientists, criminologists, and network experts. It is a secret task force established to target criminal groups with extremely strong anti-investigation capabilities and that possess cutting-edge technologies such as time reversal, artificial intelligence, gene editing, and big data information.

One day, criminal police officer Lu Tianfeng discovered he possessed the ability to replay time, allowing him to relive the same day five times at irregular intervals. Relying on this ability, Lu Tianfeng repeatedly returned to the events leading to the investigation, solving one serious case after another. It wasn’t until a murder notice from suspect X suddenly appeared that Lu Tianfeng gradually realized he wasn’t the only one possessing this ability…

chapters.title: Chapter 1
chapters.content:
April 7th, 7pm.

Ronghua Restaurant, one of the ten oldest restaurants in D City, is located in the suburbs. Its simple decor and unassuming appearance don’t impress, and its fare isn’t particularly high. Yet, its signature dish, “Dragon and Phoenix Auspiciousness,” a century-old secret recipe—a stew of old hens and fresh water snakes, accompanied by eighteen local spices and side dishes—still attracts countless diners from far and wide.

Today, as usual, the restaurant was packed by six o’clock, forcing latecomers to gather outside to get a number and wait for a table. By seven, the restaurant entrance was busier than a market. The nearby vegetable and fruit farmers, having learned their lesson, would arrive at this hour to showcase their produce to the bored patrons. Among them was a dark-skinned young man, carrying a shoulder pole, and leisurely hawking his two baskets of apples.

“Here are some excellent apples. Try them.”

A fashionable girl took a look and found that the apples were small and green. She frowned and said, “Brother, these apples are not ripe yet, right?”

The man with the carrying pole just chuckled, didn’t take it seriously, turned around and walked towards another group of customers.

At this time, a white van stopped near the gate. Four big men in black jumped out of the car swiftly then looked around. One of them made a gesture and the four of them in a line walked towards the side door of the restaurant.

The man with the carrying pole, who had looked a bit silly just now, suddenly had a gleam in his eyes. He then slightly opened his collar, revealing a miniature microphone, and lowered his head to speak quickly and clearly: “The target has appeared, be alert. Yongsheng, Xuanxuan, prepare for action.”

After saying that, he threw down two baskets of apples, picked up the shoulder pole, and rushed towards the side door.

Then, the four men in black sneaked into the restaurant through the side door, looking around for something. A concierge in a blue cheongsam quickly stepped forward and asked, “Gentlemen, do you have a reservation?”

“It’s the Rose Room, which has been reserved.” The leading man in black said vaguely.

“Oh, are you Mr. Bai’s guest?” The concierge looked at the appointment registration form in her hand. “This way, please.”

A concierge brought them to the door of the “Rose Room” private room and knocked gently. However, the men in black behind her could no longer hold back. They pushed her away roughly and rushed through the door. Several of them took out switchblades from their pockets at the same time.

“Don’t make any noise. Whoever shouts will be stabbed to death!” the leading man in black shouted viciously.

In the private room, Bai Zhuoqiang’s family of three, who were about to have their meal, and the waiter who was pouring tea for them were all stunned.

Bai Zhuoqiang, who just turned fifty, is the leading high-end clothing brand distributor in D City. He has countless assets under his name and a net worth of over 100 million yuan. His usual business social activities mostly take him to five-star hotels. Today, he had a rare opportunity to relax and brought his wife and daughter to taste the authentic local flavors, but he didn’t expect to encounter such a thing.

However, Bai Zhuoqiang had been in the business world for many years, and he realized in just a few seconds that he might have encountered kidnappers. He remained calm and immediately stood up to stand in front of his wife and daughter.

“Brothers, what can I do for you?”

The leader of the black-clad men stepped forward and reached out to pull at Bai Zhuoqiang’s sleeve: “Boss Bai, please come with us…ah!”

The leading man in black suddenly let out a scream. It turned out that the waiter, who no one noticed, suddenly attacked and smashed the teapot in his hand at the leading man in black, splashing scalding tea all over his face.

The sudden change caused the leading black man to cover his eyes and retreat with a wail. The black-clad man closest to the waiter was also quick to react. Without a word, he raised his knife and stabbed the other man in the face.

The waiter showed agility far beyond that of an ordinary person. He lowered his head, twisted his waist, dodged the knife of the man in black, picked up a bowl on the table, and threw it at the man in black.

The man in black dodged the flying bowl and was about to raise his knife to stab again, but the waiter had already stepped forward, punching him with both fists, forcing the man in black to close combat. The man in black steeled his mind, swung his knife, and slashed at the waiter’s arm. The waiter was even faster, performing a series of grappling techniques, clamping the man’s hands. Then, with a twist, there was a crisp “crack”, and the man’s wrist was broken, instantly losing his fighting ability.

Seeing their two companions defeated in less than a minute, the remaining two men in black, already weaker to begin with and their momentum overpowered, dared not fight any longer and simply fled. In their desperate attempt to escape, they had no idea that the delicate concierge who had been leading them would suddenly unleash a sweeping kick, tripping one of the men. The kick’s timing and force were perfect, clearly a true martial artist.

The man in black, who had fallen to the ground, tried to struggle, but the concierge stepped on him, handcuffed his hands behind his back, and with a click, he realized the handcuffs were real. Seeing the skilled operation, he immediately realized that the other party was a genuine police officer.

“Stop, don’t run!”

There was still one man in black who ran out without looking back, waving a knife in his hand, scaring the passersby along the way to dodge. However, there was a man in simple clothes, who looked like a farmer, holding a long shoulder pole, blocking the middle of the road with a smile.

“Get out of here!” the man in black shouted angrily. Seeing that the other party showed no signs of retreating, he didn’t hesitate to use his knife and went straight for the man’s chest.

“What a joke!” The man’s mouth curled up, and the carrying pole in his hand seemed to have a spirit, hitting the knife of the man in black. Normally, the carrying pole is much heavier than the knife, but the man in black tried to change his tactics several times, but the carrying pole blocked his attack route in advance.

Puff—the knife stabbed straight into the shoulder pole, penetrating deep into the wood. The man in black’s face changed, and he had no choice but to use his shoulder to charge forward, trying to squeeze through and escape.

“Where are you running to?”

The man in black’s eyes blurred and he didn’t even know what was happening. He involuntarily spun in the air, fell heavily to the ground and lost consciousness.

“Boss, is it done?”

“That’s amazing!”

The waiter and the concierge arrived one after another. They turned out to be the “Yongsheng” and “Xuanxuan” the man with the carrying pole had mentioned—Yu Yongsheng and Huang Xuanxuan from the 7th Detachment of the D City Criminal Police Team. The man pretending to be an apple farmer was their boss, Deputy Captain Lu Tianfeng.

“All four have been caught, but where is the driver waiting outside?” Lu Tianfeng looked calm, and did not seem particularly happy about successfully preventing a kidnapping.

“There’s no way he could escape. It seems like Captain Cheng caught him personally.” Yu Yongsheng said.

“Very good, prepare to pack up.” Lu Tianfeng waved his hand, indicating that all the suspects should be taken back first.

The onlookers in the restaurant had never seen such a movie-like scene before. After the criminals were caught, everyone felt relieved and even more unscrupulous in their efforts to squeeze in and watch the excitement. In desperation, Yu Yongsheng and Huang Xuanxuan had to ask the restaurant security personnel to help maintain order so that they could take the suspects away.

Lu Tianfeng quietly left before the crowd gathered. Before leaving, he glanced into the Rose Room and happened to meet Bai Zhuoqiang’s gaze.

The eyes of this business elite were filled with gratitude and admiration, but also with confusion and bewilderment. This evening’s dinner was a last-minute decision made this morning, and only a handful of people knew about the itinerary. If the kidnappers bribed those close to him, orchestrating this kidnapping, how did the police learn of their actions and plan their rescue in advance?

Before Bai Zhuoqiang could come up with a reasonable explanation, Lu Tianfeng’s back had disappeared into the crowd.

CONTENT END 1

chapters.title: Chapter 2
chapters.content:
April 7th, 10pm, Fa Kee Food Stall.

Beer, barbecue skewers and spicy hot pot are the three signature night snacks in D City. Today, Yu Yongsheng and Huang Xuanxuan completed their task brilliantly, so Lu Tianfeng, as their boss, had to reward them.

The table of the three was filled with skewers, but since they had to go to work the next day, they did not order beer and only had iced cola instead.

“Come on, let’s toast to the boss first!” Yu Yongsheng’s face flushed with excitement, and he shouted while raising the can of Coke.

“Cheers to the boss.” Huang Xuanxuan echoed softly. Looking at her delicate appearance now, it was hard to imagine that she was a tough “tomboy” when she was on a mission.

“Thank you all for your hard work. Come, eat more.” Lu Tianfeng had a smile on his face, but his tone remained calm.

Yu Yongsheng grabbed two skewers of grilled lamb and stuffed them directly into his mouth without even dipping them in sauce. While chewing, he said, “I can eat more. Xuanxuan should pay attention to controlling her weight, right?”

Huang Xuanxuan gave Yu Yongsheng a cold look, too lazy to answer, and picked up a grilled chicken wing.

Yu Yongsheng was clearly the most excited of the three, and he took the initiative to bring up a new topic: “Hey, Xuanxuan, did you see how accurate the boss’s intelligence is today? I’ve always said you won’t regret joining us.”

Yu Yongsheng, a criminal police officer from the Seventh Detachment, had been with Lu Tianfeng for over three years. Huang Xuanxuan, formerly a plainclothes officer at another precinct, had been transferred here just over a month earlier. Rumors swirled within the bureau that the young policewoman had applied for the transfer to follow her idol, Lu Tianfeng.

But this was just a rumor after all. No one knew what she was thinking except Huang Xuanxuan herself.

“Talk less!” Huang Xuanxuan’s face flushed, and she casually stuffed the chicken wing into Yu Yongsheng’s mouth without even having a chance to take a bite.

Lu Tianfeng smiled even more broadly, picked up a sausage and handed it to Huang Xuanxuan: “Eat it, ignore him, this guy just can’t control his mouth.”

“Thank you.” Huang Xuanxuan took the bamboo stick with her slightly trembling right hand, and her face showed the shyness unique to little girls.

Just as Yu Yongsheng was about to take the opportunity to make a fuss, he saw Lu Tianfeng giving him a reproachful look, so he obediently lowered his head and ate the chicken wings.

Huang Xuanxuan noticed the eye contact between the two men and couldn’t help but burst out laughing: “Boss, you really have a way of managing people.”

Before Lu Tianfeng could answer, Yu Yongsheng started yelling, “It’s called ‘control’ when others control me, but the boss doesn’t need to ‘control’ me because I truly admire him and obey him unconditionally.”

“Come on, you can even talk drunkenly after drinking Coke.” Lu Tianfeng patted Yu Yongsheng’s shoulder.

“I’m serious, Boss. In my mind, you’re much better than Captain Cheng.” Yu Yongsheng’s words were tantamount to directly questioning Lu Tianfeng’s immediate superior, and Lu Tianfeng frowned when he heard it.

Yu Yongsheng threw his phone on the table and said indignantly, “Look, we did all the work, but Captain Cheng took the limelight, and in the end, most of the credit went to him. What’s going on?”

Lu Tianfeng and Huang Xuanxuan came forward curiously to take a look. It turned out to be a video that had just been uploaded to the Internet and quickly became popular. It must have been taken by a customer waiting in front of the Ronghua Restaurant.

In the video, a white van was parked on the side of the road, its engine running and its headlights on. Suddenly, a commotion breaks out among the crowd watching. The van driver, noticing the disturbance, was about to flee when a police jeep sprinted into view and, with a stunning drift, abruptly stopped the van.

The following footage was extremely shaky, likely caused by the person filming the incident running towards the scene with their phone, attempting to film it up close. When the footage cleared up again, Cheng Tuo had already subdued the driver and was waving his hands repeatedly, asking the onlookers to disperse.

The video was accompanied by an exaggerated red caption: “Police officer drifts his car and catches the thief in one second. He’s so cool that he has no friends!”

“Captain Cheng must be being so ostentatious on purpose, even winking at the camera.” Yu Yongsheng said with dissatisfaction.

Lu Tianfeng was open-minded and said disapprovingly: “This video is well shot. I can feel the positive energy just watching it.”

“Boss, do you really not care about your own career prospects?” Yu Yongsheng’s face was filled with confusion, and he became more and more excited as he spoke. “To be honest, Team 7 used to be just a filler in the bureau. Major cases were basically assigned to the elites from Teams 1 and 2 to follow up. We could only play a supporting role, running wherever there was a shortage of people. If it weren’t for you leading the team and solving that shocking robbery at the Tianma Jewelry Center, how could we have the status we have today?”

Huang Xuanxuan’s eyes lit up with excitement when she heard the words “Tianma Jewelry Center.” This was a case hailed as a miracle within the police department! Two years ago, five robbers from a neighboring province had arrived in D City, orchestrating a “big heist.” They’d secured a cache of firearms from smugglers thousands of miles away and remained hidden in the area. Once their plan to rob the Tianma Jewelry Center was complete, they silenced the only local thug who might have leaked the information, burying his body in the wilderness.

Lu Tianfeng actually knew about such a carefully planned robbery in advance. When Lu Tianfeng asked his superiors to send a special police team for support, many people thought he was making a fuss out of nothing and even doubted the reliability of the informant’s information.

“The police force emphasizes cooperation. What’s the use of my accurate intelligence? If it weren’t for Captain Cheng who went against the majority and secured support from the SWAT team for us, we would probably have been shot to pieces by that group of perverts.” Lu Tianfeng sighed as he recalled the past.

Lu Tianfeng and Yu Yongsheng, both witnesses of the incident, remember that although police snipers launched the initial attack, killing two robbers in quick succession, the remaining three refused to surrender and instead engaged the police with their AK-47s. Fortunately, the police were well prepared and the crowd dispersed quickly, ultimately killing two more robbers. The final robber was also shot and arrested. Only a few police officers suffered minor injuries, and bystanders were unharmed.

Huang Xuanxuan looked at the two seniors with admiration and said, “This is truly amazing. It’s spreading like wildfire within the system. The version I heard is that you even predicted exactly where the robbers would park. All snipers were on standby, and they opened fire as soon as they confirmed the robbers’ identities.”

Yu Yongsheng said enthusiastically: “Hey, that’s what happened back then!”

“Ah? Can the informant’s information be this accurate?” Huang Xuanxuan looked at Lu Tianfeng in astonishment. The latter smiled without saying a word, raised his head and took a big gulp of Coke.

Yu Yongsheng pretended to be serious and said, “This is the boss’s most important secret. Let’s not pry into it casually.”

“Oh…” Huang Xuanxuan’s eyes rolled around, clearly not accepting this answer. But as a police officer, she was well aware of the rules. Informants, like undercover agents, were highly confidential, so Lu Tianfeng’s reticence about the matter was understandable.

“If Captain Cheng hadn’t been taking credit for it in front of the leadership, I think…”

“Yongsheng!” Lu Tianfeng suddenly raised his voice, his usually calm tone now tinged with anger. “Don’t say anything that will ruin the team atmosphere!”

“Ah… I’m sorry, I was wrong.” Yu Yongsheng covered his mouth and shrank back into his seat obediently. He was like a tiger with bared fangs and claws the previous second, but at this moment he became a kitten being scolded by his owner.

Lu Tianfeng probably felt that his tone was a bit harsh, so he sighed and said, “Actually, if you think about it carefully, if it weren’t for Captain Cheng standing in front to deal with the leaders, I wouldn’t be able to hide behind the scenes so freely and provide intelligence…”

Yu Yongsheng and Huang Xuanxuan were both smart young people. They immediately understood what was said. Safe and reliable informant resources can be said to be extremely scarce “treasures”, but if Lu Tianfeng’s reputation was too great and he rose rapidly in the police station, it would be an invisible pressure for him and the informants behind him, and may even bring fatal disaster to the informants.

“So Captain Cheng and I have a tacit understanding and work in perfect harmony. Let’s focus on our work and ignore the rumors, okay?”

Lu Tianfeng raised the can of Coke and gestured to his two subordinates to clink glasses. His words were neither humble nor arrogant, and were well-reasoned and well-founded. Yu Yongsheng and Huang Xuanxuan nodded repeatedly, and their respect for this low-key boss increased even more.

However, the intuitive Huang Xuanxuan still noticed that beneath Lu Tianfeng’s calm expression, there were some inexplicable emotion hidden – he was obviously a young man who was not even thirty years old, but he looked like an old man who had long seen through the world?

“…That’s why you are the winner in life, Boss!”

Huang Xuanxuan was distracted just now and didn’t know what she missed in a daze.

“You are such a talker, kid!”

“Solved a major case and got a beautiful woman in one day. Finding a girlfriend as outstanding as Sister Nuolan, isn’t that a winner in life?”

“How many times have I told you that you’re one year older than Chen Nuolan? Stop calling me so old, okay?”

Huang Xuanxuan had heard that Lu Tianfeng had a girlfriend a long time ago, but she only just learned her name: “Huh? The boss’s fate with sister-in-law is related to the Tianma Jewelry Center case?” Her curiosity immediately emerged.

Lu Tianfeng couldn’t help but smile happily: “That was the day when the robber opened fire, and I happened to save her life.”

“Oh my, that’s so easy!” Yu Yongsheng danced with joy. “The boss was so impressive at that moment. With a flying leap, he pounced on Sister Nuolan, who had just turned the corner, a cup of coffee in her hand, completely unaware. She was pinned down beneath him. A second later, the AK-47 bullets went flying past. It was truly thrilling.”

“Haha, I was also lucky…”

“Poor Sister Nolan, she was ‘pushed down’ by you the first time we met, so from now on I can only follow you.”

Lu Tianfeng punched Yu Yongsheng lightly and reminded him, “Don’t tell dirty jokes when there are girls around!”

“Boss, this is unfair. Can it be considered a dirty joke?”

Huang Xuanxuan didn’t care and said jokingly, “Although it’s not vulgar, it’s very cold and not funny at all.”

The topics discussed by the three of them gradually moved away from work and cases, and the atmosphere became more and more relaxed. Before they knew it, they were chatting until after eleven o’clock in the evening.

Lu Tianfeng looked at the time: “Let’s stop here today. We have to go to work tomorrow.”

“Don’t worry, boss. I will be at work on time tomorrow!” Yu Yongsheng still looked energetic. In comparison, Huang Xuanxuan seemed a little tired and spoke weakly.

Lu Tianfeng noticed this detail and ordered, “Yongsheng, take Xuanxuan home.”

“She herself…”

“I myself…”

He didn’t expect that the two of them would speak at the same time and then fall silent at the same time. It was a bit awkward.

Lu Tianfeng patted Yu Yongsheng on the shoulder: “Send her home, this is an order.”

“Yes, sir!”

CONTENT END 2

chapters.title: Chapter 3
chapters.content:
April 7th, 11:45 pm, Lu Tianfeng’s home.

Technically, this small rented apartment was Lu Tianfeng and Chen Nuolan’s shared home. However, Chen Nuolan had recently applied for a staff dormitory from the company, citing excessive work pressure and frequent overtime. She usually only stayed here on weekends.

One recent weekend, she didn’t even come home.

Lu Tianfeng took a can of beer from the refrigerator, sat on the windowsill, and opened the pull ring. The bitter, cold beer went down his throat, and he felt instantly refreshed.

People who have too many secrets always have trouble sleeping.

Lu Tianfeng had many secrets, and the biggest and most crucial one was that the so-called “mysterious informant” who helped him solve major cases repeatedly did not exist at all.

From a certain day when Lu Tianfeng was seventeen years old, he realized that he was not an ordinary person, because he experienced “that day” five times.

At the beginning, it was just an ordinary and normal day, going to school and coming home, eating and sleeping, nothing unusual.

However, after getting up the “next day”, he opened his eyes and found that the date displayed on the mobile phone screen was still “yesterday”. After getting up, every word his parents said to him, the breakfast that had been prepared long ago, the classmates he met on the way to school… everything told him that “today” was a repetition of “yesterday”.

If Lu Tianfeng hadn’t been a fan of science fiction, he would have been scared to death. He was very brave at the time, and although he felt panic and fear, he was mostly excited and thrilled.

At school, he could easily complete a test that he had already seen “yesterday.” He could even pretend to be a “prophet” in front of his classmates because he knew everything that would happen next day.

The magical day was about to end. Lu Tianfeng, who usually had a fixed schedule and went to bed on time at ten o’clock, insisted on staying up until midnight, just to find out whether he can successfully enter “tomorrow”.

An incredible thing happened. As soon as the last second of the day passed, he returned to the moment when the alarm on his mobile phone rang in the morning and he opened his eyes. Without any pause, the third “today” began.

Then there was the fourth and fifth time loops. After experiencing the same day five times, Lu Tianfeng finally welcomed a new “tomorrow”. At the same time, he also realized that everyone except himself would lose all memories of the previous four time loops, and even damaged objects would be restored to their original state in the new cycle.

Since the first time he sensed the time loop, Lu Tianfeng would fall into this strange phenomenon from time to time. Every time this phenomenon occurred, it would go through five cycles, and only the fifth cycle would become the real “reality”.

Lu Tianfeng then developed a habit of recording the date of each time loop. He soon discovered that the time loops did not occur at a fixed frequency. The shortest interval between two loops in his records was only five days, while the longest interval between two loops was thirty-nine days.

He initially found this ability amusing, but as the number of times he experienced it increased, it became a bit annoying. After all, sometimes a bad day repeated five times can be quite tiring. He first truly realized the power of this ability on the first day of his college entrance exam. That day, an uncontrolled time loop occurred, giving him five chances to ace the exam. He ultimately scored far better than expected, earning admission to the nation’s top police academy.

After graduating from university, Lu Tianfeng became a criminal police officer, fulfilling a childhood dream. New to the job, he harbored a small hope: one day, he could leverage his special ability to time-rewind, solve a major case, and achieve remarkable success, thus embarking on the path to success with a promotion and a raise.

However, fate always liked to play tricks on people. After working for several years, time loops had indeed occurred again and again, but there had never been a case that Lu Tianfeng could use his strengths, so he had always been an ordinary detective.

It wasn’t until one day two years ago that his fate took a turn. Around 6 p.m., while on his way home, he received an urgent call mobilizing all police in the city to conduct a sweeping search for the five armed robbers who had robbed the Tianma Jewelry Center that afternoon. Armed with AK-47s, they had robbed eight jewelry stores, killing thirteen innocent citizens and four responding police officers. The scene was a horrific vision of bloodshed.

Lu Tianfeng’s mission was to guard the main traffic arteries overnight, set up roadblocks, and check suspicious passing vehicles. While on duty, he fantasized idly that if time could loop today, he could prevent this bloody incident and save those innocent people…

Unknowingly, time came to midnight. Lu Tianfeng didn’t even realize anything, and the next second he returned to the morning of that day.

At that moment he almost jumped out of bed with joy, because he knew that his life would change drastically from then on.

Even though he was mentally prepared, the goddess of fate still showed up far beyond his expectations. Because at the crime scene, Lu Tianfeng met Chen Nuolan.

He remembered it very clearly. It was the third cycle of the day. He risked his life and entered the jewelry store that was about to be robbed first – Tianma Jewelry Center – as a customer before the incident, because he wanted to get close to the robbers and get first-hand information.

Just as the robbers jumped out of the car with an AK-47, Lu Tianfeng saw through the glass window a tall and beautiful woman wearing a pure white chiffon shirt and a light blue long skirt. She lowered her head to operate her mobile phone with her right hand and held a cup of coffee in her left hand, walking leisurely towards the gangsters.

What a wonderful and strange picture it was, a goddess full of sunshine and vitality, pure as snow, walking towards the cruel god of death step by step, but her steps were still relaxed and comfortable.

One of the robbers had already pointed a gun at her, and several sharp-eyed passersby dodged in fear.

“Get out of the way!” Lu Tianfeng almost screamed, but unfortunately the woman outside the window couldn’t hear him at all.

By the time she realized something was wrong, it was too late.

The robbers, probably to intimidate passersby and boost their morale, fired indiscriminately. Lu Tianfeng quickly crouched down, hearing screams and wails echoing in the street. Merciless bullets shattered shop windows, scattering glass all over the floor.

After the gunshot, Lu Tianfeng climbed to his feet. His first reaction was to look at the young woman. She lay amidst the shards of glass, her once-white shirt now stained black with blood. Her beautiful eyes stared blankly upwards. Her life had been taken almost instantly, so her face showed no trace of pain, instead carrying an endless longing and yearning for a better life.

Lu Tianfeng suddenly made up his mind that he must protect this girl and let her have the future that should belong to her.

This was the first time Lu Tianfeng met Chen Nuolan, and before he knew her name, she had already died.

“Ah!”

The cold beer spilled onto Lu Tianfeng’s thighs, and he suddenly realized that he was sitting on the balcony. He didn’t know how long he had been in a daze.

His first meeting with Chen Nuolan was a separation of life and death. Did this imply that their love would have the same ending?

“How ridiculous! Isn’t the purpose of my existence to change my destiny?” Lu Tianfeng muttered to himself.

Two years ago, Lu Tianfeng finally saved Chen Nuolan during the fifth loop of the murder, bringing her back to life, and later successfully won her heart. Today, he also used his time looping ability to save Bai Zhuoqiang, who was about to be kidnapped and murdered.

“Fate is not worthy to be my opponent!” He suddenly thought of this somewhat childish but heroic sentence.

The beer can in his hand was empty, and he was about to take another can. His slightly drunk eyes happened to glance at the box of business cards that his girlfriend had placed on the desk.

Chen Nuolan, researcher at Feng Teng Gene Center Laboratory.

D City’s leading high-tech star enterprise provided generous salaries and comprehensive welfare benefits. This job that many people envy had created an invisible crack in the relationship between Lu Tianfeng and Chen Nuolan.

No matter how small a crack was, it was still a crack.

Lu Tianfeng sighed and gently turned the business card case over. He didn’t want to see the words “Feng Teng Gene” again. Ironically, the business card case was transparent, and the company logo and English name of Feng Teng Gene could still be seen on the back of the business card.

He smiled wryly, picked up a magazine, covered the card case with it, and strode towards the refrigerator.

The wall clock chimed, and midnight arrived. The “yesterday” that had been repeated five times truly became yesterday, and a brand new day finally arrived.

CONTENT END 3

chapters.title: Chapter 4
chapters.content:
April 10th, 9:30 am.

There happened to be no major cases on hand these past two days, so Lu Tianfeng was happy to have some free time, but he had a vague feeling that something was not right.

Several years of work experience told him that being a policeman was absolutely not an option, as accidents were bound to happen if he were idle.

Sure enough, Cheng Tuo walked to Lu Tianfeng’s seat with an inexplicably serious expression.

“Ah’feng, come with me.”

Strangely, Cheng Tuo did not lead Lu Tianfeng into his office, but walked to the back stairs and motioned him to go to the rooftop to chat.

Lu Tianfeng felt more and more uneasy.

Smoking was strictly prohibited inside the police station, and smoking was only allowed on the rooftop area, so it was quite lively here after dinner or when working overtime until late at night.

But at this hour, the rooftop was empty, thus a good place to talk.

“Boss, what’s wrong?” Lu Tianfeng knew that his boss was worried, so he asked directly.

Cheng Tuo smiled bitterly and said, “Just now the leader came to me and said that there was a case over at Team One and he wanted to ask for support from Team Seven.”

“Then let’s support them.” Lu Tianfeng was a little puzzled. Wasn’t this something that couldn’t be more ordinary? But he also knew very well that Cheng Tuo was definitely not the kind of person who would complain and cause trouble for no reason, so he waited quietly for his boss to continue.

“This case is a bit complicated. Team One wants to use your informant resources, so I need to ask for your opinion first.”

“Boss, this is difficult…”

Lu Tianfeng finally understood why Cheng Tuo was so distressed. According to their prior agreement, Cheng Tuo would never ask Lu Tianfeng about his informant’s identity, nor would he ask the informant to provide intelligence on a specific case; correspondingly, Lu Tianfeng would ensure the accuracy and reliability of every informant’s intelligence.

Lu Tianfeng had always asked Cheng Tuo to deal with his superiors because he knew very well that his so-called “information from an informant” could not withstand rigorous scrutiny and verification, and he was most afraid of situations like today.

“I know your difficulties. If it really doesn’t work, I’ll find a way to turn it down.” Cheng Tuo patted Lu Tianfeng’s shoulder.

“Boss, can you tell me what the case is?” Lu Tianfeng was still curious. While the teams worked together as colleagues, they also secretly competed to see who could solve cases better. Team One, the most elite team in the bureau, actually proactively requested to use Team Seven’s secret informant. This must be an extremely troublesome case.

“He’s quite a ruthless guy, a serial killer who predicts his murders.” Cheng Tuo’s face was solemn, and his tone of voice seemed a bit heavy. “By the way, does your girlfriend work at Feng Teng Gene? The case is related to this company.”

“What?” Lu Tianfeng was shocked. A murder happened around Chen Nuolan, but he was kept in the dark.

Cheng Tuo introduced the entire case in the most concise and clear language – about three months ago, Feng Teng Gene’s vice president Zhang Hanlin received a threatening letter. The sender called himself X and predicted that Zhang Hanlin would die within a month, and the murderer of this future crime would be X himself.

Because the letter’s contents were confusing and unclear, and Zhang Hanlin’s personal driver and personal secretary were both veterans, Zhang Hanlin didn’t take the threatening letter seriously, but only slightly increased his vigilance. Unexpectedly, two weeks after receiving the threatening letter, Zhang Hanlin really got into trouble. At that time, he was just craving cigarettes, and since no one else was home, he ran to the convenience store downstairs to buy a pack of cigarettes. As he walked to the checkout counter to pay, the counter suddenly exploded, killing Zhang Hanlin and the store clerk on the spot.

The police later discovered that someone had placed a small bomb inside the cash register in advance. However, the most bizarre thing was that the bomb was not detonated by remote control, but was timed to explode. This meant that the killer had to accurately predict Zhang Hanlin’s movements and timing in the convenience store to ensure his death.

However, as the investigation deepened, all the evidence indicated that Zhang Hanlin had gone to buy cigarettes on impulse. The convenience store staff, including those killed in the explosion, were also checked one by one. None of them had any connection to Zhang Hanlin’s life, nor any grudges, thus ruling out the possibility of a hired killer. This led to a split in opinion among the investigators. Some believed that X had killed Zhang Hanlin through some extremely clever means, but they had yet to find any clues. Others objected, arguing that there was no connection between the threatening letter and the explosion, and that the killer was actually a random bomber who killed people indiscriminately. Zhang Hanlin’s death was purely coincidental.

However, both theories contained significant flaws that made them inconclusive, so neither could convince the other. They had no choice but to divide their forces and investigate both leads simultaneously. Unfortunately, after working for over two weeks, the police made extremely slow progress. X remained elusive in the vast sea of people, and not even a single piece of valuable information could be found.

As crisis accumulated one after another. The police investigation into Zhang Hanlin’s case reached a stalemate, and another key figure at Feng Teng Gene, Chief Scientist Gao Junjie, received a nearly identical threatening letter. With Zhang Hanlin’s experience as a warning, Gao Junjie was uneasy. He not only immediately called the police but also contacted a professional security company, hiring four bodyguards to protect him around the clock. Police also deployed numerous personnel to investigate the source of the threatening letter and investigate anyone who had access to Gao Junjie, but these investigations were equally fruitless.

Two weeks later, Gao Junjie also died in an explosion. This time, the incident seemed even more accidental. Gao Junjie was walking along the road when he passed a parked car. The car suddenly exploded violently, sending a piece of broken metal slicing through his neck, severing his aorta. He collapsed in a pool of blood and died soon after.

This time, the bomb was placed in the trunk of a car, also set to explode at a fixed time. The owner of the car that exploded was an ordinary female office worker who worked nearby. Gao Junjie had no acquaintance or grudge against her. The car wasn’t parked in a designated spot; she simply happened to see an empty space while on her way to work that morning and parked there randomly. As for the timing of Gao Junjie’s passing by the car, it couldn’t have been pre-planned.

Both murders were carried out using timed bombs, seemingly uncontrollable accidents, but they successfully killed two victims who had received threatening letters. This bizarre incident left the police in charge of the case racking their brains, unable to come up with a reasonable explanation. All their investigations seemed more like an effort to appease the victims’ families, with no hope of solving the case.

With two unsolved cases, the pressure on the police was already immense. To make matters worse, Feng Teng Gene’s president, Luo Tengfeng, called the police last night to report that he had also received a threatening letter from X, claiming he would be killed within the next month. If a third case were to occur, D City’s police force would likely undergo major reshuffling, with countless people facing demotions or even job losses.

“So now you understand why a team of elite masters would condescend to seek help from your underground informant? Because they’re completely out of options and have no other choice but to try their luck.”

Lu Tianfeng could feel cold sweat on his back. To Cheng Tuo and other police officers, this bizarre method of killing was simply incomprehensible. However, after listening to the first case, Lu Tianfeng roughly guessed the murderer’s method, and the situation of the second case further confirmed his guess.

Both of these crimes were absolutely impossible for ordinary people to complete, but for those who could observe time loops, this was not an impossible task – they only needed to try to grasp the victim’s movements in the previous loops, and there would be a chance to plan the murder in the fifth loop.

Was this really the case?

“Captain Cheng…on what dates did these two cases occur?”

“Let me see… the first case was on February 7th, and the second on March 15th. What’s going on?”

Lu Tianfeng had the habit of recording the date of each time a time loop occurred, and he didn’t need to check written records to confirm that time loops occurred on February 7 and March 15 of this year.

There was at least one other person in this world who could observe the time loop!

Lu Tianfeng suddenly felt his head swelling, his temples aching slightly, and even his feet were a little unsteady.

Cheng Tuo noticed that Lu Tianfeng looked a little pale, and couldn’t help but ask worriedly, “Ah’feng, are you okay?”

“It’s okay, I just didn’t sleep well last night.”

“Well, make sure you get some rest. As for the reinforcement team, I’ll go and coordinate it.” After Cheng Tuo finished speaking, he turned around and prepared to leave.

Lu Tianfeng almost blurted out: “Boss, please include me in the reinforcement team!”

“Ah?” Cheng Tuo looked at Lu Tianfeng in surprise.

“I should be able to help.” In fact, what Lu Tianfeng was thinking was that perhaps only he could prevent this murder from happening. “But I have a small request.”

“Just tell me if you need anything.” Cheng Tuo seemed to have breathed a sigh of relief. Lu Tianfeng’s decision made him feel a lot more relaxed.

“If we need to send someone to protect Luo Tengfeng personally, please let me be responsible.”

“Are you applying for a protection mission?” Cheng Tuo’s brow, which had just relaxed, furrowed again. In this case, investigating clues and pursuing the murderer was proactive, while protecting the threatened victim was passive defense. Given Lu Tianfeng’s personality, why would he choose such a thankless task when he was already willing to support the case?

Besides, the murderer this time was accustomed to using bombs, and the police officers performing protection tasks would also face life-threatening danger. There was no way that Lu Tianfeng did not realize this.

“Can you tell me why?” Cheng Tuo asked directly.

Lu Tianfeng hesitated for a moment, and when he was about to get into trouble, Cheng Tuo patted his shoulder and said, “Don’t say anything, I’ll make the arrangements.”

“Thank you, Captain Cheng…”

CONTENT END 4

chapters.title: Chapter 5
chapters.content:
April 10th, evening.

The sun was setting and the office was covered with a layer of darkness. Lu Tianfeng sat in his seat. Although he was holding a thick stack of archival materials in his hand, his eyes were fixed on the window.

He stared blankly at the afterglow of the setting sun in the distance, as if thinking about something.

“Boss, you’re here.” Huang Xuanxuan walked into the office and turned on the light. “Why didn’t you turn on the light?”

“Oh, nothing.” Lu Tianfeng put down the file in his hand, “Have you finished the meeting with Team One?”

Huang Xuanxuan sat down angrily: “It’s over. While you were away, they bullied us terribly.”

Lu Tianfeng couldn’t help but laugh: “How did you bully us?”

“I don’t know what Captain Cheng was thinking. He took the initiative to request that Team Seven be responsible for close protection. Isn’t this just pushing us into a fire pit?”

“Oh, you really misunderstood Captain Cheng. This is my request.”

“Huh?” Huang Xuanxuan’s eyes widened in disbelief. “Why, Boss?”

Lu Tianfeng didn’t answer directly, but instead asked another question: “You’ve just been transferred here for a short time. Are you familiar with the colleagues in Team One?”

“I can’t say I’m familiar with them, but I know you…”

Lu Tianfeng analyzed the situation in detail. “Team One’s captain, Liang Tao, has nearly twenty years of criminal police experience. He’s refused promotions at least three times, determined to stay on the front lines. He’s known as ‘One Even Ghosts Fear’ to criminals.’ Deputy Captain Wu Guoqing is the bureau’s foremost interrogation and intelligence expert. Several young and capable officers within the team are also promising detectives. They’re leading the investigation, with the full support of the grassroots police. But how is it that after nearly three months, they haven’t even uncovered a trace of X?”

Huang Xuanxuan was still inexperienced after all, and was stunned for a moment.

“Yes, why?” she murmured to herself.

“I’m sure you’ve read the files. Their investigation was very thorough. If X had left any flaws during the crime, he would have been caught long ago.”

Lu Tianfeng knew very well that X’s flaw was in the first four time loops, but these “four days” did not exist at all for normal people.

“A crime with absolutely no flaws? Is that possible?” Huang Xuanxuan tilted her head, thinking hard.

Since he couldn’t tell her directly about the time loop, he could only say it another way.

“X is a very cautious person. The only way to catch him is to be even more cautious than he is, leaving him no chance to strike. That way, he’ll become impatient, and impatience will lead to mistakes.”

Huang Xuanxuan couldn’t help but sigh: “I understand, Boss. This is why you want to provide close protection for Luo Tengfeng, right? But to be honest, we are in the open, and the other party is in the dark. We have to protect Luo Tengfeng 24 hours a day, and our spirits are extremely tense. X can completely wait for us to tire out and take action when we are relaxed and tired…”

“According to your thinking, aren’t we doomed to fail? Then let X kill Luo Tengfeng.”

Huang Xuanxuan blushed and lowered her head a little embarrassedly: “I’m sorry, I just…”

“Don’t worry.” Lu Tianfeng patted Huang Xuanxuan’s shoulder, “Don’t forget we still have a secret weapon.”

Huang Xuanxuan’s face turned even redder, and she nodded repeatedly. At this moment, Lu Tianfeng’s phone on the table rang with a message. He picked it up and took a look, his brows knitted together.

It was a message from Chen Nuolan: “I’m going home for dinner tonight, you should come back early too!”

Lu Tianfeng’s fingers remained motionless above the screen, his eyes fixed on the empty input box. After a long time, he put down the phone.

“Not replying?” Huang Xuanxuan guessed from Lu Tianfeng’s behavior that this should be a message that required a reply.

“You are quite sharp-eyed, little girl!” Lu Tianfeng cleverly avoided the question.

“Haha, Boss, you’re not much older than me.”

After Huang Xuanxuan’s hearty laughter, the atmosphere suddenly became quiet again, so Huang Xuanxuan tactfully took the opportunity to walk away. Lu Tianfeng finally picked up his phone again silently, shaking his head while typing slowly.

“Sorry, I have an urgent work assignment.”

Then he paused again, thought for a long time, and then added the second half of the sentence.

“Maybe we won’t be able to meet for a while.”

After hesitating for about a minute, he clicked the send button.

Chen Nuolan, who had been so distant, seemed to have walked back in again, and this time, it was Lu Tianfeng who took the initiative to push her away.

“Boss…” Huang Xuanxuan came in again with two cans of coffee and handed one to Lu Tianfeng.

“By the way, where is Yongsheng? Call him over, let’s analyze the case together and prepare for the next step of the assignment.” Lu Tianfeng took the coffee and said with a smile.

“Okay, I’ll go find him.” Huang Xuanxuan turned around and left lightly.

The phone rang again. Lu Tianfeng glanced at it and thought that her reply was quite quick this time.

Chen Nuolan’s message consisted of only one word: “Oh”, without even any punctuation.

He collected his thoughts, pushed his phone aside, opened the file on the table and began to read it carefully.

CONTENT END 5

chapters.title: Chapter 6
chapters.content:
What Lu Tianfeng had not expected was that this informal internal discussion had two other unexpected participants. One of them was Cheng Tuo. As the team leader, he seldom interfered with the work led by Lu Tianfeng. His active participation this time was enough to show that he attached great importance to this case. The other was Tong Yao, a young female criminal police officer from Team One who came under the guise of “support”. She had just been working for three years and studied under Wu Guoqing. She showed extraordinary talent in information collection and processing. Coupled with her good looks, it was natural that she became a hot new star in the bureau.

“How could Old Wu be willing to let you come to support us?” Before the meeting, Lu Tianfeng joked with Tong Yao.

Tong Yao just smiled weakly. The high-intensity work in recent days made this young and beautiful girl look a little out of shape with panda eyes.

“Come and learn from Team Lu.”

“Okay, let’s get down to business.” Lu Tianfeng waved his hand and gestured to Tong Yao, “Tong Yao, the team has been following this case for so long, so you should brief us on the current situation.”

Tong Yao nodded and stood up. When she talked about work, she immediately became much more energetic.

“The target we want to protect this time is Luo Tengfeng, the CEO of Feng Teng Gene.” Tong Yao said as she pasted Luo Tengfeng’s photo in the center of the whiteboard.

Young and promising, suave, and a business genius, these were the labels attached to Luo Tengfeng, making him the topic of conversation among the citizens of D City in recent years.

Seven years ago, Luo Tengfeng, a recent undergrad graduate, announced he had developed a novel genetic technology called “RAN,” which could target specific chronic diseases through gene repair. Upon hearing the news, industry experts and scholars generally expressed skepticism and wait-and-see attitudes. Because breakthroughs in cutting-edge biomedical technologies were so difficult to achieve, it was truly incredible for an undergraduate to claim such a game-changing breakthrough.

Over the next few years, Luo Tengfeng and his Feng Teng Gene ventured forward amidst widespread skepticism. Despite numerous trials and tribulations, the company ultimately announced the development of a gene therapy, “RAN-1,” capable of treating over 90% of diabetes patients. The therapy passed rigorous review by relevant authorities and entered clinical trials. This dispelled many doubts about Luo Tengfeng and propelled him into the spotlight.

Last year, two news stories about Luo Tengfeng grabbed headlines. First, Feng Teng Gene announced initial success in developing “RAN-2,” a targeted treatment for cardiovascular disease, with plans to enter clinical trials within three years. Second, the handsome and wealthy Luo Tengfeng announced his marriage to his girlfriend, Fan Minen, whom he had known for less than six months. Fan Minen came from a prominent background: her father was Fan Yingxiong, a veteran investor who was once recognized as one of China’s top ten angel investors. Following the announcement, Fan Yingxiong’s fund invested in Feng Teng Gene, further fueling the already gossipy marriage.

Tong Yao posted Fan Minen’s photo below Luo Tengfeng’s photo. This young woman had a standard oval face, a pair of big watery eyes and fair skin, which were in line with the current mainstream aesthetic.

“If Luo Tengfeng encounters any misfortune, most of his assets, including his shares in Feng Teng Gene worth hundreds of millions, will belong to Fan Minen.”

“That’s not quite right.” Cheng Tuo shook his head gently. “The main value of Feng Teng Gene lies in Luo Tengfeng and his RAN technology. If Luo Tengfeng dies, won’t these shares become a pile of waste paper?”

“In the long run, that’s true.” Tong Yao’s tone remained confident and resolute. “But even if Luo Tengfeng passes away, the two special treatments currently available at Feng Teng Gene alone are enough to make the company profitable for twenty years. Driven by such huge profits, it’s impossible to rule out Fan Minen’s motive for murder. In addition—”

Tong Yao slightly prolonged her voice, and with a deft movement of her delicate hand, another photo of a man appeared on the whiteboard.

“This man’s name is Zheng Yuanzhi. He was Fan Minen’s college classmate. They were in a relationship during their studies, but broke up before graduation. The reason for their breakup was very simple. To put it bluntly, Zheng Yuanzhi’s family background was too ordinary, and he wasn’t worthy of being Fan’s son-in-law.”

“Is he related to the case?” Huang Xuanxuan asked curiously.

“It’s hard to say, but what’s interesting is that Feng Teng Gene’s foreign currency account is currently opened at the foreign bank D-Bank, and Zheng Yuanzhi happens to be the account manager in charge of the Feng Teng Gene project at D-Bank.”

Yu Yongsheng patted his thigh and said, “It seems that these two people are worth investigating carefully.”

“Don’t get excited. I believe our colleagues in Team One can complete the investigation well, right?” Lu Tianfeng said to Tong Yao with a smile, looking at the relationship chart on the whiteboard with interest. This sentence subtly reminded Yu Yongsheng that their current focus was not investigating interpersonal relationships, but protecting Luo Tengfeng.

“Never miss any clues.” Tong Yao nodded vigorously, and then continued to post photos on the whiteboard. This time, the ones posted were the victims of the previous two cases.

“Luo Tengfeng, Zhang Hanlin, and Gao Junjie held more than half of Feng Teng Gene’s shares, but now two of them are dead. Zhang Hanlin’s shares will be inherited by his son Zhang Wenzhe.”

In the photo, Zhang Wenzhe had messy gray hair and a very thick copper chain around his neck, looking like someone who was not to be messed with.

Yu Yongsheng said in confusion, “This guy doesn’t look like a serious person at all!”

“Zhang Wenzhe’s relationship with his father was always strained. He disliked studying and didn’t go to university. He spent his evenings playing in underground bands and illegal car racing, and had a rebellious streak. After his father’s death, he suddenly became a billionaire, then transformed himself, donned a suit, and took a nominal position at Feng Teng Gene.”

Lu Tianfeng and Cheng Tuo exchanged glances, seeing a tacit understanding in each other’s eyes. If Zhang Wenzhe had killed his father to inherit the property, the case would have been solved long ago, and it would have been impossible for it to turn into a serial murder case.

Tong Yao paused briefly, and seeing no one had any questions, she continued, “The shares of Feng Teng Gene’s former chief scientist, Gao Junjie, were inherited by his adopted daughter, Gao Miaomiao. It’s worth noting that Gao Miaomiao was legally adopted by Gao Junjie eighteen years ago, and there’s no blood relationship between father and daughter.”

Lu Tianfeng looked at the slightly immature face of the girl in the photo without saying a word.

“After Gao Junjie’s death, Gao Miaomiao, who was studying for a master’s degree in another city, decisively chose to drop out and join Feng Teng Gene, becoming an ordinary researcher.”

“She is probably the richest ‘ordinary employee’ in the history of Feng Teng Gene.” Yu Yongsheng said with envy.

Lu Tianfeng drew a triangle on the whiteboard: “Luo Tengfeng, Zhang Wenzhe, and Gao Miaomiao, the city’s most dazzling high-tech company, Feng Teng Gene, was actually led by these three young people under the age of thirty.”

“Let’s think about it from another perspective. Why did X repeatedly target Feng Teng Gene’s shareholders? If Feng Teng Gene collapses, who will be the biggest beneficiary?” Cheng Tuo asked Tong Yao, holding his chin.

“Feng Teng Gene is a cash cow, but if it collapses, there’s actually no obvious direct beneficiary. While traditional pharmaceutical companies will gain better market opportunities, this train of thought is too convoluted.”

“Every murder has a motive, not to mention there are three of them here – two that have been completed and one that is being planned.” Cheng Tuo stared at the relationships between the characters on the whiteboard and fell into deep thought.

“But we still can’t figure out X’s motives, especially the extremely irrational behavior of forewarning the murder, which makes it much more difficult to commit the murder. But X insists on doing it… Tong Yao, do you have anything else to say?” Lu Tianfeng noticed that Tong Yao was still holding a photo in her hand, but she didn’t show it, and her expression was a little conflicted.

“Well, the investigation results show that Luo Tengfeng has recently had a close relationship with a young female subordinate. Rumors of an affair between the two of them have been circulating within the company, but it seems that they are all rumors and there is no solid evidence.” Tong Yao’s usually confident and coherent tone rarely wavered.

Lu Tianfeng’s heart skipped a beat, and he immediately guessed who the person in the photo was. It seemed Team One had sent Tong Yao to participate in the security work, both as a legitimate support and as a hidden tactic.

“Chen Nuolan, a research and development engineer at Feng Teng Gene, a talented beauty who earned a Ph.D. in biology from an American university at the age of 23…her other identity is Captain Lu’s girlfriend.”

Cheng Tuo looked normal, but Yu Yongsheng had already widened his eyes with a look of shock. Huang Xuanxuan’s face turned red and white, and her lips moved slightly. She wanted to say something but couldn’t.

Lu Tianfeng forced a smile and said, “Thank you, Captain Liang, for your trust in me and for not asking me to withdraw from the case.”

Tong Yao’s eyes flickered a little: “Captain Liang said that you are a good and reliable police officer.”

“Haha, I think he really can’t solve the case, so let’s try it out, right?” After saying that, Lu Tianfeng’s face darkened and he said seriously, “Don’t worry, even if Luo Tengfeng wants to steal my girlfriend, I will first find X and then settle the score with Luo Tengfeng. What’s more -“

Lu Tianfeng said confidently: “I believe no one can take Nuolan away from me.”

“Boss, I support you!” Yu Yongsheng was the first to stand up and express his opinion.

Cheng Tuo just smiled faintly. There was no need for much verbal communication between him and Lu Tianfeng. Both Huang Xuanxuan and Tong Yao lowered their heads and looked away. It was unknown what they were thinking.

CONTENT END 6

chapters.title: Chapter 7
chapters.content:
It was drizzling and a police car was speeding on the road.

“Ah’feng, there are some things I can only tell you in private.” Cheng Tuo held the steering wheel with both hands, staring straight ahead.

“Go ahead.”

“This case is truly bizarre. I feel like the murderer possesses the ability to predict the future! And faced with such a complex case, you didn’t choose to avoid suspicion, but instead gambled your own future…”

“Boss, I know what you want to ask.”

The two fell silent at the same time. The only sounds in the car were the faint roar of the engine and the sound of cars whizzing past outside the window.

After a long while, Lu Tianfeng spoke again: “Again, please trust me.”

Cheng Tuo seemed to smile, but it was so shallow that it was indiscernible.

“I trust you.” These words were spoken with great emphasis and force.

Outside the car window, the raindrops became denser and denser, almost covering the entire city in rain.

CONTENT END 7

chapters.title: Chapter 8
chapters.content:
April 15th was the fifth day that the police were carrying out the protection mission for Luo Tengfeng.

Over the past few days, Lu Tianfeng and Yu Yongsheng had been on duty for half a day each, providing close protection for Luo Tengfeng as “bodyguards”, while Huang Xuanxuan and Tong Yao were stationed in the European-style villa where Luo Tengfeng lived. On the one hand, they served as backup forces to provide support at any time, and on the other hand, they could also monitor one of the suspects – Luo Tengfeng’s wife Fan Minen.

However, today’s work schedule was a little different. Yesterday, Yu Yongsheng and Luo Tengfeng went on a business trip out of town, and they didn’t return to D City until midnight. Although Lu Tianfeng didn’t get much sleep the previous night, he was still on duty all day today.

At six in the morning, Lu Tianfeng was already wearing sportswear, waiting at the entrance of the villa. Just one minute after six, Luo Tengfeng, also wearing a full set of sports gear, appeared.

“Good morning, Brother Lu. Sorry to bother you today,” Luo Tengfeng said with a polite smile. He was always so polite when dealing with the police, yet he felt strangely distant. Lu Tianfeng had asked him to address him as “Brother Lu,” hoping to conceal his police identity as much as possible to avoid unnecessary trouble.

“It’s nothing. This is just our job.” Lu Tianfeng replied calmly. He had no good feelings towards the man who was rumored to be having an affair with his girlfriend, but he also maintained due courtesy.

Luo Tengfeng’s smile grew even wider: “Waking up early in the morning to accompany me for a morning run, this should be considered extra work, right?”

“It’s good to exercise a little.” Lu Tianfeng forced a smile. He knew very well that there was only a slim possibility of Luo Tengfeng being attacked while he was doing morning exercises in this most upscale villa area in the city, which was full of surveillance cameras. But he still didn’t dare to take it lightly.

After leaving, the two of them said nothing more. Luo Tengfeng adjusted the fitness tracker on his wrist, put on his sports headphones, did a simple warm-up, and then started running. This young wealthy man had an unusual obsession with exercise. No matter how busy he was at work, even if he only slept two or three hours the night before, he would still get up at six in the morning to run, rain or shine. Only when the weather was extremely bad would he jog on the treadmill in the gym instead.

Lu Tianfeng wasn’t so particular, traveling light. He kept a distance of about fifty meters between him and Luo Tengfeng, following him at a leisurely pace. This distance was enough for him to be ready for any possible emergency, while also allowing him to observe the surrounding situation.

After running for about ten minutes, Luo Tengfeng began to gradually speed up, glancing back from time to time. When he realized that Lu Tianfeng was still able to maintain the distance between them, he increased his speed a little more. And so, the two ran faster and faster, a tacit competition of speed and endurance, but the gap between them never widened. In the end, it was Luo Tengfeng who took the initiative to slow down, running slower and slower, and finally stopped at the side of the road, signaling Lu Tianfeng to “pause.”

“Brother Lu, you’re amazing!” Luo Tengfeng gave a thumbs up, “I can’t even outrun you.”

Lu Tianfeng seemed to be in a good mood after the exercise and praised: “We make a living from this. It’s not easy for Mr. Luo to maintain such a good physical condition despite his busy schedule.”

“It’s nothing. Compared to professionals, I’m nothing.” Luo Tengfeng wiped the sweat from his forehead. “You haven’t tried your best yet, have you?”

“You too.” Lu Tianfeng said.

Luo Tengfeng seemed stunned and didn’t react for a moment.

Lu Tianfeng added, “You didn’t look too tired after running, and your tone of voice was quite calm, which proves that you still have some energy left.”

“Haha, awesome! You’re worthy of being the captain of the criminal police force.” Luo Tengfeng laughed. “But if I really had to run all the way here, how could I have the energy to go to work?”

“That makes sense.”

Luo Tengfeng looked at his watch and said, “Let’s stop here for today. I have other plans later.”

Lu Tianfeng was a little surprised. Luo Tengfeng’s morning exercise usually lasted about an hour, but today he only ran for half an hour, which was indeed a bit abnormal.

“Go back and take a shower first, ask the driver to prepare the car, and we’ll go to ROOST for breakfast.” On the way back, Luo Tengfeng suddenly said.

“Where are you going?” Lu Tianfeng didn’t hear clearly for a moment.

“A high-end restaurant. I have arranged a breakfast meeting there.” Luo Tengfeng said apologetically, “I haven’t had time to give you the schedule today. Sorry.”

According to the process agreed upon by both parties, Luo Tengfeng would hand over the next day’s schedule to Lu Tianfeng one day in advance so that the police could arrange their work. However, since his schedule often changed, the final confirmation would basically not be made until early in the morning of the same day.

“How many people are attending the breakfast party? Do we need to increase security?” Lu Tianfeng asked while taking out his mobile phone to check the location of ROOST restaurant.

“Don’t worry, it’s just a private meeting. We don’t need any extra manpower.” Luo Tengfeng paused for a moment before continuing, “In fact, I chose this place precisely because I wanted to keep a low profile.”

“Oh, it involves commercial secrets?”

“That’s about right.” Luo Tengfeng smiled bitterly, “You’ll know in a moment.”

Lu Tianfeng nodded: “Then I would like to trouble Mr. Luo to give me today’s schedule as soon as possible, and I will arrange for my colleagues to handle it properly.”

“Okay, I’ll give it to you later. Today’s itinerary is all within the city, so it should be relatively easy.”

Lu Tianfeng did not answer. He believed that the word “easy” should never appear in the daily work of criminal police, but he also did not want to bring too much psychological pressure to Luo Tengfeng.

Before he knew it, the sky had become completely bright, and the blue sky was refreshing.

A new day ha begun.

CONTENT END 8

chapters.title: Chapter 9
chapters.content:
At 7:30 in the morning, a black Mercedes-Benz stopped in front of the ROOST Western Restaurant.

Lu Tianfeng, dressed in a casual suit, got out of the car first. After quickly confirming that the surroundings were safe, he opened the back door and motioned Luo Tengfeng to get out.

The two walked towards the restaurant door together. The waitress who had been waiting by the door quickly bowed and greeted them, and opened the glass door for them.

When passing through the gate, Lu Tianfeng noticed that the normal business hours of this restaurant start at 11 o’clock in the morning. However, looking at the situation in front of him, there was no doubt that Luo Tengfeng had arranged everything in advance and asked the restaurant to provide special breakfast.

As expected, there were no other customers in the huge restaurant. The waitress took the two to a booth by the window. Luo Tengfeng pointed to a table not far away and said to her, “This gentleman is my bodyguard. Let him sit over there.”

“Understood.”

“Three breakfasts, just as usual.”

“Okay, is there anything else you need?” the waitress asked in a respectful tone.

“Not at the moment, thank you.”

Just as Lu Tianfeng walked to the table and was about to sit down, he heard the sound of high heels behind him.

If the person coming was just a stranger, Lu Tianfeng should have turned around to observe the other person the moment he heard the sound to determine whether the situation was safe. But he did not turn back because the footsteps gave him a very familiar feeling.

When you know someone well enough, you can accurately tell the sound of their footsteps, even if you don’t know how you know it.

Lu Tianfeng slowly turned around and saw his girlfriend, Chen Nuolan.

Chen Nuolan was wearing a sky blue dress suit today. She walked closer and closer, first nodded to Lu Tianfeng as a greeting, and then walked to Luo Tengfeng’s table.

“Mr. Luo, good morning.”

“Good morning, that person over there is my newly hired bodyguard, Brother Lu.” Luo Tengfeng pointed at Lu Tianfeng and introduced him briefly.

“Oh.” Chen Nuolan sat down calmly without asking a single question.

Lu Tianfeng was filled with mixed emotions at the moment. Speaking of the matter, he was very satisfied with Chen Nuolan’s ability to cope with situations on the spot, because on the first day when the two confirmed their relationship, Lu Tianfeng repeatedly emphasized to her that as the girlfriend of a criminal police officer, she needed to always remember one thing: no matter where they met, they must pretend not to know each other.

“Because at that time, my undercover identity could be a policeman, a hawker, a beggar, or even a gangster or a wanted criminal… But no matter what, don’t say hello to me or behave in any unusual way. Just treat me as a stranger, okay?”

“Of course, no problem!” Chen Nuolan agreed readily, then blinked her big eyes and asked timidly, “So, even if I see you holding hands intimately with another girl on the street one day, I can’t rush up to you and get angry, right?”

“That’s right, isn’t it a scene from movies where the police pretend to be a couple while on duty?”

“Well, I don’t know why, but I’d always feel a little bothered.” Chen Nuolan said softly.

“You don’t mind me pretending to be a wanted criminal, but you mind me pretending to be someone else’s boyfriend?” Lu Tianfeng poked her nose with both anger and amusement.

“Hmph, don’t laugh at me.” Chen Nuolan’s cheeks flushed. “I hope you will always be my boyfriend, whether it’s real or fake…”

Lu Tianfeng felt warmth in his heart, hugged Chen Nuolan tightly, and kissed her forehead gently.

“But one day, I will no longer be your boyfriend…”

The girl in his arms trembled slightly, and Lu Tianfeng quickly finished the second half of the sentence.

“Because then I will always be your husband!”

“Hey, aren’t you taking it too far?” Chen Nuolan said coquettishly.

“Sir, here’s your breakfast.” A plate of Western breakfast was placed in front of Lu Tianfeng, and he realized that he had been distracted.

“Oh, thank you.”

“What kind of coffee would you like?”

“Coffee? Anything…Americano…”

“Okay, please wait.” The waitress left, and Lu Tianfeng turned his attention to Luo Tengfeng and Chen Nuolan who were talking not far away.

Both of them were deliberately speaking in low voices, so even though the restaurant was very quiet, Lu Tianfeng could only hear a few words.

“…I don’t think so…” Chen Nuolan said while shaking her head.

“…Isn’t that right?”

“Or… it will take some time…”

“…Believe in yourself, you can definitely do it…” Luo Tengfeng seemed to be repeatedly emphasizing something to Chen Nuolan, encouraging her to make up her mind.

Chen Nuolan lowered her head and quickly glanced at where Lu Tianfeng was. Lu Tianfeng quickly shifted his gaze back to the plate in front of him, avoiding eye contact between the two.

Next, Chen Nuolan spoke in a lower voice, and Lu Tianfeng could no longer hear what she said. He had no choice but to take out the itinerary that Luo Tengfeng gave him and study it carefully.

However, the itinerary made Lu Tianfeng frown. What Luo Tengfeng considered a “relaxed” schedule actually contained two very challenging elements. First, this afternoon, Luo Tengfeng would be giving a public lecture at D City University in an auditorium that could seat over 400 people. Afterward, there was a campus tour. University campuses were open to the public, with minimal security measures. This presented X with a golden opportunity to take action.

Another complication was that Luo Tengfeng had to attend a wedding banquet tonight. The daughter of D City celebrity Bai Zhuoqiang was getting married, and the Bai family had booked the entire banquet hall of the city’s most luxurious five-star hotel, the Tianfeng Xinghua, for a banquet of 288 tables. Just hearing the grandeur and extravagance of the event made it easy to imagine a sea of ​​people.

“Mr. Luo, you really don’t worry about us!” Lu Tianfeng muttered in his heart. He took out his mobile phone helplessly and contacted Huang Xuanxuan.

“Good morning, Boss!”

After Lu Tianfeng briefly explained the itinerary, he gave the order, “I’ll send you a copy of the itinerary. You’ll be responsible for scouting D City University. Be sure to pay special attention to security loopholes.”

“Clear!”

“Also, please ask Tong Yao to contact the Tianfeng Xinghua Hotel and get the detailed guest list for tonight’s Bai family wedding banquet as soon as possible. Oh, and also the list of relevant staff members. I hope Tong Yao can do a basic data check on everyone on the list.”

“Got it. Do you need to send someone to the hotel?”

“Well, let’s let Yongsheng go later. I guess he’ll be exhausted today.”

“No problem, boss. How is the situation over there?” Huang Xuanxuan asked with concern.

Lu Tianfeng turned his head to look at his girlfriend who was having a secret conversation with Luo Tengfeng, and a bitter taste formed in his throat. He really didn’t expect that Chen Nuolan could interpret the role of “stranger” to this extent.

“Everything is normal, please stay alert and keep in touch.”

“OK, contact me anytime.”

The call was hung up, but Lu Tianfeng still held the phone to his ear, listening blankly to the beeping tone of the disconnection prompt in the microphone.

“Sir, here’s your coffee. Please be careful, it’s hot.” The waitress who brought the coffee looked at him curiously.

Lu Tianfeng put down his phone and took the coffee cup: “Thank you.”

At this time, Chen Nuolan’s laughter came to his ears, crisp and pleasant. He didn’t know what Luo Tengfeng said to make her so happy.

Lu Tianfeng deliberately ignored them and picked up the itinerary on the table again.

According to the original plan, after this “breakfast meeting,” Luo Tengfeng would return to Feng Teng Gene to hold a meeting with several shareholders. Thinking carefully, Luo Tengfeng’s special appointment with Chen Nuolan before the company’s shareholders’ meeting was truly meaningful!

Lu Tianfeng tried hard to recall his recent conversations with Chen Nuolan, hoping to find some connection between her and Luo Tengfeng, but all he could recall were her complaints and exhaustion.

“It’s been very busy and stressful lately.”

“I don’t want to explain those groundless things.”

“I’m very tired and don’t want to discuss work anymore. Just leave me alone.”

Fragments of memory kept flashing through Lu Tianfeng’s mind. Only then did he realize with horror that the two of them had drifted further and further apart. He had no idea what Chen Nuolan had been busy with recently, let alone what she was thinking. If this continued, this relationship would be over.

Maybe it was over already, otherwise how could she ignore him so naturally…

“Don’t let your imagination run wild!” Lu Tianfeng inwardly cursed himself.

He took a big sip of coffee to try to concentrate again. Being distracted was a big taboo when performing a mission. He was no longer a novice, so how could he make such a low-level mistake?

Lu Tianfeng took a deep breath, then picked up his knife and fork and focused on the breakfast in front of him: sausage, bacon, ham, scrambled eggs, bread…

He found that eating wholeheartedly seemed to really help relieve his worries.

CONTENT END 9

chapters.title: Chapter 10
chapters.content:
The journey from ROOST Restaurant back to Feng Teng Gene was one of the most embarrassing experiences in Lu Tianfeng’s life. He sat silently in the passenger seat as a bodyguard, listening to Luo Tengfeng and Chen Nuolan’s small talk in the back seat. The two chatted about recent hit TV series and the latest discoveries by Nordic archaeologists. The discussion was so heated that even Luo Tengfeng’s driver, Uncle Yang, joined in, complaining about the dismal acting of the new generation of actors. Lu Tianfeng, standing by, was unable to get a word in.

Twenty minutes later, the car arrived at the basement of Feng Teng Gene’s company. Lu Tianfeng was secretly rejoicing that this ordeal was finally over, but Luo Tengfeng brought another “bad news”.

“Brother Lu, you can just rest in the next room while I’m in a meeting.”

“No problem.” Lu Tianfeng nodded. He had attended several internal meetings with Luo Tengfeng in the past few days, and each time they would stay in the lounge separated by a wall to wait.

“Nuolan, I need your participation in the second half of this meeting. Please stay over there and wait for me.”

A hint of reluctance flashed across Chen Nuolan’s face, but she still responded obediently: “Okay, Mr. Luo.”

Chen Nuolan was able to joke with Luo Tengfeng easily in the car just now, but once she returned to the public place, she had the tact to restore her respect.

Lu Tianfeng and Chen Nuolan exchanged glances and pretended nothing had happened as they followed Luo Tengfeng into the building.

Feng Teng Gene’s office building was undoubtedly worthy of the title of a star enterprise in the city. Completed less than a year ago, this brand-new building, designed by a renowned French architect, boasted a striking exterior that, at first glance, seemed a bit baffling. A closer look revealed that the entire building formed a giant DNA spiral. The interior, primarily decorated in blue and white, exuded a futuristic and technological feel that was truly breathtaking.

With about ten minutes left before the meeting, Luo Tengfeng said he would go back to the office to take care of some chores, and sent Lu Tianfeng and Chen Nuolan to wait in the lounge. Thus, by some strange coincidence, the couple finally had their first chance to be alone in nearly two weeks.

The atmosphere in the small room was suffocatingly silent, and finally Lu Tianfeng took the initiative to speak.

“Nuolan…”

These two simple syllables frightened Chen Nuolan. She looked at Lu Tianfeng in panic and silently mouthed: “Can I speak?”

Lu Tianfeng smiled. He didn’t expect Chen Nuolan to be more vigilant than himself, so he lowered his voice and said, “It’s okay in this room. Just be careful.”

“Why are you here?” Chen Nuolan’s eyes suddenly turned red, not knowing whether it was out of worry or fear.

“It’s work-related… I can’t say too much about the specific details.” Looking at Chen Nuolan’s pitiful appearance, Lu Tianfeng almost couldn’t help but want to go forward and hug her, but he knew that doing so was too risky, so he had to silently suppress the thought.

Chen Nuolan wiped the corners of her eyes and her mood gradually calmed down.

“Are you here regarding our company’s two recent cases?” She paused, then added, “The police investigation shouldn’t require you to pretend to be Mr. Luo’s bodyguard, right? Is there any new information?”

Lu Tianfeng really didn’t expect Chen Nuolan to be able to draw inferences from one instance and think of so many things at once, but due to his status, he could only shake his head, evading the questions and said, “Don’t worry, it’ll be fine.”

“Ah, you’re making me even more worried.” Chen Nuolan sighed softly, “If the situation wasn’t serious, you wouldn’t have to be so secretive and keep your mouth shut, right?”

Lu Tianfeng smiled bitterly and said, “Nuolan, sometimes being too smart is not necessarily a good thing!”

“I know…” Chen Nuolan let out a long sigh and sat down on the sofa dejectedly. “Luo Tengfeng probably saw this in me, too, right?”

“What did you guys just talk about?”

Chen Nuolan looked at Lu Tianfeng steadily, as if she was struggling with whether or not to tell her boyfriend everything.

“Is it inconvenient to say?” he asked.

“It’s a business secret.” Chen Nuolan smiled, jumped up from the sofa, took two steps towards Lu Tianfeng, and whispered in his ear, “Actually, Luo Tengfeng wants to promote me to management and take over Gao Junjie’s work.”

Lu Tianfeng frowned when he heard this: “You will be the chief scientist of Feng Teng Gene?”

Although he knew nothing about biomedicine, he knew that it was a cutting-edge discipline. For a highly anticipated industry leader like Feng Teng Gene, the chief scientist must have sufficient connections and strong influence in the industry to be able to control the situation.

To be fair, although Chen Nuolan was smart and talented, she had little experience and it would be difficult for her to convince others to take over Gao Junjie’s position.
