“I definitely wouldn’t dare take this position; it would arouse too much jealousy. However, Luo Tengfeng suggested to me that he could keep the position of Chief Scientist vacant for a long time, and I would just hold a deputy position, and still be able to control the power.”

Lu Tianfeng’s furrowed brows remained unfurled. “I don’t understand why Luo Tengfeng insisted on promoting you to the top.”

“Luo Tengfeng has read my thesis and thinks I can help him elevate RAN technology to a new level.” Chen Nuolan took a step back, putting some distance between them. “I don’t know if his judgment is correct, but I’m well aware that the relationships within the company are very delicate and complex these days. This promotion is likely to trigger a chain reaction.”

Lu Tianfeng remained silent – Luo Tengfeng’s move to promote Chen Nuolan against all odds inevitably reminded him of the recent romantic scandal. Even the police’s internal files listed Chen Nuolan as Luo Tengfeng’s “scandal cohort”. Could he still trust her completely?

“Can you refuse him?”

“Why would I reject him?” Chen Nuolan asked in surprise, “Do you know what my dream has always been?”

“I know.” Lu Tianfeng turned his face away, not wanting to meet Chen Nuolan’s gaze.

Chen Nuolan lowered her voice and spoke quickly, “Luo Tengfeng has been increasingly respectful to me recently. Under the influence of the two recent cases, the company urgently needs to introduce the next round of financing to maintain its rapid development momentum, but…”

At this moment, footsteps suddenly sounded outside the door. Chen Nuolan quickly closed her mouth and turned her head to the other side.

The door opened, and it was Luo Tengfeng’s secretary Tina.

“Chen Nuolan, Mr. Luo asked you to come over.”

“Okay, I’ll be there right away.” Before she left, she looked at Lu Tianfeng again, with indescribable complex emotions in her eyes.

The corner of Lu Tianfeng’s mouth twitched, but he said nothing, because as a bodyguard, he shouldn’t speak.

The door closed again, and the small lounge was so quiet that it made him feel suffocated.

Lu Tianfeng walked to the floor-to-ceiling glass window and stared at the scenery outside in a daze. However, not long after, he suddenly heard the sound of something breaking in the conference room next door. Although the sound was not loud, he still opened the door and rushed over.

“What’s going on?”

In the conference room, everyone sat in their seats, looking as if nothing had happened, which made Lu Tianfeng seem a little surprised.

“It’s okay, someone just accidentally broke a cup.” Luo Tengfeng responded lightly.

Lu Tianfeng quickly took a look at the situation in the conference room. Luo Tengfeng had the calmest expression, while Zhang Wenzhe, who was sitting next to him, had a red face and a pile of cup fragments at his feet; on the other side of the table, Gao Miaomiao lowered her head, looking at the documents in her hand, but was actually a little absent-minded; Chen Nuolan put on a stiff professional smile, and it seemed that this conflict was related to her.

“If everything is fine, I’ll go out first.” Lu Tianfeng certainly knew that the carpet in this conference room was so thick that if the cup fell to the ground naturally, it would definitely not break.

“Thank you for your hard work. Let’s continue the meeting.” Luo Tengfeng’s tone remained unchanged.

Lu Tianfeng sighed secretly and returned to the lounge in disappointment. It seemed that the internal power struggle that had swept Feng Teng Gene had just begun. He only prayed that Chen Nuolan could escape the storm unscathed.

The his phone vibrated. Lu Tianfeng took it out and saw that it was a call from Huang Xuanxuan.

“Xuanxuan, what’s the situation?”

“Boss, Tong Yao has obtained the guest list for tonight’s Bai family wedding banquet and is investigating anyone who has had contact with Luo Tengfeng. Yongsheng just rushed to the hotel and is investigating the situation on the scene.”

“Very good, thank you for your hard work.”

“Oh, there’s another thing…” Huang Xuanxuan hesitated, wanting to say something but stopping herself. “Just now, I was bored and looked up the news about Luo Tengfeng’s lecture at D City University this afternoon. I saw some strange comments in the news comment section, so I followed up and found a non-governmental organization called ‘Nifeng Club’.”

“Nifeng Club?” Lu Tianfeng was a little surprised.

“It means opposing Feng Teng Gene. Members of this organization believe that the RAN therapy being researched by Feng Teng Gene violates the laws of nature and will cause endless harm if promoted. Therefore, they publish various anti-RAN statements online, claiming to be the embodiment of justice.”

Lu Tianfeng couldn’t help but laugh: “Will such petty tactics be effective?”

“Of course it’s useless. The president of the Nifeng Club recently posted an article on the forum, soliciting everyone’s suggestions for killing Luo Tengfeng… but even such a statement didn’t attract any attention.”

“There are too many people like this online. They’re basically just talking nonsense.” Lu Tianfeng understood that since Huang Xuanxuan brought up this matter, she must have something to say, so he encouraged her, “Xuanxuan, do you have any ideas?”

“I don’t know why, but I’m always worried… So I asked Tong Yao to check the login information of the Nifeng Club president. I found out that he accesses the network through the IP segment of D City University.”

“Is he a student of D City University?” Lu Tianfeng looked at the schedule in his hand thoughtfully. The title of Luo Tengfeng’s speech at D City University this afternoon was “RAN Technology – Opening a New Future”, which was obviously contrary to the concept of the Nifeng Club.

“Boss, am I thinking too much?” Huang Xuanxuan asked in an uncertain tone.

“No, your point of view is very valuable.” Lu Tianfeng made a heavy mark on the schedule with a pen. “Xuanxuan, send me the information about this organization later. Also, you should go to D City University this afternoon. Remember to dress like a college student.”

“Got it!” For some reason, Huang Xuanxuan on the other end of the phone seemed very excited, perhaps because the investigation direction she proposed was taken seriously by her superiors.

Lu Tianfeng smiled bitterly and shook his head.

CONTENT END 10

chapters.title: Chapter 11
chapters.content:
2:15 pm, D City University Auditorium

Although there was a drizzle outside the window, fifteen minutes before the lecture started, the auditorium that could accommodate more than 400 people was basically full.

“Boss Luo, you’re quite popular!” Lu Tianfeng sighed, turning his head to look behind him. He and Luo Tengfeng sat side by side in the front row of VIP seats, a short distance away from the other ordinary seats.

“Haha, guess why everyone is so enthusiastic about attending this lecture?”

“Probably because they’re curious about you,” Lu Tianfeng replied nonchalantly. At the same time, he found Huang Xuanxuan, who was sitting at the back of the auditorium, wearing a bright red tracksuit. Her chosen position was perfect for observing the overall situation, and she deserved praise.

“What exactly do they want to pursue?” Lu Tianfeng only then noticed that there was a hint of sarcasm and sneer in Luo Tengfeng’s tone.

“It’s success…”

“What is success? In my eyes, RAN technology is the real success because it has rewritten the history of medical science, but what do these young people behind me think?” Luo Tengfeng also turned around, and many students immediately cheered and screamed, so he smiled and waved to them.

In the eyes of these students, Luo Tengfeng was warm, amiable, and elegant, but only Lu Tianfeng could hear the contempt in his voice: “They are not interested in technology at all. All they want is wealth and status. Whether it’s RAN, NAR, or something else, as long as they can make money, it makes no difference to them.”

Lu Tianfeng shrugged disapprovingly: “Isn’t Mr. Luo’s words a bit too arbitrary?”

Luo Tengfeng smiled mysteriously and said nothing more.

The lecture was about to begin, and now even the aisles were full of people. One could see more people trying to squeeze in at the entrance at the back of the auditorium, but they were stopped by security.

Lu Tianfeng had done his homework in advance and knew that this auditorium had only one official entrance and exit, and Huang Xuanxuan was sitting closest to the entrance and exit; there were also two emergency exits on both sides of the auditorium. Before each event, the security guards would close the emergency exits on both sides, and when the event was about to end, they would open the emergency exits on both sides to allow the crowd to evacuate more quickly.

If X really wanted to attack Luo Tengfeng in the auditorium, then waiting until the event was over and in the chaos would be the best opportunity. Seeing that the number of people present far exceeded his original expectations, Lu Tianfeng couldn’t help but feel worried.

“Boss, the people outside can’t get in anymore, but the door is blocked tightly. Although I have a good observation angle from my current position, there are too many people and I can’t see them all…” Huang Xuanxuan sent a message.

“Don’t worry, just sit there and stay alert.”

The school receptionist came over and with a nod and a bow said to Luo Tengfeng, “Mr. Luo, you can go on stage.”

Luo Tengfeng stood up and walked onto the stage, waving to the audience as he walked. The auditorium erupted in even louder cheers. Lu Tianfeng scanned the crowd with his hawk-like gaze, but found nothing suspicious.

“Dear students, good afternoon…” Luo Tengfeng began his speech, and the audience gradually quieted down. About ten minutes later, the sound of quarreling could be faintly heard outside the door.

“What’s going on?” Lu Tianfeng quickly sent a message to Huang Xuanxuan.

“It seems like someone is making a fuss and insisting on coming in.” Huang Xuanxuan answered quickly.

The noise outside was getting louder and louder, and someone could even be heard shouting through a loudspeaker: “Boycott Feng Teng Gene! Oppose RAN technology!”

Even Luo Tengfeng, who was speaking on the stage, had to stop.

“Boycott Feng Teng Gene! Oppose–” The shouting stopped abruptly, probably because the loudspeaker was snatched away by the security guard.

Luo Tengfeng smiled helplessly and changed the subject: “Look, everyone, what Feng Teng Gene is doing may cause misunderstanding and disgust from some people who don’t know the truth, and may even lead to some extreme behavior. When I personally face similar misunderstandings and doubts, I like to comfort myself with a soul-stirring quote: If everyone in this world can understand you, then how ordinary would you be?”

The whole audience burst into laughter.

“I’d like to take this opportunity to say a few words to those who oppose RAN technology. In fact, I have carefully read most of your online comments, but unfortunately, I find that you can’t even clearly explain what RAN is. I hope you can go back and study the basics before expressing your opinions.”

Luo Tengfeng’s domineering attitude catered to the rebellious character of today’s young people, so some students in the audience stood up and applauded Luo Tengfeng, and the atmosphere on the scene became boiling again.

Lu Tianfeng keenly noticed that the corners of Luo Tengfeng’s mouth inadvertently curled up, which proved that he was feeling very proud at the moment. It seemed that the students’ reaction was completely within his expectations.

What a guy who was good at stirring up emotions.

At this time, Lu Tianfeng received another message from Huang Xuanxuan on his phone: “Boss, pay attention to your right, there is a girl preparing to go on stage to present flowers.”

Lu Tianfeng immediately noticed the girl in ceremonial dress. She was holding a bouquet of flowers in her hand and standing there a little stiffly, as if she wanted to go on stage, but she couldn’t take a step.

“This girl should be fine.” Judging from her formal attire and timid behavior, Lu Tianfeng felt that she should be a “spy” arranged by the school and would not pose a personal threat to Luo Tengfeng.

Sure enough, a few minutes later, the girl finally seized the opportunity when Luo Tengfeng stopped to drink water, trotted over to present flowers, and then ran off the stage with a red face. Luo Tengfeng made a gesture similar to blowing a kiss to the girl’s back, and this little episode pushed the atmosphere of the scene to a climax.

“Boss, Luo Tengfeng is really good at flirting with girls!” Huang Xuanxuan’s message inadvertently hurt Lu Tianfeng. He couldn’t help but think of the image of Chen Nuolan and Luo Tengfeng having breakfast together this morning.

“Never mind the flirting, what’s the entrance situation like now?”

“There’s no movement outside. It seems the people from the Nifeng Club are not a big threat after all.” Huang Xuanxuan added a sad and disappointed expression.

“This expression is wrong. Do you still want them to become a serious threat?” Lu Tianfeng replied.

Huang Xuanxuan sent another emoticon of a puppy sticking out its tongue, and Lu Tianfeng couldn’t help laughing. He found that chatting with Huang Xuanxuan always made his originally depressed mood become a little lighter, and also added a bit of spice to the boring and dangerous arduous task in front of him.

“I’ll take care of things here next. You go to the next location to prepare.” According to the itinerary, Luo Tengfeng would visit the biology department teaching building after the lecture. Lu Tianfeng had inquired in advance and found out that the entire building did not implement any special security measures. Various teaching activities were still going on normally, with people coming and going, and it was difficult to guard against security.

“Understood. I’ll go first then.”

Luo Tengfeng’s speech was coming to an end and the event entered the question-and-answer session. The audience was very enthusiastic and raised their hands in the hope of being the lucky one to be selected.

The first questioner was a bespectacled man. He asked, “With the development of RAN technology, will more and more diseases be cured by RAN? If so, what will traditional pharmaceutical manufacturers do?”

Luo Tengfeng responded in his usual domineering manner, “Of course, I hope that RAN technology can make greater contributions to human health in the future. Feng Teng Gene has been working towards this goal. As for the latter question, you should ask those traditional pharmaceutical manufacturers. Thank you.”

The crowd burst into laughter and applause, and the next questioner was selected on the spot.

“I am a sophomore. If I want to work at Feng Teng Gene after graduation, what is the most important thing?” a girl asked.

“The most important thing? Of course, it’s that Feng Teng Gene doesn’t go bankrupt within two years.” Luo Tengfeng paused at the right moment, giving everyone enough time to chuckle knowingly. “When our company recruits talent, we focus on some key qualities: intelligence, hard work, and dedication. I believe that those who can embody these three qualities are like gold. No matter what company they go to or what position they take, they will definitely shine.”

Smart, hard-working and serious.

Lu Tianfeng felt that these three words were the most appropriate description of Chen Nuolan. Perhaps Luo Tengfeng’s respect for Chen Nuolan was purely out of admiration for her work and had nothing to do with any personal relationship between a man and a woman?

Lu Tianfeng stared intently at Luo Tengfeng on the stage, but his thoughts had already flown to a distant place…

CONTENT END 11

chapters.title: Chapter 12
chapters.content:
A little after three in the afternoon, in the biology department teaching building of D City University.

Although the school repeatedly emphasized that “all teaching activities were proceeding normally,” Luo Tengfeng’s visit still attracted many students. Word spread quickly, and soon the hallway of the teaching building was packed. A female student, holding a poster for today’s lecture, desperately pushed forward, finally squeezing in front of Luo Tengfeng and obtaining his autograph. This action attracted many imitators, and countless papers and pens blocked Luo Tengfeng’s way.

“Mr. Luo, please stop signing autographs.” Lu Tianfeng frowned, looking at the hundreds of students in front of him who wanted autographs. He really didn’t know how long this chaotic scene would last.

“It’s a rare opportunity to return to my alma mater, so I’ll satisfy everyone!” Luo Tengfeng took another piece of paper and pen.

Lu Tianfeng knew that it was inconvenient to say anything more, so he held the Bluetooth headset on his right ear with one hand while answering Huang Xuanxuan’s call.

“Xuanxuan, where are you?”

“I’m upstairs, watching you. Why are these students so crazy…”

“Alas, there’s nothing I can do but observe carefully. Have you noticed anything unusual?”

“Boss… I really can’t see clearly here. It’s too chaotic.”

Lu Tianfeng changed his words: “At this time, most people want to squeeze forward, but is there anyone who behaves differently?”

“Uh… there is indeed a boy in white, in front of you on the right.” Huang Xuanxuan was able to notice something unusual about that man because she was looking down from above. “Did you see that? He stayed at the outermost edge of the crowd and didn’t try to squeeze in.”

Lu Tianfeng immediately knew who Huang Xuanxuan was talking about, because the thin boy in white was indeed a little strange. Most people would either squeeze forward to get an autograph or stay away from the crowd. His ambiguous appearance was really puzzling.

“Pay attention, what is that person holding in his hand?” Lu Tianfeng asked Huang Xuanxuan because the angle was not clear.

“It’s a folder… It’s thick, and there seems to be a lot of things in it.”

“Who would hand a folder to someone else for signature…” Lu Tianfeng instantly became alert, but it was not convenient for him to take the initiative before the other party did anything extreme, after all, this was a university campus.

“Boss, there’s something on his right hand that I can’t see…”

“I can see it, it’s just a pen.” Lu Tianfeng stared at the other person intently. Even if it was just a pen, he couldn’t take it lightly.

As Luo Tengfeng fulfilled the signature requests of students one after another, the crowd gradually dispersed and the boy in white was getting closer and closer even though he didn’t push hard.

Lu Tianfeng could finally see clearly the pattern on the other person’s white T-shirt, which was the emblem of the Nifeng Club.

“Xuanxuan, if that guy escapes, please stop him for me.”

In the blink of an eye, the boy had already handed the folder forward. Although Luo Tengfeng was stunned for a moment, he still instinctively reached out to take it.

“Wait.” Luo Tianfeng stepped forward and snatched the folder first.

The boy obviously hadn’t expected Lu Tianfeng to intervene. He reacted quickly, flicking his wrist and sending the papers scattering all over the floor. Amidst the chaos, a flash of cold light flashed as the boy pulled out a utility knife hidden in the folder and fiercely stabbed Luo Tengfeng.

Lu Tianfeng was secretly surprised. Judging from the angle and strength of the knife, the opponent was actually professionally trained.

However, Lu Tianfeng was more skilled. He barely dodged the blade and then used his elbow to hit the opponent’s forearm. The boy in white groaned and the knife was knocked to the ground.

Lu Tianfeng took a step forward, intending to grab the man’s wrist, but the boy swiftly leaped back and slammed into the crowd. The area was already packed, and this added to the chaos. Fearing a stampede or another mishap after leaving Luo Tengfeng’s side, Lu Tianfeng stopped after only a few meters.

The security guard sent by the school to maintain order at the scene only reacted at this time and rushed forward shouting to intercept the attacker, but the boy had already disappeared into the crowd.

Luo Tengfeng remained calm and composed, but the head of the biology department next to him was pale and his forehead was covered in cold sweat.

“Mr. Luo… Mr. Luo…” The department head was so frightened that he couldn’t even speak clearly.

“Director, don’t worry. I’m fine now, right?” Luo Tengfeng laughed and asked Lu Tianfeng, “Are you just going to let that guy go like that?”

“Mr. Luo, my first priority is to protect you.” Lu Tianfeng said calmly. Even in such an emergency situation, he did not reveal his identity as a policeman, not to mention that Huang Xuanxuan would go to carry out the pursuit mission.

Luo Tengfeng nodded in understanding.

“Mr. Luo… let’s… let’s go to the office and rest for a while… there’s a medical kit there…” the department head stammered. According to the original itinerary, they were supposed to visit the biology lab and attend an open class next. However, with this incident, the department head clearly didn’t want to go out into the crowds.

Seeing that the director looked timid, Luo Tengfeng followed his words and said, “Okay, let’s go to the office and sit for a while.” As he said this, he looked at Lu Tianfeng, who nodded slightly in agreement.

“Report to the boss, the guy has been caught!” Huang Xuanxuan’s excited voice came from Lu Tianfeng’s headphones.

“Take him back first and interrogate him thoroughly.”

“Got it! Then I’ll withdraw first?”

“Well, just leave this to me. I guess the subsequent activities will be affected…” Lu Tianfeng thought that this might not be a bad thing.

The department head wiped his sweat as he led Luo Tengfeng and Lu Tianfeng to the department office. Because the incident had happened so suddenly, the department head made several calls, requesting increased security and staffing. He also urgently adjusted the schedule, canceling the open class and holding a symposium in the office instead. If he wasn’t afraid of neglecting Luo Tengfeng, the department head would have wanted to cancel all activities.

“I’m so sorry, so sorry… Ah, please wait a moment…” The department head hurriedly apologized to Luo Tengfeng, but was interrupted again by a phone call. As the department head went out to answer the phone, a middle-aged man in a white coat walked over with two cups of tea.

“Please have some tea, both of you. This is top-grade Hangzhou chrysanthemum tea, which is refreshing and soothing.” The middle-aged man handed over two cups of tea respectfully.

Luo Tengfeng took the teacup and was about to take a sip when Lu Tianfeng grabbed his arm.

“Wait a moment.”

“What’s going on?” Luo Tengfeng was stunned.

“Who are you?” Lu Tianfeng looked at the man pouring tea with sharp eyes.

“Me?” The man was stunned. “I’m a biology teacher, my last name is Tan…”

“Here’s the tea, drink it.” Lu Tianfeng pushed the cup back without saying anything. Teacher Tan’s face turned red and white, and his hands were shaking slightly.

Luo Tengfeng couldn’t help but ask, “Brother Lu, what’s going on?”

“I suspect there’s poison in the tea.”

“How is it possible…”

“Try taking a sip.” Lu Tianfeng looked at Teacher Tan as usual.

Teacher Tan was unable to catch the cup of tea and it fell to the ground, shattering the snow-white ceramic into pieces.

CONTENT END 12

chapters.title: Chapter 13
chapters.content:
At 5:30 p.m., when Luo Tengfeng left D City University by car, he specifically asked the driver to leave on his own and let Lu Tianfeng drive. The driver was also a smart man. He guessed that the two of them had something to discuss, so he agreed and left.

The rain was getting heavier, and the gloomy sky seemed to hang a little lower than usual.

“Tell me, what happened just now.” Luo Tengfeng leaned back in his seat, closed his eyes and stretched. Only in this kind of occasion would he slightly take off the armor of the domineering president.

“The police received a tip-off that an organization called ‘Nifeng Club’ might be harmful to you, and the leader of this organization is lurking in D City University. Therefore, we have specially increased our vigilance for this afternoon’s trip.” Most of what Lu Tianfeng said was true, but not wanting to divulge everything, he omitted some details.

“Very good, I didn’t expect that at all.” Luo Tengfeng’s tone seemed to carry a hint of dissatisfaction. “How did you know that Teacher Tan was a member of the Nifeng Club?”

“This is a long story. It starts with the lecture you held in the auditorium.” It happened to be rush hour, and the car was stopping and starting, so Lu Tianfeng had enough time to tell the story.

“Do you have any questions about the lecture?” Luo Tengfeng, who had originally closed his eyes to rest, was piqued and opened his eyes naturally.

“The biggest problem during the lecture is that there are no problems.” Lu Tianfeng said something like a tongue twister.

Luo Tengfeng thought for a moment and nodded gently, “I think I understand what you mean. If the Nifeng Club really wanted to cause trouble, it wouldn’t be difficult for them to sneak into the auditorium, but they didn’t do that.”

“Yes, the members of the Nifeng Club could have arrived early and disrupted your presentation, or picked a fight during the Q&A session, embarrassing you in front of everyone. Even if they wanted to unfurl banners, they could have just squatted outside the door in protest. But they actually chose the dumbest option: unfurling banners and protesting outside the lecture after it had already begun. What’s the point of that?”

“Couldn’t they just get the time wrong and be late?”

Lu Tianfeng shook his head. “No, the information about this lecture was made public a week ago, and the date hasn’t been changed since. If the Nifeng Club really wanted to gather outside the venue to protest, they wouldn’t have missed the date. The only reasonable explanation is that they’re deliberately creating an illusion, making us think the Nifeng Club is just a mob of incompetent people.”

“So these guys are quite scheming!” Luo Tengfeng sneered.

“The smooth running of the lecture led us to let our guard down, so during the tour of the teaching building, they implemented the second step of their plan—using the pretense of an autograph session to approach and attack you. However, this step also revealed a flaw, which made me realize they had a trick up their sleeve.”

“Flaw?” Luo Tengfeng tried to recall, but couldn’t figure out what the problem was. “What flaw?”

“There are two points. First, the attacker was wearing a T-shirt with the Nifeng Society logo printed on it, which obviously increased the risk of exposure. Why did he do that? Second, the attacker used a utility knife, and the first blow was like this—”

As Lu Tianfeng spoke, he made a simple gesture with his right hand.

“The angle of his attack was very tricky, and he used the scattered white paper to distract you. It would be difficult for someone without professional training to avoid that blow. But the interesting thing is, that knife doesn’t seem to be fatal. Even if I didn’t block it, you would only get a cut on your arm and bleed a little. It would definitely be fine. You wouldn’t even need to go to the hospital. A simple bandage would be enough.”

“So his purpose was just to warn me?” Luo Tengfeng frowned, thought for a moment, and added, “No, his real purpose is to get me to change my schedule and go to the office…”

“Indeed, I noticed that after the attack, the department head was terrified and panicked. If you were injured, you would most likely be taken to the Biology Department office for bandages. Even if you weren’t injured, given the department head’s timid personality, there’s a good chance he’d change the schedule.”

“So they went through all this trouble just to get me to come to the office?”

“Indeed, this method may seem laborious and clumsy, but it’s actually surprisingly effective. The students who provided cover will only be charged with minor offenses. The most crucial step is for Teacher Tan to personally perform the task, handing you a cup of hot tea spiked with ingredients in a seemingly completely safe location.”

“What’s in that cup of tea?”

“Preliminary identification indicates it’s a toxin extracted from a plant unique to Africa. This toxin is very unique. It won’t cause any adverse reactions when first consumed, but it will cause acute organ failure and death within half an hour. This stuff must have been extracted by Professor Tan himself in the laboratory. Once poisoned, there is no cure…”

Luo Tengfeng, who was always calm, was affected by the response. “I never thought someone would kill anyone in such a way. Does he hate me that much?”

“Hatred is something you can’t understand with common sense.” Lu Tianfeng sighed as the car got stuck. Due to the heavy traffic and everyone’s reluctance to give way, the entire city’s traffic was in a state of paralysis.

After a moment’s silence, Luo Tengfeng asked again, “But I still don’t understand. How did you determine that Teacher Tan poisoned the tea?”

Lu Tianfeng patted the steering wheel and said, “Actually, I just decided to test him out of my police intuition.”

“Don’t keep me in suspense. Just tell me directly.”

“Remember, when he handed us the teacups, he held them directly in his hands, one in each hand, right?”

Luo Tengfeng tried hard to recall: “It seems so. Is there any problem with this?”

“Most people drink tea with freshly boiled water. Of course, some tea connoisseurs will choose slightly cooler water depending on the type of tea, but it will still be a bit hot. So when serving tea to guests, they either hold the cups with both hands, one by one, or hold a tray with several cups of tea on it and let the guests help themselves. Teacher Tan’s practice of handing a cup in each hand to the guest may seem innocuous at first glance, but upon closer inspection, it is actually extremely strange.”

Luo Tengfeng showed a look of sudden enlightenment. “If he brought us tea one cup at a time, there’s no way to guarantee who takes the cup first. And if he uses a tray, it’s even harder to control who picks up which cup. So only by giving us two cups of tea at the same time can he guarantee the poison will be successful.”

“That’s right, that’s what aroused my suspicion. I just tested him a little, and he lost his composure.” Although Lu Tianfeng was talking while driving, he still drove the car steadily, no less than a professional driver.

“Hehe…” Luo Tengfeng laughed inexplicably. Lu Tianfeng glanced at him through the rearview mirror and said nothing.

“You know what I’m laughing at?”

“I don’t know.” Lu Tianfeng said frankly.

“I laugh at Mr. Tan and his members of the Nifeng Club. They were so clever and calculating, but they let their teeth fall in such an insignificant place. If it were me, I would never make such a mistake.”

“Oh?” Lu Tianfeng slammed on the brakes to avoid a van that cut in line.

“As long as he poisons both cups of tea at the same time, there will be no loopholes, right?” Luo Tengfeng said lightly, as if he was not the one who had just escaped death.

“Yes, after all, Teacher Tan is not a vicious person.”

“So he’s not X, right?”

Lu Tianfeng shook his head: “I don’t think he is, because not only did X succeed in the previous two murders, but his methods were also clean and efficient. He seems to be much more capable than Teacher Tan.”

“So you have to continue to protect me.” This is a statement, not a question.

Lu Tianfeng also responded with a statement: “So, Mr. Luo, you have something you want to discuss with me.”

This is a very simple and reasonable inference. If they were just talking about Teacher Tan and the Nifeng Club, Luo Tengfeng would not have bothered to send his driver away, so he must have something more private to discuss with Lu Tianfeng.

“I have a request.”

Lu Tianfeng glanced at the rearview mirror and did not answer immediately.

“Of course, it’s a completely legal request.” Luo Tengfeng perhaps saw the hesitation in Lu Tianfeng’s eyes, and added slowly.

“Tell me first.”

“I want you to investigate my wife, Fan Minen, privately for me.” Luo Tengfeng’s tone remained calm. “I suspect she’s cheating on me.”

A flash of lightning streaked across the distant sky, and seconds later, low, continuous rumbling thunder was heard.

CONTENT END 13

chapters.title: Chapter 14
chapters.content:
6:30 in the evening, Tianfeng Xinghua Hotel.

A small room with a sign outside the door that read “Staff Lounge” had been converted into a temporary police command center. The images on four large-screen monitors in a row on the table were divided into dozens of small windows, displaying real-time monitoring feeds from the hotel’s banquet halls.

The four policemen in the room were also dressed differently. Lu Tianfeng wore a black casual suit with a “VIP” badge on his chest. Yu Yongsheng and Huang Xuanxuan dressed up as hotel waiters, while Tong Yao wore an everyday T-shirt and jeans.

“Boss, you look so handsome!” Yu Yongsheng exclaimed.

“Stop talking nonsense. We don’t have much time. Let’s get straight to the point. Tong Yao, how’s the guest list going?”

Tong Yao picked up a thick stack of lists beside her, which were covered with various marks and symbols.

“I didn’t find any suspicious individuals on the guest list. After all, most of the people here have connections with Bai Zhuoqiang, and those who have connections with Luo Tengfeng are basically just casual business acquaintances. But there’s a big blind spot on this guest list. Many of the guests are labeled with ‘and company’, three people in total.’ This means I can only confirm the information of one of the guests, but I don’t know who the other two are.”

Lu Tianfeng smiled wryly, touched the badge on his chest, and said, “That’s right. Who would have thought that among the ‘Luo Tengfeng and his group of six’ on the list, one of them would be me?”

Huang Xuanxuan asked curiously, “Boss, why did Luo Tengfeng let you sit at the table with him?” With the financial and material resources of the Bai family, they had naturally prepared a separate banquet for the bodyguards and drivers of celebrities from all walks of life. According to common sense, Lu Tianfeng should not have occupied a spot as a wedding guest.

“Rich people always have strange ideas… Don’t dwell on this, just continue reporting on the situation on the scene. Yongsheng, have you investigated the situation of the staff?” Lu Tianfeng knew very well that Luo Tengfeng’s impromptu decision was because he hoped to create more opportunities for him to get close to Fan Minen.

Although he did not directly agree to Luo Tengfeng’s request just earlier, to be honest, he was still quite curious about the truth. Luo Tengfeng seemed to see through his thoughts at a glance and immediately made such arrangements.

“The staff have checked everything. Because tonight’s banquet is so grand, they’ve hired a lot of temporary workers to help out. So far, no suspicious individuals have been found…” Yu Yongsheng scratched the back of his head. “Frankly, ordinary people like us don’t have the qualifications to have conflicts with Luo Tengfeng, right?”

“We must never let our guard down. Xuanxuan, how is the interrogation going at the police station?”

“The student who pulled the knife is called Xu Lang. He said he had no idea Teacher Tan was planning to poison him. I guess the only charge is attempted assault.” Huang Xuanxuan asked, “Teacher Tan Jiaqiang only admitted to poisoning him today and firmly denied being X. Do you think he’s credible?”

“I don’t think Tan Jiaqiang is X, because today’s crime was far too crude compared to X’s previous two murders. We must remain vigilant and must not become complacent.”

In reality, Lu Tianfeng was a bit scared. He had always held a preconceived notion that as long as the time loop didn’t occur, X wouldn’t kill anyone, so Luo Tengfeng was absolutely safe. But he had overlooked the fact that besides X, Luo Tengfeng might have other enemies.

“Let’s disperse. Everyone, return to your posts. Report any developments.” Although Lu Tianfeng was standing there, he kept a close eye on Luo Tengfeng’s surroundings through the security screen. After all, this was a prestigious wedding, and the Bai family had hired numerous security personnel to maintain order. Without invitations, anyone could not enter the banquet hall. Therefore, Lu Tianfeng could safely leave for a few minutes.

“Huh? Boss, look!” Yu Yongsheng suddenly pointed at the image on one of the small screens and shouted.

Lu Tianfeng’s heart skipped a beat.

“Are these the other members of ‘Luo Tengfeng and his group of six’?”

He saw Fan Minen, Zhang Wenzhe, Gao Miaomiao and the unexpected person – Chen Nuolan.

“It’s such a headache…” Lu Tianfeng rubbed his temples and left in a hurry.

The three female companions that Luo Tengfeng brought with him had different styles. Fan Minen wore a bright red dress, which was well-cut and elegant. Her every move became the focus of the audience; Gao Miaomiao’s light gray evening dress looked a bit plain and elegant, just like she was low-key and inconspicuous; and Chen Nuolan wore a more everyday goose yellow chiffon dress, as if she was deliberately avoiding competing with the other two girls.

“Brother Lu, over here!” Luo Tengfeng spotted Lu Tianfeng from afar in the crowd and waved him over. “Let me formally introduce you all. This is my bodyguard, Brother Lu. After spending the past few days together, I’ve discovered that Brother Lu is a rare talent. I’m interested in recruiting him into the company, but Brother Lu hasn’t agreed yet, haha!”

Lu Tianfeng was taken aback by Luo Tengfeng’s sudden “introduction.” Unable to grasp his intentions, he could only gloss over the situation vaguely. The other four people present clearly reacted differently to the news: Chen Nuolan’s confusion, Gao Miaomiao’s indifference, Zhang Wenzhe’s surprise, and Fan Minen’s disgust.

Luo Tengfeng then introduced his wife Fan Minen, the company’s shareholders Zhang Wenzhe and Gao Miaomiao, and the “mainstay of scientific research” Chen Nuolan to Lu Tianfeng one by one.

“Hurry up and take a seat! Why are there so many people here?” Fan Minen was clearly getting impatient. “Is it really necessary for Mr. Bai to have such a grand ceremony when marrying off his daughter?”

“Honey, when we booked an island in the Maldives to hold our wedding last year, it was quite a grand affair!” Luo Tengfeng reminded.

“Hmph, we are different.” As for what the difference was, Fan Minen did not elaborate.

As the six of them sat down at their table, Lu Tianfeng continued to observe Fan Minen calmly. He hadn’t interacted much with Fan Minen in the past few days, but now that he had, he felt that this wealthy woman was quite pretentious. When she spoke to Luo Tengfeng, not only was her tone sweet, but her body language was also quite expressive. She held her husband’s hand and hugged his neck, as if she was afraid others wouldn’t know they were a loving couple.

The more one tried to show oneself off like this, the more suspicious one appeared.

Lu Tianfeng’s foot was suddenly kicked lightly by someone. He was stunned for a moment, and then realized that it should be Chen Nuolan, who was sitting next to him and pretending nothing had happened.

Chen Nuolan raised her eyebrows inadvertently, indicating “This is confusing, what’s going on?” Lu Tianfeng nodded very slowly, and at the same time made an “OK” gesture with his right hand on the table.

Trust me, it’s okay.

The lights on the scene gradually dimmed, the background music of the wedding drifted melodiously, and the wedding banquet was about to officially begin.

“Captain Lu, everything is normal inside and outside the banquet hall.” Tong Yao’s voice came from the earpiece.

“Boss, there’s no problem in the kitchen either.” Huang Xuanxuan reported at the same time.

The bride and groom walked hand in hand into the banquet hall amidst laughter. The guests stood up and applauded. Amidst the noise, Chen Nuolan said to Lu Tianfeng in a voice that only he could hear: “I’m so envious!”

Lu Tianfeng moved his lips but didn’t answer. She didn’t know that just a few days ago, Bai Zhuoqiang and his daughter Bai Shiyu were almost killed in a kidnapping case. If that day hadn’t happened to be a time loop, today would probably be the day the Bai family held their funeral.

There was often only a fine line between great joy and great sorrow, but people were almost unaware of this and took it for granted thinking they would always be on the same side as the goddess of luck.

Luo Tengfeng was such. He looked high-spirited at this moment, but how many people knew that he was facing the threat of death at any time? Just a few hours ago, he was almost poisoned to death, and now his beautiful wife who was snuggling in his arms and acting coquettishly may have hooked up with another man outside.

So was Luo Tengfeng lucky or unlucky?

When Lu Tianfeng turned his gaze to Luo Tengfeng, he noticed that in the shadows, a pair of eyes were flashing with a strange light.

He was such an unfathomable man…

CONTENT END 14

chapters.title: Chapter 15
chapters.content:
Lu Tianfeng didn’t quite understand why modern people pursued efficiency in everything but still retained the lengthy and cumbersome wedding ceremony. It could even be said that as people’s living standards gradually improved, the wedding banquet process became even longer.

Luo Tengfeng was already fed up with it. After two rounds of toasts, he sneaked to the terrace outside the banquet hall and lit a cigarette.

Lu Tianfeng didn’t dare be negligent and followed Luo Tengfeng to the terrace. It had rained all afternoon today, and the air seemed to be fresher than usual. From the terrace, one could see the beautiful night view of D City, dazzling and full of lights.

“Haha, Captain Lu, you’re too nervous!” Luo Tengfeng flicked his cigarette butt. “This place should be pretty safe, right?”

Although the terrace was empty, Lu Tianfeng still walked closer before speaking: “It is indeed quite safe, but I also happen to have something to say to Mr. Luo in private.”

“Are you trying to protest my using you to test them?”

“It’s not as serious as a ‘protest’. I just hope Mr. Luo can be more careful in his words and actions so as not to bring unnecessary risks to our work.”

Lu Tianfeng’s tone was a bit harsh, but unexpectedly, Luo Tengfeng laughed instead of getting angry: “Haha, could it be that Captain Lu thinks that what I just said was simply random talk without thinking through it?”

“That’s not the case…” In fact, Luo Tengfeng only used one sentence to intuitively reveal the subtle relationship between the people present, which was quite clever.

Luo Tengfeng patted Lu Tianfeng on the shoulder: “Actually, I think there is no need for us to talk so much nonsense, you know.”

“Mr. Luo, you overestimate me…” Lu Tianfeng had just said half of his words when Tong Yao’s voice came from the headset.

“Team Lu, there’s movement on the terrace.”

“Terrace? There’s no one else on the terrace!”

“It’s on the other side of the terrace… Chen Nuolan and Fan Minen seem to be arguing, and there’s been some pushing and shoving between them. Do you want to go over and take a look?”

Only then did Lu Tianfeng realize that the two sides of the banquet hall led to two different terraces. Before he could reply, Tong Yao spoke again, “Fan Minen has returned to the banquet hall. Chen Nuolan is left alone on the terrace, looking dejected and depressed. Captain Lu… please give me your instructions.”

Lu Tianfeng thought about it and decided that he couldn’t give Chen Nuolan special treatment just because she was his girlfriend. Although he didn’t know the reason for the conflict between the two, now was not the time to ask about her well-being, so he asked, “How are the others doing?”

“Some guests left early one after another. Zhang Wenzhe had already left, but Gao Miaomiao remained.”

“Forget it, don’t worry about Chen Nuolan. The scene is quite chaotic. Pay attention to protecting the target.” For Lu Tianfeng, Luo Tengfeng’s safety was the top priority. However, after saying this, he still couldn’t help but sigh softly.

Luo Tengfeng heard Lu Tianfeng sigh, then extinguished the half-smoked cigarette in his hand and said, “Captain Lu, why don’t we just stand here and wait for the guests to leave? It’s most dangerous when the party is over, right?”

“I think no matter what the circumstances, there’s danger when you let your guard down too much.”

“For example, right now, it’s just you and me. Can’t we let our guard down?” Luo Tengfeng turned around and looked at the brightly lit city night scene. “Unless you are X.”

Lu Tianfeng smiled bitterly: “Theoretically, this possibility cannot be completely ruled out, but I have no motive to kill!”

“You may not have the motive to kill Zhang Hanlin and Gao Junjie, but don’t you have the motive to kill me?” Luo Tengfeng always had a smiling face, making it difficult to tell whether he was real or not.

“Boss Luo, are you kidding?”

“Did you know that large companies conduct background checks on every new employee? The more important the employee, the more detailed the background check will be.” Luo Tengfeng changed the subject, leaving Lu Tianfeng a little confused.

“What does this… mean?”

“Chen Nuolan is a key training target for our company. We have conducted a very thorough background investigation on her.” Luo Tengfeng deliberately paused for a few seconds. “I have known for a long time that she has a boyfriend who is a police officer, and I also know that man is you.”

Lu Tianfeng was shocked. He didn’t expect that Luo Tengfeng actually knew the relationship between him and Chen Nuolan. In this way, their many encounters today were not coincidences, but Luo Tengfeng’s deliberate arrangement.

“Mr. Luo’s acting skills are really good.” Lu Tianfeng replied slowly.

“You two are both very good at acting.” Luo Tengfeng put his hand on Lu Tianfeng’s shoulder again, “Do you know why I did this?”

“You are testing me because you don’t trust me.”

“Hahaha, Captain Lu, you’re mistaken. It’s precisely because I trust you that I want to test you to see if you can live up to my trust.” Luo Tengfeng laughed heartily. “Of course you know about the scandal between Chen Nuolan and me, but you still managed to hide your identity calmly. I admire you.”

Lu Tianfeng replied coldly: “Boss Luo seems to like testing others.”

“When you’re in my position, you have no choice. I don’t want to deal with people whose background I don’t know.”

“Isn’t it tiring to live like this?”

“Life is tiring!”

The night breeze blew on their faces, and the two men standing on the terrace fell into a long silence. Luo Tengfeng lit another cigarette.

“Come to think of it, we’re quite interesting.” After smoking for a while, Luo Tengfeng continued coldly, “My wife and I have to pretend to be very close, but you and your girlfriend have to pretend you don’t know each other.”

Lu Tianfeng said reluctantly: “That’s because of my job responsibilities.”

Luo Tengfeng blew a smoke ring into the air: “Actually, I’m the same as you…”

Same? How could they be the same?

Rumors have long circulated that Luo Tengfeng and Fan Minen’s sudden marriage was due to the Fan family’s influence in the investment world. However, conversely, it could also be understood that the Fan family was attracted by the promising prospects of Feng Teng’s genes. If marriage was viewed as a business, this one was a mutually beneficial one.

Unfortunately, marriage was not a business.

Yu Yongsheng’s voice came from Lu Tianfeng’s earpiece: “Boss, the wedding banquet is coming to an end, and more and more people are leaving. Do we still need to stay here and wait?”

“Change back into casual clothes first and wait for my next instructions.” Lu Tianfeng thought for a moment and asked again, “There must be a lot of people outside now. We can leave later.”

“I can wait here, but I’m afraid you’ll have to arrange for someone to take my wife home first,” Luo Tengfeng interrupted. “She doesn’t have that much patience.”

“It doesn’t matter. Everyone’s patience is developed little by little.”

“Interesting…” Luo Tengfeng’s cigarette went out. “Then let’s follow Team Lu’s instructions.”

“Please remember, our opponent is a very patient person.” Lu Tianfeng said seriously, “So we need to be more patient than him.”

CONTENT END 15

chapters.title: Chapter 16
chapters.content:
It was past eleven o’clock in the evening when Lu Tianfeng returned to his home. In fact, since Chen Nuolan was not there, he was reluctant to call this place home. When he came back in the middle of the night and opened the door, he was greeted by a cold and lonely atmosphere.

Honestly, he could choose to stay in Luo Tengfeng’s villa. In order to cooperate with the police in carrying out their tasks, Luo Tengfeng specially arranged two guest rooms for several policemen to stay in, so that they could rest better and recharge their energy.

But after a whole day of hard work, Lu Tianfeng chose to return here.

As soon as he entered the door, he didn’t even bother to drink a sip of water. He ran to the desk, took out a small notebook from the drawer, and quickly wrote down all the important events that happened that day.

This was a task he must complete every night, because writing down the day’s itinerary helped him sort out his thoughts. In the event of a time loop, he could arrange and deal with his work with the highest efficiency.

Compared to the ordinary experiences of the past few days, a lot happened today. There was the unexpected encounter with Chen Nuolan, the clarification of the internal struggle of Feng Teng Gene Company, the lecture at D City University, the attack from the Nifeng Club, the suspicion of Fan Minen’s affair, and Luo Tengfeng taking the initiative to reveal his cards to him during the wedding banquet… Unconsciously, Lu Tianfeng wrote two pages worth to basically record the context of this day’s events.

Lu Tianfeng looked at his notes and said to himself, “What a mess! One experience like this is enough…”

In the past few nights, Lu Tianfeng had been silently looking forward to the occurrence of the time loop, because he couldn’t wait to face X head-on; but today, he prayed that time would pass quietly and smoothly into the next day.

11:59.

He must stay awake at midnight every day so that if a time loop occured, he would not waste even a second.

The second hand ticked away.

Let it go, just let this day pass…

Lu Tianfeng stared at the scribbled words on the notebook and forced himself to memorize it as quickly as possible, because the notebook might disappear without a trace in a moment.

Of course, he hoped in his heart that the note in front of him would not disappear.

There were still ten seconds left, and Lu Tianfeng felt inexplicably nervous. For some reason, he had a very bad premonition.

The phrase “Murphy’s Law” suddenly appeared in his mind –

The unexpected situations you worry about will always happen.

Lu Tianfeng blinked subconsciously, and before he knew it, midnight had passed. The page of notes in front of him reverted back to snow-white. He looked down at his clothes and found that they had changed into the same ones he wore in the early morning of the 15th.

The time displayed on the phone was still midnight on April 15th, and the time loop had occurred.

Lu Tianfeng suppressed his excitement, took several deep breaths, forced himself to calm down, and immediately wrote down everything that was going to happen today in his notebook as quickly as possible, and at the same time called Cheng Tuo’s cellphone.

“Captain Cheng, there’s an emergency. I’m requesting a 24-hour curfew.”

“Okay.” Cheng Tuo simply replied with one word. He didn’t seem too surprised by the late-night call, nor did he ask Lu Tianfeng why he did this.

“Thank you, Captain Cheng.”

“Thanks a lot.”

That’s the trust between the two of them.

Lu Tianfeng thought, the good show was finally about to begin.

After hanging up the phone, Lu Tianfeng unconsciously opened the window. It was clearly spring, but the night wind outside the window was a little chilly, as if winter had not gone away.

CONTENT END 16

chapters.title: Chapter 17
chapters.content:
April 15th, second cycle, 1 a.m.

All members of the protection team gathered in the guest room of Luo Tengfeng’s house. Although they didn’t know why Lu Tianfeng had suddenly called them together in the middle of the night, they all sensed the arduous new task ahead. So, while their faces were exhausted, they also had a certain eagerness to try.

Lu Tianfeng was certainly very excited, but looking at his colleagues’ active performance, he couldn’t help feeling a little guilty, because he knew very well that no matter how hard everyone worked, the next day’s work would not leave the slightest trace in the real world.

But even so, they still had to try their best.

Lu Tianfeng cleared his throat with a dry cough and said, “Everyone, I’ve just received reliable intelligence that X might make his move today. Therefore, from this moment on, please follow the tasks I’ve assigned to monitor the suspects. Tong Yao, you’ll follow Fan Minen throughout the entire process; Xuanxuan, you’ll be responsible for keeping an eye on Gao Miaomiao; Yongsheng, your target is Zhang Wenzhe. From this moment on, I need you to record their every move, who they come into contact with, where they go, and even what they eat for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Record everything. Do you understand?”

“Understood!” the three responded in unison.

“I’ve asked Captain Cheng to send in more personnel. Each surveillance team will have one or two more people to help. I’ve also applied to monitor their phones and emails.”

Yu Yongsheng couldn’t help but yawn and asked, “Boss, we’re deploy all the police forces to these people. Luo Tengfeng is the only one here. Is that okay?”

Lu Tianfeng groaned inwardly. He knew this assignment wasn’t rational, but he couldn’t explain the real reason. Fortunately, nothing that happened in this cycle would truly remain in their memories, so even if there were any oddities, they could just gloss over it for “today.”

“Don’t worry, I will naturally make arrangements.” Lu Tianfeng said vaguely.

“Um, should the surveillance start now?” Huang Xuanxuan asked hesitantly.

“Yes, start immediately.” Lu Tianfeng glanced at his watch. “Yongsheng followed Luo Tengfeng all day yesterday. Go get a few hours’ sleep. I’ll have Captain Cheng send someone else to monitor Zhang Wenzhe.”

“Boss, I’m not tired…”

“Are you kidding? This is an order! You can only sleep for five hours and get up on time at six o’clock!” Lu Tianfeng waved his hand without giving any reason, and Yu Yongsheng had to keep silent.

“Others will act separately and report any situation at any time.”

“Yes, sir!”

Yu Yongsheng and Huang Xuanxuan left after receiving the order, and only Tong Yao stayed in the room, tapping on the keyboard thoughtfully.

“Is there anything you want to say?” Lu Tianfeng had just seen Tong Yao’s inner confusion. After all, she was not his direct subordinate, and she was not used to such “incomprehensible” orders.

“Captain Lu, are you sure X is connected to these three people? What if…”

Tong Yao didn’t continue, but Lu Tianfeng already understood what she meant.

“You’re worried that if X has nothing to do with them, we’ll have wasted our time and energy, right?”

“I’m more worried that Luo Tengfeng might be in danger.”

“Don’t worry, I’ll make all the arrangements.” Lu Tianfeng had no choice but to comfort her. “By the way, when you’re monitoring Fan Minen, pay special attention to whether she has any private contact with her ex-boyfriend Zheng Yuanzhi.”

“Zheng Yuanzhi?” Tong Yao was clearly surprised by this instruction, as this bank account manager hadn’t appeared in their field of vision during the past few days of their mission. “May I ask why?”

“Maybe it’s police’s intuition.” Lu Tianfeng could only say this to fool people.

Tong Yao frowned, but said nothing more. Following orders was the duty of a police officer.

Just as Lu Tianfeng was about to turn around and leave, he heard Tong Yao say softly, “Captain Lu, I don’t know what you think, but anyway…”

“Um?”

“Please be careful.” Tong Yao took a deep breath, as if this was the only way to finish the second half of the sentence.

“I will.” He nodded vigorously.

CONTENT END 17

chapters.title: Chapter 18
chapters.content:
April 15th, second cycle, 6 a.m.

Luo Tengfeng, dressed in sportswear, appeared at the entrance of the villa on time, and Lu Tianfeng had been waiting there for a long time.

“Good morning, Brother Lu. Sorry to bother you today.”

This was exactly the same conversation as the first time, but Lu Tianfeng changed his way of responding.

“Good morning, Mr. Luo. Are you going for morning exercise as usual today?”

“Of course.” Luo Tengfeng was surprised and looked at Lu Tianfeng, “Is there any problem?”

“Nothing, I just feel that the air quality is not very good today.”

Luo Tengfeng looked up at the sky and said in surprise: “Really? I think it’s okay.”

Lu Tianfeng smiled but said nothing. He simply wanted to test whether he could influence Luo Tengfeng’s decision. Many people have heard of the “butterfly effect,” the belief that a butterfly flapping its wings in the Amazon jungle could cause a tornado in the United States. However, as time loop cycled, what Lu Tianfeng most deeply understood wasn’t the butterfly effect, but a phenomenon he himself named the “spring effect.”

What was the spring effect? For example, if you changed something in a new cycle, causing your destiny to seem to have deviated from its original track, then according to the theory of the butterfly effect, what would happen after that day may be very different from the previous cycle; but in reality, most of the things that would happen on that day was the same as the previous cycle. Only the “changed” event would be changed, and the rest of the events would hardly be affected.

So, fate was like a spring: as long as you apply external force, its shape could change, but that was all. Once the external force was removed, fate would return to its original path. Lu Tianfeng also gradually grasped this law after experiencing many time loops. Therefore, he would try to change different events in each loop and observe the chain reaction it caused.

Lu Tianfeng had anticipated Luo Tengfeng’s reluctance to change his morning jog. So, the two of them headed out together, doing some simple warm-up exercises before beginning their jog. This time, Lu Tianfeng didn’t bother chasing Luo Tengfeng, letting him run faster and faster. He simply followed from a distance, ensuring his safety.

After running for about fifteen minutes, Luo Tengfeng slowed down his pace and Lu Tianfeng finally caught up. The two began to walk slowly.

Luo Tengfeng wiped the sweat off his face and panted, “Brother Lu, you don’t seem to be in a good condition today!”

“Really? Maybe I didn’t sleep well last night.”

“Being a police officer must be very stressful for you, right?” Luo Tengfeng asked with concern.

“Who doesn’t have a lot of pressure these days?” Lu Tianfeng asked back, “Even if you, Mr. Luo, are worth over 100 million and have no worries about food and clothing, you wouldn’t dare say that you have an easy life, right?”

“Haha, that makes sense, very reasonable!” Luo Tengfeng patted Lu Tianfeng on the shoulder, “Then let’s improve the food for breakfast today and relieve some stress.”

“Where are you going?” Lu Tianfeng asked knowing the answer.

“A Western restaurant called ROOST, it’s pretty good. Oh, by the way, let’s end our morning exercise early today, I have an appointment at 7:30.”

“No problem.”

“Come on, run for a while.” Luo Tengfeng stepped forward, while Lu Tianfeng looked down at the latest updates on his mobile phone: Fan Minen and Zhang Wenzhe were still sleeping at home, Gao Miaomiao had just gotten up and was making breakfast in the kitchen, and there didn’t seem to be anything unusual.

“Keep paying close attention.” After giving the instructions, Lu Tianfeng quickly caught up with Luo Tengfeng who was running in front. At this moment, he was thinking about how he should respond when he saw Chen Nuolan later.

CONTENT END 18

chapters.title: Chapter 19
chapters.content:
7:30 am, ROOST Western Restaurant.

An hour passed in a flash, and even when Lu Tianfeng sat in his comfortable seat, he still couldn’t think of any way to deal with the situation.

Chen Nuolan appeared in front of him as expected, and just like the last time they met, she pretended not to know him and walked straight towards Luo Tengfeng.

“Wait a minute!” Lu Tianfeng gritted his teeth and stood up resolutely.

Chen Nuolan paused and looked at Lu Tianfeng in astonishment. Luo Tengfeng, who was sitting in the booth by the window, also looked surprised.

“I have something to say.” Lu Tianfeng became the focus of the whole audience. He looked at Luo Tengfeng, “Boss Luo, don’t you know her identity?”

“She is from our company…”

“No, I mean her other identity.” Lu Tianfeng interrupted Luo Tengfeng rudely, “I believe Mr. Luo should know that Chen Nuolan is my girlfriend.”

Luo Tengfeng’s face darkened at first, then he said calmly, “I know, so what?”

“So…” After being asked so calmly by Luo Tengfeng, the unprepared Lu Tianfeng was speechless.

Luo Tengfeng sat down again, picked up the knife and fork on the table and played with them, saying, “What I want to ask is, will your relationship affect your working principles as a police officer?”

Lu Tianfeng remained silent.

“Also, will your relationship affect Chen Nuolan’s work at Feng Teng Gene?”

Lu Tianfeng still didn’t speak.

“One more question. Just because she’s your girlfriend, she can’t have breakfast with the boss? Do you really believe those rumors circulating online?”

Lu Tianfeng, who had been silent the entire time, recalled what Luo Tengfeng had said to him in the previous cycle: “Actually, I don’t think we need to talk so much nonsense between us.”

Chen Nuolan walked up to Lu Tianfeng and said in a voice that only he could hear: “Feng, what’s wrong with you?”

These five short words contained countless complex emotions, including confusion about Lu Tianfeng’s appearance at this time and place, but more importantly, concern and worry for him.

Because in Chen Nuolan’s mind, her boyfriend, who had always been calm and rational, should never take the initiative to expose the relationship between them during the mission.

“I’m fine.” Lu Tianfeng replied softly.

Chen Nuolan seemed a little embarrassed, standing there at a loss. At this time, Luo Tengfeng said, “Nuolan, sit down. Captain Lu can also sit at this table if he feels it is necessary. I promise, we will only discuss business matters.”

“I won’t bother you two anymore. I just hope that if Mr. Luo arranges this kind of ‘surprise’ next time, please notify me in advance.” Lu Tianfeng said very seriously, “Because doing so is really too dangerous.”

“Dangerous?” In the western-style restaurant where only three people were, the air suddenly became still.

Lu Tianfeng glanced at Chen Nuolan, then looked into Luo Tengfeng’s eyes and said, “I think I have an obligation to remind Mr. Luo again that your life is under serious threat. The deranged serial killer X could attack you at any time, and could also harm innocent people around you.”

Luo Tengfeng couldn’t help laugh: “So… you want me to have as little contact with your girlfriend as possible?”

Seeing that Luo Tengfeng’s attitude was not very serious, Lu Tianfeng couldn’t help but feel a little angry. He emphasized his tone and said, “Also, we have received the latest news that X may choose to take action today.”

“Bang—”

Luo Tengfeng dropped the fork in his hand onto the plate and seemed shocked.

“What did you say? Today?”

“Yes, today.” Since nothing would be left unrecorded, Lu Tianfeng simply spoke openly, testing the limits of today’s spring effect. “So I hope Mr. Luo can fully cooperate with our work. If possible, I suggest canceling some non-essential activities.”

After the initial wave of shock passed, Luo Tengfeng picked up the knife and fork again and tapped them gently against each other, making a crisp tinkling sound.

“I’m actually quite curious, if the police thought X was going to take action today, why didn’t they increase extra security?” Luo Tengfeng’s question was sharp and to the point.

“We naturally have arrangements…”

“Don’t fool me. This western restaurant is empty with only three of us. If X attacks now, can you really handle it alone?”

“X will not launch an attack here. I am not in a position to disclose the specific details.” In fact, Lu Tianfeng was unable to explain this matter to Luo Tengfeng at all, so he simply used a tough tone to express his position.

“It’s hard to believe what you said.”

The two men remained deadlocked for several minutes, neither backing down. Even the restaurant waiter didn’t dare approach. Finally, Chen Nuolan spoke up to smooth things over: “Boss Luo, will the breakfast meeting be held or not?”

“Let’s continue with the meeting. My schedule for today will not change for the time being.” Luo Tengfeng glanced at Lu Tianfeng, who sighed and consciously stepped back a little, but could still hear their conversation.

Luo Tengfeng ignored Lu Tianfeng and said to Chen Nuolan, “Due to time constraints, I’ll get straight to the point. I think you should have noticed that since Gao Junjie’s death, Feng Teng’s R&D department has become panic-stricken. Some want to be promoted, some want to leave, and some are worried about losing their jobs. Few people are working seriously anymore.”

“The atmosphere in our department has been a bit strange lately…”

“And you are one of those people who sticks to his post and works hard.”

“Mr. Luo, thank you for your compliment.” Chen Nuolan subconsciously glanced in the direction of Lu Tianfeng, and then her face flushed slightly.

“Given the current state of the R&D department, I believe that no matter who succeeds as the Chief Scientist, it will trigger a new round of conflicts. However, if a leader is not chosen quickly, subsequent work will be difficult to carry out.”

Chen Nuolan nodded in agreement: “So Mr. Luo wants to ask for my opinion on the candidate successor?”

“No, you’re mistaken. I want you to take over.”

“What?” Chen Nuolan was shocked. “Boss Luo, stop joking. With my qualifications, how could I possibly take on such an important task…”

“It’s certainly hard to convince everyone to let you become Chief Scientist directly, but I’d like to vacate that hot potato position and appoint you as Chief Assistant, temporarily leading research and development. I’ve read your papers and know that some of your ideas and hypotheses coincide with mine, but I haven’t been able to verify them yet. Now, I can give you a chance to try.”

“Well…” She hesitated.

“We can discuss the salary issue again. I will definitely satisfy you.”

Chen Nuolan looked at Lu Tianfeng again, but he had turned sideways, avoiding her gaze.

“Let me think about it.”

“No problem, I’ll give you an hour to think it over.” Luo Tengfeng waved his hand, asking the waiter who had been waiting in the distance to serve breakfast. “There’s a shareholders’ meeting this morning, and I’ll announce your promotion to everyone then.”

“Have you decided?” Chen Nuolan widened his eyes.

“You still have time for me to change my decision. Now, let’s have breakfast first.”

Lu Tianfeng was once again savoring this high-end but tasteless breakfast when he received a new message from Tong Yao.

“Fan Minen went out for morning tea, and I also saw Zheng Yuanzhi. The two pretended not to know each other at first, but ended up entering the same private room.”

“Keep watching.”

Lu Tianfeng thought to himself, the world was really wonderful. While Luo Tengfeng was having breakfast with someone else’s girlfriend, his wife was secretly meeting another man for morning tea.

“Captain Lu, I have one more thing to ask you.” Tong Yao sent another message with a strange tone.

“Just say it.”

“I secretly installed a bug on Fan Minen. Do I need to enable monitoring?”

Lu Tianfeng understood what Tong Yao meant. According to normal procedures, wiretapping required an application for registration, but now Lu Tianfeng did not seem to be following the procedures, so Tong Yao did not dare overstep the line.

“Enable it. I’ll take care of anything that comes my way.”

“Clear.”

Lu Tianfeng thought for a moment and then typed in another sentence: “We can be flexible in today’s operations. Special matters can be handled specially.”

After several minutes, Tong Yao replied: “Okay.”

While waiting for Tong Yao’s reply, Lu Tianfeng had already devoured his breakfast. Everyone understood that a full stomach gave them the strength to fight, but not everyone could actually do it.

CONTENT END 19

chapters.title: Chapter 20
chapters.content:
April 15th, second cycle, 10 a.m., in Feng Teng Gene conference room.

At Lu Tianfeng’s insistence, he was allowed into the conference room to observe today’s shareholders’ meeting. Of course, his presence as a bodyguard drew curious glances from others, but after Luo Tengfeng announced Chen Nuolan’s promotion and invited her to the conference room, no one cared about the presence of a bodyguard.

Zhang Wenzhe looked at Chen Nuolan warily and was the first to express his objection. “I disagree. Chen Nuolan has only been in the company for a little over a year and has no management experience at all. This decision is nothing short of risky.”

Luo Tengfeng seemed to have anticipated Zhang Wenzhe’s question and said calmly, “Feng Teng Gene has only been established for a few short years. Are only veterans qualified to be part of the management team? With all due respect, Chen Nuolan has much more experience than the two new shareholders here, right?”

Zhang Wenzhe flew into a rage. He slammed the table and stood up, saying, “Boss Luo, what do you mean by that? Although I’ve just joined the company, I’ve at least been around for a few years…”

“Mr. Zhang, what industry were you working in a few years ago?” Luo Tengfeng smiled sarcastically. “Loan sharking could probably be considered finance? Running an underground dance hall could barely be considered entertainment services. And illegal racing, you could define it as sports…”

As Luo Tengfeng scolded him, Zhang Wenzhe’s face became redder and redder, and his hands on the table were clenched into fists.

“But no matter what, you have zero experience in the field of biomedicine. I hope that the empire built by your father with his own hands will not be destroyed in your hands.” Luo Tengfeng took advantage of the situation and stabbed the last knife without mercy.

“Hmph!” Zhang Wenzhe slammed the conference table hard, then swung his right hand vigorously again.

“Bang—”

The teacup in front of him suddenly shattered to the ground.

“So that’s how it is…” Lu Tianfeng said secretly in his heart, “There are quite a few broken cups today.”

“Miaomiao, do you have any opinions?” Luo Tengfeng called Zhang Wenzhe “Mr. Zhang” and used a much more intimate name for Gao Miaomiao.

“I have no objection…” Gao Miaomiao always spoke softly, as if she was afraid of offending others.

“Very good, then it’s decided. From now on, the company appoints Chen Nuolan as the Chief Assistant of the R&D Department. Until the Chief Scientist is in place, she will temporarily be in charge of the daily work of the R&D department.”

“Wait a minute.” Zhang Wenzhe suddenly said, “Isn’t it possible that Mr. Luo is planning to keep the position of Chief Scientist vacant so that Chen Nuolan can take over?”

Luo Tengfeng remained calm and said, “The selection of Chief Scientist must be carefully considered. I wonder what Mr. Zhang thinks?”

“I don’t have any brilliant ideas. I just want you to tell the shareholders how long this position is expected to remain vacant and how to find a suitable successor as soon as possible. Mr. Luo has to give an explanation to the shareholders.” Zhang Wenzhe was not stupid. He threw the ball to Luo Tengfeng again without any hesitation.

Lu Tianfeng secretly updated his evaluation of Zhang Wenzhe. According to the previous police investigation data, Zhang Wenzhe was just a gangster who was uneducated and spent his time drinking and carousing. However, when he thought about it carefully, he dared to fall out with his rich and powerful father, and made his way in society with his own abilities. Now he shamelessly inherited his father’s business, and still refused to give in in the face of the powerful Luo Tengfeng. It could be seen that this person was not as simple as the legend.

Could he be X?

Lu Tianfeng turned his gaze to Gao Miaomiao again. According to Huang Xuanxuan’s follow-up report this morning, this seemingly frail and timid girl had gotten up early to make breakfast, then spent half an hour reading before leaving the house. She even continued reading English books on the crowded subway on her way to work. She was often the first one in the department to arrive at the office, and she didn’t need anyone to urge her to get down to work.

In fact, she inherited her father’s shares and could have directly entered the management level like Zhang Wenzhe, but she was said to have rejected Luo Tengfeng’s repeated invitations and insisted on starting from an entry-level position.

She was both strict with herself and self-aware. Based on these two points alone, Lu Tianfeng would never underestimate this girl.

“Actually, I have a few things to say…” Somewhat surprisingly, Chen Nuolan took the initiative to speak. Her voice was gentle, but her tone was incredibly firm. “My inner thoughts are very simple. I just hope to continue to make my own contribution to the research and development of RAN technology.”

She paused for a moment, and her eyes swept over everyone in the conference room one by one, and seemed to linger on Lu Tianfeng’s face for a particularly long time.

“Today, Mr. Luo believes that I can help the R&D department get back on track as soon as possible, so I am willing to try this new position. If one day you think I am not competent for the job, then I am willing to step down at any time. My greatest personal pursuit is to continue to fight at the forefront of human biomedicine, nothing more.”

After Chen Nuolan said this, even Zhang Wenzhe, who always had a tough attitude, lowered his head and stopped talking. Gao Miaomiao kept writing notes, and no one knew what she was recording.

Lu Tianfeng swallowed hard. For some reason, he always felt that it was because of his presence that Chen Nuolan said such words.

Luo Tengfeng snapped his fingers and said, “Looks like we can wrap up this topic. Nuolan, please go back to the R&D department and make some preparations. I’ll have the Human Resources department handle and announce the position change as soon as possible.”

“I understand. Thank you all for your trust.” Chen Nuolan bowed slightly and left the meeting room.

“Very good, next topic… Do you still need to continue to attend?” Luo Tengfeng said the latter half of the sentence to Lu Tianfeng in a low voice with a hint of ridicule.

Now that the topic about your girlfriend is over, can you feel relieved?

Lu Tianfeng replied calmly: “Yes.”

Yu Yongsheng’s voice came from the headset: “Boss, we are actually monitoring the situation in the conference room. You can go check on your sister-in-law.”

Lu Tianfeng replied through his phone, feeling both angry and amused: “Stop talking nonsense. Contact Tong Yao when you have time to find out the latest situation with Fan Minen.”

“Got it.” Yu Yongsheng said decisively.

After the shareholders’ meeting of Feng Teng Gene ended, Lu Tianfeng and others held a brief meeting while Luo Tengfeng and others returned to their respective offices to work.

First, Yu Yongsheng relayed the details of a private conversation between Fan Minen and Zheng Yuanzhi that morning, which Tong Yao had overheard. This time, it was Zheng Yuanzhi who initiated the meeting with Fan Minen, and the two discussed insider information regarding Feng Teng Gene’s preparations for its next round of financing.

Zheng Yuanzhi stated that Feng Teng Gene’s new investor was said to be from overseas, very powerful, and in commercial competition with D-Bank where he worked. Once the investment was finalized, D-Bank would likely lose Feng Teng Gene as a major client, and his performance as an exclusive account manager would certainly be severely affected. However, if he could find a way to retain this distinguished client, his future career path would be smooth sailing.

The best way to stop this round of financing was to find an investor with a higher bid, and the only person Zheng Yuanzhi could think of was Fan Minen’s father, Fan Yingxiong. But an investment of hundreds of millions of dollars was no joke for any company. Would Fan Minen persuade her father to save her ex-boyfriend’s job?

Surprisingly, after much hesitation, Fan Minen finally agreed to Zheng Yuanzhi’s request. Zheng Yuanzhi even told Fan Minen that if he could be promoted to the position of deputy governor, Fan Minen would “no longer have to endure the wrath of that man.” Although he didn’t say it explicitly, everyone understood that the man was Luo Tengfeng.

Fan Minen did not refuse this extremely outrageous “teasing” outright, but responded vaguely with a few words. It seems that Luo Tengfeng’s guess in the last cycle was not unfounded. Even if Fan Minen and Zheng Yuanzhi did not have a substantial affair, their relationship was very subtle.

“Boss, these two people are considered to be cheating on their partner, right? At least mentally,” Yu Yongsheng asked.

“I’m not interested in whether they’re cheating or not. I just want to know if they’re conspiring to murder someone.” Lu Tianfeng turned to Huang Xuanxuan and asked, “Xuanxuan, what do you think?”

“Me? I don’t think Fan Minen is that kind of person… Of course, I don’t have any evidence, it’s just a hunch.”

“I have a different opinion,” Yu Yongsheng interrupted hastily. “Would a normal married woman put aside her father’s and husband’s careers for her ex-boyfriend’s job? The fact that she would do this clearly proves that her thinking is different from that of ordinary people. We can’t use common sense to judge her.”

“Wait, she only verbally agreed to Zheng Yuanzhi, and she didn’t really do it. Besides, it’s still unknown whether she can influence her father’s decision.”

“Being able to verbally agree to such an incredible request is already quite impressive, okay?”

Lu Tianfeng smiled and let his two subordinates argue fiercely with each other. In fact, he quite liked this kind of atmosphere. Only a team of independent thinkers can face greater challenges.

Yu Yongsheng and Huang Xuanxuan exchanged sharp words for several minutes, and finally noticed that their boss had not spoken, so they turned their gazes to Lu Tianfeng at the same time, waiting for him to make the decision.

“Don’t look at me. I can’t see through Fan Minen either.” Lu Tianfeng laughed self-deprecatingly. “I admit that her first impression is that of a superficial beauty.
