Her appearance is a little unreal, but her mind is terrifyingly simple. But think about it carefully. She can marry a man like Luo Tengfeng. What kind of person is Luo Tengfeng? I believe that after meeting him these days, you all have a very intuitive feeling. Is he the kind of man who can be impressed by a stupid woman?”

Yu Yongsheng and Huang Xuanxuan were both silent.

Lu Tianfeng continued his analysis, “Many people think Luo Tengfeng married Fan Minen purely to attract investment, but I think that’s unlikely. Feng Teng Gene possesses the world’s only patented RAN technology, making it a highly sought-after asset in the eyes of investors. There’s no need for Luo Tengfeng to use his marriage as leverage.”

“And Luo Tengfeng doesn’t look like the kind of person who is greedy for beauty.” Yu Yongsheng said.

Huang Xuanxuan rolled her eyes at him and said, “What man isn’t lustful?”

“Well…”

“Haha, stop bickering. I’ve noticed that everyone around Luo Tengfeng has a lot of stories. Besides Fan Minen, tell us about Zhang Wenzhe and Gao Miaomiao, too.”

Yu Yongsheng yawned and said, “Zhang Wenzhe seems to have boundless energy. The guy who was keeping watch on him this morning said he didn’t get home from the bar until after two o’clock. When I went to relieve him at six o’clock, he was already up. And after waking up, he did something that I didn’t expect… Can you guess what it was?”

Yu Yongsheng deliberately kept it a secret. Lu Tianfeng smiled and said, “That’s not hard to guess. It’s just eating, drinking and having fun.”

“Boss, you’re amazing! That guy got up and didn’t even have breakfast. He just sat in front of the computer in his pajamas and played games for over an hour…”

“Wait, what game is he playing?” Lu Tianfeng suddenly asked.

“A racing game, what’s wrong with that?” Yu Yongsheng was stunned.

“I need to know the exact name of the game. If it’s an online game, he can communicate with other people in the game. This is a blind spot in our monitoring. Do you understand?” Lu Tianfeng vaguely felt that Zhang Wenzhe playing games early in the morning might have a deeper meaning. Maybe he actually wanted to contact someone through the game.

“If it really is an online game…”

“Have Captain Cheng think of a way to contact the Internet police and find out who he talked to and what he said in the game. Act immediately.”

“I know!” Yu Yongsheng quickly started making a call.

“Xuanxuan, tell me more about your observations on Gao Miaomiao.” Lu Tianfeng turned to ask Huang Xuanxuan.

“I’ve always felt something was a little strange about Gao Miaomiao’s life, but I can’t quite put my finger on what’s wrong.” Huang Xuanxuan tilted her head and thought for a moment. “She’s diligent, hardworking, and down-to-earth. All of these should be strengths, but yet I feel an inexplicable unease.”

“How can a person be all good and without any bad qualities? That’s why she strikes you as weird.”

“Yes, she strikes me as an actor meticulously playing the role of a ‘good kid’.”

“So what is she really like…” Lu Tianfeng suddenly thought of the Nifeng Club, Xu Lang and Tan Jiaqiang.

In fact, each of us is an actor, the only difference is the level of our acting skills.

“Alright, everyone, continue your surveillance missions. Remember, don’t miss any details.”

Lu Tianfeng was convinced that by comparing the details of each cycle, he would be able to discover X’s flaws, because X’s actions in each cycle should be significantly different. In fact, the key point of this contest was whether Lu Tianfeng discovered X first, or whether X noticed Lu Tianfeng’s existence first.

Lu Tianfeng’s advantage was that he can deploy more manpower to collect information, and X’s greatest advantage was that he has always been hiding in the dark.

“I will definitely smoke you out.” Lu Tianfeng said secretly in his heart.

CONTENT END 20

chapters.title: Chapter 21
chapters.content:
April 15th, second cycle, 1:30 PM.

Luo Tengfeng’s private car was driving to D City University. Luo Tengfeng sat in the back seat without saying a word, looking down at the documents.

Outside the car window, the sky began to grow overcast. The rain that had been lingering all afternoon was about to arrive as expected.

“Captain Lu, don’t we need to deploy more police force for this afternoon’s activities? That’s a busy university campus.” Luo Tengfeng suddenly asked.

Lu Tianfeng was stunned. He noticed that Luo Tengfeng didn’t even raise his head, his eyes still fixed on the document in his hand.

“Please rest assured, Mr. Luo, I have already requested reinforcements.”

“Now that you mention it, I’m even more curious.” Luo Tengfeng finally put down the document. “Why didn’t we need extra security this morning at ROOST, but we will need it later at D City University?”

“This involves the internal workings of the police system and I’m sorry I can’t tell you.”

“But it also involves my personal life safety, and I feel I have the right to know.”

Lu Tianfeng thought that avoiding Luo Tengfeng’s questioning was not the best approach. It would be better to throw the Nifeng Club out as a target first.

So he said, “Because the police investigation discovered that there is a radical organization called the ‘Nifeng Club’ within D City University. They specifically target RAN technology. They claim to want to eliminate you and save human civilization.”

“Hahaha…” Luo Tengfeng laughed out loud. “Such a stupid statement, will the police take it seriously?”

“Human lives are at stake. We absolutely cannot afford to be careless.”

Luo Tengfeng let out a cold smile. “Actually, I’ve heard of these guys. I even had a fight with them on the forum using a fake account.”

“Oh?” This was information that was beyond Lu Tianfeng’s expectations.

“It’s just a mob, not a threat.”

Lu Tianfeng decided to dampen Luo Tengfeng’s enthusiasm: “But there are also many great figures in history who were eventually killed by insignificant little characters.”

Luo Tengfeng couldn’t help but frown when he heard this: “Captain Lu, what you said is really unlucky!”

“Good medicine tastes bitter, and honest advice is unpleasant to the ears.” Lu Tianfeng didn’t say much and stopped there.

Luo Tengfeng pondered for a moment and asked half-jokingly, “If I let the car go back to the company with a U-turn, do you think it would be a wise decision?”

Lu Tianfeng was also stunned.

“Whether it’s wise or not is hard to say, but it’s certainly a rational choice.”

For some reason, Luo Tengfeng laughed again.

“Captain Lu, let me tell you a secret,” Luo Tengfeng said, a bit mysteriously, “If I were a rational person, there would be no RAN technology in this world.”

Lu Tianfeng really wanted to ask what this sentence meant, but the car had already stopped in front of the auditorium of D City University, and he had no chance to ask for the time being.

Fate, spring-loaded, returned to normal. Luo Tengfeng, just like the last time, walked into the auditorium in high spirits, waving to the students’ enthusiastic cheers and applause. Lu Tianfeng, on the other hand, sat calmly in the front row until the lecture officially began, with everyone’s attention focused on the stage. Only then did he quietly stand up and leave the auditorium through a side door.

Lu Tianfeng arrived at the Biology Department building early. An hour later, this corridor would be packed with students asking for Luo Tengfeng’s autograph, but right now, it was completely silent. The loudest sound Lu Tianfeng could hear was the footsteps of a female student hurrying to class.

Lu Tianfeng walked slowly around the teaching building and soon found Xu Lang sitting in the last row of a study room, looking down at a book. Lu Tianfeng noticed that Xu Lang was holding a thick English book, and he didn’t recognize any of the English words on the cover. He thought it was probably a biology textbook.

Just looking at Xu Lang’s fair and thin face, it was easy to think that he was just a weak nerd, but Lu Tianfeng noticed the muscle lines on Xu Lang’s arms, which were the result of long-term exercise.

“Classmate, you look very serious!” Lu Tianfeng calmly sat down in the seat next to Xu Lang.

Xu Lang looked up and was stunned for a moment, because there were still many empty seats in the classroom. He couldn’t understand why this man who didn’t look like a student at all insisted on sitting next to him.

“Excuse me… do I know you?”

“You don’t know me, but I know you, classmate Xu Lang.”

Xu Lang looked at Lu Tianfeng in surprise, and couldn’t help but shrink his body, and his right hand subconsciously clenched into a fist.

“Who are you?”

Lu Tianfeng didn’t answer. He lowered his voice and pretended to be casual, “I admire your passion for learning. You’re about to attack someone, yet you still have the mind to sit here and read.”

After all, Xu Lang was just a college student. He was so confused by Lu Tianfeng’s continuous verbal attacks that he almost wanted to stand up and run away.

But Lu Tianfeng took the initiative and pressed Xu Lang’s shoulder.

“Don’t panic, young man, just answer me a few questions.” Lu Tianfeng didn’t seem to be using much effort, but he pressed Xu Lang firmly on the seat.

“Just ask.” Xu Lang said dejectedly, knowing that he had met an expert.

Lu Tianfeng still didn’t let go and asked, “Are you a member of the Nifeng Club?”

“So what…”

“Do you know Mr. Tan Jiaqiang?”

“He’s my mentor.”

“Did he ask you to come here to ambush Luo Tengfeng?” Lu Tianfeng asked questions one after another, leaving Xu Lang no time to breathe or think.

“I’m just… responsible for scaring him.” Xu Lang had no idea about Lu Tianfeng’s background and didn’t dare to lie, so he had to answer honestly.

“Did you know that Tan Jiaqiang is planning to poison Luo Tengfeng today?”

“Murder?” Xu Lang’s face turned pale in an instant, and it didn’t look like he was pretending. “How is it possible? How could this happen…”

Lu Tianfeng glanced at the English textbook in Xu Lang’s hand and asked, “If Luo Tengfeng was killed by Tan Jiaqiang, do you know what crime you would be charged with?”

“I… I…” Xu Lang’s lips trembled and he couldn’t say a word.

Lu Tianfeng reached into the drawer of Xu Lang’s seat and took out the folder inside. Xu Lang’s mouth curled up, but he didn’t say anything.

“I have confiscated this thing. As for what’s inside, I will pretend that I have never seen it.” After saying that, Lu Tianfeng put the folder under his arm and left the classroom.

Xu Lang’s problem has been solved, and now it’s Tan Jiaqiang’s turn.

Lu Tianfeng casually threw the folder into the trash can in the stairwell and walked towards the office on the top floor.

Because the department head attached great importance to Luo Tengfeng’s visit, most of the faculty and staff were assigned various reception tasks. With so much activity running around, the office seemed unusually quiet. The ticking of the wall clock was clearly audible, along with the sound of boiling water and the occasional clink of cups.

“Who is it?” A weak voice came from the innermost part of the office. Lu Tianfeng recognized it as Tan Jiaqiang’s voice.

“I’m here to see Teacher Tan.”

“It’s me. What can I do for you?” Tan Jiaqiang looked at the visitor puzzledly, with a bewildered look on his face.

Lu Tianfeng changed his tactics and went straight to the point, showing his police ID: “I’m sorry, there’s a case that requires your assistance in investigating.”

“Police?” Tan Jiaqiang looked at him with wide eyes, showing a little bit of disbelief.

“I want to ask, have you heard of the Nifeng Club?”

Tan Jiaqiang shrugged and said, “Why is this happening again? I told you all a long time ago that I founded the Nifeng Club, but I wasn’t the one making all those radical comments online. It’s no use coming to me!”

It turned out that Tan Jiaqiang did not look at the police officer’s ID carefully and mistakenly thought that Lu Tianfeng was an Internet police officer. The expression on his face suddenly relaxed a lot.

Lu Tianfeng deliberately put on a stern face and said coldly: “I’m sorry, I’m a criminal police officer, and I need to investigate a murder case.”

“Murder?” Tan Jiaqiang looked at Lu Tianfeng in confusion. “You must be mistaken, right?”

“Would it be convenient for me to take a look?” Lu Tianfeng walked forward with a slightly tough tone, reaching out to examine the snow-white ceramic tea set on the table. The moment his fingers touched the teacup, he realized that he had made a serious mistake –

In the last cycle, only the cup of tea that Tan Jiaqiang handed to Luo Tengfeng was poisonous, so there was no poison in the teapot now. He should have waited until Luo Tengfeng walked into the office before taking action.

So there was no point in checking the tea set at this point in time.

“What’s the matter, police officer?” Tan Jiaqiang asked with a hint of sarcasm in his tone, “Do you suspect I poisoned the tea?”

Lu Tianfeng was quite patient. He picked up the teapot, slowly filled himself a cup of tea, put it to his mouth and took a sip.

“High-quality tea leaves, perfect water temperature, wouldn’t it be a waste to use them to kill people?” Lu Tianfeng drank his tea leisurely, making it difficult for Tan Jiaqiang to figure out his true identity.

“I don’t know what you’re talking about…”

“But you’re not angry at all.” Lu Tianfeng put down his empty teacup. “If it were me, and a peculiar stranger rushed into my office and pointed at my nose and called me a murderer, I would be very angry.”

Tan Jiaqiang’s face turned red and white, and he moved his lips but said nothing.

“How about, let’s talk about your student Xu Lang?” Lu Tianfeng approached.

“Xu Lang…what happened to him?”

“He has been taken into custody by the police and has confessed everything.” Lu Tianfeng was not worried that Tan Jiaqiang would see through the lie later. Anyway, everything would be reset because of the subsequent time loop.

Unexpectedly, after hearing this, Tan Jiaqiang laughed. This was not a forced smile, but a smile from the heart.

“Comrade Police Officer, I really have no idea what you are talking about. Xu Lang is indeed my student, but what exactly did he do?”

Lu Tianfeng secretly groaned. He noticed that Tan Jiaqiang’s expression was completely relaxed, without any sign of oppression at all. What had gone wrong? Could it be that Tan Jiaqiang and Xu Lang had not joined forces?

That was impossible. What happened in the last cycle was enough to prove that they worked together to set up a trap against Luo Tengfeng. If that were the case, how could Tan Jiaqiang be so calm when he heard the news that Xu Lang was arrested?

Unless he was sure that the news was false.

Lu Tianfeng glanced at the phone on Tan Jiaqiang’s desk. It seemed the only plausible explanation was that Xu Lang had contacted Tan Jiaqiang immediately after being exposed. Working backwards, it became clear that Tan Jiaqiang’s misconception that Lu Tianfeng was an internet police officer had all been an act.

He never thought that this seemingly ordinary middle-aged man could be so cunning.

“Do you mind if I search you?” Lu Tianfeng decided to cut the Gordian knot1 and went straight forward to search him.

Tan Jiaqiang raised his hands above his head and said self-deprecatingly, “Even if I minded, there’s nothing I can do about it, right?”

“You can complain to me…but may I ask what this is?” Lu Tianfeng took out a small glass bottle from Tan Jiaqiang’s trouser pocket. The bottle mouth was not only corked, but also wrapped with a layer of transparent film, which was extremely carefully protected.

“This is a plant toxin. Please be careful. One drop can be fatal.”

“You admit it’s poison?”

“Why not? I’m a biologist, and this is a sample of the toxin I’m studying.”

“Carrying highly toxic research samples with you like this? Wouldn’t this violate your school’s regulations?” Lu Tianfeng asked aggressively.

“Well, it’s a bit against the rules. If the department head finds out, I might be punished.” Tan Jiaqiang had a strange smile on his face. “I never thought the criminal police would have the time and energy to manage the daily work safety regulations in our university laboratories!”

Lu Tianfeng felt a sense of frustration in his heart. He now understood that Tan Jiaqiang was also a tough nut to crack and might become a strong resistance in the next few cycles. It seemed that special police force had to be arranged to deal with him.

“I need to take this bottle back to the police station for analysis and investigation.”

“No problem, could you please give me a certificate or something?” Tan Jiaqiang said with a smile on his face. “I need this to apply for a research project. Make sure keep it safe. Please.”

CONTENT END 21

chapters.title: Chapter 22
chapters.content:
April 15th, the second cycle, 5:30 pm, in Luo Tengfeng’s private car.

The sky was still gloomy, the clouds hung very low, and the rain was intermittent, so the traffic conditions on the road seemed more congested than usual.

The “spring effect” showed a pattern again. Luo Tengfeng asked the driver to leave first, and just like the last time, he arranged for Lu Tianfeng to drive.

For Luo Tengfeng, today’s trip to D City University ended successfully. He not only stole the limelight at the lecture, but also showed a friendly image during the visit to the teaching building.

Therefore, Luo Tengfeng was now in high spirits, which was in sharp contrast to Lu Tianfeng who was driving with a sullen face.

“Captain Lu, why do you look so worried? Didn’t your trip this afternoon go smoothly?”

You think it’s going smoothly only because you haven’t noticed the unsuccessful parts—Lu Tianfeng certainly wouldn’t say that. He just smiled faintly and said, “It’s hard to describe the bitterness behind it!”

“So, X is a member of the Nifeng Club?” Luo Tengfeng’s eyes lit up.

“No, we haven’t found him yet.” Lu Tianfeng answered honestly.

“So your warning this morning is still in effect?”

“Yes, we also need to be extremely careful at tonight’s banquet.”

Luo Tengfeng couldn’t help but frown: “There are thousands of people attending this banquet. I don’t think X would dare to do anything rash, right?”

“We police officers never dare to underestimate the madness of criminals.”

In fact, it was not just Tan Jiaqiang that worried Lu Tianfeng. The several suspects under surveillance were also not easy to deal with.

According to Tong Yao’s report, Fan Minen spent over three hours at a spa and hair salon this afternoon before taking a car to the city’s famous upscale nightclub, the Paris Club. Unexpectedly, outside the club, she ran into Yu Yongsheng, the man who was responsible for monitoring Zhang Wenzhe. It turned out Zhang Wenzhe was also a shareholder in the nightclub, and Fan Minen was there specifically to meet him. What was the connection between these two individuals?

Most people who deliberately choose to “talk business” in such places operated in a gray area on the edge of the law. Therefore, the Paris Club installed a signal jammer in the private room, rendering Tong Yao’s eavesdropping device inoperable.

If it was during business hours, Yu Yongsheng could still find a way to pretend to be a customer or a waiter to sneak in and find out the information, but in broad daylight like this, with two people chatting behind closed doors, he was really helpless.

Fan Minen and Zhang Wenzhe spent nearly two hours in a secret conversation, while Tong Yao and Yu Yongsheng could only stare blankly from outside. Around 4:30 PM, Fan Minen left first, followed by Zhang Wenzhe ten minutes later. Both had blank expressions, making it impossible to guess what they had discussed.

The actions of another monitored subject, Gao Miaomiao, was simple. She had been sitting in the office working and had not gone anywhere. However, with the help of the Internet police, Huang Xuanxuan obtained Gao Miaomiao’s web browsing data and discovered that she had been searching for personal information about Chen Nuolan the entire afternoon.

Before getting off work, Gao Miaomiao logged into a professional biomedical database website and read several papers in the professional field. One of them was about a laboratory toxic leak accident, which inevitably led to a variety of associations.

After reading his subordinates’ reports, Lu Tianfeng felt his head swell.

During the previous cycle, the Bai family wedding banquet went smoothly, but a deeper investigation revealed that everyone had their own agenda.

Lu Tianfeng recalled the small conflict that broke out between Chen Nuolan and Fan Minen. Why did two people who had barely interacted have a conflict during the wedding banquet?

It seemed that Zhang Wenzhe said something to Fan Minen when they met this afternoon, which sparked her hostility towards Chen Nuolan.

Lu Tianfeng decided to send someone to sneak into the private room of the Paris Club in advance to install recording equipment in the next cycle to fill the nearly two hours of blank information.

Another destabilizing factor was Gao Miaomiao. This seemingly kind and innocent girl hid her hostility towards Chen Nuolan even deeper. Even so far, it had been impossible to accuse her of any wrongdoing. But such an unspoken enemy was more formidable. Thinking further, if Gao Miaomiao harbored hatred towards Luo Tengfeng, could she have concealed it just as seamlessly?

But if Gao Miaomiao were X, why would she kill her father?

A muffled thunder roared outside the car window, and Lu Tianfeng suddenly realized something: Gao Miaomiao wasn’t Gao Junjie’s biological daughter, but an adopted one. Could something have caused this father and daughter to become enemies?

It was no use. The more Lu Tianfeng thought about it, the more confused he became.

An inexplicable cold wind blew on Lu Tianfeng’s back. Only then did he notice that Luo Tengfeng had lowered the glass of the back seat window, and the sporadic raindrops outside were blown into the car by the wind.

“Get some fresh air, and you’ll feel more refreshed.” Luo Tengfeng said as if he saw through everything. “When driving, you still have to pay attention to safety and don’t let your mind wander to other things.”

“These are matters concerning Mr. Luo’s life and safety, so I have to think about them.”

Luo Tengfeng was silent for a moment, then he said, “Actually, in my mind, there’s one person who’s very suspicious…”

Lu Tianfeng glanced at the rearview mirror.

“This person is your wife, Fan Minen.”

Luo Tengfeng was slightly stunned, but didn’t show any particular surprise: “How did you figure that out?”

“Because you specifically arranged for the driver to avoid me. If you were talking to me about Zhang Wenzhe, Gao Miaomiao, and the others, there would be no need to do that.”

“Amazing! I admire you!” Luo Tengfeng clapped his hands lightly. “Then, Captain Lu, can you guess why I said this to you?”

“Do you need any other reason than to help the police catch the criminals who want to hurt you as soon as possible?”

Luo Tengfeng sighed and said, “But I hope you can keep a low profile during your investigation. After all, this kind of thing… is really too embarrassing.”

“Do you mind if I ask you one more question? Why do you suspect your wife?” Although he already knew the reason, Lu Tianfeng still wanted to confirm it again.

As expected, Luo Tengfeng replied in the same calm tone as in the previous cycle: “I suspect she’s having an affair.”

“With whom?”

“I don’t know…”

“Then why do you think she’s having an affair?”

Luo Tengfeng curled his lips and did not answer.

This kind of question didn’t need to be answered. An ordinary couple who spent every day together could accurately judge whether the other party had changed their mind without any substantial evidence.

Moreover, if Luo Tengfeng, whose intelligence and methods far surpass those of ordinary people, couldn’t even sense his wife’s infidelity, it would be truly bizarre.

“Understood. We will thoroughly investigate this clue.”

The rain intensified again. Luo Tengfeng rolled down the car windows, and the interior suddenly became unusually quiet.

CONTENT END 22

chapters.title: Chapter 23
chapters.content:
April 15th, second cycle, 7:00 p.m., Tianfeng Xinghua Hotel.

The banquet hall and the nearby corridors were decorated in a festive atmosphere, and the background music was constantly playing “Marry Me Today”. Because it was played so many times, it was inevitably a bit annoying to listen to.

Lu Tianfeng found himself a little impatient. His patience, which he had always been proud of, had disappeared today.

Because of the change in plan, Lu Tianfeng no longer arranged personnel to monitor the situation in the entire venue. Instead, he asked everyone to closely track and monitor their assigned targets, recording their every move, even when they went to the bathroom.

Lu Tianfeng naturally followed Luo Tengfeng closely, even canceling the brief work meeting they had held in the previous cycle. However, he had not anticipated that this small change would trigger a chain reaction.

The source of all the changes happened the moment Luo Tengfeng stepped into the banquet hall.

As a renowned and wealthy businessman in the city, Bai Zhuoqiang was naturally adept at socializing. Upon seeing Luo Tengfeng, also a prominent local figure, arrive, he immediately stepped forward to greet him. The two exchanged a warm handshake and embrace, exchanging pleasantries.

Bai Zhuoqiang noticed a man standing behind Luo Tengfeng. Although he didn’t immediately recognize him, he knew that anyone who could follow Luo Tengfeng so closely in such a social setting was likely someone of considerable importance. He stepped forward and extended his right hand to Lu Tianfeng.

Lu Tianfeng then realized that he shouldn’t be too close to Luo Tengfeng, but it was too late to step back, so he had to shake hands with Bai Zhuoqiang politely.

As a renowned and wealthy businessman in the city, Bai Zhuoqiang was naturally adept at socializing. Upon seeing Luo Tengfeng, also a prominent local figure, arrive, he immediately stepped forward to greet him. The two exchanged a warm handshake and embrace, exchanging pleasantries.

Bai Zhuoqiang noticed a man standing behind Luo Tengfeng. Although he didn’t immediately recognize him, he knew that anyone who could follow Luo Tengfeng so closely in such a social setting was likely someone of considerable importance. He stepped forward and extended his right hand to Lu Tianfeng.

Bai Zhuoqiang appeared normal, warmly welcoming Luo Tengfeng and his group to their table. But Lu Tianfeng noticed he turned and called over two black-clad security personnel, presumably those responsible for on-site security, whispering something in their ears.

Lu Tianfeng immediately contacted Yu Yongsheng: “Yongsheng, pay attention, Bai Zhuoqiang recognized me just now, and he may have recognized you as well.”

“Ah? So what?” Yu Yongsheng didn’t react for a moment.

“If it were you, what would you think if you found plainclothes officers everywhere at your wedding banquet?”

“I think… I must be in some big trouble, right?”

“That’s right, Bai Zhuoqiang thinks so too.” Lu Tianfeng looked around the banquet hall and saw people in black wearing headphones coming in from outside. Many of them were holding portable metal detectors and scanning the guests one by one.

“Boss, this might alert the enemy.”

Lu Tianfeng stamped his foot in frustration. Even if X was truly hiding in the banquet hall, he probably wouldn’t dare act rashly after seeing this situation. Then again, this unexpected round of security measures might disrupt X’s plans. So, they’d have to wait and see.

After all, today was the Bai family’s wedding, and since most of the guests present were prominent figures, the men in black responsible for security didn’t dare to be too abrupt and could only politely check each guest.

Luo Tengfeng also noticed that the atmosphere was not right. He gently touched Lu Tianfeng’s elbow and asked, “Captain Lu, did you arrange these people?”

“No, they should be security personnel hired by the Bai family.”

Lu Tianfeng felt something was amiss. The number of security personnel Bai Zhuoqiang had arranged for this wedding banquet was a bit too much. Was this because of his near-kidnapping experience last time, or was there something else going on?

Each black-clad figure who entered the scene could be considered a new variable. Adding dozens of variables at once likely exceeded the limit of the spring effect, completely altering the trajectory of fate.

The spring effect finally turned into a butterfly effect.

“Boss, what should we do?” Huang Xuanxuan’s voice came from the earpiece.

“Hold still and keep a close eye on your respective targets.”

“Sir, can I have a word with you?” Lu Tianfeng turned around and found that Bai Zhuoqiang was standing behind him.

Lu Tianfeng looked at Luo Tengfeng, and Luo Tengfeng naturally nodded gently, giving his host face. Then Bai Zhuoqiang led Lu Tianfeng across the stage of the banquet hall and all the way to the lounge prepared for the newlyweds.

“Are you a policeman?” After confirming that there was no one else in the lounge and closing the door, Bai Zhuoqiang went straight to the point.

“Yes.” Lu Tianfeng knew he couldn’t hide it and directly admitted it.

“Thank you for saving our whole family last time.” Bai Zhuoqiang took the initiative to extend his right hand to Lu Tianfeng again. This time it was obviously more enthusiastic and powerful than the previous polite handshake.

“You’re welcome. This is what the police should do.”

“But there is one thing I have never figured out. Why was the police able to know about the criminals’ actions in advance that night?” Although Bai Zhuoqiang spoke very politely, Lu Tianfeng always felt that there was a hint of questioning in his words.

“I’m sorry, this is not convenient for us…”

Unexpectedly, Bai Zhuoqiang suddenly interrupted, “Then I want to know clearly, how did the police know about what happened tonight?”

Lu Tianfeng was genuinely stunned. What exactly was this incident referring to tonight?

Bai Zhuoqiang’s usually calm expression wavered. “Whether it was my dinner at the Ronghua Restaurant last week or the letter I received this morning, there were no more than five people in my family who had access to this information. How could the police possibly know?”

Lu Tianfeng finally figured out something. It seemed that the Bai family suddenly received a threatening letter today, probably saying that the wedding would be disrupted or something like that. That’s why Bai Zhuoqiang was extremely nervous and deployed a large number of people outside the banquet hall, ready to take action immediately at any sign of trouble.

“Well…” Lu Tianfeng was really in a dilemma. He could never tell Bai Zhuoqiang that Luo Tengfeng’s life was threatened, but how should he explain it?

Just as Lu Tianfeng was hesitating, he heard Bai Zhuoqiang sigh heavily: “Since the police have intervened in this matter, I hope you will ensure my daughter’s safety no matter what…”

“That letter…can you show it to me?” Lu Tianfeng asked calmly, acting as if he already knew the whole story.

“I tore up the letter, but I took a photo of its contents.” Bai Zhuoqiang pulled out his phone and handed it to Lu Tianfeng. “Oh, what a bad year…”

On a plain white A4 sheet, scrawled in red ink, were the words: “How dare you marry someone else? I’ll destroy your body! Your entire family will be buried with you!”

It turned out that the letter was a direct threat to Bai Zhuoqiang’s beloved daughter, Bai Shiyu. On the surface, it seemed likely to be about a relationship entanglement.

It was one thing after another. With Luo Tengfeng’s situation still unresolved, how could he possibly have the energy to care about Bai Shiyu right now? However, what reassured Lu Tianfeng was that, in the previous cycle, the wedding banquet had concluded without incident. So he felt the threatening letter was likely just a threat to scare the Bai family.

“Don’t worry, there will be no problems at the wedding. I suggest you ask most of the security personnel to withdraw from the banquet hall. Sometimes the more people there are, the more trouble there would be.”

Bai Zhuoqiang pondered for a moment, then finally said, “Okay, I believe you… By the way, may I know the officer’s name?”

“My last name is Lu, Lu Tianfeng.”

“Okay, Officer Lu, I’ll let them leave now.” Bai Zhuoqiang picked up the phone and hurriedly gave orders. However, before he could finish his words, his face suddenly turned pale.

“What’s wrong?”

Bai Zhuoqiang threw down the phone and made a mad dash towards the banquet hall. Lu Tianfeng secretly thought that something was wrong and ran back as well.

At the same time, Yu Yongsheng’s voice came from the earpiece.

“Boss, something happened here…”

CONTENT END 23

chapters.title: Chapter 24
chapters.content:
The once festive banquet hall was now a shambles, with petals and balloons strewn across the floor. The neatly arranged tables and chairs were now scattered, as if ravaged by a typhoon. Many guests were scrambling for the door. In the center of the hall, a “Road of Happiness” was paved with red carpet and decorated with flowers. But the three people standing on the carpet now wore fearful expressions.

The man in the black suit, supposedly the happiest groom tonight, half-knelt on the ground, trembling with fear, with an expression that looked like he was about to cry.

“Let her go, let her go…” The groom kept repeating these three words.

A few meters away from the groom, Bai Shiyu, who was wearing a snow-white wedding dress, was being held by a tall young man with his arms around her neck, while a dagger-like object was pointed at her throat.

Bai Shiyu’s face was covered in tears, her makeup smudged, her eyes filled with confusion and fear. Her captor’s features were contorted, a scowl of fury on his face.

Lu Tianfeng quickly looked around and saw that most of the guests chose to stay as far away from the scene as possible. Although Yu Yongsheng and Huang Xuanxuan were not too far away from the hostage taker, they did not dare to act rashly.

Bai Zhuoqiang originally wanted to step forward and say a few words of advice, but after the hostage taker glared at him fiercely, he could only stand there in a daze.

“Don’t… hurt my daughter…”

Lu Tianfeng believed that the hotel and its guests had already called the police, and that police support would arrive soon. However, he did not forget his primary task and diligently searched for Luo Tengfeng in the chaotic crowd.

“Tong Yao, what’s your position?”

“I’m following Fan Minen. She ran to the terrace.” Tong Yao’s voice was very noisy and a little unclear.

“Where’s Luo Tengfeng?”

“He’s not here.”

“Yongsheng, Xuanxuan, go keep an eye on your respective targets, leave this to me.” Lu Tianfeng stared at the hostage taker intently. The dagger had already cut through the delicate white skin on Bai Shiyu’s neck, and a light red color flowed out.

Bai Shiyu was so terrified that she couldn’t even cry. Her body trembled constantly, her legs weak, and she looked like she was about to collapse.

The groom even knelt on the ground and shouted to the hostage taker: “Please, let her go, please…”

Even though he knew today would reset, and that those who had died in the previous four cycles would undoubtedly be “resurrected,” Lu Tianfeng still didn’t want to witness their deaths.

He approached the hostage taker cautiously, step by step.

“Who are you! Get back!” The man noticed Lu Tianfeng’s actions and shouted.

Lu Tianfeng opened his arms: “I’m here to help you.”

“Get lost, I don’t need help!”

“You only need her, right?” Lu Tianfeng approached slowly step by step.

“Yes!” The hostage taker’s crazy eyes revealed joy. “I need her. She also said that she would love me forever, but she wants to marry someone else!”

Lu Tianfeng actually laughed: “So she can’t fulfill her promise, unless her life ends today.”

“Oh, I didn’t expect you to be my soulmate!” The man grinned and laughed.

The conversation between Lu Tianfeng and the hostage taker not only shocked Bai Zhuoqiang and the groom, but also frightened Bai Shiyu so much that her face turned pale and her lips turned white.

“You’re quite clever, even using aluminum foil and wood as weapons.” Lu Tianfeng saw clearly that the “dagger” in the attacker’s hand was not made of metal, and quickly figured it out. “This is the only way to sneak the stuff in by hiding it from the metal detector.”

“Don’t come any closer. If you take another step forward, I will kill her!” The hostage taker finally noticed that Lu Tianfeng was getting closer and closer to him and became alert.

Poor Bai Shiyu could no longer hold on and fainted, her body falling limply into the arms of the attacker.

Lu Tianfeng stood still and said, “It’s a pity that the method you’re using to kill someone is wrong. Aluminum foil and wood can indeed be made into sharp enough weapons after repeated polishing, but this weapon has a disadvantage: the blade wears out very easily, and the wound that can be inflicted is very small.”

The hostage taker held Bai Shiyu’s waist with one hand, and the other hand holding the homemade dagger was shaking constantly.

“What…what do you mean?”

Lu Tianfeng made a throat-slitting gesture: “If you use a real dagger to cut her throat, the wound must be deep and large enough to cause heavy bleeding that cannot be saved. If you use your dagger to cut her throat, although it will cut the skin and she will bleed, but as long as she is bandaged, she will be fine.”

The man’s hands trembled even more violently.

“Why are you telling me these things?!”

“Because if you want to kill someone, you should use a dagger to pierce her heart. The heart is different from the trachea. Even the smallest wound is difficult to save. Killing someone also requires professionalism, do you understand?”

“Who are you? Get out of here! Get away!” The man was on the verge of collapse, and his dagger subconsciously left Bai Shiyu’s throat and pointed at her chest instead.

Lu Tianfeng took two steps back, then suddenly rushed forward. The hostage taker screamed and stabbed the dagger down fiercely. The onlookers turned their heads away, unable to bear to see the tragedy of blood splattering on the spot.

With a dull “bang”, Lu Tianfeng knocked the man to the ground with a hook punch, then tied his hands behind his back and held him tightly.

“Come and help!” Lu Tianfeng shouted, and several young and strong men rushed forward and tied up the hostage taker.

Bai Zhuoqiang rushed forward and hugged his daughter immediately. Although she was pale and unconscious, the wedding dress on her chest was still snow-white and there was no blood.

The dagger didn’t hurt her. Was it a miracle?

“What’s going on…” Bai Zhuoqiang asked tremblingly while holding his unconscious daughter.

Lu Tianfeng straightened his clothes and said, “It’s nothing, he just fell for my trick.”

Aluminum foil and wood weapons could “slice” with their sharp edges, but they were not as effective at “piercing” as real metal blades. Just like in everyday life, a sharp edge of ordinary printer paper could easily cut a finger, but it was unlikely to penetrate the body like a knife.

Therefore, everything Lu Tianfeng did was to prevent the hostage taker from using the “slicing” action and to trick the dagger in his hand away from Bai Shiyu’s throat. As long as this was done, Bai Shiyu would be almost impossible to get hurt. In addition, the wedding dress she was wearing had a complex pattern on the chest, with at least several layers of fabric. How could it be so easy to pierce it?

Of course, Lu Tianfeng didn’t have time to explain all this to Bai Zhuoqiang. The most urgent task was to find Luo Tengfeng.

“Everyone, report your position.”

“I’m on the terrace, Fan Minen is here.” Tong Yao said.

Yu Yongsheng and Huang Xuanxuan also reported the situation of their respective surveillance targets. Zhang Wenzhe was smoking in the hotel’s smoking area, while Gao Miaomiao was sitting in the lobby, at a loss.

“Where’s Luo Tengfeng? Has anyone seen him?”

No answer.

“And Chen Nuolan, has anyone seen Chen Nuolan?”

Still no answer.

“Damn it!”

Lu Tianfeng kicked the chair next to him, cursed himself viciously, and then started dialing Luo Tengfeng’s cellphone.

CONTENT END 24

chapters.title: Chapter 25
chapters.content:
Fortunately, the phone connected immediately.

“Mr. Luo, where are you?”

“Me? In the staff lounge.” Luo Tengfeng’s tone was very calm. “Don’t worry, your girlfriend is here too.”

Both angry and appeased, Lu Tianfeng said, “Why did you end up in a place like that?”

“Is the chaos outside over? Then let’s go back now.” Luo Tengfeng still had an indifferent tone.

A few minutes later, Luo Tengfeng and Chen Nuolan returned to the banquet hall and leisurely recounted the details of what had happened. It turned out that when Bai Shiyu had been grabbed, many guests panicked and scrambled to get out. Amidst the chaos, a man in a hotel uniform took the initiative to direct Luo Tengfeng to the staff lounge, which was reserved for the staff.

“Who was the employee who showed you the way? Was he wearing his ID card?” Lu Tianfeng asked with a suspicious look.

“Work badge?” Luo Tengfeng and Chen Nuolan exchanged glances. “I don’t think I saw one.”

“How could an employee of a hotel of this level not wear his ID card? How did he greet you at that time?”

Luo Tengfeng scratched his head. “He seemed to say, ‘Mr. Luo, please follow me this way, there’s no one on this path.’ Something like that.”

“Are you sure he called you ‘Mr. Luo’? Does that mean he knows who you are?”

“Is that so…” Luo Tengfeng was also a little uncertain and cast an inquiring look at Chen Nuolan.

Chen Nuolan said softly: “If I remember correctly, he did call out ‘Mr. Luo’.”

“How could this person recognize you?” Lu Tianfeng’s expression became more serious.

“It’s not surprising. I appear in news reports all the time. Besides, I’m safe now, so why are you so nervous?”

Lu Tianfeng shook his head. He couldn’t explain in detail to Luo Tengfeng, so he could only ask, “If that person just now wanted to harm you, would you have had a chance to ask for help from others?”

Luo Tengfeng was speechless for a moment.

“Describe the man’s appearance.”

“He was of medium build, looked to be under 30 years old, and wore a top hat. His face was not clearly visible…”

“Top hat? What top hat?” Lu Tianfeng was stunned.

Chen Nuolan added, “It’s the kind hotel doormen wear.”

“Looking back on it this way, it’s really strange.” Luo Tengfeng also realized the strangeness of it. “The man was wearing a waiter’s uniform, but he was wearing a doorman’s hat.”

“But he didn’t do anything!” Chen Nuolan was still confused. In her eyes, since the other party hadn’t made any aggressive behavior, there was no need to dwell on such a small issue.

Lu Tianfeng had completely different ideas.

If that man was really X, he was doing this to test his murder plan. This time he was able to successfully lead Luo Tengfeng to the staff lounge, and next time he might be testing the murder weapon.

Thinking deeper, Lu Tianfeng had a more terrifying guess. The hostage taking incident in the banquet hall just now was probably caused by that man. Otherwise, it would be difficult to explain why the spring effect was broken and such a serious incident occurred that was very different from the previous cycle.

It seemed that X’s understanding and application of the time loop event rules were better than Lu Tianfeng’s, but he would never give up easily.

“Everyone, please tell me the latest situation.”

“Fan Minen has been on the terrace and is now preparing to leave.”

“The wedding has been cancelled, guests are leaving the hotel in a chaotic situation, and Zhang Wenzhe is in the basement garage.”

“Gao Miaomiao is currently outside the hotel, waiting in line for a taxi.”

After listening to his subordinates’ reports, Lu Tianfeng asked, “Did anyone have private contact with the hotel staff tonight?”

“No.” The three of them gave negative answers one after another.

Lu Tianfeng pondered for a moment and said, “Today’s surveillance mission ends here for now, as X has appeared. Tong Yao, Xuanxuan, go retrieve all the surveillance footage from the banquet hall tonight and perform facial recognition screening on every person in uniform. Yongsheng, contact the hotel. I need a list and information of all the staff attending tonight’s banquet, including their ID photos. Please get it as soon as possible.”

“Clear!”

“Mr. Luo, I hope you can recognize the man just now.” Lu Tianfeng looked at Chen Nuolan meaningfully, and added, “Of course, Nuolan can also help identify the person.”

“I… didn’t look carefully…” Chen Nuolan said a little embarrassedly.

Yu Yongsheng quickly brought over the hotel staff’s information, but neither Luo Tengfeng nor Chen Nuolan could identify the man who had given them directions. Lu Tianfeng then gave the relevant information to Tong Yao and Huang Xuanxuan, asking them to help compare the surveillance footage. After a round of screening, they finally discovered a man in a work uniform who was not listed as an employee.

“This is the person!” Luo Tengfeng said, pointing at the screen.

It was a pity that the man was wearing a hat that covered most of his face. Although his figure was captured in the surveillance cameras from several angles, his face could not be seen clearly from any angle.

“This guy is really careful!” Tong Yao tried countless times but still couldn’t recognize the suspect’s face. “The angle of the hat is too subtle.”

“No matter how much the hat covers it, it can’t hide his habit. Pay attention here—” Lu Tianfeng pointed at one of the surveillance pictures, “Look, his shoulders shrugged unconsciously, and the amplitude was quite noticeable.”

“That’s right…” Tong Yao carefully watched several other video playbacks. “This person does have this habit, but finding him is still like looking for a needle in a haystack!”

“It’s better to have a clue than no clue. Who is he?” Lu Tianfeng muttered to himself.

“Boss, there’s another strange thing. We’ve also compared and analyzed the surveillance videos outside the banquet hall, including the corridors and hotel lobby, and we haven’t found the mysterious man in uniform again,” said Huang Xuanxuan.

“So this person either left through another passage, or changed his clothes…” However, with thousands of people at the banquet and the chaos caused by the hostage taking, it was impossible to find out how the mysterious person left the scene.

“Boss, shall we request reinforcements and thoroughly analyze all the surveillance footage? After all, there aren’t many people who habitually shrug their shoulders like him. As long as we spend some time, we’ll definitely be able to find it.” Yu Yongsheng’s suggestion was a conventional investigative approach, but he didn’t know that there were only a few hours left today before he would jump into the next cycle and live “today” all over again, so this tactic of investing manpower and time in analysis was meaningless.

“No, it’s too late…” Lu Tianfeng’s mind was working rapidly. X couldn’t be invincible. He must find X’s loopholes.

That’s right! If the hostage taker’s actions were different from the previous cycle because of X’s interference, then by analyzing the hostage taker’s whereabouts, we might be able to find evidence of X’s contact with him!

“How’s the man who took Bai Shiyu hostage?”

“He was taken away. I have to ask to find out which police station he was sent to…”

“Contact them immediately. I want to interrogate him personally.” Lu Tianfeng glanced at the time. “Tong Yao, you’ll be in charge of making the arrangements and contacts. I hope to be able to interrogate the suspect within the hour. Yongsheng and Xuanxuan, the two of you will be in charge of escorting Mr. Luo home. Have headquarters send reinforcements to take over and keep a close eye on the suspects.”

“Boss, what about you?” Yu Yongsheng asked with a hint of sarcasm in his tone.

“I’m going to report to Captain Cheng…” Lu Tianfeng was halfway through his words when he realized what Yu Yongsheng’s strange tone meant. All the people at the scene had been arranged, but only Chen Nuolan had been left aside, and he actually ignored this.

“Nuolan, you…”

“I can just take a taxi back to the dormitory by myself.” Chen Nuolan said lightly. Perhaps only Lu Tianfeng would notice that she said “dormitory” instead of “home”.

“Be careful on the road…” Because what happened today would be reset in a few hours and disappear without a trace, Lu Tianfeng must not miss this only opportunity to investigate.

He looked at Chen Nuolan, begging her with his eyes to understand him, but she had already turned her head away and didn’t look at him.

Of course, this little conflict would only last until midnight tonight and would not have any impact on their future relationship, but for some reason, Lu Tianfeng still felt inexplicably depressed.

“Captain Lu, we’ve made contact. The suspect who attacked and took Bai Shiyu hostage is named Qin Dazhi. He is currently detained at the Langhua Road Police Station and is being prepared for interrogation.” Tong Yao was indeed efficient and effective.

“Okay, I’ll be right there.”

Lu Tianfeng glanced at Chen Nuolan again, but she was looking elsewhere. Or maybe she didn’t want to look at anything, just didn’t want to look at him.

CONTENT END 25

chapters.title: Chapter 26
chapters.content:
April 15th, second cycle, 9:30 p.m., Langhua Road Police Station.

The interrogation room contained only four gray walls, a wooden door, a simple square table, and two round wooden stools. Qin Dazhi sat on one of the stools, his hands cuffed and placed neatly on the table. His clothes were a little disheveled, his eyes bloodshot and empty.

The door opened and Lu Tianfeng walked into the interrogation room alone.

“You are actually a policeman?” Qin Dazhi’s wandering eyes finally found their focus and he stared straight at Lu Tianfeng.

“Yes.”

“I thought you could understand how I feel…”

“Just because I understand you doesn’t mean you can break the law.” Lu Tianfeng shrugged and threw Qin Dazhi’s personal file on the table. “I see that you come from a wealthy family, graduated from a prestigious foreign university, and have achieved some success in your career. Why would you go through such actions?”

“I… I love her…” Qin Dazhi’s tone began to become excited, “She deceived me, she abandoned me…”

“Actually, I think you’re a different kind of person—you love Bai Shiyu, but you also hate her, and you even prepared a murder weapon in advance. But on the night of the wedding banquet, you hesitated again and again, still unwilling to personally ruin the happy moment of your beloved woman…” What Lu Tianfeng said was actually what happened in the first cycle. “Isn’t this the normal behavior of Qin Dazhi?”

Qin Dazhi widened his eyes in panic. He simply couldn’t understand how this policeman, who had only met him once, could describe his mental journey so accurately.

“You… I…”

“But what exactly went wrong? Why did you suddenly become angry with Bai Shiyu?” Lu Tianfeng pushed a printed photo in front of Qin Dazhi, “Is it because of him?”

The blurry photo showed the mysterious man wearing a waiter’s uniform but a doorman’s hat.

“Who is this person?” Qin Dazhi looked confused.

“You haven’t seen him?”

“I didn’t notice.” He shook his head repeatedly.

Lu Tianfeng frowned and asked again, “Do you remember what happened before you angrily attacked Bai Shiyu? What made you so impulsive?”

“I… let me think…” Qin Dazhi pressed his temple, his face full of pain. “Oh, right, there was a group of strange men in black in the banquet hall. They seemed to be searching for something…”

Lu Tianfeng did not interrupt Qin Dazhi, letting him recall the past slowly by himself.

“A lot of people were discussing what had happened. Then the waiter standing next to me said something… He said there was someone among the guests with ill intentions towards the bride, and we had to find that bastard now…”

Qin Dazhi’s body began to tremble uncontrollably.

“Everyone started talking at once, and some people even said some pretty unpleasant things. I was already a little nervous, and then I felt even more like I’d been exposed…”

“So you just decided to go all out and kidnap Bai Shiyu?”

“I… I was so confused at the time that I can’t even remember what I did… When I came to my senses, I had already put the knife to Shiyu’s neck…”

Qin Dazhi covered his face with his hands and lowered his head, unable to hide his inner regret.

Lu Tianfeng finally asked the most crucial question: “Did you see the face of the waiter who suddenly interrupted?”

“Ah?” Qin Dazhi was stunned. “I turned my head and glanced at him at the time, but I didn’t have any special impression.”

“But you still saw his face.”

“Yes.” Qin Dazhi, who had no idea what Lu Tianfeng meant, said with a timid tone.

“Try hard to recall, this is very important.” Lu Tianfeng paused and said to him soothingly, “According to police intelligence, this person is very likely an enemy of the Bai family. He was fanning the flames at the banquet and wanted to ruin the wedding. If you can help us find him, it will be equivalent to meritorious service and can reduce the punishment. Do you understand?”

Anyway, it wouldn’t cause any impact, so Lu Tianfeng didn’t care about fooling Qin Dazhi with nonsense. The key was to find that man.

When Qin Dazhi heard about the possibility of a sentence reduction, his eyes immediately lit up and he nodded repeatedly, “Don’t worry, I remember him. Anyone who I’ve seen once I can remember! He has small eyes and a high nose bridge…”

“Don’t worry, I’ll have a colleague make you a jigsaw puzzle portrait of the suspect,” Lu Tianfeng thought. A mere description wouldn’t be reliable; a picture would be better. As long as he could remember the man’s general appearance, even if he didn’t have time to investigate him during this cycle, he’d still have a full 24 hours to use during the next one. Lu Tianfeng suddenly felt a surge of confidence, as if victory was just around the corner.

It was just ten o’clock in the evening, and this cycle would end in two hours.

“The finished portrait must be sent to me before 11 o’clock. I have some urgent matters to deal with now.” After a brief handover with his colleague, Lu Tianfeng immediately rushed to the Luo family.

Lu Tianfeng now felt that there were too many mysteries surrounding this woman, Fan Minen, and she was connected to too many people and things.

In the last cycle, the brief but inexplicable conflict between Fan Min’en and Chen Nuolan still bothered Lu Tianfeng. However, in this cycle, due to the series of unexpected events at the Bai family’s wedding banquet, the conflict did not occur again, and Lu Tianfeng lost an opportunity to learn the truth.

The relationship between Fan Minen and Zheng Yuanzhi could be considered complicated and difficult to sort out, and it was really unbelievable that she and Zhang Wenzhe, two people who seemed to have little intersection at all, actually met and talked privately at this critical juncture.

Another interesting point was that in both cycles, Luo Tengfeng mentioned to Lu Tianfeng that he had begun to suspect Fan Minen of cheating, but neither time did he say what specifically made him suspicious.

Lu Tianfeng decided to try to question Fan Minen face to face. Although it might cause some unpleasant conflicts, since he was in a time loop today, he didn’t need to worry about the consequences – because there would be no real “consequences”.

However, when Lu Tianfeng arrived at the Luo family villa, he only saw Tong Yao sitting alone in the living room organizing documents. The room was quiet, and Luo Tengfeng and Fan Minen were nowhere to be seen.

“Where are the two of them?” Lu Tianfeng asked curiously. Luo Tengfeng and his wife were typical night owls. After a few days of contact, he had never seen them go to bed before one in the morning.

“Fan Minen said she was frightened in the hotel and took half a sleeping pill as soon as she got home, so Luo Tengfeng also slept with her.”

Lu Tianfeng didn’t say anything, but pointed to his ear to ask whether the eavesdropping was still going on.

Tong Yao shook her head slightly. This was a very natural choice. After all, Lu Tianfeng had not gone through any formal procedures when issuing this mission. It was a bit too much to ask Tong Yao to eavesdrop on a couple sleeping in the same bed.

Lu Tianfeng smiled bitterly. Throughout the whole day, Fan Minen left too many mysteries. It seemed that in the next cycle, more people would need to be sent to investigate her.

At that moment, the Langhua Road Police Station also sent over a newly completed portrait of the suspect. Lu Tianfeng frowned at the sight. The man in the portrait had a high nose bridge, thick eyebrows, and a full beard—all relatively recognizable features. However, only the nose was difficult to disguise; the eyebrows and beard were likely fake. Therefore, the portrait’s reference value was limited.

Tong Yao also asked curiously: “Is this a portrait of that mysterious man?”

“Well, we still have a little time. Let’s quickly compare the hotel’s surveillance footage and see if we can find a clear frontal image of this guy.”

“Ah?” Tong Yao was a little surprised. “Captain Lu, I can still hold on. Don’t worry.”

Lu Tianfeng knew that he had spoken out of turn, because he was subconsciously very clear that Tong Yao only had more than an hour to investigate. But in Tong Yao’s opinion, she felt that it would be no problem to work overtime, and that she would be able to find the suspect by staying up all night.

“Nothing, just keep working harder.” Lu Tianfeng changed the subject. It was almost eleven o’clock, and he had to go home to sort out the information and data he had obtained today.

As the saying goes, a good memory is not as good as a bad pen, but in the time loop, Lu Tianfeng could only rely on his own head to remember all the important clues, and then at the beginning of the next loop, he would write down the clues as completely as possible.

So now he needed some time and space alone.

CONTENT END 26

chapters.title: Chapter 27
chapters.content:
Lu Tianfeng opened the door again. The same darkness, the same coldness, the same loneliness. This small room seemed to be his entire world.

He sat at his desk, taking a deep breath as usual, but his thoughts seemed particularly chaotic today, and his heart couldn’t calm down. Facing the blank page in his notebook, he felt an inexplicable urge to tear it up.

“What’s wrong with me?”

Lu Tianfeng gritted his teeth, lowered his head and wrote quickly, and finally completed his ideas for the second cycle before midnight.

The biggest breakthrough today was undoubtedly two key figures, one obvious and one hidden. The obvious one is Fan Minen, who has always been listed as one of the suspects but has not received much attention; the hidden one was the mysterious man whose identity was a complete mystery but who quietly changed the pace of fate at the Bai family’s wedding banquet.

Lu Tianfeng also had a bolder guess. The mysterious man was not necessarily X himself. He may just be controlled by X. But in any case, he should be able to find out X’s true identity through him.

Therefore, the focus of the third round of investigation was on the content related to these two people:

The true relationship between Fan Minen and Zheng Yuanzhi:

Why did Luo Tengfeng suspect Fan Minen of having an affair?

Why did Fan Minen meet with Zhang Wenzhe?

The reason for the conflict between Fan Minen and Chen Nuolan, which occurred in the first cycle but not in the second.

Did Fan Minen have any connection with the mysterious man?

All more detailed information about the mysterious man.

Lu Tianfeng then listed several other points that also require special attention:

The specific situation of Zheng Yuanzhi’s work.

The relationship between Zhang Wenzhe and Fan Minen.

Whether Gao Miaomiao harbors hostility towards Chen Nuolan.

The relationship between Gao Miaomiao and her adoptive father Gao Junjie.

After writing the above, Lu Tianfeng hesitated for a long time before adding another line:

What is the relationship between Chen Nuolan and this series of events?

Was it really a coincidence that Luo Tengfeng chose today to promote Chen Nuolan? Often, one couldn’t immediately discern the cause and effect of a situation. Perhaps Chen Nuolan’s promotion was the source of the chain reaction.

Completely different from his previous experiences, after sorting out what happened today, Lu Tianfeng did not feel that his thoughts became clearer. Instead, he seemed to be walking deeper and deeper into a fog.

If in the first cycle, Lu Tianfeng saw the dangerous trap set by the hunter, then in this cycle, he managed to avoid the trap, but stepped into the quagmire. Even more terrifying, he found himself in the center of the swamp, surrounded by bottomless pits one after another. Once fallen in, it would be impossible to climb out.

Now the situation he least wanted to see had happened. Chen Nuolan had also fallen into the swamp. Her body was sinking at a speed visible to the naked eye. The muddy water had already submerged her knees. She screamed desperately. Lu Tianfeng stretched out his right hand, trying to pull her back, but no matter how hard he tried, he could not reach her hand because he himself was also trapped in the sticky mud…

The phone suddenly rang, and Lu Tianfeng jumped out of the swamp and finally came to his senses. It was less than five minutes until midnight. While secretly thanking the caller, he answered the call and heard unexpected good news.

“Hello, is this Team Lu?”

“Yes, who is it?”

“I’m Xiao Yu from the Langhua Road Police Station. The suspect portrait you just instructed us to draw has been released through the system. I didn’t expect to receive a response so immediately.”

“Oh? Found the suspect?”

“I found a suspect with a very high match in the database. I’ll send you his information right away.”

“Thank you, you’ve worked hard!” This surprise felt like it came out of nowhere. Lu Tianfeng had always thought that the mysterious man would not be so easy to find.

However, Lu Tianfeng quickly calmed down. Since the police were able to find this person so quickly, the probability that he was X was even lower. It was impossible for X to be exposed so easily.

Xiao Yu quickly sent over the information. The suspect’s name was Mo Rui. His registered occupations were actor, lighting technician, and prop master, but he was actually a marginal figure in the film and television industry, relying on various menial tasks on set to make a living. Last month, he was caught on the subway with flammable and explosive items and reported to the police. He finally explained that they were props needed by a TV drama’s explosives crew and paid a fine. Although he didn’t have a formal criminal record, it was still recorded in the city’s networked criminal database.

After reading this information, Lu Tianfeng became more convinced that this guy who lived at the bottom of society and was impulsive by nature should not be X, but why did he appear at the Bai family’s wedding banquet wearing a hotel waiter’s uniform?

Since there was no time to conduct a detailed investigation, Lu Tianfeng had to write down the two words “Mo Rui” and leave it for discussion in the next cycle.

“There’s always light at the end of the tunnel!” Lu Tianfeng looked at the time. With only one minute left in “today”, he finally had a rare breakthrough.

However, just a few seconds before midnight, Lu Tianfeng’s phone rang again, and the caller ID showed “Nuolan”.

Chen Nuolan had a very regular sleep schedule. Unless there were special circumstances, she would go to bed at 11 p.m. every night. Why would she suddenly call him at midnight today? Furthermore, the two of them had long been accustomed to communicating via text messages or chat apps, and they wouldn’t call unless it was urgent.

But what could be so urgent at this time?

Lu Tianfeng was just about to swipe the screen to answer the call when his vision blurred. In the blink of an eye, he was back to the very beginning of the day, and the phone was gone. He sat there, first opening his empty right hand, then slowly clenching it into a fist, as if trying to grasp something, but finding nothing.

Lu Tianfeng felt empty in his heart. The joy and satisfaction brought by the latest suspect Mo Rui were completely destroyed by this missed call. What made him even more uncomfortable was that he might never know why Chen Nuolan was looking for him.

Even if you didn’t know what you’ve lost, the feeling of loss was still painful.

In order not to miss anything else, Lu Tianfeng rushed to the desk and began to quickly write down clues one after another on the white paper…

CONTENT END 27

chapters.title: Chapter 28
chapters.content:
April 15th, third cycle, 1 a.m.

At Luo Tengfeng’s home, an emergency meeting was held that was almost identical to the second cycle. Everyone reacted exactly the same as in the second cycle, as if it was a movie being replayed. Faced with the somewhat strange task requirements, everyone was eager to get started and their spirits were high. However, Lu Tianfeng had not yet fully recovered from the regret of missing Chen Nuolan’s call at the last moment of the previous cycle, and was a little absent-minded.

“Also, I require you to monitor the entire process…”

“Boss, you mentioned the monitoring issue once just now!” Yu Yongsheng raised his hand to ask a question.

“Ah, sorry, I meant that we need to install an additional micro-recording device on Fan Minen to prevent the signal from being blocked…”

“Signal blocking?” Tong Yao stared at Lu Tianfeng in astonishment. “Is it just targeting Fan Minen?”

“Yes.” Lu Tianfeng knew it was too much to explain, so he ignored Tong Yao’s confusion and turned to Yu Yongsheng. “Yongsheng, I’ve received a tip that Fan Minen might meet with Zhang Wenzhe this afternoon. Tong Yao and other colleagues will be responsible for monitoring him during this time. You have at least two hours of free time to carry out a special mission.”

Yu Yongsheng was also stunned. He didn’t understand why Lu Tianfeng could come up with such a precise arrangement, but since he had long followed Lu Tianfeng’s lead, he still responded without hesitation: “Understood!”

Lu Tianfeng casually tore off a sticky note and wrote the words “Mo Rui” on it: “This guy is a second-rate actor. Find a reason to bring him back to the police station and let me question him.”

“Understood!”

Yu Yongsheng agreed readily, but Tong Yao frowned. Lu Tianfeng had issued several inexplicable orders today, which made her suspicious.

“Captain Lu…”

“I know what you want to say, but please trust me.” Lu Tianfeng first looked at Tong Yao with an extremely sincere gaze, then glanced at the others present one by one. “For today only, I hope that each of you can trust me unconditionally and carry out the tasks I assign, even if some of the tasks seem unreasonable. Do you understand?”

When he said the last few words, Lu Tianfeng suddenly raised his voice and used a more serious commanding tone. The other three immediately stood at attention subconsciously and said in unison: “Understood!”

Huang Xuanxuan added, “Boss, do you have any special arrangements on my side?”

“Not yet.”

“Oh…” For some reason, Huang Xuanxuan seemed a little disappointed.

Lu Tianfeng smiled bitterly in his heart. He knew that as the number of cycles increased, the instructions he gave would only become more and more strange. He hoped that he could control the emotions of the young people in front of him.

“Okay, everyone, go to bed early. Tomorrow is another hard day.”

As expected, just like the last time, Yu Yongsheng and Huang Xuanxuan left the room, but Tong Yao stayed there without saying a word. She looked at Lu Tianfeng hesitantly, as if she wanted to wait for Lu Tianfeng to speak first.

Lu Tianfeng deliberately remained silent, and Tong Yao finally couldn’t help but break the silence.

“Captain Lu, are you sure X is connected to these three people? What if…”

Lu Tianfeng laughed. The reason he laughed was that Tong Yao’s words were exactly the same as the last time, but Tong Yao seemed to mistakenly think that he was mocking her immaturity, and a blush appeared on her pretty face.

“Go to bed early, don’t worry too much.” Lu Tianfeng said confidently, “I have a feeling that there will be a major breakthrough in the case today.”

Tong Yao nodded thoughtfully, then said, “Captain Lu, I believe you. Please believe me too.”

“Huh?” Lu Tianfeng was a little stunned.

“I always feel that there are some things that you have been carrying by yourself… I’m sorry, I spoke too much.” Perhaps noticing that Lu Tianfeng’s expression became stiff, Tong Yao quickly changed the subject.

Lu Tianfeng showed a smile that was both relieved and bitter: “Thank you.”

Tong Yao blinked curiously, moved her lips, and left without saying anything else.

Lu Tianfeng slowly turned around, faced the endless darkness outside the window, and sighed heavily.

CONTENT END 28

chapters.title: Chapter 29
chapters.content:
April 15th, third cycle, 6:00 a.m.

Lu Tianfeng was already dressed and standing at the entrance of the villa, alert and full of energy, waiting for Luo Tengfeng to appear. The sky was a gray-blue, with a unique charm, and as it gradually brightened, he couldn’t help but think of the call from Chen Nuolan.

What exactly was she trying to say? Should he test the waters when he met her at ROOST later? But how should he test the waters?

“Captain Lu, good morning.” A sweet female voice brought Lu Tianfeng back to reality. He turned his head and saw that the person who appeared in front of him was Fan Minen, who was wearing a nightgown and looked confused, instead of Luo Tengfeng.

This nightgown was too revealing, the white gauze was almost transparent, and Lu Tianfeng quickly looked away.

“Good morning, Mrs. Luo.”

As Lu Tianfeng subconsciously uttered these words, doubts welled up in his mind. Luo Tengfeng had always been inexplicably obsessed with morning exercises, and nothing had happened during the first two cycles. Why had things changed this time?

Fan Minen half-closed her eyes, yawned, and continued to explain, “I’m sorry, Tengfeng had some urgent work to do. It was already past four in the morning when he finished and went to bed, so he wanted to sleep a little longer, so I came to let you know.”

“What?” Perhaps because Lu Tianfeng’s reaction was a bit exaggerated, a confused expression appeared on Fan Minen’s face.

“Uh…is there any problem?” After all, Fan Minen was a night owl who was used to going to bed late and getting up late. She rubbed her eyes hard, looking like she was about to fall asleep again at any moment.

“It’s nothing, I understand.” Lu Tianfeng quickly lowered his head to hide his panic.

Fan Minen yawned repeatedly and turned to leave without saying anything else. Lu Tianfeng stood there in a daze, his heart in turmoil.

This cycle had just begun, and Lu Tianfeng had hardly done anything to try to change the course of fate, but Luo Tengfeng’s trajectory of action had undergone earth-shaking changes, which was a phenomenon he had never encountered in so many previous time loop experiences.

No, not only did Luo Tengfeng’s movements change, but Fan Minen’s words and deeds were also very different. At least Lu Tianfeng had never seen this rich lady get up early in the morning and wander around the house in a sexy nightgown.

“What’s going on…” Lu Tianfeng sighed. Five minutes ago, he was full of confidence and ready to face all challenges, but now he was extremely depressed by this sudden change.

The only reasonable explanation is that X did something to change the course of events “today”, but what did X do? Why did Lu Tianfeng hardly feel the existence of the spring effect?

Fear, tension, anticipation.

The three emotions intertwined and spread in Lu Tianfeng’s heart. He felt that he had always underestimated X. It was not until this moment that he truly realized that he actually knew nothing about the deep principles of the time loop.

But X’s strength was far superior to his.

“Captain Lu?” Another female voice pulled Lu Tianfeng from his thoughts. This time it was Tong Yao.

“Morning, how’s it going?”

“After Fan Minen returned to the bedroom, she fell asleep within a few minutes.”

“Where’s Luo Tengfeng?”

“I didn’t hear his voice. I guess he’s still sleeping.” Tong Yao looked at Lu Tianfeng curiously, obviously not understanding why he cared so much about these trivial matters.

Lu Tianfeng hesitated for a moment and said, “Today’s mission may be particularly difficult, so you must be extra careful.”

Although Tong Yao didn’t understand why Lu Tianfeng said that, she still answered seriously and firmly: “I understand. Please rest assured, Captain Lu!”

Lu Tianfeng seemed to see Tong Yao again in the early hours of the morning, solemnly saying to him, “Please trust me.” He nodded and casually asked, “Has Luo Tengfeng’s schedule for today not been released yet?”

“Huh? It’s out. I sent the email at around 3am.”

Lu Tianfeng then realized that he had missed the new email notification message on his mobile phone, so he immediately opened the itinerary and found something wrong at first glance.

Luo Tengfeng’s first schedule today was to attend the internal shareholder meeting held at Feng Teng Gene at 10 a.m., and there was no breakfast meeting that had appeared in the previous two cycles.

So Lu Tianfeng and Chen Nuolan would not meet at the ROOST restaurant this morning.

“Another person’s trajectory has completely changed…” Lu Tianfeng muttered to himself and took out the notebook in his arms.

The battle plan prepared in advance was almost completely scrapped in just a few minutes.

“Captain Lu, is there anything wrong with this itinerary?” Perhaps noticing that Lu Tianfeng was absent-mindedly looking at his notebook, Tong Yao asked with concern.

Lu Tianfeng had an idea and decided to take this opportunity to use Tong Yao’s opinions and perspectives to analyze the situation and try to find his own blind spots in thinking.

So Lu Tianfeng asked: “What do you think?”

“I think…” Tong Yao hesitated for a moment, then expressed her opinion. “The afternoon event at D City University and the evening wedding banquet are both crowded places, posing a significant safety risk.”

This was a very conventional view and did not bring any surprises or accidents to Lu Tianfeng.

“So if you can only choose one, which activity do you think is more dangerous?”

Tong Yao thought silently for a long time before saying, “It should be D City University.”

“Why?” In fact, this answer was a bit beyond Lu Tianfeng’s expectations, because according to common sense, there were more suspects gathered at the Bai family’s wedding banquet, and it should be an occasion with a more complicated situation.

“Luo Tengfeng has a close connection with D City University. It’s his alma mater, and the prototype of RAN technology was developed in a D City University laboratory. Many of his current connections and social relationships can be traced back to his university days.”

Seeing Lu Tianfeng lost in thought, Tong Yao added, “In the eyes of outsiders, Luo Tengfeng is the darling of D City University and one of its most successful representatives. But I’ve always believed that love and hate are two sides of the same coin. Just as Luo Tengfeng attracts love, he also attracts hatred and jealousy.”

Lu Tianfeng sighed: “That’s a good sentence, it sounds quite reasonable.”

Tong Yao felt a little embarrassed after hearing what Lu Tianfeng said.

“Tong Yao, there’s something I’d like you to investigate.”

“Captain Lu, please speak.” Tong Yao realized that there must be a reason for Lu Tianfeng’s sudden politeness.

“You reminded me that we’ve been overlooking the connection between Luo Tengfeng and D City University. I want you to check among the current faculty and staff at D City University to see which ones have had close ties with Luo Tengfeng. Perhaps they were friends, or perhaps they were sworn enemies. There might be some hidden murderous intentions hidden among them.”

“Got it. No problem.”

“We must not relax our surveillance of Fan Minen. If necessary, I can request two more people to come and help, is that okay?”

Tong Yao nodded vigorously: “Don’t worry, Captain Lu. Leave everything to me.”

“Very good.” Lu Tianfeng patted her shoulder gently.

Tong Yao seemed to stiffen for a moment, but a relaxed smile soon appeared on her face. Is this the trust she wanted?

Lu Tianfeng knew very well that if he wanted to defeat X, he had to rely on the strength of the team in front of him and could not fight alone.

CONTENT END 29

chapters.title: Chapter 30
chapters.content:
April 15th, third cycle, 10:00 a.m.

A shareholders’ meeting was underway in Feng Teng Gene’s conference room.

Just now, Lu Tianfeng took advantage of the little free time before the meeting started to quickly review the developments of all parties from morning to now.

Luo Tengfeng slept until after eight o’clock and then began to prepare for work. During this time, Lu Tianfeng kept a close eye on the latest developments of other suspects.

What made Lu Tianfeng feel a little relieved was that Zhang Wenzhe and Gao Miaomiao’s routes of action were basically the same as the previous cycle, without any major deviations.

Zhang Wenzhe had been playing racing games online since early in the morning, enjoying it endlessly. He looked nothing like a senior executive at a major company, but more like a teenager addicted to the internet. Following Lu Tianfeng’s instructions, Yu Yongsheng investigated Zhang Wenzhe’s gaming data and discovered that he was simply killing time and hadn’t interacted with anyone else in the game.

Gao Miaomiao remained the same frugal and simple girl. After getting up, she simply washed up, started doing housework and made breakfast, and even studied on the way to work. She was really the typical “good kid next door”. Judging from her appearance, it wasw hard to imagine that she was so wary of Chen Nuolan.

But maybe in this cycle, Gao Miaomiao would not pay so much attention to Chen Nuolan, because the breakfast meeting was cancelled, and Chen Nuolan should not have been promoted by Luo Tengfeng to the Chief Assistant of the R&D department.

This cycle unfolded with a rather bizarre twist. First, the series of changes that occurred early in the morning left Lu Tianfeng feeling profoundly powerless. He had mentally prepared himself for one daunting challenge after another. Unexpectedly, however, the ensuing hours unfolded with a rather dull, quiet calm. Lu Tianfeng felt a surge of energy, yet he had nowhere to direct it.

Even now, when Luo Tengfeng was sitting in the conference room, meeting with Zhang Wenzhe, Gao Miaomiao and others, the topic was also dull and boring. Zhang Wenzhe even yawned again and again, making no effort to hide his fatigue.

Halfway through the meeting, Luo Tengfeng suddenly interrupted, “By the way, there’s a new personnel change around me, and I’d like to inform you all now.”
