Zhang Wenzhe and Gao Miaomiao immediately perked up. Lu Tianfeng, who had been listening, was even more puzzled. Could it be that Luo Tengfeng would directly promote Chen Nuolan without communicating with her?

“I want to add a new assistant to the president, and I have already found a suitable candidate.”

“New assistant?” Zhang Wenzhe said with a sarcastic smile, “Isn’t Tina doing a pretty good job?”

“Tina’s expertise lies in administrative matters, and I also need an assistant who can assist me in scientific research and technology.”

As soon as these words were spoken, the eyes of the three people in the conference room lit up at the same time, but for different reasons.

Lu Tianfeng’s eyes were filled with concern and worry. He didn’t expect that things would take such a turn and lead to his girlfriend again, and this time the title was changed. He didn’t know how the follow-up development would be.

Zhang Wenzhe’s eyes were full of vigilance. He realized that Luo Tengfeng would not promote a personal assistant for no reason. Moreover, the position of chief scientist in the R&D department was vacant. This assistant who came out of nowhere was probably appointed by Luo Tengfeng in order to “save the country in a roundabout way” and gain actual power in the R&D department.

Gao Miaomiao’s face was filled with hope and anticipation. She probably believed she was the perfect candidate for the technical assistant position. She knew her abilities and reputation weren’t enough for a management position, which was why she insisted on starting as an ordinary employee. But becoming Luo Tengfeng’s personal assistant would be a different story. While seemingly humble, it actually put her very close to the center of power.

Luo Tengfeng didn’t seem to notice the change in everyone’s expressions at all, and continued to speak slowly: “The best candidate in my mind is Chen Nuolan from the R&D department.”

Subtle and complex emotions flashed across the faces of the other three people, especially Gao Miaomiao. Her face first turned pale, then flushed red, her lips trembled slightly, and finally she lowered her head without saying a word.

“Oh…” Zhang Wenzhe drew out the last word, holding his chin, as if thinking about something.

Lu Tianfeng’s mood was the most complicated, but he could only pretend to be an outsider and watch the development of the situation coldly. However, he still had a question in his mind: why didn’t Chen Nuolan attend this meeting?

“If you have no objection, let’s move on to the next topic…”

“Please wait, where is Chen Nuolan?” Zhang Wenzhe asked this question.

“I didn’t arrange for her to attend this meeting.” Luo Tengfeng replied with a smile.

“At a time like this, she should show up.”

“She has another important task to attend to today. Besides, we don’t need to discuss this matter. I’m just taking this opportunity to inform everyone.”

Zhang Wenzhe couldn’t help but ask, “Is she given an important task right after being promoted?”

“She already has many important tasks on her shoulders.”

Luo Tengfeng and Zhang Wenzhe were arguing with each other, speaking back and forth at a very fast pace, and the atmosphere in the conference room became tense.

After hearing Luo Tengfeng’s strong words, Zhang Wenzhe smiled instead of getting angry and said, “Mr. Luo should have heard about the recent rumors about you and your female subordinate. They haven’t had a good impact.”

Luo Tengfeng replied calmly, “Mr. Zhang knows that these are just rumors, so please don’t waste our shareholders’ meeting’s precious time.”

“The rumors may be false, but the negative impact is real. For the benefit of the company, Mr. Luo should at least avoid suspicion appropriately instead of promoting the woman involved in the scandal to his personal assistant.”

Luo Tengfeng’s expression changed, and he stared at Zhang Wenzhe. Zhang Wenzhe continued to smile, as if he didn’t realize that his words had gone too far.

Lu Tianfeng appeared calm on the surface, but he was already feeling inexplicably anxious. He hadn’t anticipated Chen Nuolan’s absence, which had led to an even more intense verbal conflict. He stole another glance at Gao Miaomiao, who seemed to be sitting nonchalantly, but was actually rubbing her fingers back and forth on the conference table, unable to conceal her nervousness.

“Mr. Zhang, do you mean that I can’t distinguish between public and private affairs and am favoring people based on personal connections?” Luo Tengfeng’s tone was cold and contained obvious aggressiveness.

“Mr. Luo is an upright person. I know that.” Zhang Wenzhe was really calm and kept a smile on his face. “I’m just worried that others will misunderstand.”

“I wonder what Mr. Zhang has to say?”

“If Mr. Luo feels it is necessary to add a new technical assistant position, I have a very good candidate to recommend, and I guarantee that no one will gossip about it.” Zhang Wenzhe said as he turned his gaze to Gao Miaomiao.

Gao Miaomiao’s face turned red and white, and her expression became even uglier. Zhang Wenzhe’s hint was already very obvious. She definitely couldn’t continue to play dumb, but she really didn’t know how to respond at the moment.

Fortunately, Luo Tengfeng didn’t let Gao Miaomiao feel embarrassed for too long. He took the initiative to take over the topic: “I need someone with greater professional expertise to serve as my assistant. Although Miaomiao is from this field, she hasn’t completed her graduate studies after all. Chen Nuolan, on the other hand, is a returned overseas doctoral student and is known as a genius in this field. The difference in ability between the two is still very obvious. Do you agree?”

The last question was thrown directly to Gao Miaomiao, and she blurted out: “I agree…”

“Very good. It seems that Mr. Zhang can’t find anyone to replace Chen Nuolan for the time being?” Luo Tengfeng, who regained the upper hand, smiled again.

“In that case, I won’t say much more.” Zhang Wenzhe was able to let go of things easily, and actually stopped there and no longer dwelled on this topic.

The conference room suddenly fell into a strange silence. Everyone had their own thoughts, but no one was willing to speak first to break the deadlock.

At this moment, Luo Tengfeng’s phone on the table suddenly vibrated. He looked down at the caller ID and smiled brightly. When the call was connected, Luo Tengfeng spoke fluent English at a very fast speed. With Lu Tianfeng’s poor English, he could hardly understand what he said.

The call was quickly disconnected, and Luo Tengfeng smiled and said to everyone, “Everyone, I have good news. We are all well aware of the recent cash flow pressure on the company. And just now, the internationally renowned venture capital firm Volly has extended an olive branch to us. They are very interested in our company.”

This was absolutely fantastic news for Feng Teng Gene, so whatever emotions Zhang Wenzhe and Gao Miaomiao had were instantly wiped away, and they smiled. Lu Tianfeng, on the other hand, frowned upon hearing a new piece of news he hadn’t heard in the previous two cycles.

“We were able to contact Volly this time thanks to Chen Nuolan’s help.” Luo Tengfeng simply said this, and he re-established Chen Nuolan’s position in the eyes of the shareholders. Now everyone knew that she was not only beautiful and knowledgeable, but also had a strong network of connections.

“Do we need to make any preparations?” After all, they were facing a benchmark company in the investment community, and even the usually arrogant Zhang Wenzhe had become cautious.

“I’ll decide on the specifics after I have initial contact with them today.”

“Today?”

“So soon?”

Everyone was shocked. Zhang Wenzhe and Gao Miaomiao did not expect Volly to launch a surprise attack, and Lu Tianfeng was even more surprised that there was such an important event in this cycle.

“Mr. Luo, this arrangement is not included in today’s schedule?” Lu Tianfeng asked softly as a bodyguard.

“Because this was decided just three minutes ago, let’s go and head to the airport right now.”

“Airport?”

“Yes, one of Volly’s vice presidents has a layover at D City Airport today, heading abroad. He only has an hour between 11 and 12 o’clock.” Luo Tengfeng glanced at his watch. “You know our airport highway, once it gets congested, it’s no joke.”

Lu Tianfeng was silently operating his mobile phone with his head down, sending Luo Tengfeng’s latest schedule to his colleagues. At this time, he saw the message from Tong Yao.

Fan Minen had been hiding in her bedroom and sleeping in all day. She just got up and washed up, and didn’t look like she was getting ready to go out. It seemed she won’t meet Zheng Yuanzhi this morning.

All hell broke loose.

Feeling a dull pain at his temples, Lu Tianfeng rubbed it vigorously. If he felt like he was trapped in a swamp in the previous cycle, what happened in this third cycle indicated that the whole world was a swamp, with no place for people to stand safely.

CONTENT END 30

chapters.title: Chapter 31
chapters.content:
April 15th, third loop, 11:00 a.m., on the Airport Expressway.

Lu Tianfeng believed that airplanes were the most interesting and contradictory means of transportation in the history of human civilization.

On the one hand, precise scientific data statistics show that whether calculated in terms of accident rate, mortality rate, number of deaths, etc., airplanes were the safest means of transportation in human history, and their safety far exceeded that of other means of transportation.

On the other hand, ordinary people were always unable to get rid of the stereotype that “airplanes are dangerous” and believed that airplanes are “much more dangerous” than trains, cars, ships and other means of transportation.

Airports were also places full of contradictions.

From the perspective of police work, the airport could be said to be relatively safe. After all, there were strict security measures in and out of the terminal, and there were also many well-trained security personnel inside the airport to assist in dealing with various emergencies.

But in reality, the dangers of airports largely lay in the hidden undercurrents invisible to the naked eye. The larger the airport, the more entrances and exits it had. For example, D City Airport, including the staff entrances, had over a hundred entrances and exits. Even the most stringent security measures were bound to have loopholes. Furthermore, criminals who choose airports as their locations were often insiders familiar with airport operations, rendering security measures virtually ineffective for them.

On the way there, Lu Tianfeng constantly deployed his forces, first dispatching Yu Yongsheng and Huang Xuanxuan to the airport for support, and assigning Tong Yao full responsibility for monitoring the other suspects. Of course, another reason Lu Tianfeng kept his head down on his phone was that Chen Nuolan and Luo Tengfeng were chatting side by side in the back seat, and he wanted a distraction so he couldn’t hear their conversation.

Yet, the fragmented words still stubbornly drifted into Lu Tianfeng’s ears. He was completely bewildered by the talk of risk agreements, return on capital, premium acquisitions, and equity incentives. Most frustratingly, he hadn’t realized until that moment that Chen Nuolan was so familiar with the workings of the capital market. This wasn’t the academically inclined girlfriend he’d imagined, detached from the world and devoted to research.

At this time, Yu Yongsheng’s call broke Lu Tianfeng’s thoughts.

“Boss, I’m here.”

“Great, let’s check the several cafes in the airport security area in advance to see if there are any suspicious people.” Transit passengers would not leave the security area, which also had an advantage, that is, there would be fewer people in the security area.

“Got it! By the way, there’s another thing I want to report to you…” Yu Yongsheng’s tone suddenly became stammering.

“What’s wrong?”

“We’ve found the Mo Rui you asked me to investigate, but… he doesn’t seem to be the right person!”

“What? Does it mean that the person is wrong?” After a series of unexpected situations, Lu Tianfeng almost forgot about this person.

“Although that guy claims to be a director, screenwriter, and actor, he’s actually just a low-level, 18th-tier actor. He has absolutely nothing to do with the Feng Teng Gene case. Furthermore, he’s been with a crew filming at a film studio outside of D City for the past few days and hasn’t left at all.”

“Really? What are his plans for today?” Lu Tianfeng’s brows were already twisted into a knot.

“I received a faxed notice from the crew. Mo Rui has a few rare scenes tonight where he can appear. He definitely doesn’t want to miss it.”

“Is this person just a cover…”

“Ah? What?” Yu Yongsheng, who had no memory of the last loop, naturally didn’t understand what Lu Tianfeng said.

“Let’s deal with Mo Rui’s matter this afternoon. Now go choose a less crowded cafe for us and pay attention to the surrounding environment.”

“Acknowledged!”

“We’ll be there soon.” Lu Tianfeng could already see the airport buildings looming in the distance.

D City Airport, Transit Terminal.

The coffee shop that Yu Yongsheng selected in advance was called “Super Coffee”. It was located in an inconspicuous corner of the Transit Terminal. It didn’t have many customers on weekdays. Now, because of cooperating with the police, the clerk had been replaced by Huang Xuanxuan, and she certainly wouldn’t take the initiative to solicit customers, so it seemed even more deserted.

“Is this the place?” Luo Tengfeng couldn’t help but wonder when he saw the empty cafe. “Are they open for business?”

“It’s open. Look, isn’t that a waiter?”

Luo Tengfeng had been under the close protection of the police for several days, so he naturally recognized Huang Xuanxuan. He smiled helplessly and said, “You guys don’t even trust me at the airport!”

“So what if it’s the airport? Didn’t we enter the security area without buying tickets?” said Lu Tianfeng.

“Officer Huang’s gestures for making coffee are very professional!” Luo Tengfeng couldn’t help but look at Huang Xuanxuan twice more.

“Of course, she is a professional.” Lu Tianfeng has always felt that Huang Xuanxuan’s temperament was particularly suitable for roles like waitresses, and there was no flaw at all.

Luo Tengfeng walked into the coffee shop and chose a seat near the counter. Chen Nuolan sat next to him. Without wasting any time, the two of them immediately took out the information and began to discuss in a low voice, preparing for the upcoming meeting and negotiation.

This scene made Lu Tianfeng feel a little redundant, so he walked out the door to observe the surrounding environment. He noticed that Yu Yongsheng, disguised as a security guard, had occupied the only high ground nearby, and couldn’t help but praise him.

“What a great location!”

“Haha, boss, you’re too kind. Huh?” Yu Yongsheng exclaimed in confusion.

“What’s going on?”

“Two strange men were walking towards us. They were wearing baseball caps, sunglasses and masks, so we couldn’t see their faces clearly.”

“Wearing sunglasses indoors?” Lu Tianfeng immediately became alert.

Soon, Lu Tianfeng saw the two people Yu Yongsheng had mentioned. They were both wearing hip-hop-style sportswear, one bright red, the other aqua blue, and were completely wrapped up. They were wearing black masks, baseball caps pulled low, and oversized sunglasses, making their faces completely indistinguishable.

The two weirdos looked around, as if looking for something. Finally, the man in red pointed in the direction of Super Coffee and whispered something in the ear of the man in blue. Then the two of them walked towards the coffee shop together.

“Boss, what should we do?” Huang Xuanxuan, who was pretending to be a shop clerk, asked a little nervously.

“Hold on, since we’re open for business, we can’t stop people from coming in to buy coffee!” Lu Tianfeng kept staring at the backs of the two men. He saw them walk straight into the cafe. The man in blue found a seat farthest from the counter and sat down, while the man in red walked towards Huang Xuanxuan and prepared to order coffee.

“Boss, did they just happen to pass by?” Yu Yongsheng kept looking towards the cafe.

“How could it be such a coincidence? They obviously came here on purpose. Stay put and don’t panic. Xuanxuan, place the customer’s order normally.”

“I’m sorry, our store can only provide Americano coffee at the moment…” The conversation between Huang Xuanxuan and the man in red was heard through the earpiece. In fact, the preparation methods of each type of coffee were similar. What Huang Xuanxuan said was just a disguised way of driving away customers.

The man in red ordered two cups of Americano coffee nonchalantly, and Huang Xuanxuan had no choice but to concentrate on making the coffee as if nothing had happened. However, she took the opportunity, when the man in red was standing aside waiting, to secretly point the hidden camera concealed behind the employee badge at the face of the man in red.

Even though Huang Xuanxuan didn’t say a word, Lu Tianfeng, who was in control of the situation behind the scenes, immediately understood her intention.

“Tong Yao, are you online?” Lu Tianfeng asked.

“Yes, I have received Xuanxuan’s imaging data and am analyzing it… but there is too little useful information about his face. Basically, we can only see his eyebrows.” Tong Yao also reacted very quickly and started analyzing without wasting any time.

“Don’t worry, can they drink coffee with masks on?” Lu Tianfeng slowly calmed down, because through observation he judged that although the two men looked suspicious, they seemed to just want to come here to drink a cup of coffee. Their seats were also quite a distance away from Luo Tengfeng, so they should not pose any threat.

“Someone else is coming over. Could it be Volly’s investor? But he’s Chinese.”

Lu Tianfeng felt mixed emotions: “Can’t foreign companies hire Chinese people?”

“Of course they can. I just heard from the boss that Luo Tengfeng was communicating with the other party in English, so I mistakenly thought that the other party was a foreigner.”

Lu Tianfeng was stunned for a moment and said, “Maybe he is an ABC.”

“What?”

“American-born Chinese refers to Chinese people who were born and raised in the United States. Many of them cannot speak Chinese.” Tong Yao’s faint voice came from the earpiece.

“Okay, stop chatting, they’ve met up.”

The visitor was indeed Steve, the vice president of Volly. Lu Tianfeng watched them shake hands enthusiastically, exchange business cards, and then both sides took their seats and quickly entered into a discussion.

On the other side, the two strange men were drinking coffee by themselves. They had taken off half of their masks and hung the straps on their ears, looking ready to put them back on at any time.

“Boss, the actions of those two people are a bit like celebrities running away from paparazzi.” Yu Yongsheng said.

“Really? Which celebrity?”

“How could I recognize so many? Let Xuanxuan go and take a look. She’s familiar with these.”

In fact, before Yu Yongsheng said this, Huang Xuanxuan had already found an excuse to approach the two people. Even if she couldn’t recognize who they were, at least she could take a clearer picture.

“Do you two need anything else?” Huang Xuanxuan asked softly.

“No, thank you.” The voice of the man in red was a little hoarse, and the man in blue even put down his coffee cup and put on his mask again, for fear that his appearance would be seen.

Huang Xuanxuan’s gaze stayed on the face of the man in red for a few seconds. She really didn’t recognize who the other person was, but she felt that he looked a little familiar.

“Tong Yao, can you see the face clearly this time?” Lu Tianfeng noticed that the conversation between Luo Tengfeng and Steve was going smoothly, so he focused more on the two mysterious men. He believed that these two were the biggest variables at the scene.

“Wait a minute… We have the result. The man in red is Su Lei, the manager of the famous boy band Power Up. So, based on the limited facial features, the man in blue should be Chen Hangfei, a member of Power Up.”

“Who? I’ve never heard of it…” Yu Yongsheng was still confused.

“Of course you don’t know, but they are popular star idols now.” From Huang Xuanxuan’s tone, she obviously knew this group.

Lu Tianfeng asked, “So these two people were afraid of being recognized by fans, so they found a secluded place to drink coffee?”

“Well, that should be the case.” Huang Xuanxuan replied.

However, Lu Tianfeng still had doubts in his heart. He didn’t believe that there would be such a coincidence in the world, not to mention that there had been enough unexpected situations in this cycle.

“Xuanxuan, do you think there is a chance that this Power Up group will appear on tonight’s TV news?” Lu Tianfeng suddenly thought of a possibility.

“Oh, considering how popular their group is, it’s not surprising that they’re on the entertainment section. If their crazy fans find out and something goes wrong, it might even make headlines!”

That’s right, that’s it!

Lu Tianfeng himself rarely paid attention to entertainment news, especially lately, as he’d been so busy with work that he’d barely noticed any gossip. But X might be someone who paid attention. If, during the previous cycle, X noticed the news about Power Up appearing at the local airport, and capitalized on it this time—

Lu Tianfeng couldn’t help but shudder. If all the changes that happened today were led and controlled by X, then this X was really terrifying, so terrifying that it made people feel despair.

This was also the first time that Lu Tianfeng experienced the obstacles brought to him by the time loop. If this incident happened “yesterday”, then no matter how covert the matter was, the police could send people to investigate, but all events that occurred in the previous cycle were in the past, and even if Lu Tianfeng really had the ability to see through the sky, he would have no way to investigate.

This was a war with completely asymmetric information. X should have known very well what the Power Up group would encounter at the airport today, and used this to set a trap, while Lu Tianfeng and the others had no idea and could only respond as they went.

So Lu Tianfeng decided to take a risky move and disrupt X’s plan.

“Let’s go somewhere else.”

“Change place? Luo Tengfeng is now discussing a business worth hundreds of millions. Is he willing to change place?” Yu Yongsheng was stunned.

“Hurry, Xuanxuan will be responsible for taking them away, and Yongsheng will find another cafe or a fast food restaurant with no customers.” Lu Tianfeng no longer cared about anything else and raised his hand to let the two of them act immediately.

Although Yu Yongsheng and Huang Xuanxuan didn’t understand what was going on, they still followed Lu Tianfeng’s instructions and prepared to act. However, just as they made their move, Su Lei and Chen Hangfei, who were drinking coffee, suddenly put down their cups.

About twenty people wearing the same style but different colors of tracksuits suddenly appeared from nowhere and surrounded the cafe. Most of them were young people, both men and women. The leader was a tall man holding a plastic board with the words “Power Up” written in large English letters.

“Are they going to cause trouble?” Yu Yongsheng had involuntarily stopped and watched from a distance.

Lu Tianfeng also had a worried look on his face. It was not impossible to take Luo Tengfeng and the others away now, but with more than 20 people watching, it might be more likely to cause trouble. It would be better to wait and see.

“Xuanxuan, be careful with protecting Luo Tengfeng.”

“I understand.” Huang Xuanxuan moved her feet and quietly approached Luo Tengfeng’s seat before saying, “Boss, you don’t have to worry too much. I think they seem to be fans of the fan club.”

“So what?” Lu Tianfeng really didn’t understand why young people were chasing stars nowadays.

“The fan club is quite well-behaved and is an organized and disciplined fan group. They won’t do anything out of line because they all cherish their idols and their own reputations.”

When Lu Tianfeng took a look, it was indeed like that. Although the group of people who suddenly appeared looked a bit weird, they just stood quietly ten meters away, holding signs and watching their idol drink coffee. No one even came forward to ask for an autograph.

“What the hell is this?” Yu Yongsheng was a little stunned. “I thought chasing stars was just rushing up to take photos and get autographs.”

“Your thinking is still stuck in the past, isn’t it?” Huang Xuanxuan laughed. “Nowadays, fans in fan clubs are very particular about boundaries. When they see their idols working or resting, they’ll watch from a distance and not disturb them unless the idols actively invite them closer.”

“Huh? If I were a star, I wouldn’t have time to pay attention to them.” Yu Yongsheng said again.

“So you can’t be a star.” Huang Xuanxuan snorted.

“Everyone, please keep quiet.” Tong Yao finally couldn’t stand the bickering of the two and had to remind them.

While Lu Tianfeng was listening to Yu Yongsheng and Huang Xuanxuan’s discussion, his eyes were fixed on Luo Tengfeng. As long as no suspicious people approached Luo Tengfeng, he didn’t care whether he was a fan or not.

Su Lei and Chen Hangfei had noticed the fans, of course. After a brief discussion, Chen Hangfei removed his hat and sunglasses and waved in the direction of the fan group. The fans immediately erupted in enthusiastic cheers, but the noise didn’t last long. Instead, they lined up and walked into the cafe one by one to shake Chen Hangfei’s hand. Some even held CDs they had prepared and asked him to sign them.

This spectacle attracted the attention of many passersby. Some, noticing that it was Chen Hangfei from Power Up who appeared in the cafe, immediately joined the star-chasing crowd. As the crowd grew, Su Lei kept making calls, presumably to arrange for help.

“Boss, there are more and more people, what should we do?”

“Hold still and protect Luo Tengfeng.”

Luo Tengfeng, Chen Nuolan and Steve also stood up. It seemed that the noisy and chaotic environment made it impossible for them to concentrate on the negotiations. The three of them were ready to leave and find another place to continue.

However, before Luo Tengfeng could even leave the cafe, the situation took a turn for the worse. Four burly men who looked like bodyguards arrived in a hurry and immediately began to disperse the crowd, leaving a passage for Chen Hangfei to escape.

At this moment, several passersby who had joined the front of the line for fun started shouting indignantly, and the person being scolded was actually the leader of the fan club. Lu Tianfeng heard a few intermittent arguments. It turned out that the passersby believed that the fans of the fan club were preventing them from getting close to their idols, while the fans of the fan club accused the passersby of trying to cut in line and disrupt order.

One of the most boisterous was a young woman dressed fashionably, pointing her finger at the nose of the group leader and hurling curses. The older man, over 1.80 meters tall, stood there, his face flushed red from holding back. It seemed the woman’s curses were too harsh.

Chen Hangfei hurriedly left the scene under the escort of bodyguards, while some die-hard fans followed their idol closely, more people stayed and watched, and some took the opportunity to stir up trouble, watching the excitement and not minding the trouble.

Seeing this scene, Lu Tianfeng felt a foreboding premonition. X must have seen this news story about the airport during the previous loop, right? If it were just ordinary fan news, it wouldn’t have been noticeable at all, and X wouldn’t have likely noticed it. Could it be, as Huang Xuanxuan had casually joked, that this was news worthy of making headlines?

“Yongsheng, come and help. Xuanxuan, keep an eye on it and don’t let anyone get close to Luo Tengfeng.” Lu Tianfeng said as he ran towards the center of the conflict, ready to mediate.

“Boss, don’t worry. They will only follow in the footsteps of their idols.” Although Huang Xuanxuan said it lightly, she was not at all careless mentally and stared at the crowd vigilantly.

Seeing that Chen Hangfei’s back had disappeared, the young woman became even more irritable and uneasy. Perhaps she felt that the leader was cowardly and could be bullied because he did not fight back, so she simply poked his face with her finger, and her nails immediately scratched a bright red mark on it.

The boy finally lost his patience and slapped the young woman in the face. The woman had not expected the boy to fight back, and the boy was quite strong, so she lost her balance and was knocked to the ground.

“Wuwaa——” The woman sat on the ground and cried.

Suddenly, a burly man rushed out from the crowd and shouted, “Damn it, you even dare to hit my woman?”

Before he could finish his words, a huge fist came towards the head of the leader of the fan club.

After a dull thud, the heavy punch hit the fan club leader in the face, knocking him to the ground and making him faint.

The strong man took a step forward, raised his fist, and wanted to chase, but he didn’t expect a strong hand to grab him tightly.

Lu Tianfeng said sternly, “Police, stop! Do you still want to kill someone?”

“This guy touched my woman!” The strong man was still cursing.

“If you have anything to say, come back to the police station with me.”

As soon as these words came out, the tall and strong man seemed to shrink a few centimeters and put on a smile: “Let’s talk it over, big brother, we still have a plane to catch…”

“You still know this is an airport?” Lu Tianfeng said to the crowd with a stern face and a raised voice, “If you’re just watching the fun, please disperse. Otherwise, take them back to the police station to record a statement and assist in the investigation.”

Hearing that they might get into trouble, the curious people around immediately dispersed. Only a few fans from the fan club remained trembling and wanted to check on their companions.

Lu Tianfeng released his hand restraining the burly man, walked forward and saw that the boy leading the team was lying on the ground with his face up, motionless, with blood oozing from his mouth and nose.

“Oh no!” Lu Tianfeng knelt down and touched the boy’s breath. It was icy cold, with almost no heat.

Someone was killed in the airport terminal… Could it be that this was the news that X saw in the last loop?

“Quickly seal off the scene and call an ambulance! Also send someone to take this guy back.” Lu Tianfeng calmed down and gave orders on the communication channel.

The burly man who had been so arrogant just now and the noisy woman were both frightened to the point of turning pale and looking panicked. They supported each other and looked like they couldn’t even stand steadily.

“Brother Police Officer… I just… I hit him…”

“If you have anything to say, let’s talk about it slowly in the interrogation room.” Lu Tianfeng looked back at Luo Tengfeng and others, only to see that they were still standing quietly in the corner of the cafe, while Huang Xuanxuan was standing by diligently and responsibly, and it seemed that she was not affected too much.

Yu Yongsheng also ran over to help evacuate the crowd. Airport security and medical personnel arrived shortly afterwards and took the unconscious, life-or-death victim away. The muscular man who had assaulted others and the noisy woman were taken back to the police station.

Looking at the hustle and bustle in front of him, Lu Tianfeng was a little dazed.

Was this an event orchestrated by X? What good would it have for X to create such a mess?

Lu Tianfeng couldn’t figure it out for a while, but he firmly believed that X’s actions were definitely justified, and this kind of conspiracy that could not be seen through was even more terrifying.

“Boss, can we pack up now?” Yu Yongsheng asked.

It turned out that on the other side, Luo Tengfeng and Steve’s first meeting had ended. Although it was interrupted by an unexpected incident and ended a bit abruptly, looking at the smile on Luo Tengfeng’s face and Chen Nuolan’s confident expression, it can be inferred that this meeting was quite successful.

“Okay, let’s pack up. Yongsheng, remember to go find Mo Rui this afternoon and take him under custody. Xuanxuan, come with me to D City University.”

“Understood. Then Tong Yao will still be in charge of the surveillance mission?”

Lu Tianfeng thought that the surveillance mission was no longer meaningful. Everyone’s movements had completely deviated from the previous cycle. Even if he obtained their route map for today, he would not be able to make a comparative analysis.

But of course he couldn’t say that, so he had to order Tong Yao: “Yes, Tong Yao, you continue to monitor the suspects. By the way, has Fan Minen gone out?”

“Understood! Also, reporting to Captain Lu, Fan Minen has been at home all day and just ate a whole box of strawberry ice cream.”

Lu Tianfeng smiled bitterly. He had no interest in what flavor of ice cream Fan Minen ate. But when he thought about it carefully, it seemed that this was a half-joking requirement he made to everyone when arranging the surveillance mission. It seemed that Tong Yao was a little too serious.

“You must be careful this afternoon.”

“Okay, but Boss…” Huang Xuanxuan said worriedly, “What exactly should we be on guard against?”

“I don’t know either.” Lu Tianfeng said his true feelings helplessly.

CONTENT END 31

chapters.title: Chapter 32
chapters.content:
April 15th, third cycle, 2:40 p.m., D City University Auditorium.

Due to a traffic jam on the way back to the city from D City Airport, Luo Tengfeng and his group arrived a little later than planned, but his demeanor and style still impressed the university students present. Furthermore, the domineering CEO’s first words upon taking the stage were an apology for his lateness, instantly redeeming his favorability.

Luo Tengfeng’s second words were to solemnly introduce a “beautiful extra-curricular senior student” to everyone and invite Chen Nuolan to the stage for a speech. On the surface, it seemed that traffic jams had wasted time, preventing him from taking a detour to return Chen Nuolan to Feng Teng Gene. Luo Tengfeng had suddenly changed his plans and brought her along to the D City University event. But a closer look revealed that if Luo Tengfeng didn’t genuinely want Chen Nuolan to be exposed to the public, he could have simply let her get off midway and return to the company on her own, or even brought her to the event without any high-profile publicity.

However, Luo Tengfeng chose to respond to the recent rumors circulating on the streets in this way, which was really beyond Lu Tianfeng’s expectations.

Chen Nuolan walked onto the stage with confidence and waved to everyone with a smile, but Lu Tianfeng always felt that her eyes were avoiding him intentionally or unintentionally.

“I envy everyone here for being able to be a part of D City University. This has been my childhood dream.” Chen Nuolan’s opening remarks greatly increased the students’ favorability towards her, and the atmosphere of this lecture was more harmonious than the first time.

So what was the meaning of the title “extra-curricular senior student”? Even Lu Tianfeng didn’t know until this moment that when Chen Nuolan was still a high school student, she had come to D City University several times to sit in their biology classes. However, in the end, she didn’t take the college entrance examination, but chose to study abroad.

Chen Nuolan briefly recounted her experience working at Feng Teng Gene, expounding on the company’s strengths as an employee without blindly flattering or fawning over it, appearing particularly sincere. Listening from the audience, Lu Tianfeng felt that this would have a much better positive impact on Feng Teng Gene’s publicity than Luo Tengfeng’s one-man show.

So when Luo Tengfeng took the stage again, the enthusiastic atmosphere reached another climax, and it even gave people the illusion of being at a star concert.

The more lively the scene became, the more bitter Lu Tianfeng felt in his heart. He nervously took out his phone and sent a message to Huang Xuanxuan: “Is there any movement outside the door?”

“No, everything is fine.” After a few seconds, Huang Xuanxuan sent another message, “Boss, are you worried about something?”

Lu Tianfeng was a bit embarrassed and didn’t know how to respond for a moment. Huang Xuanxuan sat in the last row of the auditorium, very close to the exit, just like in the first cycle, but this time she didn’t hear the protests coming from outside.

In other words, in this cycle, the action trajectories of the members of the Nifeng Club also changed.

Thinking of this, Lu Tianfeng had no intention of listening to Luo Tengfeng’s long talk anymore. The faces of Tan Jiaqiang and Xu Lang flashed back and forth in his mind, and could not be shaken off.

In the end, he decided to let Huang Xuanxuan take the initiative.

“Go to the Biology Department building now and look for a teacher named Tan Jiaqiang in the department office.”

“Okay, then?”

Lu Tianfeng thought about it and there was really no good solution.

“You just need to hold him back and don’t give him the chance to come into contact with Luo Tengfeng.”

“Understood.” Although the order was a bit confusing, Huang Xuanxuan agreed without hesitation.

Lu Tianfeng turned around and watched Huang Xuanxuan leave the auditorium. At this time, the audience began to ask questions. He didn’t hear the first question clearly, but he vaguely felt that the content was exactly the same as the first cycle.

However, the next question from the student made Lu Tianfeng feel like he was struck by lightning.

“Mr. Luo, as far as I know, RAN technology has been around for less than ten years. By medical standards, it hasn’t been tested long enough. So how can we be sure of the security of RAN technology?”

What shocked Lu Tianfeng most wasn’t the question itself, but the fact that the thin boy holding the microphone was actually Xu Lang! Why hadn’t he been lying in wait in the teaching building preparing to attack Luo Tengfeng? With Xu Lang’s presence, had Tan Jiaqiang changed his plans?

Lu Tianfeng subconsciously clenched his fists, became fully alert, and looked at the audience around him vigilantly.

Faced with such a hostile question, the host who was responsible for passing the microphone to the questioner looked very embarrassed. On the contrary, Luo Tengfeng, who was standing on the stage, still had a smile on his face, as if nothing had happened.

“That’s a very profound question, worthy of being my junior fellow alumni.” Luo Tengfeng actually praised Xu Lang before changing the subject. “However, the contradiction between efficacy and side effects has been a topic of endless research and debate in the medical community for hundreds of years. Whether RAN has security risks cannot be determined in a few words. I can only assure you that my team and I have used all the most advanced technical means and the most stringent testing standards to demonstrate the security of RAN technology, and so far, no security issues have been found.”

The host, standing in the audience, wore a stiff smile. As soon as Luo Tengfeng finished speaking, he tried to snatch the microphone from Xu Lang, but Xu Lang shouted, “Although Feng Teng Gene hasn’t detected any safety risks, several experts and scholars have pointed out the flaws in RAN technology over the past two years. But all of these comments have been suppressed by public opinion. Isn’t this just a PR ploy by Feng Teng Gene?”

Luo Tengfeng’s face darkened. This student’s question far exceeded the information most students could grasp. However, he remained calm and replied slowly, “Actually, our internal technical staff have carefully studied the claims you made, but we are still unable to verify the fantasies of these so-called experts and scholars.”

“To put it bluntly, RAN technology hasn’t killed anyone yet, so it’s safe, right?” Xu Lang smiled strangely. “Revolution really does require bloodshed!”

The whole room erupted in an uproar. Xu Lang’s question was already a bit unreasonable, and Luo Tengfeng’s expression became unnatural. Lu Tianfeng’s nerves were stretched to the limit. He reached into his arms, ready to pull out his gun at any time to deal with any emergency.

“Student, I hope you can learn more about the relevant knowledge before discussing it with me…”

“But RAN technology has already killed people, hasn’t it? Your company’s executives Zhang Hanlin and Gao Junjie, why were they killed? Doesn’t President Luo know?” Xu Lang said almost hoarsely.

Not only did Luo Tengfeng’s face become even uglier, but Lu Tianfeng was also shocked. Why did Xu Lang know this internal information that was strictly blocked by the police?

The auditorium erupted in an uproar, with everyone talking and speaking, and the scene instantly turned into a noisy vegetable market. Two security guards rushed forward and tried to hold Xu Lang down.

Xu Lang jumped into the back seat and tried to escape, shouting as he ran: “There will be new victims, just wait and see!”

“Quiet, everyone please be quiet…” The host’s voice sounded small and helpless as he tried to maintain order.

“Xuanxuan, return to the auditorium immediately!” Lu Tianfeng called for help urgently.

“Got it.” Huang Xuanxuan’s tone was full of confusion, but Lu Tianfeng didn’t have time to explain to her.

Lu Tianfeng was afraid that the situation would get out of control further, so he rushed to the podium, used his body to protect Luo Tengfeng and Chen Nuolan, and prepared to take them out through the safety exit at the side and rear.

Unexpectedly, another loud shout rang out from the crowd: “Luo Tengfeng, the new victim is here!”

A shrill scream erupted from the crowd, and Lu Tianfeng looked in the direction of the sound. It turned out that Tan Jiaqiang was also lurking in the venue! Not only that, he was holding a gleaming dagger in his hand, and he had roughly strangled the neck of the girl sitting next to him with his arm.

Lu Tianfeng recognized the hostaged girl. During the first cycle, she shyly went on stage to present flowers to Luo Tengfeng.

“I am a policeman, put down your weapon!” Faced with the lives of the people, Lu Tianfeng did not care about concealing his identity and directly drew his gun and aimed at Tan Jiaqiang.

“Police? What’s the use of police? You’re letting Feng Teng Gene run rampant, and you’re still protecting them.” Tan Jiaqiang showed no fear, but laughed wildly, pressing the blade of his dagger against the girl’s neck. The hostaged girl was terrified, her face pale, tears streaming down her face, and her body staggered, as if she would collapse at any moment.

“What’s the point of taking an innocent girl hostage? Let her go and talk slowly.” Realizing that the teacher had lost his mind, Lu Tianfeng slowly pointed the gun at Tan Jiaqiang.

“Comrade police officer, you must not have heard that only the blood of innocent people can awaken the numb onlookers.” There was a crazy light in Tan Jiaqiang’s eyes, and the dagger was almost inserted into the girl’s neck.

“This is one last warning. Put down your weapon…”

Lu Tianfeng’s hands were shaking slightly, not because he was facing a life or death decision, but because the scene before him was too similar to the scene in the previous cycle when Bai Shiyu was taken hostage at the wedding banquet.

It was basically the same script, just with a different time, place and characters.

Why was this happening?

“It’s too late!” Tan Jiaqiang smiled strangely, and slashed the girl’s snow-white neck with the dagger in his hand. Suddenly, a thin blood mark appeared on the girl’s snow-white neck.

“Bang!” Almost at the same second, a bullet hit Tan Jiaqiang right between the eyebrows. He hardly struggled and fell straight back to the ground.

The students screamed and cried, scrambling to escape towards the exit. Some fell to the ground, screaming miserably, and then something was knocked over and broken… All kinds of terrible noises came one after another. The scene was like hell on earth, in chaos.

Lu Tianfeng rushed forward and supported the injured girl. She was holding her neck tightly with both hands. Blood was oozing out from between her fingers, staining her clothes crimson.

“Calm down, don’t panic.” Lu Tianfeng wanted to bandage her, but he didn’t know where to start.

The girl’s face grew paler and paler, her lips trembling, but she couldn’t utter a single word. Soon, the girl finally dropped the hands covering her neck. Her body went limp, without a trace of strength, and she leaned against Lu Tianfeng’s chest. Lu Tianfeng took off his clothes and applied pressure to the wound on her neck, but the blood continued to flow, making the action seem futile.

“Boss, what happened?” Huang Xuanxuan finally returned to the scene. She finally rushed into the auditorium against the crowd and saw such a tragic scene at first sight.

“Call an ambulance quickly!” Although he knew that there was no way to save the girl and that she could be “resurrected” in the next cycle, Lu Tianfeng’s heart still felt very heavy.

He couldn’t bear to watch such a young and vibrant life slowly wither away in his arms.

“Hold on, don’t close your eyes, you’ll be fine.” He kept encouraging the girl, but the girl’s eyes gradually became dull and lost focus.

Huang Xuanxuan also reached out to help press on the girl’s wound. It seemed that the bleeding had gradually stopped. Of course, it was also possible that there was not much blood left to flow.

The girl moved her purple-blue lips and seemed to say something, but no one could hear it clearly, and then she slowly closed her eyes.

“Boss… she’s dying…”

Lu Tianfeng laid the girl’s body flat on the ground without saying a word, then turned to look at Tan Jiaqiang. He had a bullet in his brow, but he died peacefully.

Only then did he notice Chen Nuolan curled up in the corner. She was so scared that her face turned pale and her legs were weak. She looked like she couldn’t even stand steadily. She only managed to avoid falling down with the support of Luo Tengfeng.

Luo Tengfeng was like wearing a human skin mask, and his emotions could not be seen, but Lu Tianfeng noticed that his shoulders were shaking constantly. It seemed that this scene also brought him a great shock.

Lu Tianfeng stood up and instinctively wanted to go over to comfort Chen Nuolan, but suddenly realized that his hands and body were covered in blood, and he stopped in his tracks.

Huang Xuanxuan keenly sensed something. She wiped the blood off her hands, walked over to Chen Nuolan, and said, “Mr. Luo, Ms. Chen, let me take you away from here first.”

“Wait a moment.” Lu Tianfeng took a deep breath and forced himself to calm down. “Xuanxuan, lead your men to search the campus. We must find a boy named Xu Lang. He is closely related to this incident.”

“I understand…” There was a rare hesitation in Huang Xuanxuan’s tone. After all, Lu Tianfeng had just transferred her away from the scene with an inexplicable order, and in the blink of an eye, two people died in the auditorium. It was hard to say whether there was a causal relationship between the two.

Lu Tianfeng deliberately ignored her hesitation and just urged: “Go quickly, leave this to me.”

After Huang Xuanxuan left, Lu Tianfeng also walked to Luo Tengfeng and Chen Nuolan. Luo Tengfeng still gentlemanly supported Chen Nuolan with his hand, but Chen Nuolan seemed to have not recovered from the shock.

“Let’s go.” Lu Tianfeng squeezed out these words from his mouth.

“Where are we going?” Luo Tengfeng asked calmly, but Chen Nuolan stared at the two corpses and bit her lips.

“Go back to the police station. There are some issues I need to clarify.”

“Police station?” Luo Tengfeng frowned.

“Three people have died around Mr. Luo today. I think it would be safer for you to come with me to the police station.”

“Which three people?” Luo Tengfeng asked.

“In addition to the two in front of us, there was also the young man who was knocked to the ground at the airport this afternoon. He was rushed to the hospital and was resuscitated for over two hours, but ultimately died.”

Luo Tengfeng was silent for a long time before he said, “Their deaths probably have nothing to do with me, right?”

“I don’t know.” Lu Tianfeng looked straight at Luo Tengfeng, and Luo Tengfeng met his gaze without fear.

“Then let’s go.”

CONTENT END 32

chapters.title: Chapter 33
chapters.content:
April 15th, third cycle, 4 p.m.

Lu Tianfeng sat quietly in the interrogation room of the police station, his hands on his chin. Observing through the one-way glass wall, he gazed at Luo Tengfeng and Chen Nuolan sitting in two interrogation rooms respectively.

In this cycle, X set at least two death traps at the airport and the D City University auditorium. Lu Tianfeng couldn’t figure out how X did it for the time being, but he firmly believed that in the police station, X would no longer have the opportunity to make any tricks, and Luo Tengfeng and Chen Nuolan would be relatively safe.

Lu Tianfeng also took this opportunity to take a breath, recall and sort out what happened today.

“Boss, you’re here.” Yu Yongsheng tiptoed in, as if afraid to disturb Lu Tianfeng.

“Did you bring back Mo Rui?”

“Yes, but he repeatedly claimed that he knew nothing… I don’t think he was lying.” Yu Yongsheng spoke hesitantly, perhaps he was also doubting what Lu Tianfeng was doing.

“Then I’ll go see Mo Rui first. I’ll leave Luo Tengfeng to you.”

“I… what should I ask him?” Yu Yongsheng was really a little confused.

“Ask him about the Nifeng Club and D City University. I just discovered that both Luo Tengfeng and Chen Nuolan have connections to D City University, so the Nifeng Club, which is rooted in D City University, may have a deeper connection to this matter.”

“Even my sister-in-law is involved?”

“At work, she is Chen Nuolan, not sister-in-law.” Lu Tianfeng said seriously.

“I understand, I understand.” Yu Yongsheng responded repeatedly.

In another interrogation room, Lu Tianfeng met Mo Rui. This man had a nondescript appearance and was easily overlooked. If it weren’t for his habit of shrugging his shoulders every half a minute, he would be a perfect candidate for a spy or undercover agent.

“Hello, Mr. Mo.”

Mo Rui’s eyes wandered, as if he was troubled. He said in a dry voice, “Comrade police officer, I have always been law-abiding…”

“Don’t talk about these nonsense. I just want to ask you one thing.” Lu Tianfeng saw through Mo Rui’s character and asked directly, “Did you take on a special job tonight?”

“No, I’ve been on the crew these days. I have a scene tonight…” He shrugged again.

“Hasn’t anyone else come to you and ask you to go somewhere else?” Lu Tianfeng stared at Mo Rui’s face, hoping to find clues that the other party was lying.

“Ah? What did you say?” Mo Rui looked completely confused and didn’t seem to be telling a lie.

Lu Tianfeng thought about it and changed the way he asked the question: “How do you usually get work on the crew?”

“Those of us in the film and television industry naturally have our own connections, like agencies and the like…”

“It’s best to tell the truth in front of the police. Where did your agency come from? The only agency you’re affiliated with is yours, and you’re the only official employee.”

Lu Tianfeng put the information on the table. Mo Rui stuck out his tongue and smiled bitterly.

“Brother, you’ve already checked everything, why are you still asking me…”

“Don’t be so frivolous here. Have you forgotten about that time you took the subway with dangerous goods? If you don’t cooperate, I’d like to see which crew would hire an 18th-tier actor with a criminal record.”

Mo Rui seemed to be startled and shrank back.

“I… I’m very cooperative… My jobs are usually introduced by friends in the circle. After all, I know a lot of things. In addition to being a stuntman, I can also do stage work, props, and blasting. I do all the dirty and tiring work, so I have a good relationship with people in the circle, and people often introduce jobs to me.” Mo Rui said a lot in one breath.

“Has anyone contacted you in the last few days about a new job?”

“No, really not… Brother, I joined the crew last week and I don’t have time to take other work!”

Lu Tianfeng was very puzzled. If that was the case, why did Mo Rui appear at the Bai family’s wedding banquet in the last cycle and trigger a series of events?

The only possibility was that X didn’t contact Mo Rui until the daytime of the last cycle, and arranged for him to go to the Tianfeng Xinghua Hotel with a large sum of money. But what happened in the last cycle was now impossible to trace.

Was there really no other solution?

At this moment, Lu Tianfeng’s eyes lit up. He took out a tablet computer and called up the photo album of people related to this case.

It was unlikely that X would find a second-rate actor to carry out the plan at the last minute. It was more likely that Mo Rui and X had met before on other occasions and had some intersection.

“See if there’s anyone of your acquaintance here.”

“I know this guy!” Unexpectedly, Mo Rui said he knew him after just the first photo. “Luo Tengfeng, who doesn’t know him?”

“When I say acquaintance, I mean the kind you’ve dealt with in real life.” Lu Tianfeng felt both angry and amused.

“Then I don’t know him.” Mo Rui shrugged.

The next picture was of Fan Minen. Mo Rui smiled and said, “I know this person too. Fan Minen, Luo Tengfeng’s wife. Of course, I’m still not an acquaintance.”

“You are quite knowledgeable!”

“People in our line of work have to pay attention to all the news.”

However, Mo Rui did not recognize Zhang Wenzhe, Gao Miaomiao, Chen Nuolan, Zheng Yuanzhi and others at all.

“Have you never seen these people before?”

“No. If I had, I would definitely remember.”

So was it because X was not there, or did X really just spend the morning to find Mo Rui and make some small moves at the Bai family wedding banquet?

“By the way, do you recognize these people?” Lu Tianfeng suddenly had an idea and pulled out the archival ID photos of Tan Jiaqiang and Xu Lang that he had just received.

“I don’t know this young man. He seems to be a teacher at D City University. I forgot his name.”

“Tan Jiaqiang.”

“Oh, yes, Teacher Tan, I took the elective course he taught, but I forgot what it was called.” Mo Rui touched his head.

“Are you a graduate of D City University?” Lu Tianfeng didn’t expect that when he tried it, he would actually get some unexpected information.

“It doesn’t look like it, does it?” Mo Rui said self-deprecatingly. “In fact, no matter which key university you go to, there are graduates who don’t do well.”

It was D City University again, which seemed to be the intersection of everyone’s fate.

“Are you also in the biology department? Did you know Luo Tengfeng when you were studying there?”

“No, I’m a sociology student. I chose Mr. Tan’s class purely to get credits. I don’t think Luo Tengfeng and I were in the same class. As I said earlier, I don’t know know him.”

“Have you heard of the Nifeng Club?”

“What? I don’t know.” Mo Rui denied it flatly.

Why D City University? Why Mo Rui?

There must be a reason why X chose this person. Could it be that X himself was also a student or teacher at D City University?

Lu Tianfeng fell into deep thought. The clues in front of him were like a tangled ball of wool, and he couldn’t see where the ends of the threads were at all.

“Big brother…can I go back now? The action scene tonight is very important, and it won’t work without me as the martial arts stunt double.” Mo Rui asked with a wry smile.

“Wait a moment.” Lu Tianfeng said this, and without paying attention to Mo Rui’s reaction, he left the interrogation room. Now he had a vague, unformed idea in his mind, but he had a hunch that this should be a breakthrough.

So now he needed to have another good talk with Luo Tengfeng.

Before that, he wanted to say a few words to Chen Nuolan in private.

“Thank you for your hard work.” Lu Tianfeng considered it over and over again and finally chose this opening line.

Chen Nuolan, who was sitting opposite him, raised her head, her eyes full of fatigue.

“I’m fine, how about you?”

“I’ve gotten used to it…” Lu Tianfeng was still not used to talking to Chen Nuolan in such an occasion. He sighed and said a little stiffly, “I’m on a mission.”

“I know.” Chen Nuolan nodded slightly. The couple was like strangers all day long, with almost no communication, just as Lu Tianfeng had told her.

“Then do you know why I brought you back to the police station?”

“I don’t know, but you must have your reasons.” She smiled slightly, “So I’m not worried at all.”

“I can only tell you that Luo Tengfeng’s life is currently under threat and the police are protecting him. I cannot disclose any further details.”

Chen Nuolan blinked, but didn’t seem too surprised, as if she had already guessed it.

“So is there anything I can do to help?”

“I suspect there’s some connection between the criminal and D City University. Luo Tengfeng was also a student there. The origin of all this grudge might date back to his college days.” Lu Tianfeng tapped the table lightly. “You’re one of Luo Tengfeng’s most trusted subordinates. Has he ever told you about his college life?”

Chen Nuolan thought about it and shook her head: “It seems not.”

“Never?” Lu Tianfeng held his chin and pondered. “Don’t you find it strange? Luo Tengfeng is a big shot in school. He developed the prototype of RAN technology for his graduation project and achieved an astonishing technological breakthrough as an undergraduate. This is enough glory for him to brag about for the rest of his life!”

“Maybe he just doesn’t like to be in the spotlight?” Chen Nuolan asked uncertainly.

“Look at how organized and eloquent he was at the lecture today, and how he’s been on the headlines every now and then. Does he look like someone who doesn’t like the spotlight?” Lu Tianfeng pounded the table even louder. “He just doesn’t want to talk about his college days.”

“Why?”

“This is exactly the question I want to know most.” If one wanted to know the answer to this question, one could only find out from Luo Tengfeng.

“Is it finally my turn?” Although Luo Tengfeng looked a little tired, he seemed to be in good spirits.

“I’m sorry, Mr. Luo, there are some things I need to confirm with you.” Lu Tianfeng opened the notebook in front of him, “I hope you will cooperate.”

“I have always cooperated with the police.”

“Then may I ask, what is the relationship between you and the Nifeng Club?”

“Nifeng Club?” Luo Tengfeng raised his eyebrows. “They are just a non-governmental organization looking for trouble and opposing me at every turn. They are not a threat.”

“Can you tell the truth?” Lu Tianfeng raised his voice slightly.

“That’s the truth.”

“And yet, in order to discredit Feng Teng Gene, Tan Jiaqiang actually killed an innocent girl.” Lu Tianfeng leaned forward and asked aggressively, “What is the deep hatred between you two?”

Luo Tengfeng lowered his eyes, as if he wanted to hide something.

“It’s related to your college experiences, right? Actually, even if you don’t tell us, we can still find a way to know, but it will only waste more time.”

Luo Tengfeng finally spoke slowly: “This is just a misunderstanding…”

“Misunderstanding?” Lu Tianfeng frowned.

CONTENT END 33

chapters.title: Chapter 34
chapters.content:
Luo Tengfeng told the story of his college days, at least one version of the story.

Although Luo Tengfeng’s academic performance was not outstanding back then, he was eloquent and good at socializing. He joined several clubs and achieved outstanding results in each of them. Over time, he became a campus celebrity in everyone’s eyes.

When Luo Tengfeng entered his senior year and faced a series of practical problems such as graduation thesis and employment prospects, he made a surprising decision – he resolutely chose Zhou Huansheng, a biomedical leader known for his extreme strictness and who had not guided undergraduate graduation thesis for several years, as his thesis advisor among the many teachers in the biology department.

Zhou Huansheng found it difficult to understand Luo Tengfeng’s choice, so he met with Luo Tengfeng privately and told him that he was a person with very high standards. If the school did not require every teacher to open up the right to choose a thesis advisor to students, he would not want to get involved in something as “unskilled” as undergraduate thesis.

Zhou Huansheng even directly persuaded Luo Tengfeng to change his advisor, but Luo Tengfeng was also stubborn and refused, saying that he felt that following Zhou Huansheng was the most promising.

In desperation, Zhou Huansheng could only bring this inexperienced “little book” to participate in his project, and decided to find some less important content for Luo Tengfeng to try to follow up, and find a way to get him a high-quality graduation thesis, and everything would be fine.

However, Luo Tengfeng’s performance exceeded Zhou Huansheng’s expectations. Although in the initial stage Luo Tengfeng could not keep up with the pace of the master’s and doctoral students’ in Zhou Huansheng’s laboratory, within half a month, the clever Luo Tengfeng gradually became a capable person. After a month, he was so proficient that he did not look like an undergraduate.

Zhou Huansheng, impressed by Luo Tengfeng, began to persuade him to apply for his graduate program, promising to enroll him as his own student if he passed the exam. Luo Tengfeng didn’t immediately agree, as he was also struggling between pursuing a job and a higher degree. However, the prospect of becoming Zhou Huansheng’s student was undoubtedly a huge temptation for a young person interested in the biomedical field.

Luo Tengfeng hesitated for more than a week, and just when he was about to agree to Zhou Huansheng, the situation changed subtly.

Zhou Huansheng had already invested years of his time and experience in gene therapy research, but he was constantly stuck on several technical bottlenecks, unable to break through. After Luo Tengfeng joined the team, he offered many outlandish ideas, but Zhou Huansheng always laughed them off, urging him to focus on the technology and avoid shortcuts.

As Luo Tengfeng gradually established his position within the team, some of his “unconventional methods” finally found their way into practice. Of course, most of Luo Tengfeng’s “innovative ideas” ultimately proved ineffective, but one seemingly “absolutely unworkable” idea he proposed unexpectedly solved a problem that had been plaguing Zhou Huansheng.

The research progress that had been stagnant for a long time finally made a major breakthrough. Luo Tengfeng was very happy when he heard the news. He wanted to take this opportunity to agree to become Zhou Huansheng’s disciple and show his talents.

Unexpectedly, after Zhou Huansheng met Luo Tengfeng again, he withdrew his previous promise to recruit him as a graduate student and persuaded Luo Tengfeng not to pursue scientific research anymore.

Luo Tengfeng was naturally extremely shocked and a little angry. He didn’t understand why, after he helped his mentor solve a difficult problem, his mentor not only did not reward him, but instead advised him to quit the academic field.

According to Zhou Huansheng, he felt Luo Tengfeng was very smart, perhaps even a little too smart, and overly smart people often avoid hard work. Zhou Huansheng had originally thought that by letting Luo Tengfeng try out his so-called new methods, he would realize the importance of diligent research after encountering setbacks. Unexpectedly, Luo Tengfeng actually solved a problem that conventional methods couldn’t solve.

“From that point on, you become more obsessed with finding shortcuts and lose sight of the basics.”

“But as long as it’s a solution to the problem, it’s a good solution, isn’t it?”

“One day, you will realize that it is wrong.” Zhou Huansheng sighed. This was the last time the master and the apprentice had a calm and thoughtful talk.

After that day, Luo Tengfeng applied to change his mentor and focused on developing gene therapy with his unique ideas. He eventually developed the world-shocking RAN technology after graduating from college. Zhou Huansheng, on the other hand, repeatedly expressed his doubts about Luo Tengfeng in public, believing that Luo Tengfeng’s ability was not enough to lead the technology research and development work.

The conflict between the master and the apprentice reached its peak when Luo Tengfeng published his first paper on RAN technology. Zhou Huansheng believed that the technical level of the paper was not up to standard and that Luo Tengfeng had plagiarized his experimental data, and he claimed that he would take him to court.

However, before the two could even face court, Zhou Huansheng mysteriously disappeared. He left a note at home saying he was going out to relax and then vanished. Zhou Huansheng rarely socialized, sometimes shutting himself in his home for days at a time. It wasn’t until the fifth day after his disappearance that someone noticed his absence and called the police.

Police reviewed several days of surveillance footage but were unable to confirm when or how Zhou Huansheng left, much less his whereabouts. After searching thoroughly for over two weeks, Zhou Huansheng’s whereabouts remained unknown, and he was subsequently classified as a missing person.

Because RAN technology hadn’t really caught the public’s attention back then, few people knew about this anecdote. Only a few versions circulated within D City University and within professional circles. Later, Luo Tengfeng became famous and as Feng Teng Gene grew, they invested heavily in public relations, completely erasing this potentially suggestive story from the internet.

“And the Nifeng Club are targeting me everywhere because they always think that I was the one who killed Zhou Huansheng.” Luo Tengfeng finally finished this long speech and breathed a sigh of relief.

Lu Tianfeng frowned instead: “According to you, the real purpose of the Nifeng Club is to avenge Zhou Huansheng?”

“I think so.”

“So what is the relationship between Tan Jiaqiang and Zhou Huansheng?”

“Who?” Luo Tengfeng’s eyes widened. “I don’t know any Tan Jiaqiang.”

“That’s the man who attacked the female student in the auditorium just now. He’s a biology teacher and the mastermind behind the Nifeng Club.”

“Captain Lu, you must be mistaken! The founder and organizer of the Nifeng Club is Zhou Huansheng’s son!”

“What’s going on?” Lu Tianfeng was genuinely shocked. He had always believed that Tan Jiaqiang was the leader of the Nifeng Club. “Is your source of information reliable?”

Luo Tengfeng said, “The Nifeng Club has been targeting Feng Teng Gene for several years. Shouldn’t I send someone to uncover their past?”

“So, you have known about this organization for a long time?” Lu Tianfeng began to quickly recall Luo Tengfeng’s reaction when he heard the name “Nifeng Club” in the previous two cycles.

Luo Tengfeng had expressed disdain before and would sneer at them, but it seemed he had never shown any surprise. He also said that he had argued with people from the Nifeng Club on the forum.

“Yes, Team Lu only started investigating them recently, right?”

Lu Tianfeng was a bit amused. Of course, he only became interested in the Nifeng Club after taking over Luo Tengfeng’s case. In fact, he had only heard of the organization during the first cycle. Of course, the information he collected in just one day could not compare to what Luo Tengfeng had accumulated over several years.

“So who is Zhou Huansheng’s son?”

“Zhou Huansheng, obsessed with work and neglecting his family, divorced after just a few years of marriage. Later, his wife immigrated to the United States with their young son, Zhou Mingle. Father and son primarily communicated through letters, having only met twice in all those years. After Zhou Huansheng’s mysterious disappearance, Zhou Mingle joined forces with several of his father’s friends to form the Nifeng Club, specifically to target me.”

“Is Zhou Mingle still in the United States?”

Luo Tengfeng spread his hands. “That I don’t know. After all, I’m not a policeman. He can remotely control most of the Nifeng Club’s actions through the Internet. These people in China are just his puppets. Also, Zhou Mingle probably doesn’t have that name anymore. His mother has remarried. He seems to have changed his English name, but I really can’t find any more information about him. Private detectives in China aren’t very reliable.”

“Zhou Mingle…” Lu Tianfeng muttered the name over and over again. A new suspect suddenly appeared out of nowhere, and he felt a little overwhelmed. Who should he investigate next?

“Captain Lu, can we wrap this up now?”

Luo Tengfeng looked at the watch on his wrist and said, “I can’t be late for the wedding banquet tonight.”

“Wait a moment, I’ll go to the hotel with you.”

CONTENT END 34

chapters.title: Chapter 35
chapters.content:
Before leaving the police station, Lu Tianfeng listened to reports from all parties and quickly sorted them out in his mind.

Fan Minen’s actions were truly unexpected. She stayed home until around 3:00 PM, only to go out and get her hair done and buy two new dresses. Then she went home to fix her makeup and prepare for the evening party. This woman, so enigmatic in the previous cycle, did almost nothing in this one. Could she not be a key figure?

Zhang Wenzhe and Gao Miaomiao stayed in the company. They neither went out nor had any special communication with each other, as if today was just an ordinary working day.

After being questioned, Mo Rui took a taxi back to the crew in the suburbs. It seemed that he really would not have any connection with the Bai family wedding banquet in this cycle. This further showed that X may have contacted Mo Rui in the morning of the second cycle and used him as a pawn.

Preliminary investigation results had been released into the conflict that occurred at the airport at noon. The two parties involved in the dispute had no grudges against each other and it could be deduced that it was purely accidental. The person who started the fight was still in detention and was likely to be charged with manslaughter.

The bloody incident at D City University was even more serious. Although major mainstream media outlets received a gag order and only published a short press release, self-media outlets all over the street broke the news, with many different opinions. Some even exaggerated the incident and vividly described an unbearable story, saying that the murdered girl was the secret lover of Tan Jiaqiang and Luo Tengfeng, and classified the case as a crime of passion.

Having just experienced such a thrilling scene and with the company at the center of public opinion, Luo Tengfeng was still thinking about attending someone else’s wedding. Did this man have a heart made of iron?

Chen Nuolan’s behavior was relatively “normal.” She sat in the interrogation room, her face pale and uneasy. Lu Tianfeng saw this and felt quite distressed. So he walked over and asked quietly, “How about I take you home first?”

“Are you free?” A hint of joy flashed in Chen Nuolan’s eyes, and then she quickly realized that she must have misunderstood. How could Lu Tianfeng have time to take her home now?

The smile on Lu Tianfeng’s face was also a little awkward: “I have something else to do, I can ask a colleague to take you back.”

“No need to bother, I can go back by myself.” Chen Nuolan stood up with a bit of indifference, “Can we leave now?”

“Yes, but…”

“I’m fine, don’t worry.” When passing by Lu Tianfeng, Chen Nuolan said in an unnatural tone, “You have to be careful.”

“By the way, what are your plans tonight?” Lu Tianfeng suddenly remembered that Chen Nuolan attended the Bai family’s wedding banquet in the previous two cycles. Was she not going this time?

“I was supposed to accompany my boss to a social event, but now I feel a little dizzy, so I decided to go home and sleep.”

“Then you… go back and have a good rest…” Lu Tianfeng was a little dazed. He vaguely grasped something in his mind, but couldn’t put it into words.

In a trance, Chen Nuolan had already left the interrogation room, and Lu Tianfeng stood alone for a long time, suddenly slapping his head and shouting, “I understand!”

He figured out the clue about Mo Rui—

Since Mo Rui didn’t show up at the Tianfeng Xinghua Hotel today, and repeated questioning revealed no one had commissioned him to attend the Bai family wedding, it could be inferred that X met with Mo Rui during the daytime of the second cycle. While the specific circumstances of the second cycle were no longer available, why did X choose this time to meet with Mo Rui? It must be because X knew of Qin Dazhi’s presence at the wedding, and even saw him carrying his homemade paper dagger, which led him to devise a plan to use him to create chaos.

Following this line of reasoning, X could only have seen Qin Dazhi and the weapons he carried if he appeared at the wedding on the night of the first cycle, so X must have been one of the guests!

Lu Tianfeng felt as if he had suddenly become enlightened. He even seemed to have seen through X’s overall tactical thinking at once – in each cycle, X was looking for opportunities that might trigger a chain reaction and create a chaotic scene, and then used specific tactics to cause chaos. After multiple comparative tests, he used the most reliable plan to commit the crime in the final fifth cycle.

The Bai family’s wedding banquet, the live event at D City University, the brawl among tourists at the airport… Looking back on this series of events, they all completely matched Lu Tianfeng’s inference. He had finally caught the tail of this cunning old fox.

In the police’s list of key suspects, Fan Minen, Zhang Wenzhe and Gao Miaomiao all attended the first cycle of the Bai family wedding banquet. Lu Tianfeng could basically confirm that X was one of these three people.

The more Lu Tianfeng thought about it, the more excited he became. His brain was working rapidly. Why was the development of today’s events so different from the previous two cycles? He thought of a very reasonable explanation, and perhaps the only reasonable explanation.

Luo Tengfeng’s morning jogging plan was changed, proving that X must have done something before six in the morning, thus affecting the progress of the entire cycle, and the most likely possibility was that X directly interacted with Luo Tengfeng himself.

Wasn’t Fan Minen the only person who could have interacted with Luo Tengfeng in the early hours of the morning?

Thinking of this, Lu Tianfeng immediately called Tong Yao.

“Keep a close eye on Fan Minen for me. She’s a serious suspect now! Also, check for me to see if Fan Minen contacted anyone between midnight and six this morning. Thoroughly check her call and internet records.”

“I see. By the way, is your business still not over? Fan Min’en keeps complaining, saying she’s waiting for Luo Tengfeng to come home and attend the wedding banquet with her.”

“Don’t worry about what she says. Keep a close eye on her every move and don’t let your guard down. I’ll ask Captain Cheng to send two more people to you.” Lu Tianfeng felt an inexplicable sense of nervousness and excitement in his heart.

Fan Minen, could she be X?

Tianfeng Xinghua Hotel, the Bai family wedding banquet.

This time there were both absences and unexpected appearances.

Lu Tianfeng never expected to see Cheng Tuo in the hotel’s temporary command center.

“Boss, why are you here?”

Cheng Tuo’s face was full of worry, and he said, “It seems that today’s progress is not going well!”

“Yes, there were casualties at the airport and at D City University, although the incidents themselves had nothing to do with our protection operations…”

“But the media and netizens who don’t know the details don’t think so.” Cheng Tuo interrupted, with a hint of criticism in his tone.

Lu Tianfeng certainly knew that as a policeman, he was responsible for two murders in a row while leading a team on a mission. It was reasonable for Cheng Tuo to hold him accountable, but he was not so anxious as to go to the mission site specifically to hold him accountable. This was even more unlike Cheng Tuo’s usual style.

“I’m sorry, I didn’t prepare the emergency plan well.”

Cheng Tuo patted Lu Tianfeng on the shoulder and said, “Don’t get me wrong. I just wanted to ask you if you need more manpower. Your subordinates are under a lot of pressure right now, right?”

“We can still manage for now.” Lu Tianfeng said.

“Regarding the case, do you have any latest thoughts we can discuss? You even brought Luo Tengfeng back to the police station today, which has caused a lot of speculation in the public opinion.”

“Haha, let them guess.” Lu Tianfeng took a deep breath before continuing, “Back to the case itself, the person I suspect most now is Fan Minen.”

“Her? Why?” Cheng Tuo seemed dissatisfied with the answer.

“This…” Lu Tianfeng was stuck for a moment. He obviously couldn’t tell Cheng Tuo his reasoning process, so what should he say?

“Because she is actually the core of the interest network. Although Zhang Wenzhe and Gao Miaomiao both had the opportunity to join Feng Teng Gene because of their father’s death, it is difficult for them to obtain corresponding status within the company, and the motive for committing the crime is too indirect. On the other hand, Fan Minen has the closest relationship with Luo Tengfeng. Once Luo Tengfeng has an accident, Feng Teng Gene will almost certainly fall into her hands. The motive is the most direct. Moreover, I found that Fan Minen may have an ambiguous relationship with her ex-boyfriend, which also increases her suspicion.” Lu Tianfeng was quick-witted and made up a reason that seemed to be barely acceptable.

Cheng Tuo didn’t say anything, just looked at Lu Tianfeng quietly. After a long while, he said, “I don’t know if you used a secret informant this time, but I know your informant is very powerful, and you also value his intelligence very much in handling the case.”

Lu Tianfeng couldn’t figure out Cheng Tuo’s thoughts for a moment, so he simply remained silent.

“However, I am worried that you rely too much on the clues provided by the informant and thus overlook some obvious things.” Cheng Tuo said earnestly.

Lu Tianfeng was shocked when he heard this. Could it be that he really put the cart before the horse, only thinking about using the circumstances of the time loop to solve the case, but ignoring the normal investigation process?

“Boss, why do you say that?”

“Because I think the possibility of Fan Minen committing the crime is the lowest.”

Lu Tianfeng’s thoughts, which had just been cleared up, became chaotic again because of Cheng Tuo’s words.

Cheng Tuo continued his analysis, “Think carefully. Of the three people most closely related to Feng Teng Gene, only Fan Minen has lived a life of luxury and comfort, never worrying about food and clothing.
