The likelihood of someone like her committing a crime is very low, and the chance of her using extreme violence to kill is negligible.”

Lu Tianfeng suddenly understood. It was like a word that woke him up from his dream. According to criminal investigation theory, if someone like Fan Minen became a criminal, the most likely reason would be an economic dispute. Even if it escalated into a murder case, she would usually use relatively “mild” killing methods such as poison. Installing a time bomb was not something she would do.

“On the other hand, Zhang Wenzhe has been in the underworld for so many years, dealing in both legal and illegal worlds, so it’s understandable that he’s a bit ruthless. Gao Miaomiao seems to be a reserved and peaceful girl, but she’s too reserved. She’s kept some negative emotions deep in her heart for a long time, which can easily intensify and explode when faced with unexpected events. Furthermore, she’s a biology major and has the mindset of a science and engineering student. From a criminal psychology perspective, both of these people are more like criminals than Fan Minen.”

Lu Tianfeng nodded repeatedly. It was true that those involved in the case were often confused, while those who were on the sidelines could see things more clearly. Cheng Tuo’s words pointed out the blind spots in his thinking. Now he could not just rely on the time loop to solve the case, but also needed to conduct solid investigation and analysis.

“Boss, in your opinion, what should we do next?” Lu Tianfeng wanted to hear Cheng Tuo’s advice. After all, there might not be this opportunity again in the next cycle.

“Let’s be frank. Fan Minen, Zhang Wenzhe, and Gao Miaomiao have been investigated repeatedly by the team for many days. If there were any problems with them, they would have been found out long ago.”

“You mean, X isn’t among them?”

Cheng Tuo said, “That’s my intuition, but I also know that we can’t just rely on intuition when investigating a case. These three are definitely the biggest suspects.”

Lu Tianfeng suddenly remembered the name he had just heard today, Zhou Mingle.

“What if X has a grudge against Luo Tengfeng because of something that happened many years ago, and now wants to destroy Feng Teng Gene?”

“What do you mean? I don’t understand.” Cheng Tuo frowned.

So Lu Tianfeng briefly recounted the events of Luo Tengfeng’s college years. The more Cheng Tuo listened, the tighter his brows furrowed.

“So where is Zhou Mingle now?”

“I haven’t had time to investigate further. According to Luo Tengfeng, Zhou Mingle disappeared after immigrating. He has only appeared online since then, remotely controlling the Nifeng Club.”

“Even if we have to call in Interpol, we have to find him!” Cheng Tuo said hurriedly. “How about this, I’ll follow up on this lead and try to find Zhou Mingle’s whereabouts within 24 hours.”

Lu Tianfeng secretly groaned in his heart. They actually only had a few hours, and the real investigation might have to be put off until the next cycle.

At this moment, the wedding march could be heard faintly in the background, and the “third” Bai family’s luxurious wedding began.

CONTENT END 35

chapters.title: Chapter 36
chapters.content:
Lu Tianfeng hadn’t expected the wedding banquet to be so joyful, with no unexpected incidents. Qin Dazhi, seated in the crowd, appeared to still be carrying his unusual paper knife, but he reached into his arms several times without pulling it out. Chen Nuolan didn’t attend the wedding, so the conflict between her and Fan Minen naturally didn’t occur.

As for the group of people from Feng Teng Gene who came to attend the wedding banquet, except for Luo Tengfeng, the other ones were a little absent-minded. After all, the Internet was flooded with news about the vicious murder case at D City University, and they didn’t know how much negative impact it would bring, so their minds had long drifted away.

Because of the awkward atmosphere, Zhang Wenzhe and Gao Miaomiao hardly spoke throughout the whole process, and there was only the simplest communication between Luo Tengfeng and Fan Minen. The police responsible for surveillance were actually happy to have some free time.

When the wedding banquet was in the second half, Tong Yao called Lu Tianfeng. It turned out that she had thoroughly checked Fan Minen’s mobile phone and Internet communication records in the early morning, but she did not call anyone, and her Internet browsing history was all about shopping and beauty, so there was nothing suspicious.

“Also, I checked Luo Tengfeng’s computer usage history and found that he had been working overtime in the early hours of the morning and had sent several work emails. There was nothing suspicious.”

“Okay, thank you for your hard work…” Perhaps because the wedding banquet was too boring, Lu Tianfeng casually asked as he was about to hang up the phone, “Did Luo Tengfeng send the work email from him or was it someone else who sent it to him?”

“Well, let me see… there are so many emails…”

“Just take a look at the content of the first email received after midnight today.”

“Found it. It was sent by… Chen Nuolan to Luo Tengfeng.”

“Sender is Chen Nuolan, recipient is Luo Tengfeng?” Lu Tianfeng confirmed again.

“Yes. The content of the email is that Chen Nuolan said that after careful consideration, she felt that she could try a new challenge and thanked Mr. Luo for his kindness… There doesn’t seem to be anything wrong with it!”

Lu Tianfeng’s heart skipped a beat. This was seriously wrong.

This email from Chen Nuolan may be the beginning of a chain reaction. Although it was not known whether this email appeared in the previous two cycles, it could be inferred from the previous two arrangements at the ROOST Western Restaurant that Chen Nuolan had not yet accepted Luo Tengfeng’s promotion.

But in the early hours of this cycle, Chen Nuolan took the initiative to email Luo Tengfeng and agreed to his request. Then Luo Tengfeng’s all-night overtime must be related to this incident, and the cancellation of the morning run was related to overtime.

Lu Tianfeng shook his head violently. The more he thought about it, the more something seemed off. The cancellation of the ROOST breakfast meeting was clearly related to this email. Furthermore, the two unique events that occurred during this cycle were both directly related to Chen Nuolan—the meeting with Volly’s investors at the airport had been arranged by Chen Nuolan, and at the afternoon event at D City University, Chen Nuolan had also broken with the planned course of events by appearing at the lecture.

“Captain Lu, do you have any other instructions?” Tong Yao interrupted his thoughts. It turned out that he had not hung up the phone yet.

“Not for now. Thank you for your hard work.” Lu Tianfeng hung up the phone hastily, the doubts in his heart growing.

This afternoon, Lu Tianfeng still couldn’t quite understand why X went to so much trouble to arrange such a scene at the airport. But if Chen Nuolan was in cahoots with X, or even if she was X, then everything would be easy to explain.

The scene was in chaos at the time, and everyone’s attention was on the people who were arguing. No one would notice what Chen Nuolan was doing. Even Huang Xuanxuan, who was protecting her closely, was definitely facing the scene of the conflict, ready to stop outsiders from approaching at any time, and would not pay attention to Chen Nuolan behind her.

If Chen Nuolan wanted to poison Luo Tengfeng, that would be a good opportunity, especially after the incident. She could easily say that there were too many people at the scene and she had no idea what happened.

The situation in the auditorium of D City University was similar. It could be said that the scene was even more chaotic, with screams coming one after another. The students were only concerned with fleeing in all directions. Even Lu Tianfeng could only focus his attention on Tan Jiaqiang and had no time to care about what was happening with Luo Tengfeng and Chen Nuolan.

Thinking of this, Lu Tianfeng even had an urge to send someone to monitor Chen Nuolan immediately, but he couldn’t figure out why his girlfriend had the motivation to do such a thing.

Lu Tianfeng didn’t dare say that he understood Chen Nuolan 100%, but in the process of getting along with each other, he could truly feel her sincerity and kindness. Would a girl like this kill someone?

Lu Tianfeng could no longer sit still. He called out into the communication channel, “Yongsheng, Xuanxuan, the two of you come over and take over my shift. After the wedding banquet, escort Luo Tengfeng and Fan Minen home.”

“Understood. Where are you going, Boss?”

“There is something very important that I need to check immediately.” Lu Tianfeng simply explained and prepared to leave.

Unexpectedly, Luo Tengfeng was a little stunned: “Brother Lu, where are you going?”

Lu Tianfeng thought about it and realized that his public identity was still Luo Tengfeng’s bodyguard. It was indeed a bit unreasonable for him to leave the table like this, so he replied in a humble tone: “Mr. Luo, I have an emergency at home and need to go back. My colleagues will be responsible for ensuring your safety.”

“I see. Then go quickly.” In fact, Luo Tengfeng just needed to find a way out in public.

Lu Tianfeng hurriedly left the banquet hall and just walked to the parking lot when he received a call from Cheng Tuo.

“We have found some clues about Zhou Mingle’s whereabouts.”

“So fast?” Lu Tianfeng was extremely surprised.

“On the one hand, we found the director and contacted his friends in the United States for help. On the other hand, it can be said to be pure coincidence because Zhou Mingle from that year still appears in our field of vision today in a different identity.”

“Ah? Who is he?” Lu Tianfeng walked to the car.

“You met him just a few hours ago. He’s Steve, Volly’s vice president.”

“What?” The first thing Lu Tianfeng thought of was Luo Tengfeng introducing it to the shareholders at the meeting, saying that it was all thanks to Chen Nuolan that they were able to contact Steve successfully this time.

“Chen Nuolan and Zhou Mingle are college alumni. They knew each other when they were in the United States.”

“I understand. I’ll go find her and ask her clearly now.” Lu Tianfeng answered in the calmest tone, but when he hung up the phone and sat in the driver’s seat, his whole body seemed stiff, and his hands and feet were not under his control.

Lu Tianfeng, feeling pent up in anger, slammed the steering wheel hard. He couldn’t figure out why he was angry, or who he was angry at, and a few seconds later, he slammed it again. He suddenly felt exhausted, both physically and mentally, and just wanted to lie down on the steering wheel and take a nap. He could deal with any big issues after he woke up.

But he couldn’t do that.

He was a policeman. He wanted to protect Luo Tengfeng and find out the truth of the case.

Even if this truth would hurt him all over.

Lu Tianfeng raised his head, gritted his teeth, slapped his cheeks with both hands to wake himself up, and then stepped hard on the accelerator.

CONTENT END 36

chapters.title: Chapter 37
chapters.content:
In the drizzle, the car rushed at a speed close to the limit and soon arrived outside Chen Nuolan’s dormitory.

Truthfully, Lu Tianfeng didn’t like coming here very much. Every time he visited, he had an illusion that it was this dormitory that caused him and Chen Nuolan to be “separated”.

But in fact, he knew very well in his heart that the real reason why the two of them were so close yet so distant was their love and pursuit of their respective work. If neither of them was willing to give in and accommodate, the result would only be that they would drift further and further apart.

Lu Tianfeng came to the door and rang the doorbell, but no one came to open the door. He began to suspect that he had walked into the wrong room, but after a closer look, he found that he was not mistaken. So why didn’t Chen Nuolan answer?

There was no light from inside the house through the crack in the door, so there were only two possibilities: Chen Nuolan hadn’t come back, or she had fallen asleep. Chen Nuolan had given him a spare key, but he felt he had little chance of using it, so he left the key at home.

Lu Tianfeng had no choice but to take out the lock picking tools to open the door. He couldn’t help but smile bitterly while working on it. The boyfriend, who was a policeman, wanted to break into his girlfriend’s dormitory, but the methods he used were no different from those of a thief.

“Click–” The door finally opened. Lu Tianfeng pushed it open carefully. There was no sign of anyone in the room, and the temperature seemed to be one or two degrees lower than outside.

He gently turned on the light and confirmed at a glance that Chen Nuolan was not there.

Where did she go?

Lu Tianfeng took out his cellphone, hesitated for a long time, and finally called Chen Nuolan.

Beep-beep-beep-

The phone kept ringing until it was about to be disconnected, and then it was picked up. Chen Nuolan’s lazy voice came to his ears.

“Hey, what’s up…”

“Nuolan, where are you?”

“I’m sleeping at home. I took some medicine for a headache and I feel listless.”

“I’m almost off work. Should I come over to see you?” Lu Tianfeng just wanted to test and see what Chen Nuolan would say.

“Ah? I’m at home… Didn’t you hear clearly?” Chen Nuolan asked in surprise.

Lu Tianfeng then understood that what Chen Nuolan meant by “going home” was returning to the house where they lived together. It was obvious that in her heart, that was her real “home”.

He was a little touched and a little ashamed, so he said, “Then wait for me to come back.”

“But I’m so sleepy… If you find me asleep when you get home, please don’t wake me up.” Perhaps because she was drowsy, Chen Nuolan spoke in a girlish, coquettish tone, which was rare.

Lu Tianfeng was very conflicted. On the one hand, he had a lot of questions that he wanted to ask Chen Nuolan in person. On the other hand, he thought that Chen Nuolan’s behavior was not like that of a criminal at all.

But if Chen Nuolan was not X, then why did her behavior completely conform to the characteristics of X?

Lu Tianfeng closed his eyes and fell into deep thought. Cheng Tuo’s words kept echoing in his ears: “I’m worried that you’re relying too much on the clues provided by the informant and overlooking some obvious things.”

What was so obvious that he hadn’t seen it?

Lu Tianfeng opened his eyes suddenly, and he almost missed the most important basis for judgment.

X, like him, was a person who can experience time loops, so had Chen Nuolan shown any signs of this?

Every detail of these three cycles flashed through Lu Tianfeng’s mind like a slide show. Whenever Chen Nuolan appeared, he would press “pause” and carefully recall Chen Nuolan’s words and actions in that scene.

However, after some thought, Lu Tianfeng did not find any flaws in her.

So would the focus of investigation in the next cycle be his girlfriend Chen Nuolan?

Lu Tianfeng didn’t dare to jump to this conclusion yet. As he drove home, he imagined what he would say to Chen Nuolan when he meet her later. In contrast to the rush he had just made to the dormitory, he drove slowly now, as if hoping this journey would never end.

But no matter how long the road was, there was still an end.

Lu Tianfeng stood downstairs of his house. Looking up, he could see the living room filled with warm orange light, but he was actually a little afraid to get close.

“I’m back.” Lu Tianfeng quietly opened the door and spoke into the house in a voice that was neither loud nor soft.

There was no response.

The lights were on in the living room, there were apples and bananas on the dining table, and warm water in the kettle, all of which Chen Nuolan had prepared for him.

A warm feeling welled up in Lu Tianfeng’s heart, and he immediately recalled the chilling darkness and loneliness he’d felt the last two times he’d returned to this room. This only made the warmth of this moment all the more precious. He tiptoed towards the bedroom, the door ajar. A single bedside lamp lit the room, dimmed to its lowest setting. Chen Nuolan had long since fallen asleep, clutching a pillow, snoring softly.

Lu Tianfeng leaned against the door frame, staring in a trance. How could a girl who made people feel so warm be the cold-blooded X?

But his identity as a police officer and his sense of responsibility made Lu Tianfeng doubt her. In the end, he did not enter the room. He sighed softly and turned away.

It was past eleven o’clock, and what he needed most now was to calm down and sort out everything that had happened in this cycle.

The original comparative analysis plan was shelved due to the earth-shaking changes in this cycle. Lu Tianfeng decided to follow Cheng Tuo’s advice and not put all his bets on the “time loop”.

If he followed the normal police work process, how should he analyze it?

First of all, these were two independent cases. The first case was a conflict and fight between tourists at the airport, which resulted in one death; the second case was in the auditorium of D City University, where a teacher killed a female student.

Regardless of whether X participated in the planning of the first case, Lu Tianfeng was certain that the second case should not have happened, so X must be related to the people involved in the second case.

According to the information currently known, two people have been confirmed to be involved in the second case: Tan Jiaqiang and Xu Lang. The person who had not been fully confirmed but was highly suspected was Zhou Mingle, who changed his name.

These three people were the breakthrough point in the investigation, and one of them may even be X.

“But… that’s not right…” Lu Tianfeng quickly flipped through the guest list for the Bai family’s wedding banquet. Just as he remembered, these three people were not on the list.

According to previous reasoning, X should have appeared at the Bai family’s wedding banquet in the first cycle, which would trigger the second cycle of Qin Dazhi taking Bai Shiyu hostage. Then Tan Jiaqiang and others could not be X, they were just acquaintances of X.

In addition, Lu Tianfeng believed that X was also at the Bai family wedding banquet during the second cycle, because the scene in which Tan Jiaqiang killed the female student in the third cycle was very similar to the scene in which Qin Dazhi threatened to harm Bai Shiyu. It was even possible that X witnessed the incident at the wedding banquet and then figured out how to induce Tan Jiaqiang to kill.

The relationship between X and Tan Jiaqiang was also quite complex. The crime occurred around 3:00 p.m., meaning X had only the morning to manipulate Tan Jiaqiang, causing the teacher, who had originally planned to poison Luo Tengfeng, to resort to a violent, public killing, specifically of an innocent girl who had no connection to Feng Teng Gene. The disparity between these two actions was so significant that it was fair to say X completely altered a person’s mental state and behavioral patterns. Why did X possess such magical power?

Lu Tianfeng summarized the current clues into two main lines. One main line was centered on D City University and took Zhou Huansheng’s disappearance as the starting point, involving the grievances and hatred between the Nifeng Club and Luo Tengfeng; the other main line is centered on the Feng Teng Gene company itself, involving the shareholders and the interests behind them.

However, after this round of analysis, the only person who was related to both main lines was Chen Nuolan. It had to be said that from a rational point of view, she was still the most suspicious.

It was getting closer to midnight, and Lu Tianfeng really wanted to wake Chen Nuolan up and ask her a few questions.

But even if she woke up, what could he ask?

For the first time, Lu Tianfeng felt regretful, perhaps he really shouldn’t have participated in the investigation of this case. Facing Chen Nuolan, he couldn’t treat everyone equally and distinguish between public and private matters.

Perhaps in the end, he would disappoint the trust that Cheng Tuo and his colleagues have placed in him.

“Feng? Are you back?” Chen Nuolan called softly from the room.

“Yes, I’m here.” He hurried to the bedside and saw Chen Nuolan rubbing her eyes, looking sleepy but also a little happy.

“Hurry up and take a shower and go to bed. There are some fruits I just bought on the table.”

“I saw. Does your head still hurt?” Lu Tianfeng gently stroked her black and smooth hair, unable to utter a word of questioning.

“I feel much better after sleeping for a while. What time is it now?”

“It’s almost midnight.” Once midnight came, everything “today” would cease to exist. If Chen Nuolan was someone who could experience the time cycles, she would definitely react to this sensitive time point, right?

She just said “Oh” and fell asleep again.

“I’m tired, you should rest early…”

“Well… are you still going to work tomorrow?” Lu Tianfeng didn’t know why he came up with such a question.

“Of course I have to go to work, and it might be very busy.” Chen Nuolan’s voice gradually faded.

Lu Tianfeng looked back at the clock on the wall. Only two minutes remained on this cycle. He gently climbed onto the bed and gently embraced Chen Nuolan from behind. Her body temperature, scent, breathing, heartbeat… and the warm touch of her—everything brought him a long-lost sense of peace.

“Nuolan, do you trust me?” he asked softly.

“Huh? Of course I trust you.” She replied a little confusedly.

“So… can I trust you?”

“Do you believe those rumors?” Chen Nuolan said with a smile, a hint of teasing in her voice. She misunderstood Lu Tianfeng’s meaning.

Lu Tianfeng didn’t answer, but just hugged her tighter.

“Ah, you haven’t taken a shower yet… you stink…” Chen Nuolan said coquettishly.

Lu Tianfeng kissed Chen Nuolan’s neck.

“I will always believe in you.” The man said word by word in a firm tone.

Perhaps it was because the tone of this sentence was too serious, Chen Nuolan also noticed the complex meaning contained in it, and she became serious all of a sudden.

“Feng, I think you’re acting weird today. Can you tell me why?”

“I… ” He hesitated.

“Okay, I understand.” The considerate Chen Nuolan did not ask any further questions, but took the initiative to hug Lu Tianfeng’s body and leaned her lips forward.

A confused expression, hot breath, and pink lips.

However, at the moment when the two were about to kiss, Chen Nuolan’s fragrant and warm body disappeared. Lu Tianfeng returned to his desk, back to darkness and confusion, but the warmth still remained in his heart, giving him endless courage.

The night wind messed up the papers on the desk. Lu Tianfeng simply stuffed all his notes into the drawer and stopped looking at them.

He only had one last chance to try and fail. If X could change his fate drastically, then he could do it too.

This time, he would use completely different tactics.

CONTENT END 37

chapters.title: Chapter 38
chapters.content:
April 15th, fourth cycle, 1 a.m.

In Lu Tianfeng’s eyes, this emergency meeting was held for the third time, but the others were unaware of it. They still felt the same excitement and confusion as in the second cycle.

This time, Lu Tianfeng decided to give up the wide-ranging surveillance and instead focus on one thing.

“We just received a tip that an extremist organization called the ‘Nifeng Club’ is planning an attack on Luo Tengfeng, and it’s very likely to happen today—just a reminder, everyone, it’s already April 15th.”

“Nifeng Club?”

“Extremist organization?” Everyone whispered to each other, looking confused.

Lu Tianfeng coughed dryly and continued, “This organization previously operated primarily online. They published several articles questioning Feng Teng Gene and RAN technology, but they didn’t cause much of a stir. However, recently, the head of the Nifeng Society has been soliciting murder proposals, claiming they want to kill Luo Tengfeng and save human civilization.”

Yu Yongsheng was shocked and said, “This kind of nonsense can’t be taken seriously, right?”

“If it were just online comments, it would be fine. But my informant told me that the people from the Nifeng Club have indeed planned several complete and mature attack plans. They really want to kill people.” Lu Tianfeng said seriously.

Lu Tianfeng’s informant – this non-existent character was no different from a legend in the police world in the eyes of Yu Yongsheng and Huang Xuanxuan. Even though Tong Yao, who was temporarily transferred here, did not worship Lu Tianfeng so blindly, she also knew that his mysterious informant was extremely reliable.

Everyone suddenly became nervous. Lu Tianfeng continued, “Luo Tengfeng is going to D City University to attend an event this afternoon. That will be the perfect opportunity for the members of the Nifeng Club to take action.”

As he spoke, he distributed the simple information he had just prepared to everyone.

“Our priority target is Tan Jiaqiang, a biology professor at D City University. He’s very likely the perpetrator of the attack. Search his home and office, and check his online communications and phone records from the past month. If we find any suspicious leads, arrest him immediately.”

“Another target is Xu Lang, a biology student at D City University. He may be an accomplice or co-conspirator, but he’s only a supporting role, so his priority is lower than Tan Jiaqiang. Xuanxuan will be responsible for these two individuals.”

“I understand!” Huang Xuanxuan, who was named, was actually a little surprised. She didn’t quite understand why the two targets who seemed to be most related to the case were assigned to her alone to follow up.

“On Tong Yao’s side, we also need to investigate two people. They are father and son. Zhou Huansheng, a former professor of biology at D City University. Eight years ago, he was Luo Tengfeng’s mentor. Later, the two clashed due to a disagreement. Zhou Huansheng mysteriously disappeared shortly afterward, and his whereabouts remain unknown. Zhou Mingle, Zhou Huansheng’s only son, has lived with his mother in the United States since his parents divorced. He changed his English name to Steve Chou and is now the vice president of the venture capital firm Volly. I suspect he is the mastermind behind the Nifeng Club, and Tan Jiaqiang and Xu Lang are just his pawns.”

“Captain Lu, do you think Nifeng’s attack on Luo Tengfeng is related to Zhou Huansheng’s disappearance that year?” Tong Yao asked with some confusion.

“Yes, Zhou Mingle has always believed that his father’s disappearance was related to Luo Tengfeng, so he planned this organization and targeted Feng Teng Gene.”

“Okay, I understand…”

“Boss, what about me?” Yu Yongsheng couldn’t contain himself and stood up, volunteering.

“Go get some sleep for a few hours. Starting at six in the morning, you will be responsible for protecting Luo Tengfeng. No one can afford to lose him.”

“Got it! What about you, Boss?”

Lu Tianfeng smiled and said, “I’ll take on the role of mobile support.”

“Mobile support?” Yu Yongsheng looked as if he had misheard. In his mind, his captain would never voluntarily apply to withdraw from the front line.

“Because I still need to hurry up and investigate some things.” Lu Tianfeng said it briefly and didn’t want to explain in detail.

“Captain Lu, I have a question.” Tong Yao was always the most cautious person in this small team. “These missions are no longer simply protection missions. Why don’t you ask our colleagues from Team One for help with similar investigations?”

Tong Yao carefully considered her words. Lu Tianfeng knew in his heart that sending people to investigate the Nifeng Club would be putting the cart before the horse and putting the most important protection mission aside.

“You can find someone to assist with the investigation, but you must compile all the information and send it to me as soon as possible.” Lu Tianfeng ordered in a firm tone. “This situation is urgent, and we can’t follow the rules completely. Please bear with me.”

“I understand.” Tong Yao nodded.

“One last word of warning. Don’t take it lightly. The other party has extremely violent tendencies.” As he said this, Lu Tianfeng’s gaze was mainly on Huang Xuanxuan, making her blush a little. “Okay, everyone, disperse first. Stay in touch.”

“Understood!” the three responded in unison.

CONTENT END 38

chapters.title: Chapter 39
chapters.content:
April 15th, fourth cycle, 6:00 a.m.

There was a small breakfast shop downstairs from Chen Nuolan’s dormitory. The owners were a middle-aged couple. They opened the shop at six o’clock every day and sell the most ordinary buns and soy milk. However, because of their fair prices and genuine ingredients, they established a good reputation among nearby residents. Sometimes one even had to wait in line during peak meal times.

The first customer of the day was Lu Tianfeng. He bought two meat buns, one vegetarian bun, and two cups of soy milk, and went straight to Chen Nuolan with his breakfast.

According to the original plan, Chen Nuolan would arrive at ROOST restaurant around 7:30, so she must have gotten up, washed and put on makeup by then.

This time, Lu Tianfeng did not forget to bring the spare key, but he still chose to knock on the door.

“Who is it, so early in the morning…” The door opened, and Chen Nuolan saw Lu Tianfeng and was stunned.

“Delivery man.” Lu Tianfeng tried to smile naturally and raised the buns and soy milk in his hands.

“Are you kidding me?” Chen Nuolan was extremely shocked. Her boyfriend’s action seemed romantic, but it was too inconsistent with his usual style. What’s more, she still remembered that he had said that he had to carry out a mission in the near future and they could not meet for the time being.

“I’m not kidding, let’s have breakfast.” Lu Tianfeng noticed that Chen Nuolan had already put on her makeup.

“No, I have an appointment today.” Chen Nuolan paused and added, “Business.”

Lu Tianfeng put the buns and soy milk on the table and said, “I know you made an appointment with your boss Luo Tengfeng to have breakfast at a high-end Western restaurant.”

Chen Nuolan frowned: “How do you know?”

“Because my latest mission is to protect Luo Tengfeng 24 hours a day.”

Chen Nuolan was even more confused. Lu Tianfeng would never reveal mission details to her, let alone come to her and tell her like this.

“Did you encounter any difficulties at work?” She immediately realized, “Why did you tell me the mission specifics?”

Lu Tianfeng stared at Chen Nuolan’s eyes, trying to find any signs of lying or acting in her eyes. If Chen Nuolan were X, she would definitely reveal some clues.

But her performance was flawless.

“It’s hard to explain in a few words. I just want to ask, can you not go to see Luo Tengfeng? Or, in other words, take a day off today and stay at home and don’t go out, okay?”

“You have to tell me why first.” Chen Nuolan asked blankly, “Can you give me a reason? Feng, you look a little scary to me.”

“I’ll explain it to you tomorrow, but today you have to listen to me.”

“No, you have to explain it to me right now.” Chen Nuolan shook her head repeatedly, “Because you are making fun of my career prospects.”

Lu Tianfeng smiled bitterly: “Is career prospects that important?”

“You should know that I don’t do this job just to make money,” Chen Nuolan said calmly. “I want to break through the bottleneck of gene therapy. RAN technology is the hope for the future of mankind.”

“I understand your lofty goals, but before saving humanity, mind your own business first.”

“What’s the matter?” Chen Nuolan asked in confusion.

“Regarding the series of cases involving Feng Teng Gene, you have been included in the police’s suspect list. If you want to clear suspicions of you, keep a certain distance from Luo Tengfeng.”

Chen Nuolan’s eyes widened. She was a little surprised, but her expression was more obviously angry. “Are you crazy? Are you talking to me like this as a police officer?”

“No, I’m talking to you as your boyfriend.”

“Then I reject you as your girlfriend.” Chen Nuolan walked out the door without saying anything. “Sorry, please move aside. I’m going to be late.”

“Nuolan!” Lu Tianfeng almost subconsciously grabbed her hand, “Let me ask you another question.”

“Go ahead!”

“Do you know Zhou Mingle? His English name is Steve Chou.”

At this moment, Lu Tianfeng finally caught the trace of panic and uneasiness that flashed across Chen Nuolan’s face.

“I don’t know him.”

Chen Nuolan’s eyes drifted away. She was lying.

“Really?”

“Really.” Her eyes rolled unnaturally, and it was still a lie.

Lu Tianfeng felt a chill in his heart. He thought Chen Nuolan would give him an explanation, saying that she and Zhou Mingle were just casual acquaintances, and that she had nothing to do with the Nifeng Club. If she said that, he would choose to believe it.

Yet she lied, not even caring whether she could deceive him.

Chen Nuolan walked out the door, and Lu Tianfeng said coldly to her back: “In this case, I can only put you on the watch list.”

Chen Nuolan stopped, her shoulders trembling slightly. After a long while, she said, “Do you police officers need to greet suspects before monitoring them?”

“Not necessarily.”

“Then let’s just do business as usual.” She said this and left in a hurry.

Lu Tianfeng remained standing, not rushing to chase her. He knew where she would go anyway. The question he was pondering at the moment was, why did she lie? Was she really connected to the incident?

“Xuanxuan, Tong Yao, are you there?” Lu Tianfeng called in the communication channel.

“Yes.” They responded immediately.

“When investigating interpersonal relationships, add one person. Chen Nuolan.” He seemed to hear a gasp from the other end of the line. “I want to know the relationship between her and the other suspects. The more detailed the better.”

“Got it.” Tong Yao’s reply was without a trace of personal emotion.

Huang Xuanxuan couldn’t help but ask, “Boss, what happened?”

“I don’t know either, so I want you to check.”

Huang Xuanxuan also heard the depression in Lu Tianfeng’s tone, so she stopped asking questions.

At a time like this, only Yu Yongsheng could speak so heartlessly: “Boss, Luo Tengfeng actually wants to take me to a high-end Western restaurant for breakfast. What a surprise!”

“Not bad, there will be more unexpected surprises later.” Lu Tianfeng joked.

When he arrived at ROOST Western Restaurant, Yu Yongsheng understood what Lu Tianfeng meant by “even more unexpected surprise”. Not only did he see his boss’s girlfriend, but he also saw his boss in person a few minutes later.

Yu Yongsheng naturally knew about the scandal between Luo Tengfeng and Chen Nuolan. If these three people sat together, it would only be an “accident” but no “surprise” at all.

Unexpectedly, Lu Tianfeng really did not shy away and sat directly next to Luo Tengfeng and Chen Nuolan.

“Brother Lu, what’s going on?” Luo Tengfeng asked in confusion.

“There’s no one else here, so let’s just cut to the chase. Just call me Captain Lu.” Lu Tianfeng glanced at Chen Nuolan, then said to Luo Tengfeng, “Chen Nuolan is my girlfriend. Of course she knows who I am, so there’s no need to hide it.”

“Very good, then Captain Lu, please speak frankly.”

“Mr. Luo is planning to promote Chen Nuolan and appoint her as the Chief Assistant of the R&D department, right?” Lu Tianfeng went straight to the point.

“How do you know…” Luo Tengfeng glanced at Chen Nuolan, and Chen Nuolan shook her head, indicating that she didn’t tell anyone.

“Can I ask why you’re promoting her?”

“We don’t need to explain the internal operations of our company to the police, right?” Luo Tengfeng looked at Lu Tianfeng warily.

“Let me guess. You value Chen Nuolan for two reasons. First, she was able to secure venture capital for you from Volly, and your company desperately needed funding. Second, you recognize her technical prowess, and you believe she can handle the subsequent research on RAN technology.”

Luo Tengfeng’s face darkened, and his tone became a little unhappy: “Captain Lu, how do you know all this? Can the police just look through commercial secrets when investigating a case?”

“Mr. Luo, you’re worrying too much. I don’t know your company’s business secrets, but I know who the investor Chen Nuolan will introduce you to is.”

“Who?” Luo Tengfeng’s tone softened a little.

“A person you want to find but can’t find, Zhou Mingle, now known as Steve Chou.”

“You…” Luo Tengfeng no longer wanted to ask Lu Tianfeng why he knew so much secret information.

“Or you should ask Chen Nuolan what is going on.” Lu Tianfeng breathed a sigh of relief. He finally had the situation under control.

Luo Tengfeng looked at Chen Nuolan with a bewildered expression, and Chen Nuolan also looked confused. They simply couldn’t digest such a large amount of information at once.

They both spoke almost at the same time: “Steve…”

Then they both fell silent again. Finally, Luo Tengfeng asked first, “Steve is Zhou Mingle?”

“He seemed to have been called this name before. Is there any problem?”

“Don’t you know about Zhou Mingle?” Luo Tengfeng asked again.

“I don’t know. Why would I know?” Chen Nuolan asked curiously.

Luo Tengfeng stopped talking, and Lu Tianfeng also stopped talking. Both men were observing Chen Nuolan, trying to read some information from her face.

“What’s going on?” Chen Nuolan felt a little uneasy when she was looked at.

“To summarize briefly, Zhou Mingle considers Mr. Luo his enemy. He believes Mr. Luo killed his father, so he formed an organization called the ‘Nifeng Club’ to smear Feng Teng Gene online. Recently, their methods have become increasingly radical, and they are even secretly plotting to kill Mr. Luo.”

“Steve is that kind of person? I don’t believe it.” Chen Nuolan looked at Lu Tianfeng in disbelief.

Lu Tianfeng pressed the issue: “Aren’t you his accomplice?”

“Of course not!”

“Then why did you lie to me just now and say you didn’t know Zhou Mingle?”

The atmosphere in the restaurant, which was already filled with awkwardness, seemed to freeze at that moment.

Chen Nuolan’s face turned pale in an instant. She bit her lips tightly and said after a long while, “I… don’t want to answer this question…”

“Why…”

“Enough!” Lu Tianfeng wanted to ask more, but was interrupted by Luo Tengfeng’s loud shout, “This is not the police interrogation room, but the scene of my breakfast meeting. If possible, I would like to have a few words with Chen Nuolan in private.”

Lu Tianfeng stood up and said, “No problem, I’ve said everything I wanted to say.” After saying this, he turned and left. Before leaving, he gestured to Yu Yongsheng who was standing blankly beside him, meaning to keep a close eye on them.

Although Yu Yongsheng was a little confused by this sudden change, he still made an “OK” gesture to Lu Tianfeng.

Before Lu Tianfeng left, Luo Tengfeng suddenly spoke up: “Captain Lu, there was something wrong with what you just said.”

Lu Tianfeng couldn’t help but stop.

Luo Tengfeng smiled and said, “I promoted Chen Nuolan for one real reason: she’s very suitable to be the research leader for RAN technology. Everything else is secondary.”

Lu Tianfeng said nothing and continued to leave ROOST with big strides. The next place he was going to was probably something no one could have expected.

Taking the initiative to attack made him feel relieved from the suffocating feeling he had felt in the previous cycles, so he decided to stick with this tactic and completely disrupt X’s original deployment.

CONTENT END 39

chapters.title: Chapter 40
chapters.content:
April 15th, fourth cycle, 8:20 am.

“Hello, Miss Gao.”

Gao Miaomiao, who was hurriedly following the crowd towards the subway station, looked up in surprise and found a strange man blocking her way.

“You are…” she asked in surprise.

“Criminal Police Team, Lu Tianfeng.” Lu Tianfeng showed his police ID and pointed to the car parked on the side of the road. “It’s on our way, let me take you to work.”

The doubt in Gao Miaomiao’s eyes became even stronger. She moved her lips, as if she wanted to refuse, but didn’t know how to say it.

“Choosing between the subway during the morning rush hour and a free carpool shouldn’t be that difficult, right?” Lu Tianfeng smiled. His smile always made people let down their guard.

The interior of a car, as a moving, enclosed space, always stirred up tension and unease, so Gao Miaomiao, sitting in the passenger seat, seemed very reserved. She had been questioned by the police many times since Gao Junjie’s murder, but for some reason, this time felt a little different.

“Police notice…” She spoke timidly, only saying half of the sentence, and didn’t know what to say next.

“Don’t worry so much, I really just came to give you a ride.” Lu Tianfeng turned his head and saw Gao Miaomiao’s face with an expression of “Do you think I’m stupid?”, so he had to add, “Just wanted to chat with you for a few minutes.”

“Well, is there any new progress in the case? Why haven’t I seen you before?” Gao Miaomiao was still very cautious. Although Lu Tianfeng had been Luo Tengfeng’s personal bodyguard for a few days, he had never appeared in front of Gao Miaomiao, so she didn’t recognize him.

“I’m from the Seventh Squadron. I’ve just joined as reinforcements, so there are some things I want to know from you.”

“Just ask anything.” Gao Miaomiao seemed to relax a little.

“Have you ever had any connection with D City University?”

“What?” This was an unexpected question. Gao Miaomiao was a little confused about what Lu Tianfeng meant.

“I know you didn’t go to university in D City, but I’d like to ask if you have any other connections with D City University, such as having collaborated on a project with them, or if you have any relatives or friends working there?”

“No, why do you ask?” Gao Miaomiao was completely confused.

“And your father?”

“Maybe he knows some teachers at D City University. After all, it is the top local university, so it’s not surprising that the two sides have academic exchanges, but I don’t remember him having any particularly good friends there.” Gao Miaomiao tilted her head, as if trying hard to recall.

“Sorry, I need to correct my question. The person I was asking about was not Gao Junjie, but your biological father.”

Gao Miaomiao’s face suddenly turned red. She probably didn’t expect Lu Tianfeng to raise such a question involving personal privacy so directly.

“I don’t know who my biological father is.” She looked away and answered coldly.

“Really?” Lu Tianfeng only said this and stopped talking. In fact, he was not sure at all, but this was the only way to test Gao Miaomiao.

With Gao Miaomiao’s serious and almost paranoid personality, would she really not look for her biological father?

If her answer was that her biological father had died long ago, Lu Tianfeng might believe it, but it would be hardly convincing if she said she didn’t know who her father was.

The car slowed down, almost coming to a standstill in the morning rush hour traffic. Gao Miaomiao began to regret it a little, her fingers tangled in a complicated way. If she were given another chance to choose, she would definitely take the subway.

Lu Tianfeng still didn’t break the silence, and the longer he remained silent, the more Gao Miaomiao couldn’t help but think wildly. Finally, she asked, “Why did you suddenly ask me such a question?”

“You just need to answer my questions.” Lu Tianfeng tapped the edge of the steering wheel. “You know your father’s identity, right?”

Gao Miaomiao lowered her head, which was basically equivalent to her agreement.

“Gao Junjie never married because he was too busy with work to take care of his family. So why did he adopt you? It must be because your parents and Gao Junjie have an unusually deep friendship.”

A trace of hatred flashed in Gao Miaomiao’s eyes, and she spoke word by word, “Officer Lu, do you really have to dig deeper into this matter?”

“It depends on whether it’s related to the case. If it is, I will definitely get to the bottom of it. If it’s not, then please explain it to me clearly.”

Gao Miaomiao’s face turned red and white, and her lips seemed to have lost their color. She was hesitating whether to tell her biggest secret.

“I’ve carefully studied Gao Junjie’s files. He doesn’t actually have many close friends, so it wouldn’t take much time to check them all. But I’m curious: why did your parents entrust you to Gao Junjie? They must have had some compelling reason, right?”

Gao Miaomiao’s face became paler and paler, and her hands subconsciously clenched into fists.

“I understand the pain of being a parent. If there were any other way, they would never abandon you.”

“But they did abandon me.” Gao Miaomiao finally responded coldly, as if she was talking about something that had nothing to do with her. “Officer Lu, you’re right. Given my personality, I won’t give up until I get to the bottom of this. Like you, I’ve deduced that the relationship between my adoptive father and biological father must be very good – and I’m sure Gao Junjie knew my father, not my mother, because I’ve been with him for so many years, and I’ve never seen him understand a woman’s heart.”

“Then what?”

“Like me, my adoptive father is also a paranoid person with a very stubborn temper. He promised my biological father to keep this secret, so even in the face of my soft and hard nagging, he refused to budge. However, I was his daughter who had lived with him for so many years after all, and I understood his thoughts. So I changed my tactics and stopped asking about my parents’ identities. Instead, I asked him to tell me some stories about them. He couldn’t refuse such a request, so I slowly learned more information and pieced together the truth…”

Lu Tianfeng did not interrupt. He knew that Gao Miaomiao had already started talking and there was no need to ask any further questions.

“When I graduated from high school and was about to leave home for college, my adoptive father finally told me why my parents abandoned me. It turned out that my mother was a girl from the countryside, living alone in the city doing odd jobs. My father… that guy was already married, but he tricked my mother into having sex, got her pregnant, and that’s how I was born. To keep this affair a secret, my father arranged for my mother to give birth in a small private clinic. It was originally agreed that after my birth, she would receive a sum of money and take me back to the countryside to live. However, my mother encountered a difficult labor during childbirth, and the small clinic didn’t have adequate emergency procedures, which led to her unfortunate death.”

“My father is a university professor and already has a happy family. So he couldn’t raise me, so he had to entrust his best friend, my adoptive father, to take care of me. This was originally a good excuse, but do you know what the most ironic thing is?”

“The most ironic thing is that your biological father’s family wasn’t happy at all. Not long after, he got divorced, and his wife and son moved to the other side of the world, right?”

Gao Miaomiao felt as if she had been electrocuted and her whole body was shaking. She couldn’t imagine that the truth she had been pursuing for many years would be easily revealed by a policeman.

“You… you know who he is…” Her lips trembled involuntarily.

“I just guessed it.” Lu Tianfeng couldn’t help but sigh. This world was really too small. “When you speculated about the identity of the biological father, Zhou Huansheng had already disappeared, right?”

“Yes, I didn’t even have the chance to see him.” She gritted her teeth.

“Then have you contacted your half-brother?” This was the crux of the matter. Lu Tianfeng had previously only guessed that all the people and things might be related to D City University, and he never expected that Gao Miaomiao was actually Zhou Mingle’s sister.

“No, why would two people who have nothing to do with each other contact each other?” Gao Miaomiao responded casually, and it didn’t seem like she was lying.

“Do you know where your brother is now?”

“I don’t know, and I’m not interested in knowing.” Gao Miaomiao, perhaps having come out of her sadness, suddenly asked, “Are these things related to the case?”

“Maybe, maybe not. Do you know that Zhou Huansheng’s death might be related to Luo Tengfeng?”

“I’ve heard similar rumors.” She answered calmly.

“Will you take revenge on Luo Tengfeng for this?”

Gao Miaomiao was silent for a long time before she said, “So-called revenge and the like are meaningless.”

Before they knew it, the car had arrived at Feng Teng Gene.

“One last thing I want to tell you. Later at your shareholders’ meeting, Luo Tengfeng will promote Chen Nuolan to the position of Chief Assistant of the R&D Department. I think you should know what this position means.”

Gao Miaomiao curled her lips: “This matter has nothing to do with me, right?”

“If you were just an ordinary employee, this wouldn’t have anything to do with you, but in fact, you are the third largest shareholder of Feng Teng Gene.”

“So what?”

“If Chen Nuolan enters the management team, she will become a threat to you.”

“Huh?” Gao Miaomiao almost laughed, “You might be overthinking it.”

“Aren’t you worried?” Lu Tianfeng responded indifferently.

“I never worry about such vague things.” Before getting out of the car, Gao Miaomiao turned back and asked, “Lu Tianfeng, are you really a policeman?”

“I am.”

“I’ve never seen a cop like you, in real life or on TV. You’re a real weirdo.”

Lu Tianfeng shrugged noncommittally.

In fact, you have never seen me, because this cycle will be history that does not exist.

Lu Tianfeng hadn’t told anyone about his meeting with Gao Miaomiao beforehand, not even his most trusted subordinate, Yu Yongsheng. He had a vague suspicion that perhaps X had planted a mole within the police force, someone who could access their tactics and every move. If that weren’t the case, it would be hard to explain why X had deliberately orchestrated such a drastic change in the previous iteration, completely thwarting Lu Tianfeng’s planned strategy.

Next, he had to temporarily hide it from the main force and go to another place to meet another person.

CONTENT END 40

chapters.title: Chapter 41
chapters.content:
April 15th, fourth cycle, 10:20 a.m.

Xiangyuan, a long-established restaurant in D City, was famous for its exquisite dim sum. With its good quality and reasonable prices, it attracted customers all year round.

Lu Tianfeng was sitting at a small table in the corner of the hall, playing with his mobile phone. There were two baskets of dim sum in front of him. He looked no different from other diners.

But in fact, he was monitoring the conversation between Fan Minen and Zheng Yuanzhi in the private room through a wireless earpiece, while looking at the latest investigation materials sent by Huang Xuanxuan on his mobile phone. The snacks in front of him had long gotten cold, and he had not even touched his chopsticks.

Xu Lang’s profile was the simplest and most straightforward, remaining largely the same as what was revealed during the first loop: he was an ordinary university student who had studied martial arts, a bit hot-blooded and naive, and easily deceived. Lu Tianfeng also noted that Xu Lang had once helped patrol officers catch criminals on the streets during middle school, earning him the title of “Brave Young Man.” This likely contributed to his selection by Tan Jiaqiang and his involvement in the attack.

Tan Jiaqiang’s profile was delved into deeper and more detailed than in the first iteration, with a particular focus on his relationships with others. It turned out that Tan Jiaqiang arrived at D City University after Zhou Huansheng’s disappearance, making it seem as if the two had no prior connection. However, Tan Jiaqiang and Zhou Huansheng had actually met earlier, having attended academic conferences together. Zhou Huansheng had also frequently discussed issues he encountered during research and development with Tan Jiaqiang.

The two men’s close connection truly began more than two months before Zhou Huansheng’s disappearance. Zhou Huansheng contacted Tan Jiaqiang, suggesting they collaborate on gene therapy to overcome technical difficulties. Tan Jiaqiang immediately expressed strong interest and discussed the details with Zhou Huansheng in depth. However, Luo Tengfeng suddenly appeared, with a fantastic idea that catapulted Zhou Huansheng’s experiment forward, putting their collaboration on hold.

If the two had been able to successfully collaborate on research and development, RAN technology might not have fallen into Luo Tengfeng’s hands. Tan Jiaqiang had devoted years to academic research, only to have his achievements snatched away by a young, fledgling entrepreneur at the very moment they were about to see the light of day. It was easy to imagine the disappointment he had felt.

After Zhou Huansheng disappeared, Tan Jiaqiang came to D City University full of passion and hope, replacing Zhou Huansheng’s vacancy. However, he did not do well in D City University. He did not make any achievements in interpersonal relationships nor in academic research. As a result, his personality became more and more withdrawn, and he completely became a marginal figure in the college.

After reading these materials, Lu Tianfeng finally understood why Zhou Mingle chose Tan Jiaqiang as the puppet of the Nifeng Club. It can even be considered that even if Zhou Mingle did not fan the flames, Tan Jiaqiang would still resent Luo Tengfeng in his heart, and Zhou Mingle only needed to use a little trick to manipulate Tan Jiaqiang to kill people.

Manipulate.

This word suddenly popped up in Lu Tianfeng’s mind and couldn’t be shaken off. He thought about it carefully and finally realized that everything about the case had obvious traces of psychological manipulation.

In the first cycle, Xu Lang was used as bait and Tan Jiaqiang attempted murder. In the second cycle, Qin Dazhi was tricked into losing control of his emotions and took Bai Shiyu hostage. In the third cycle, Tan Jiaqiang took hostage of and killed an innocent girl in the same way…

These methods were exactly the same. One could even boldly speculate that in the first two cases, the reason why Zhang Hanlin went to the convenience store to buy cigarettes and the reason why Gao Junjie passed by the car equipped with the bomb could be explained as coincidence. However, it was also possible to obtain the necessary information through the time loop and then use appropriate psychological manipulation to realize the plan.

It was very likely that X had studied psychology.

Lu Tianfeng felt that he was one step closer to X. Although he still couldn’t see clearly or catch him, he was closer at least.

There was a rustling sound from the earpiece. Lu Tianfeng knew that Fan Minen and Zheng Yuanzhi were preparing to pay the bill and leave, so he quickly turned his gaze to the private room where they were.

Sure enough, Zheng Yuanzhi pushed the door open first, and two minutes later, Fan Minen also left the private room. The two deliberately staggered their time and pretended to be strangers.

“Mrs. Luo, what a coincidence!” Lu Tianfeng put down his phone and greeted Fan Minen openly.

Fan Minen’s face turned cold. She was a smart person, so she immediately knew that Lu Tianfeng was waiting for her here on purpose.

“Captain Lu, why are you here?”

“Here for morning tea, would you like to sit down for a moment?” Lu Tianfeng gestured for her to sit down.

Fan Minen was able to keep her composure and sat down calmly.

“I can’t believe it…”

“If you could have imagined it, I wouldn’t have come.” Lu Tianfeng smiled.

“Do you want to talk to me about something?”

“Did Zheng Yuanzhi want to talk to you about something?”

“Nothing, just chatting.” Fan Minen said disapprovingly.

“If it was just chatting, what’s with dodging and evading? Why not leave together?” Lu Tianfeng decided to bluff her. “To be honest, it was your husband who asked me to spy on you.”

Fan Minen brushed her hair and said nothing.

“He seems to know something…” Lu Tianfeng deliberately only said half of the sentence in order to observe Fan Minen’s reaction.

Fan Minen frowned and asked, “What do you mean?”

Lu Tianfeng leaned forward slightly and said in a low voice, “Mrs. Luo, let’s be honest. In short, your husband paid a price and asked me to investigate whether you were cheating on him.”

Facing the accusation of cheating, Fan Minen did not overreact, but simply said coldly: “So? Can’t I have morning tea with other men?”

“Of course, there’s no problem drinking tea.” Lu Tianfeng said as he poured a cup of hot tea for Fan Minen. “Mrs. Luo should know that if the police are serious about investigating something, they will definitely find out. This is also an important reason why your husband asked me to investigate.”

“But why are you telling me?” Fan Minen frowned. Beautiful girls always revealed a pitiful temperament when they frown, which made people feel sorry for them. She naturally understood this very well.

“Because even if I tell you, I can still monitor you.” Lu Tianfeng casually reached out and picked up Fan Minen’s handbag, touched the bottom of the bag, and then a button-sized black thing appeared in his palm.

“What’s this…”

“Eavesdropping device. I was listening to your conversation with Zheng Yuanzhi just now.” Lu Tianfeng smiled and pointed at the earpiece. “So I know enough information.”

Fan Minen’s brows relaxed and she actually started to laugh.

“Since you overheard our conversation, I don’t need to waste my breath explaining that there is no romantic relationship between Zheng Yuanzhi and me. I asked him out to meet me solely because of Feng Teng Gene’s recent fundraising.”

“Is there any need to be secretive when discussing this kind of thing? What’s even more interesting is that Feng Teng Gene’s company affairs shouldn’t be managed by you, right?”

“In China, talking about business is talking about feelings. Captain Lu must know this, right?” Fan Minen continued to downplay the issue and avoid giving a direct answer.

“Mrs. Luo, have you subconsciously considered yourself the CEO of Feng Teng Gene?”

Fan Minen’s face darkened. The meaning of this sentence was almost equivalent to directly accusing her of murdering her husband.

“You can’t just say something without any evidence!”

“Then I’ll give the recording to Mr. Luo to listen to. What do you think he will think after listening to it?”

Fan Minen’s face flushed and darkened, and she seemed about to explode. Finally, she reluctantly said in a calm tone, “Captain Lu, are you trying to trade this recording with me?”

“It’s not a deal. I just want to know your relationship with Chen Nuolan.” Lu Tianfeng said a name that surprised the other party.

Fan Minen’s expression suddenly became complicated. After a long while, she finally said, “I don’t know her well. I only know that she is my husband’s subordinate.”

“Go on, I know it’s not like I don’t know everything.” In fact, the information Lu Tianfeng knew was extremely limited, but he had always been concerned about an unpleasant conversation between Fan Minen and Chen Nuolan during the wedding banquet on the first cycle, but he never had the chance to verify what was going on.

“There are indeed some romantic rumors between her and Luo Tengfeng, but they are all groundless gossip. As Luo Tengfeng’s wife, I haven’t noticed anything unusual about her.”

Lu Tianfeng raised his eyebrows, he caught two very subtle pieces of information: first, Fan Minen called Luo Tengfeng by his name instead of using “husband” as a nickname; second, Fan Minen said that she did not find anything abnormal with Chen Nuolan, but did not say whether Luo Tengfeng had any abnormalities.

So, did the problem lie with Luo Tengfeng?

“But you still harbor hostility towards Chen Nuolan. Why is that?”

Fan Minen sighed, “Because I always feel that Chen Nuolan is like the mad scientist in the storybooks when I was a child. Her passion and dedication to her work are amazing. Although Chen Nuolan and Luo Tengfeng have nothing to do with each other now, who knows if she will suddenly fall in love with him one day in the future?”

“Didn’t you tell your husband about your concerns?”

“I hinted at it once or twice, but he chose to avoid answering.” Fan Minen smiled a little bitterly, “When a man doesn’t want to answer a question, there’s no point in asking further.”

“I understand. But besides your relationship with Luo Tengfeng, do you and Chen Nuolan have any other connections?”

“No,” she flatly denied. “To be honest, I didn’t even know this person existed before I saw those rumors online.”

“If one day, Chen Nuolan becomes a member of Feng Teng Gene’s management team, what would you think?”

“I’ll definitely be upset. That woman is very smart. If she were allowed into management, she would definitely rise to the top at rocket speed.” Fan Minen paused and added, “Fortunately, she seems to be devoted to scientific research and has no interest in power struggles.”

“Unfortunately, what I assumed would happen today.”

“What did you say?”

At this time, Fan Minen’s mobile phone on the table suddenly rang. She took a look at the caller information displayed on the screen and saw that it was Zhang Wenzhe.

“Sorry, I have to take a call first.”

“Please go ahead, Mr. Zhang has an important message.” According to the time, Feng Teng Gene’s internal shareholder meeting should have just ended, so this was the call that Zhang Wenzhe made to ask Fan Minen to meet in the afternoon.

However, after hearing what Lu Tianfeng said, Fan Minen didn’t want to answer the phone anymore. She wanted to hear what the policeman in front of her wanted to say.

“Do you know why he’s calling me?”

“Luo Tengfeng promoted Chen Nuolan out of turn.”

Fan Minen swiped the screen doubtfully and answered the call. As she listened to what was said on the other end of the phone, her face gradually became ugly.

“Why do you know all this…” Fan Minen looked at Lu Tianfeng suspiciously, her body trembling slightly.

“Finally, I want to tell you that Chen Nuolan will definitely not have a private affair with Luo Tengfeng.”

“Why?”

“Because she’s my girlfriend.”

When these words came out, Fan Minen’s eyes widened, as if her eyeballs were about to fall out.

Lu Tianfeng smiled secretly. He said some things that he should never have said and did some things that he should not have done. Even he himself had not expected this, let alone X.

“I really don’t believe you have such great powers!” He silently declared war on X in his heart.

CONTENT END 41

chapters.title: Chapter 42
chapters.content:
April 15th, fourth cycle, 11:00 a.m.

Lu Tianfeng’s phone rang. He glanced at the incoming call information and smiled with satisfaction. In fact, he had been waiting for this call from Tong Yao. Given her ability, she should have found Zhou Mingle’s information by now.

“Captain Lu, there’s the latest news. I just checked the itinerary of Zhou Mingle, now known as Steve. He happened to be transiting at the local airport at noon today, and had a three-hour waiting time. We’ve arranged for someone to go to the airport to question him, and I’m on my way there.” The content of Tong Yao’s report was exactly what Lu Tianfeng expected.

“Great, I’m almost at the airport.”

“Huh? Why would you…”

“Come by and take a look.”

Tong Yao was silent. Everyone knew that the D City Airport was located in the far suburbs, and there was no place that was “on the way” to get here.

Lu Tianfeng instructed again: “By the way, when you arrive at the airport, go to a coffee shop called Super Coffee in the security check area and make up an excuse to ask the staff to close the shop for two hours.”

“Captain Lu, do you mean that we should clear the area first, and then use the coffee shop to question Zhou Mingle?” Tong Yao didn’t quite understand the meaning of this instruction.

“No, we’re not going to the coffee shop. You just need to ask them to suspend business.” Lu Tianfeng’s real purpose was to stop the bloody conflict caused by star chasing.

“Oh… I understand…” Tong Yao accepted the task without knowing what it meant.

“Send me all the information you have on Zhou Mingle, and I’ll study it first.”

Lu Tianfeng received the documents from Tong Yao, glanced through them, and couldn’t help but smile bitterly. The documents were quite long, but only the first few were in Chinese, recording Zhou Mingle’s birth information and household registration data. However, he was only five years old when he left the country, so the information after that was all in English.

It wasn’t a big deal that the information was in English. Although Lu Tianfeng was not proficient in English, his reading ability was acceptable. What really drove him crazy was that the information was basically just trivial things from kindergarten, including various award records, transcripts of exams for each semester, etc. There was no really useful information.

It wasn’t until Lu Tianfeng came across information from his university years that he discovered something of value. Zhou Mingle and Chen Nuolan entered KMU the same year. Zhou Mingle studied economics and, after graduation, pursued a master’s degree from the same university, also in economics. During his time there, Zhou Mingle excelled academically, ranking in the top ten of his class in most subjects. He received several scholarships and even represented his school on a poverty alleviation project in Africa, spending three months living on the East African savannah. Even before he finished his master’s, he was recommended by the university for an internship at Volly, and upon completion, he was successfully hired. His life journey had been nothing short of smooth sailing.

However, this information didn’t reveal what Lu Tianfeng truly wanted to know. How did Zhou Mingle organize and operate the Nifeng Club? Had he and his father maintained contact over the years? The biggest question was, would he really give up his comfortable life and promising career to avenge his father?

Unless Zhou Mingle was absolutely certain that Luo Tengfeng had killed his father, why would he have done something so extreme? But how could Zhou Mingle, far away in the United States, have confirmed something that even the police couldn’t confirm despite their painstaking investigation? If he had crucial evidence, why didn’t he call the police?

He hoped all these questions could be answered in today’s cycle.

In a private room in the VIP lounge, Lu Tianfeng met Zhou Mingle, dressed in a suit and tie. During the previous cycle, Lu Tianfeng had been focused on observing suspicious individuals near the coffee shop and had barely noticed Zhou Mingle. So, only now did he have the chance to take a closer look at this high-spirited investment professional.

A high-end custom-made suit, a neat and dry hairstyle, a professional smile on his face, and intelligence and confidence in his eyes – this was a very typical image of a successful businessman.

“Hello, Captain Lu.” Zhou Mingle’s Chinese was very standard, without any foreign accent.

“Hello, Mr. Zhou, thank you for your cooperation.” Lu Tianfeng’s words were not just a courtesy. If Zhou Mingle refused to meet or made excuses to delay, given the current progress of the case, he really had no way to forcibly interrogate Zhou Mingle.

“My flight is at one o’clock, so we still have time to chat.” Zhou Mingle glanced at his watch calmly. This reminder was just right, worthy of being a financial elite on Wall Street.

“Very good, then I’ll get straight to the point. Have you heard of the ‘Nifeng Club’ organization?”

“Of course I know. It was a forum I started when I was in college, but I didn’t have much time to take care of it later.” Zhou Mingle seemed to answer readily, but there was something else in his words.

“Why did you set up such an organization?” Lu Tianfeng frowned. He could of course hear the evasiveness in Zhou Mingle’s tone.

“At that time, I was young and ignorant, and I thought that gathering a group of angry young people to post messages everywhere on the Internet to discredit Feng Teng Gene was a way to vent my father’s anger.” Zhou Mingle smiled faintly, as if he was telling someone else’s story.

Lu Tianfeng pressed the issue, “Do you think Zhou Huansheng’s disappearance is related to Luo Tengfeng?”

“Actually, I don’t know the specifics. I only know that my father invested years of hard work and energy in gene therapy, and Luo Tengfeng was just a recent undergraduate senior at the time. Logically, it’s impossible for Luo Tengfeng to have developed RAN technology before my father. But in the end, my father mysteriously disappeared, and Luo Tengfeng became famous. I simply won’t believe there’s no connection between the two.”

“So you founded the Nifeng Club to oppose Feng Teng Gene?”

Zhou Mingle laughed again: “They say we are opposing each other, but in reality we are not doing anything. We are just talking nonsense online.”

“Do you know Tan Jiaqiang?” Lu Tianfeng asked a question unexpectedly.

“Is that Mr. Tan from D City University? We’ve communicated online.”

“What is your relationship with him?”

“Online users, just online users.” Zhou Mingle spread his hands. “I haven’t even seen his photo, so strictly speaking, I don’t know him.”

“I thought you had been remotely controlling the affairs of the Nifeng Club through him.”

“Captain Lu, you’re overthinking it. The Nifeng Club is just a loose online group with no real business to speak of…”

Lu Tianfeng interrupted, “That’s not right. I saw that you were quite organized and disciplined when you were trying to discredit Feng Teng Gene.”

“I didn’t organize or plan those things. Do you think I have the leisure time for this given the pressure of my work?”

“So you didn’t know that Tan Jiaqiang was planning to murder someone?”

“Murder?” Zhou Mingle frowned, and for the first time, his face lost its composure. “I don’t understand what you are talking about…”

“Tan Jiaqiang is planning to kill Luo Tengfeng this afternoon.” Lu Tianfeng paused deliberately, staring into Zhou Mingle’s eyes. “You really don’t know?”

“I don’t know. Teacher Tan and I are just casual acquaintances. How could he possibly tell me something like this?”

Lu Tianfeng fell into deep thought. Judging from Zhou Mingle’s response and attitude, he did not seem like an insider. However, was he really just a bystander in the whole incident?

“Do you know Chen Nuolan?” Lu Tianfeng changed the subject and asked another question.

“I know her. We were classmates in college, in the same batch but in different departments.”

“Have you contacted her recently?”

“Yes, she contacted me via email a while ago and asked if Volly was interested in investing in Feng Teng Gene.”

“What’s your answer?”

“Of course there’s interest. After all, Feng Teng Gene is a rare star enterprise.”

Lu Tianfeng asked a little confusedly: “But don’t you hate Luo Tengfeng in your heart? Why invest in his company?”

“There’s no contradiction between the two!” Zhou Mingle revealed a mysterious expression. “I hate Luo Tengfeng, but I don’t hate Feng Teng Gene. Who would hate a company that makes money every day? I even hope to snatch this company from Luo Tengfeng!”

Lu Tianfeng savored the meaning of this sentence carefully. Zhou Mingle continued to explain: “If you want to fight for control of a company, the first step is to buy shares and become a shareholder with voting rights.”

“Could this be the real reason why you are willing to invest in Feng Teng Gene?” Lu Tianfeng finally understood.

“Whether to invest or not is not up to me alone. Even if Volly eventually acquires a stake in Feng Teng Gene, I may not be qualified to participate in the company’s operations. But if I want revenge on Luo Tengfeng, I will choose to use business means such as equity investment and mergers and acquisitions to compete with him, because only in this field can I maximize my advantages.”

“So, for you right now, there’s no point in posting negative comments about Feng Teng Gene online.”

“That kind of behavior has never been meaningful. It was just that I mistakenly thought it was meaningful when I was young.” Zhou Mingle was actually only in his twenties, but his words showed that he had experienced a lot.

Lu Tianfeng fell silent again. He was quickly thinking about what had happened in these cycles in his mind. He once thought that Zhou Mingle was the key to solving the mystery, but now it seemed that his judgment was wrong.

The biggest difference between Zhou Mingle and Tan Jiaqiang was that Tan Jiaqiang only wanted to destroy everything of Luo Tengfeng, while Zhou Mingle wanted to take away everything from Luo Tengfeng and take back the honor and interests that should have belonged to his father. They have fundamental differences and it was difficult for them to join forces.

“So do you have any additional information about your father’s disappearance?”

“Haha, how could I possibly know something I can’t even find in China?” Zhou Mingle’s smile was a bit sad. “I even posted a reward online before, offering a bonus to anyone who could provide valid clues. However, it only attracted some bored scammers, and I didn’t get anything in return.”

“Have you seen these people?” Lu Tianfeng took out photos of Fan Minen, Zhang Wenzhe and Gao Miaomiao and placed them in front of Zhou Mingle one by one.

Zhou Mingle only took a quick look and said, “I haven’t seen them, but I know who they are. After all, I did a background check on Feng Teng Gene.”

“Have you ever had contact with them?”

“No.”

“Take a closer look at this photo.” Lu Tianfeng picked out Gao Miaomiao’s photo and placed it in front of Zhou Mingle. “Did you notice anything?”

“I know her name is Gao Miaomiao, but…” Zhou Mingle suddenly stopped talking. He probably saw some clues from Gao Miaomiao’s brows.

“Her eyes and nose look a bit like yours, don’t they?”

Zhou Mingle bit his lip and said nothing.

“Did you know she was your half-sister?”

“No… Impossible…” Zhou Mingle picked up the photo in disbelief as he listened to Lu Tianfeng’s question and looked closely at it. He didn’t look like he was acting.

“If necessary, we can arrange for you to do a genetic test…”

“No, there’s no need for that.” Zhou Mingle immediately interrupted Lu Tianfeng, “I don’t want to do something like this that has no meaning.”

Lu Tianfeng was shocked when he heard these ordinary words. Didn’t Gao Miaomiao say almost the same words this morning?

If these two siblings really haven’t communicated with each other for many years, why did they speak in such similar tones?

“It’s very interesting. I had heard what you just said earlier today.”

“Oh?” Zhou Mingle’s facial muscles became stiff. Although he tried his best to pretend that he didn’t care, he still showed a slight nervousness.

“Gao Miaomiao’s tone of voice is very similar to yours!” Lu Tianfeng picked up the photo on the table. “It seems that you two siblings are very connected. If you two join forces, will you become the largest shareholder of Feng Teng Gene?”

Zhou Mingle’s mouth twitched twice, and he said, “Captain Lu, you have a very rich imagination.”

“It’s okay. If you’re not comfortable talking about it, we can check. If you were in contact with each other, there wouldn’t be any traces left, right?”

Zhou Mingle fell silent.

“I’m a police officer. I have no interest in the intrigues about you in the business world. As long as you don’t do anything illegal, all is fine.”

“I won’t do anything illegal. As I said earlier, if I want to defeat Luo Tengfeng, I will definitely choose to face him head-on in the business field.”

Lu Tianfeng chuckled: “With your sister as your insider, you have a great chance of winning this battle!”

Zhou Mingle no longer insisted on denying his relationship with Gao Miaomiao, but just said softly: “It’s too early to say these things now…”

“If Luo Tengfeng were to meet with an accident and die, would that have any impact on your plans?”

Zhou Mingle was stunned, seemingly confused as to why Lu Tianfeng asked this question: “The cooperation between Volly and Feng Teng Gene has not officially begun. If something happens to Luo Tengfeng, the investment negotiations will naturally be stranded, and this matter will basically fail.”

“So, you have no motive to kill Luo Tengfeng.”

“Of course not!” Zhou Mingle denied it flatly.

“I understand, Mr. Zhou, thank you for your valuable time.” Lu Tianfeng was secretly delighted. The progress made in this meeting was far greater than he expected.

After Lu Tianfeng left, Zhou Mingle sat there blankly, looking down at his leather shoes as if there was something dirty on them.

After Lu Tianfeng left the VIP lounge, Tong Yao, who had been following him silently, finally spoke up: “Captain Lu, why are you spending so much time and energy investigating the relationship between Gao Miaomiao and Zhou Mingle?”

“I need to find out the details of Luo Tengfeng’s ‘enemies’. I also have a feeling that Zhou Huansheng’s disappearance might be the source of the hatred between these two siblings, so I want to test how much they hate Luo Tengfeng.”

“However, how could Luo Tengfeng, who had just graduated from college, be able to plan and execute such a nearly perfect criminal plan? Is there someone secretly assisting him?” Tong Yao still couldn’t believe it.

“Then how do you explain Zhou Huansheng’s disappearance?”

“Actually, regarding this case, I know a police officer who was involved in the investigation back then…”

“Who?” Lu Tianfeng immediately perked up.

“My master, Wu Guoqing.”

Lu Tianfeng patted his head and said, “I’m really confused. With Old Wu’s ability, how could this unsolved case that shocked the whole city be without his involvement? I’m going to go back and ask him now!”

“I’m just worried that the direction of our investigation is getting further and further away from the focus.”

“Please believe me, this is just the darkness before dawn, and the truth will soon be revealed.”

CONTENT END 42

chapters.title: Chapter 43
chapters.content:
April 15th, fourth cycle, 1:30 p.m.

No matter how busy he was at work, Wu Guoqing always needed an hour-long lunch break. As he puts it, if he didn’t sleep at noon, he’d crash in the afternoon. This one-hour break boosted his productivity for the entire afternoon, like sharpening the knife before chopping wood.

His colleagues in the police station all knew about his habit, so unless there was an emergency, no one would bother him.

But today, Lu Tianfeng courageously broke the convention and woke up Wu Guoqing who was taking a nap leaning on a chair in a corner of the conference room.

“Sorry to bother you, Old Wu, I need your help with something.” Lu Tianfeng said politely.

Wu Guoqing knew Lu Tianfeng wouldn’t come visit for no reason, so he didn’t complain. He rubbed his sleepy eyes and asked directly, “What’s going on? Is there any new developments with Luo Tengfeng?”

“I guess so. It’s hard to explain. I wanted to ask you about an old case.”

“Old case?” Wu Guoqing was a little puzzled. The case at hand was already overwhelming enough, so why did Lu Tianfeng still have the mind to care about an old case?
