“I now suspect that X is related to the disappearance of Luo Tengfeng’s mentor Zhou Huansheng eight years ago. Tong Yao reminded me that you were one of the people involved in the investigation back then.”

“Oh, I see. This case can be considered the biggest stain in my career.”

“Old Wu, you’re exaggerating. It’s not your sole responsibility that the case can’t be solved.” Lu Tianfeng was a little surprised by Wu Guoqing’s statement.

Wu Guoqing sighed and said, “Just listen to me first, and you’ll understand.”

Eight years ago, the first person to discover Zhou Huansheng was missing was the head of the biology department. Because he hadn’t come to the laboratory or office for several days and he couldn’t be reached by phone, they went to his home in the teacher’s dormitory area of D City University. However, no matter how hard they knocked on the door, there was no response from inside.

Initially, the supervisor worried Zhou Huansheng might have suddenly fallen ill and collapsed at home. They quickly called in a locksmith, who pried open the door to Zhou’s home. They found the house empty, with belongings neatly arranged. This suggested Zhou Huansheng left home in a relaxed and unhurried state, likely without any threat or coercion.

However, Zhou Huansheng’s disappearance still attracted the school’s high attention. They immediately reported the matter to the police. The police also followed the routine procedures and immediately dispatched personnel to check the surveillance videos on the D City University campus in the past three days.

There weren’t many surveillance cameras on campus at the time, so the only video the police found of Zhou Huansheng was of him carrying a sports backpack, passing by a supermarket in front of the teachers’ dormitory. From then on, Zhou Huansheng vanished from the face of the earth.

Based on Zhou Huansheng’s last known location, police speculated he had left in a specific vehicle. However, campus vehicle management at the time still relied on traditional paper time clocks, and security guards were often lazy, recording only the last three digits of license plates. D City University had six entrances and exits, one of which lacked surveillance. This made the vehicle investigation extremely difficult. The police officers assigned to the case labored tirelessly, deducing and investigating through incomplete information, but were unable to determine which vehicle Zhou Huansheng had boarded.

Wu Guoqing was drafted in to provide support when the investigation reached a stalemate. His first act upon joining the team was to go to Zhou Huansheng’s home and thoroughly search it. If Zhou Huansheng had a purposeful and planned departure, he would have made some preparations in advance, leaving behind traces.

As a result, Wu Guoqing actually found some potentially useful clues: a week before Zhou Huansheng disappeared, he bought a new city tourism promotion book, and focused on the pages introducing the Moyun Mountain area in the remote suburbs of D City, and made a few lines of notes; Zhou Huansheng also bought sports shoes and sportswear online. He was carrying a backpack when he disappeared, so it was possible that he went to Moyun Mountain.

By then, morale within the task force was low, and the vehicle investigation was progressing slowly. As time went on, the investigation became increasingly difficult. So, upon learning that Wu Guoqing had uncovered new leads, everyone was thrilled and immediately shifted their focus to Moyun Mountain. Moyun Mountain, a scenic tourist destination with vast expanses of undeveloped forest, presented a challenging search. At its peak, the police deployed over a hundred personnel, including helicopters, to comb the mountains for days, yet still found nothing.

At this point, Wu Guoqing suddenly stopped and looked up at Lu Tianfeng. Lu Tianfeng understood that this was a small test set by Wu Guoqing to see if he could see the problem.

“The fact that Zhou Huansheng bought travel books and sports equipment suggests he was interested in going to Moyun Mountain. However, he didn’t necessarily intend to go there on the day he disappeared. There’s no necessary connection between the two.”

“Yeah, that makes sense.” Wu Guoqing nodded casually.

“The more crucial point is, why did Zhou Huansheng go to Moyun Mountain? Why couldn’t he just take a car there openly, instead of going through all this drama of disappearing from the face of the earth?”

“If you were in charge of the investigation, what would you do?”

“Investigate the real reason why he is interested in Moyun Mountain. Until the reason is found, continue to check the information of vehicles entering and leaving the campus that day.” Lu Tianfeng thought for a moment and replied.

“Very good. If I had calmed down and thought about it at that time, maybe I could have made the same decision instead of blindly sending people to search Moyun Mountain.” Wu Guoqing continued to talk about the case handling that year.

The search at Moyun Mountain was fruitless, but the vehicle search continued. Finally, a breakthrough was discovered: Zhou Huansheng’s old classmate had driven from a neighboring city to D City University on business that day and happened to encounter Zhou Huansheng as he was leaving. After a brief conversation, the classmate learned that Zhou Huansheng was heading to the Chengbei Bus Station and offered him a ride. During their conversation, Zhou Huansheng even revealed that his final destination was Moyun Mountain, but he didn’t explain why he was going there.

Police later recovered surveillance footage confirming Zhou Huansheng had gotten off a car at the Chengbei Bus Station. However, instead of entering the station, he turned into a nearby alley and entered the urban village. This shifted the focus of the search to the urban village near the bus station. However, since Zhou Huansheng had disappeared more than ten days earlier, the video surveillance system at the time was relatively backward, retaining footage for only seven days unless there were special circumstances. This made the investigation quite difficult.

Although the police continued to investigate for a while, the clues were lost and Zhou Huansheng disappeared completely and never appeared again.

After Wu Guoqing finished speaking, he let out a long sigh and shook his head gently.

“Old Wu, your judgment was correct. Zhou Huansheng did want to go to Moyun Mountain, but he didn’t make it because of some accident along the way.”

“I just don’t understand. How did Zhou Huansheng’s old classmate happen to show up at D City University and took him away by chance? If it weren’t for this old classmate who appeared out of nowhere, this case would be extremely simple, and we might have found Zhou Huansheng long ago…”

Lu Tianfeng asked: “Did you continue to investigate that old classmate?”

“Of course we did. We even considered him a key suspect. But firstly, Zhou Huansheng did get out of his car, as evidenced by surveillance footage. Secondly, the classmate’s itinerary that day made perfect sense, and running into Zhou Huansheng was pure coincidence. Thirdly, there was no grudge between the two men, and no motive for a crime. So, in the end, we could only chalk it up to bad luck.”

“Bad luck…” Lu Tianfeng pondered these words over and over again, and suddenly slapped his forehead. “By the way, when did Zhou Huansheng disappear?”

“I can’t quite remember the exact time… Tong Yao, please check.”

“The report was filed on June 8th, eight years ago, and Zhou Huansheng left home on June 6th.” Tong Yao had just finished reading the file and could recite the time nodes by heart.

“June 6th.” A very scary guess emerged in Lu Tianfeng’s mind. Didn’t the feeling he got from Zhou Huansheng’s disappearance case sound exactly the same as the murders of Zhang Hanlin and Gao Junjie?

Unexplainable randomness and coincidences were inevitable, and this inevitability was achieved through the time cycle.

Lu Tianfeng quickly pulled out his phone and, ignoring Wu Guoqing and Tong Yao’s curious gazes, opened his calendar app. Ever since he became smartphone-dependent, he’d kept a digital record of his time cycles for easy reference.

June 6th, eight years ago.

Lu Tianfeng saw the red circle on the date. He didn’t add any remarks, so only he understood the meaning of the red circle.

A time loop occurred that day.

Lu Tianfeng stared at his phone like a statue, seemingly unwilling to face the answer, and repeatedly checked whether there were any mistakes in the year and date.

“Captain Lu, were there any problems that day?” Tong Yao asked in confusion.

Although Wu Guoqing did not ask any questions, he obviously noticed that Lu Tianfeng was acting strangely.

“Old Wu, do you think that there are many inexplicable coincidences in Zhou Huansheng’s disappearance case, and that it is extremely similar to the cases of Zhang Hanlin and Gao Junjie?” Lu Tianfeng said slowly.

Wu Guoqing frowned and his expression became complicated.

“Could it be the same criminal in a case eight years apart?”

“It’s hard to say…” Lu Tianfeng casually picked up the folder containing the Zhou Huansheng case file. Inside, there were a bunch of photos. Although the electronic file Tong Yao sent him also included scans of these photos, he thought the clarity was a bit low, so he didn’t look at them closely at the time.

These were all photos in Zhou Huansheng’s home. Lu Tianfeng saw the travel brochures, sportswear, and sneakers purchase receipts that Wu Guoqing mentioned, and also discovered some details that he had not noticed before.

For example, there were Zhou Huansheng’s college graduation photo, a photo of Zhou Huansheng with the first batch of graduates after he became a teacher, and another photo of Zhou Huansheng with teachers and students when he returned to his alma mater, Ninth Middle School, to attend an open class.

“This girl…” Lu Tianfeng widened his eyes. He noticed that the short-haired girl standing on Zhou Huansheng’s right had very familiar facial features.

“Who is she?”

Was it really her?

“Who is she?” Tong Yao asked curiously.

At that moment, Lu Tianfeng was a little dazed: “Nuolan… seems to be a student of Ninth Middle School…”

Tong Yao flipped through the information: “Uh, let me see…Nineth Middle School in the city, that’s right.”

“Oh? Is the person in the photo your girlfriend?” As one of the best intelligence experts in the bureau, Wu Guoqing certainly knew the relationship between Lu Tianfeng and Chen Nuolan.

This photo was taken ten years ago, when Zhou Huansheng was a renowned scholar in his field. Chen Nuolan, then a senior in high school, would likely not have missed the opportunity to learn from Zhou Huansheng up close. Considering what Luo Tengfeng had mentioned at a lecture at D City University, Chen Nuolan had attended several classes there, most likely those of Zhou Huansheng.

After deducing all the way, they had to admit that the probability that Chen Nuolan knew Zhou Huansheng was quite high.

Lu Tianfeng said nothing, his mind was in turmoil, but on the surface he tried to appear calm.

Wu Guoqing patted Lu Tianfeng’s shoulder sympathetically: “Don’t think too much, she may just happen to know Zhou Huansheng.”

Coincidence? No, all of this cannot be simply explained by “coincidence”. What role did Chen Nuolan play in this story?

“I don’t think this can be a coincidence. What do you think?” Lu Tianfeng asked directly without any hesitation, because he really wanted to hear the opinion of the old senior. Anyway, this cycle would end in less than twelve hours, and no matter what Wu Guoqing said, he would not really “remember” it.

“Do you suspect her?” Wu Guoqing asked instead of answering.

“Yes, I suspect her.” Lu Tianfeng said bluntly.

Tong Yao cautiously interjected, “Captain Lu, when Zhou Huansheng disappeared, Chen Nuolan had already gone to study in the United States, and June isn’t a regular school holiday, so she shouldn’t be a suspect.”

Wu Guoqing reacted quickly and said, “Don’t we have her file? We can find out by checking her entry and exit records.”

Tong Yao nodded and quickly pulled up Chen Nuolan’s entry and exit records on the tablet.

“Hey, Chen Nuolan’s entry and exit records eight years ago…” Tong Yao was stunned and a little at a loss.

“What’s wrong?” Lu Tianfeng took the tablet and took a look. It recorded that Chen Nuolan entered the country through the customs of D City Airport on June 3 of that year, and left the country through the customs of D City Airport on June 9.

Chen Nuolan was in D City on the day Zhou Huansheng disappeared.

Lu Tianfeng smiled bitterly.

The three people in the conference room exchanged glances knowingly, and it was Wu Guoqing who spoke first: “How could this happen? It’s really weird!”

Lu Tianfeng only felt a bitter taste in his mouth. He swallowed hard, trying to dilute the bitterness, only to find that even his saliva was as bitter as coptis root.

“Leave it to me, I will get to the bottom of it.” He spoke word by word, his voice trembling slightly.

Tong Yao moved her lips, wanting to speak but stopping herself. Wu Guoqing was a senior after all, so he spoke more directly: “Xiaolu, if you have any difficulties, just tell me, and we’ll work together to find a solution.”

“Don’t worry, I’m fine.”

While Lu Tianfeng was speaking, he received a message on his phone. He looked down and saw that it was from Huang Xuanxuan.

“Boss, we have already set up surveillance on Tan Jiaqiang and Xu Lang. They can be arrested at any time.”

Lu Tianfeng replied: “Be careful to catch them in the act, and be cautious.”

“What time will you arrive?” Huang Xuanxuan asked again.

Lu Tianfeng hesitated. He really wanted to rush to Feng Teng Gene immediately and question Chen Nuolan in person, but the matter between Nifeng Club and Tan Jiaqiang was also very critical, and he was really worried if he didn’t go to the scene in person.

“Don’t worry, I’ll be there before the lecture starts.”

In fact, it might not be a bad idea to meet Chen Nuolan later.

CONTENT END 43

chapters.title: Chapter 44
chapters.content:
April 15th, fourth cycle, 2:30 p.m.

When Lu Tianfeng arrived at the D City University auditorium, Huang Xuanxuan had already completed the on-site control work. More than a dozen plainclothes officers were standing on both sides of the podium and in the audience seats to ensure that no movement would escape their eyes.

Huang Xuanxuan also dressed up as a student and sat in the last row of the auditorium. If Lu Tianfeng remembered correctly, this was exactly where she sat during the first cycle.

It turned out that people still had some habits that could not be changed.

Huang Xuanxuan immediately took away her schoolbag, smiled and asked Lu Tianfeng to sit down. It looked as natural as if she was saving a seat for her boyfriend.

“What’s going on?” After sitting down, Lu Tianfeng spoke to her in a voice that only Huang Xuanxuan could hear. In the eyes of others, this was just a whisper between a young couple.

“Xu Lang and Tan Jiaqiang are under close surveillance by our people. They are both in the biology department building and have not come to the auditorium.”

“I see.” Lu Tianfeng immediately realized that things were happening according to the first cycle. He couldn’t help but wonder, had X not noticed that he was “messing around”? Why was X so indifferent?

Luo Tengfeng took the stage to speak, still stirring the students’ emotions, but this time, Chen Nuolan was not by his side. His words, the students’ reactions, and the interactions were all nearly identical to the first time around. Finally, the innocent girl who had been killed in the previous cycle presented flowers up the stage, though this time, Tan Jiaqiang did not rush out to harm her.

“Boss, the activities here are almost over, and Xu Lang and Tan Jiaqiang are still staying in the teaching building, which is the next stop on Luo Tengfeng’s itinerary.”

“Be careful, Xu Lang has a sharp weapon on him, and Tan Jiaqiang has prepared poison. Have the surveillance colleagues keep a close eye on him.”

“Boss… how do you even know this?” Huang Xuanxuan was shocked.

“Just knowing is useless. We need to get solid evidence.”

Huang Xuanxuan and Yu Yongsheng didn’t disappoint Lu Tianfeng. This time, the arrest operation was perfectly planned. When Xu Lang approached Luo Tengfeng, he didn’t even have time to draw his knife before two plainclothes officers handcuffed his hands and restrained him. After the department head brought Luo Tengfeng to his office, Tan Jiaqiang, as expected, offered him the poisoned hot tea, only to be pinned to the ground by Yu Yongsheng.

Tan Jiaqiang originally wanted to make a few excuses, but Huang Xuanxuan took out the hidden camera that had been installed in his office a long time ago – this was of course installed in advance according to Lu Tianfeng’s instructions.

After seeing the camera, Tan Jiaqiang turned pale. He knew that he would not be able to escape the crime this time.

“Boss, perfect!” Yu Yongsheng walked forward and wanted to high-five Lu Tianfeng, but Lu Tianfeng seemed to be thinking about something and ignored him.

“Huh? What’s wrong with the boss?” Seeing that Lu Tianfeng was worried, Yu Yongsheng asked Huang Xuanxuan quietly.

Huang Xuanxuan shook her head: “I don’t know, he’s a little weird today.”

“Is there something wrong with the arrangement you just made?”

“I don’t think so…isn’t everything going well?” Huang Xuanxuan really couldn’t think of what mistake she had made that would make Lu Tianfeng look so solemn.

“I don’t think there’s any problem with it either! Why don’t you ask the boss?” Yu Yongsheng encouraged.

“Don’t be silly. If you want to ask something, ask it yourself.” Huang Xuanxuan rolled her eyes at him.

In fact, Lu Tianfeng heard every word Yu Yongsheng and Huang Xuanxuan said, and he also understood that his subordinates were concerned about him in this subtle and indirect way.

What he was worried about was not that any link was not done well enough, but that everything was done too well and too smoothly.

Compared to the previous loop, X seemed to have truly vanished from view this time. Why? Could it be that X was already 100% certain of successfully assassinating Luo Tengfeng in the fifth cycle, so he simply didn’t bother to intervene this time?

Lu Tianfeng smiled wryly and shook his head. Regardless, by remaining constant in the face of ever-changing circumstances, X had gained another psychological advantage. Even so, Lu Tianfeng still had to continue seeking change.

“Don’t send Tan Jiaqiang back to the police station yet. I need to conduct an urgent interrogation in the car.”

“Emergency interrogation?” Yu Yongsheng and Huang Xuanxuan were both a little stunned.

“Yes, both of you wait for me outside the car so I can talk to him alone.”

This request was naturally against the rules, but Yu Yongsheng and Huang Xuanxuan did not say anything. They stood on both sides of the police car and acted as lookouts.

“Hello, Teacher Tan.”

A somewhat embarrassed Tan Jiaqiang looked at Lu Tianfeng suspiciously, perhaps unable to figure out where his flawless plan had been exposed, and even more confused about why the police officer was so polite to him. He deliberately turned his face away, pretending to look at the scenery outside the window, as if he hadn’t heard Lu Tianfeng’s words.

“Teacher Tan, I want to ask you a few questions.”

Tan Jiaqiang shifted his gaze to Lu Tianfeng’s face and blinked suspiciously. Being a suspicious person by nature, he had already noticed that something was a little unusual.

“Isn’t that against the rules?” he replied reluctantly. “I have the right to remain silent.”

Lu Tianfeng persisted and asked, “It’s just a simple question. Was it someone behind the scenes who instructed you to do all this, or was it your own will?”

Tan Jiaqiang remained silent. He looked at Lu Tianfeng vigilantly, as if he was evaluating how to answer in his best interest.

“If you are just an accomplice, you can confess and seek leniency and a reduced sentence.”

Unexpectedly, Tan Jiaqiang rolled his eyes and burst into laughter: “Comrade police officer, why do I feel like you are trying to induce a confession? It’s really unprofessional.”

Lu Tianfeng’s face turned cold: “Are you trying to say that you are the mastermind?”

“I want to wait until the interrogation room to talk slowly.” Tan Jiaqiang looked outside the car. “This isn’t a good place to take a statement.”

Lu Tianfeng didn’t answer. Instead, he took out his phone and pulled up a photo of Zhou Mingle: “Do you know this person?”

Tan Jiaqiang glanced at him casually and said, “I don’t know him.”

“His name is Zhou Mingle, the son of Zhou Huansheng.” Lu Tianfeng said coldly. It was obvious that it was impossible for Tan Jiaqiang not to know Zhou Mingle.

“Oh, so this is what he looks like! He and I are just online friends and have communicated online.”

“Is it you or him who is running the Nifeng Club now?”

Tan Jiaqiang rolled his eyes. “That guy is living such a comfortable life in America, he’s long forgotten how his father died. How can you still expect him to help?”

“Are you sure Zhou Huansheng has met with an accident?”

“Old Zhou must have been killed by Luo Tengfeng! If he were still alive, would he have watched Luo Tengfeng use some kind of RAN technology to cheat people out of money?” Tan Jiaqiang said full of indignation but equally full of confidence.

“It seems like you have a deep prejudice against Luo Tengfeng.”

Tan Jiaqiang snorted and didn’t answer. Lu Tianfeng switched to another photo of Chen Nuolan and showed it to him.

“Do you know this person?”

“I don’t know her either.”

“Really?”

It would be understandable if Tan Jiaqiang had never met Zhou Mingle, but considering that the Nifeng Club was targeting Luo Tengfeng in every way, would Tan Jiaqiang not know Chen Nuolan’s identity?

Tan Jiaqiang pursed his lips and said nothing, but Lu Tianfeng noticed a slight hesitation in his expression.

“This is the female subordinate who’s rumored to be having an affair with Luo Tengfeng online. Chen Nuolan, how come you don’t know her?”

“Ah, I saw it on the news, but I didn’t recognize her.”

Lu Tianfeng couldn’t help but frown. Tan Jiaqiang was unwilling to defend himself and shirk the charge of attempted murder. Was it necessary for him to hide the relationship between him and Chen Nuolan?

“I know there must be someone behind you.” Lu Tianfeng suddenly gave up beating around the bush and went straight to the point.

“Oh? Then smoke him out.” A sneer of disapproval appeared on Tan Jiaqiang’s face.

Although Tan Jiaqiang’s attitude was very uncooperative, Lu Tianfeng suddenly realized that Zhou Mingle and Chen Nuolan were not the masterminds behind the scenes, otherwise Tan Jiaqiang would not be so relaxed.

His contemptuous sneer was a mockery of Lu Tianfeng’s wrong judgment. But it was also this attitude that allowed Lu Tianfeng to get the answer he wanted.

“Very good, I understand.” Lu Tianfeng smiled, got out of the car and left without saying any more nonsense, which surprised Tan Jiaqiang.

“Boss, how is it?” Yu Yongsheng and Huang Xuanxuan immediately stepped forward to ask.

“Yongsheng, you continue to be responsible for protecting Luo Tengfeng. Xuanxuan, take Tan Jiaqiang and Xu Lang back to the police station and interrogate them thoroughly.”

“Aren’t you going back?” Huang Xuanxuan heard the hidden meaning in Lu Tianfeng’s words.

“I need to go to Feng Teng Gene first to confirm some things.”

CONTENT END 44

chapters.title: Chapter 45
chapters.content:
April 15th, fourth cycle, 3:30 p.m.

Lu Tianfeng sat in Feng Teng Gene’s reception room, his head aching. He closed his eyes and rubbed his temples repeatedly, then remembered that during these four cycles, he had only rested for four or five hours each time.

Physical fatigue could be endured by gritting one’s teeth, but mental fatigue was really irresistible.

Lu Tianfeng had just leaned his back on the sofa and was about to take a nap when he heard Chen Nuolan’s footsteps coming, so he immediately opened his eyes.

Chen Nuolan also looked tired. After all, she was suddenly promoted today and had to deal with a lot more things. However, she seemed to be in good spirits.

“Captain Lu, what brings you here?” Chen Nuolan’s tone was cold and icy, as if to keep people at a distance. It was obvious that the anger from this morning had not yet subsided.

“I’m sorry, Nuolan…”

“Sorry, I’m busy. Just get to the point.” Chen Nuolan said indifferently.

Lu Tianfeng sighed. He knew that once he asked the question, their relationship would only get worse, but he had no other choice.

“Okay, there’s a case that requires your assistance in the police investigation.” Lu Tianfeng also switched back to a businesslike tone. “It’s the disappearance of Zhou Huansheng, a teacher at D City University, which happened eight years ago.”

When Zhou Huansheng’s name was just mentioned, a trace of unease flashed across Chen Nuolan’s face, but it disappeared in the blink of an eye, but it did not escape Lu Tianfeng’s eyes.

“What do you want to know?”

“Do you know Zhou Huansheng?”

“I do.”

“How did you meet?” The pace of questions and answers between the two became faster and faster.

“We met in middle school. He came to our school to give a lecture.” Chen Nuolan was very frugal with words and didn’t want to say even a single word.

Lu Tianfeng had to ask, “Zhou Huansheng is a leader in the industry. You’re just an ordinary middle school student. Was it that easy to get involved with him?”

Chen Nuolan glared at Lu Tianfeng and said, “I’m sorry, I was the best student in our school at that time, and I was very interested in biology, so I chatted with Teacher Zhou for a while.”

“Did you guys keep in touch afterwards?”

“We occasionally contacted via email, and Mr. Zhou even invited me to sit in on his class.”

“At D City University?” This is completely consistent with the information in the previous cycle when Luo Tengfeng said in his speech at D City University that Chen Nuolan was an “extra-curricular senior student.”

“Yes.” Chen Nuolan replied stiffly.

“Why didn’t you apply to D City University later?”

“Is this related to the case?” Chen Nuolan asked sharply.

Lu Tianfeng shrugged. This was indeed a selfish question, so he might as well not ask it. So he changed the question: “On June 6th, eight years ago, the day Zhou Huansheng disappeared, were you in China?”

“I was.”

This decisive answer made Lu Tianfeng a little stunned, and he couldn’t help asking: “How do you remember it so clearly?”

Chen Nuolan frowned. “Because it left a particularly deep impression on me—my grandmother passed away at that time, and I rushed back to attend the funeral. Unexpectedly, I heard the news that Teacher Zhou had disappeared.”

“I want to know where you were on June 6th.”

“I stayed at my grandmother’s house for a few days until all her funeral arrangements were completed before returning to the city.”

Lu Tianfeng asked, “Downtown? Is your grandmother’s house in the suburbs?”

“Yes, her home is in Moyun Town in the northern suburbs.”

“The small town at the foot of Moyun Mountain?” Lu Tianfeng was stunned. Could it be that the reason Zhou Huansheng was going to Moyun Mountain was because of Chen Nuolan?

“Yes, is there any problem?” Chen Nuolan asked curiously.

Lu Tianfeng thought silently. It seemed that Chen Nuolan didn’t know the details of the police investigation, nor did she know that the place Zhou Huansheng planned to go before he disappeared was Moyun Mountain.

“During your trip back to China, did you ever meet or contact Zhou Huansheng?”

She paused for a few seconds, then said, “No.”

Lu Tianfeng had no choice but to reveal his trump card: “But the police investigation results show that the place Zhou Huansheng wanted to go to before he disappeared was Moyun Mountain.”

Chen Nuolan’s body trembled, and her eyes widened in shock: “He wanted to go to Moyun Mountain?”

“Yes, I think he wanted to find you.”

Chen Nuolan bit her lip and didn’t respond.

“Do you know why he wanted to go to Moyun Mountain?”

“I guess… he originally wanted to come to see me.” Chen Nuolan said in an inaudible voice.

Lu Tianfeng looked at her in disbelief. How could she suddenly change her mind after just a few words?

“Why did Zhou Huansheng look for you? Didn’t you say you hadn’t contacted him?”

“I didn’t contact him after I returned to China, but before I returned, I sent him an email…”

“What email?”

Chen Nuolan turned her head and stared blankly out the window, as if she didn’t hear Lu Tianfeng’s question.

“Nuolan, tell me…”

“That’s not important at all.” Chen Nuolan suddenly changed her tone. “I can only tell you that Zhou Huansheng didn’t come looking for me in the end, and I have nothing to do with his disappearance.”

“What are you hiding?” Lu Tianfeng couldn’t contain himself anymore and shouted anxiously.

“You are investigating a case now, right? Investigations should be done step by step according to processes and procedures. I indeed did not meet with Zhou Huansheng, and the reason for our meeting has nothing to do with the case. There is no point in you continuing to question me.” Chen Nuolan was still insisting and refused to explain the reason.

Lu Tianfeng was speechless for a moment. Chen Nuolan was right. Zhou Huansheng disappeared near the North City Bus Station. The place where he was last seen was dozens of kilometers away from Moyun Mountain.

“Even though you knew he was kidnapped to see you, and was probably killed for it, you still refuse to tell the truth?”

“Feng, please believe me. It’s hard for me to explain all this, but please believe that I have not done anything illegal, and I have no idea about Teacher Zhou’s disappearance.” Chen Nuolan’s eyes turned red in desperation.

“I suspect someone learned about Zhou Huansheng’s meeting with you and took the opportunity to set him up to be killed. So I want to find out, who else knew that Zhou Huansheng would go to Moyun Town?”

Chen Nuolan shook her head repeatedly and said, “Impossible. No one would know this, not even me. I sent him an email while I was still in the United States, attaching my personal schedule. But I wasn’t sure if he would really come to see me, and I was even less sure which day he would choose to come.”

“Even you don’t know…” Lu Tianfeng thought of another possibility. Because that day happened to be the day of the time loop, the criminal might have learned about Zhou Huansheng’s itinerary to Moyun Town to find Chen Nuolan in the first loop, and then used the subsequent loops to design an ingenious layout, and finally killed him, directing a good show of disappearing from the face of the earth.

The biggest premise of this series of reasoning was that Chen Nuolan did not lie – she really didn’t know that Zhou Huansheng was coming to see her at the time.

But why didn’t she tell him why Zhou Huansheng would meet her?

“Don’t waste your time on me, look for other clues.” Chen Nuolan seemed to want to end the topic.

But Lu Tianfeng didn’t want to give up. “Nuolan, Zhou Huansheng’s disappearance may be the real reason why Feng Teng Gene executives are being murdered one after another. If we can’t find out the truth from eight years ago, it will be difficult to catch the murderer today.”

“Are you saying that the criminal who kidnapped Teacher Zhou is the murderer of Zhang Hanlin and Gao Junjie?”

“That’s one possibility. Another possibility is that serial killer X wants to avenge Zhou Huansheng and destroy Feng Teng Gene.” Lu Tianfeng sighed. “No matter which possibility it is, the truth of the incident is extremely important.”

Chen Nuolan lowered her head silently, looking at her toes, and finally squeezed out a sentence: “Tomorrow, I’ll tell you tomorrow.”

“Tomorrow?” Lu Tianfeng was at a loss whether to laugh or cry. He was afraid that he couldn’t wait until tomorrow.

“Well, let me organize my thoughts first, but don’t have any expectations, because all I know are some personal matters, which have nothing to do with the case…” Chen Nuolan said hesitantly.

Lu Tianfeng thought about it and said, “Very good, I’ve guessed it.”

“Guessed it?” Chen Nuolan frowned.

“This is related to Zhou Mingle, right?” Lu Tianfeng finally sorted everything out. What kind of private matter could there be between Chen Nuolan and Zhou Huansheng? Of course, it was about someone they both knew, Zhou Mingle.

Chen Nuolan’s face was drained of its color. What secret had she been hiding?

“Your expression tells me the answer.” Lu Tianfeng cast his gaze out the window. For some reason, he didn’t want to keep staring at Chen Nuolan. “Zhou Mingle had something to ask. He requested that you find a chance to tell Zhou Huansheng in person. The fact that Zhou Huansheng has been hesitant about whether to meet you proves that this matter is very important to both father and son.”

Chen Nuolan still didn’t say anything, she nodded subconsciously.

“Father and son haven’t seen each other for years. What could be so important? This matter needs someone to connect them.” Lu Tianfeng looked at his girlfriend and said slowly, “You are that link, so you could make the appointment with Zhou Huansheng, right?”

“Yes.”

“Plus, you’ve been reluctant to tell me about this, which shows that it’s somehow related to me. So, there aren’t many things in the world that meet the above conditions.” Lu Tianfeng paused, “Why don’t you tell me?”

Chen Nuolan laughed at herself: “It’s really not much. Feng, you are very smart. In fact, Zhou Mingle is my ex-boyfriend. At that time, we even thought about getting engaged…”

A bolt of lightning suddenly exploded in Lu Tianfeng’s mind, but he still tried his best to maintain a calm tone.

“So Zhou Mingle wanted to consult his father?”

Chen Nuolan clasped her left thumb tightly with her right hand and spoke slowly, a little hesitantly, “Steve’s mother passed away when he was eighteen, leaving Zhou Huansheng as his only relative. So when he found a girlfriend, especially one who would work in the same industry as his father, he desperately wanted his father’s approval. So I took advantage of that opportunity to return to China and mustered up the courage to meet Zhou Huansheng…”

“Actually, you also wanted his approval.” Lu Tianfeng sighed secretly. Regardless of whether this matter was related to the case or not, he seemed to see the rift between the two of them slowly widening, and perhaps it would eventually become a chasm in the future.

Chen Nuolan’s gaze drifted off into the distance. “Well, back then, I simply hoped that Zhou Huansheng would appreciate me, both as a biology student and as his son’s girlfriend.”

“Was it necessary to keep hiding this kind of thing from me?”

She was stunned for a moment before she said, “I wasn ‘t trying to hide anything, I’m just thinking about how to tell you…”

Chen Nuolan’s voice lowered, and Lu Tianfeng didn’t want to ask any more questions.

After a brief silence, Lu Tianfeng rudely changed the subject: “Let’s get back to the case itself. Doesn’t Zhou Mingle know that you sent an email to Zhou Huansheng?”

“He knew about it, but he was out of the country at the time.”

“It’s enough for him to know. He can have an accomplice…”

“But he has no motive to kidnap and harm his father!” Chen Nuolan immediately retorted.

“Maybe there is, only we don’t know it.” Lu Tianfeng said lightly, “After all, he is a child who was abandoned by his father since childhood.”

Chen Nuolan’s cheeks flushed, and she clenched her fists and placed them on the table. She looked a little angry: “Why do I feel like you are targeting Steve everywhere?”

“Because apart from this possibility, there is only one last, more terrifying answer that I don’t want to face.” Lu Tianfeng couldn’t help but take a breath when he said this.

“What is that?” Chen Nuolan looked at Lu Tianfeng in confusion.

Lu Tianfeng also looked at Chen Nuolan steadily. After thinking it over again and again, he said, “Do you believe that there are superpowers in this world?”

“Ah?” Chen Nuolan became even more confused.

“If Zhou Mingle and Zhou Huansheng’s disappearance are unrelated, then the perpetrator may have used abilities beyond scientific common sense to carry out this kidnapping.”

“I don’t understand what you are talking about.” Chen Nuolan smiled bitterly and shook her head repeatedly.

Lu Tianfeng’s words weren’t impulsive, but rather a carefully considered decision. He believed X must possess the ability to experience time loops, and even speculated that X had experienced more time loops than he did. Therefore, X, like himself, would do his best to disguise himself as an ordinary person to avoid unnecessary trouble.

But no matter how you disguised it, there would be flaws, especially under Lu Tianfeng’s careful and detailed close observation.

He wanted to test and confirm once again whether Chen Nuolan was X.

“Nuolan, what I’m going to say next may be a little beyond your imagination, and I hope you can give me some advice as a scientist.”

“Well, go ahead.” Chen Nuolan still looked confused.

“Is it possible that there are things in this world that are beyond scientific understanding?”

“Of course there are. With the development of science, these things will gradually be mastered by humans. But there are also some things that may be mysteries that human civilization cannot solve until the end, such as human birth, aging, illness and death.” When discussing these rational topics, Chen Nolan performed more easily.

“So, science can’t deny the existence of superpowers?”

“I can’t confirm it, nor can I deny it. It depends on what kind of superpower it is.”

“What if it’s some ability that goes against the laws of nature and science?”

“That depends on the specific situation. There are some things I’m willing to believe, or at least I won’t completely deny them in my heart. But there are some things I may never believe in my entire life.”

“Time, some people can transcend the limitations of time.” Lu Tianfeng noticed that when he said this, there was no visible change in Chen Nuolan’s expression, and her heart was calm.

“Do you mean time travel?” Chen Nuolan asked.

“No, it’s a time loop. Some people claim that they can experience the time loop. They will experience a certain day repeatedly… several times.” Lu Tianfeng deliberately concealed some details to test Chen Nuolan’s reaction.

“Humanity knows almost nothing about the time dimension. Even the most advanced scientists can only come up with some unverified conjectures, so I can’t make any judgment on this.”

Lu Tianfeng was certain in his heart that Chen Nuolan really didn’t know the specific operating mode of the time loop. She was just analyzing it from the perspective of a pure bystander and as a scientist.

She was not X, but why did everything involve her?

The only explanation was that X was someone she knows and had a pretty good relationship with.

“If you can only choose to believe or not believe, would you believe in the existence of time loops?”

Chen Nuolan thought hard for a long time before saying, “I believe it.”

“Why?” Lu Tianfeng was really curious.

“Because according to our current understanding, time is eternal, stable, and uninterrupted by anything. But I always feel that there can’t be anything eternal in the universe. There must be some way to affect the operation of the time dimension, but we haven’t noticed it yet.”

“This is an interesting point of view, something I’ve never heard of before.”

“By the way, who said he could sense time loops? Or maybe I could contact experts and scholars in this field to do some targeted research.”

Lu Tianfeng didn’t want to tell her the answer to this question, even if everything would disappear in a few hours, he was unwilling to say it, because he was afraid that Chen Nuolan would look at him as if he were a laboratory mouse.

“An informant, but I don’t believe him.” Lu Tianfeng looked away while lying.

Chen Nuolan blinked doubtfully. Although they were less than a meter apart, they seemed as far away as the ends of the earth.

CONTENT END 45

chapters.title: Chapter 46
chapters.content:
April 15th, fourth cycle, 4:30 p.m., in the basement parking lot of Paris Club.

Because it wasn’t even business hours yet, the parking lot, which could accommodate over 200 cars, was currently occupied by only three or four. Looking at the scene, it was hard to imagine how bustling this place would become after dark.

A black Mercedes-Benz SUV was parked in the VIP parking space closest to the elevator entrance.

Zhang Wenzhe lowered his head and approached the car. Because he used an automatic sensing electronic key, he habitually stretched out his hand and prepared to open the car door.

Just as he was about to open the door, Zhang Wenzhe’s body suddenly stiffened and he turned around quickly – standing silently behind him was Lu Tianfeng.

“So it’s Officer Lu! My apologies! I thought some thief would dare attack me in broad daylight!”

“How do you know I’m a policeman?” Lu Tianfeng asked with interest, because he always appeared beside Luo Tengfeng as a bodyguard. Of course, it might also be that Fan Minen leaked the secret in advance.

“I’m not so bad that I can’t even recognize the police.” Zhang Wenbin politely opened the car door and invited Lu Tianfeng to get in. “Come on, let’s talk in the car.”

Lu Tianfeng didn’t hesitate and sat directly in the passenger seat and said, “You don’t seem too surprised to see me coming to you.”

“What’s the big deal? It’s all about work. Officer Lu, if you have anything you want to know, just ask me.”

“Very good. I want to ask, why did Fan Minen come to you just now?”

Zhang Wenzhe laughed broadly: “Is that all? We were just meeting to chat.”

“Chatting? Are you very familiar with her?” Lu Tianfeng knew that Zhang Wenzhe and Luo Tengfeng did not have a good relationship, and subconsciously thought that the relationship between Zhang Wenzhe and Fan Minen should be average as well.

“Not really, we just used to be in the same circle.”

“What circle?”

Zhang Wenzhe said nothing, but pointed upward. Directly above this parking lot was the Paris Club, a place of decadence and extravagance. Every night in the wee hours, young men and women would vent their excess energy and passion here.

“So you and Fan Minen have known each other for a long time!” Lu Tianfeng said with interest.

“Yeah, when I met her, she hadn’t hooked up with Luo Tengfeng yet.” Zhang Wenzhe put his hands on the steering wheel, looking straight ahead, but had no intention of driving at all.

The two men fell silent at the same time, each with their own thoughts. In this small car, a delicate and balanced stalemate took shape. Both sides remained motionless, waiting for the other to say the next word.

Lu Tianfeng suddenly had a bold idea. If Fan Minen was likely cheating, then the suspected other party might not be only her ex-boyfriend Zheng Yuanzhi. Wouldn’t the man in the car with him be a more suitable candidate?

If Fan Minen inherited Luo Tengfeng’s shares and then joined forces with Zhang Wenzhe, he would be able to obtain absolute controlling rights of Feng Teng Gene. At that time, even Gao Miaomiao would not be able to pose any threat to them.

When he thought of this, Lu Tianfeng’s heart trembled, and he finally took the initiative to speak and break the deadlock.

“Were you really just chatting?”

“What else can we talk about?” Zhang Wenzhe asked back.

“Luo Tengfeng suddenly promoted Chen Nuolan today, and you were discussing how to deal with her.” Lu Tianfeng went straight to the point.

Zhang Wenzhe seemed to be trying to hold back his laughter, but he finally laughed out loud: “Hahaha, Officer Lu, it seems you don’t quite understand the operating model of our company.”

“Oh? I’d like to hear more about it.”

“If we want to deal with Chen Nuolan, there’s no need to discuss it. We can kick her out at any time.”

Lu Tianfeng said confidently: “Impossible. After today’s appointment takes effect, it will not be so easy for you to kick Chen Nuolan out of the management.”

“Oh? What makes you say that?”

“I know very well how valuable Chen Nuolan is to Feng Teng Gene, and Luo Tengfeng knows this as well.” Lu Tianfeng stared closely into Zhang Wenzhe’s eyes. “Now, do you all realize that Chen Nuolan is a threat?”

Zhang Wenzhe touched his chin and remained silent.

“You can’t let Chen Nuolan gain a foothold in management. The best way is to remove her from office before she’s firmly established. But you also know that Chen Nuolan is Luo Tengfeng’s confidant. In that case, why not choose a more direct and effective approach?”

“Is there a more direct way?” Zhang Wenzhe asked.

“Get rid of Luo Tengfeng.”

Zhang Wenzhe chuckled dryly, “Officer Lu, the charges you’re making are serious. Do you have any substantial evidence?”

“If there was evidence, would I still be arguing with you here?”

“Then all this is just your fantasy…”

“But I can provide you with another important piece of information.” Lu Tianfeng interrupted Zhang Wenzhe without hesitation, “Besides you, there are others who want to compete for control of this company.”

“Are you referring to Gao Miaomiao? What can that little girl do!” Zhang Wenzhe said disdainfully.

“Behind Gao Miaomiao is the top venture capital firm Volly…” Lu Tianfeng deliberately kept the topic in suspense and didn’t say anything further.

This hesitant attitude really hooked Zhang Wenzhe: “How is that possible? I’ve checked her background…”

“Do you know who her biological father is?”

“I don’t know.” Zhang Wenzhe put on a bright smile. “Officer Lu, you’ve said so much because you want to discuss whether there is any opportunity for cooperation between us, right?”

“Isn’t it normal for the police and the public to cooperate?”

“Yes, yes, it should be…”

“Then take my advice and don’t do anything illegal or criminal.”

“Absolutely not, absolutely not…”

“That’s good. I’ll go first.” Lu Tianfeng opened the door and jumped out of the car. His phone was vibrating, which meant there must be a new development.

“Officer Lu?” Zhang Wenzhe sat in the car confused, not understanding why Lu Tianfeng left in a hurry before they even discussed the terms.

Lu Tianfeng did not rush to answer the call. Instead, he walked far enough away and made sure that Zhang Wenzhe could no longer see him before answering the call.

“Tong Yao, what’s going on?”

“Captain Lu, I was just investigating Luo Tengfeng’s movements around the time Zhou Huansheng disappeared, and I stumbled upon something very strange.”

“Tell me about it?”

“In July of that year, the online ticket purchasing system at the Chengbei Bus Station went live. Since the system began recording, Luo Tengfeng has been going to the station almost every Friday to take the intercity bus to C City, returning to D City on Saturday or Sunday. This behavior continued until September of that year.”

“July, isn’t it a bit far from the time of the crime?” Lu Tianfeng asked puzzledly.

“But there’s no computer data recorded before July. Judging from the persistence of Luo Tengfeng’s actions, he likely began this regular travel back and forth in June, or even earlier.”

Lu Tianfeng suddenly had an idea and said, “You mean, Luo Tengfeng might be quite familiar with the environment around the Chengbei Bus Station?”

“Yes, after all, Luo Tengfeng is the biggest beneficiary of Zhou Huansheng’s disappearance.”

Lu Tianfeng felt a little ashamed. Why could Tong Yao rationally advance the investigation based on the two major factors of profit and motivation, while he was entangled in the affairs of Chen Nuolan and Zhou Mingle, and even insisted on forcing out the truth about their relationship?

Did he really not trust Chen Nuolan enough?

“Captain Lu?” Lu Tianfeng remained silent, leaving Tong Yao unsure.

“Can you find out why Luo Tengfeng was traveling back and forth so frequently between the two places?”

“I’ll try, but it’s been a while…”

“I will also investigate through other channels,” said Lu Tianfeng.

“Other channels?”

“I can ask Luo Tengfeng directly.”

Tong Yao was almost unable to react, and it took a while before she spoke up: “Ask him directly? Will he tell you?”

“Why not?”

CONTENT END 46

chapters.title: Chapter 47
chapters.content:
April 15th, fourth cycle, 5:45 p.m.

In the VIP lounge of Tianfeng Xinghua Hotel, there were only Luo Tengfeng and Lu Tianfeng, and the atmosphere was indescribably strange.

Luo Tengfeng, who was rarely seen today, held a cigarette but didn’t light it. Instead, he turned it back and forth between his fingers: “Why do you suddenly ask me such a question?”

“Because I suspect Zhou Huansheng’s disappearance directly led to today’s series of events.”

“You think I’m involved in the case?” Luo Tengfeng gently tossed his cigarette onto the table. “Eight years ago, I was a key suspect. If I were involved, you would have found me out long ago.”

“I agree. So I speculate that the connection between you and X is definitely not the superficial one, but rather a deeply hidden one. In order to find this inner connection, I can’t miss any detail.”

In fact, Lu Tianfeng had another idea in his mind: if Luo Tengfeng’s trip to C City had nothing to do with the case, he could just say it directly; if he was evasive, there might be something fishy going on.

Luo Tengfeng picked up the cigarette on the table again, sighed, and then said, “This matter has absolutely nothing to do with Teacher Zhou’s disappearance, but it’s a bit embarrassing to say. At that time, I was in a long-distance relationship…”

“Long distance relationship?”

“Her name is Zhu Xiaoyue. She was a university student in C City. I was fascinated by her during that time, so I would go to C City to meet her almost every weekend.”

Another Zhu Xiaoyue popped up? Lu Tianfeng really didn’t expect the answer to be like this, but when he thought about it carefully, Luo Tengfeng was only in his early twenties at the time, full of youth, and it was normal for him to be obsessed with love.

“When did it start?”

“Our relationship started in May of that year. From May to September, I would go to C City to date her almost every weekend.”

“What happened after September? Did you break up?”

Luo Tengfeng shook his head: “She graduated and decided to come to D City to find a job. We were no longer separated.”

“Then what?” Lu Tianfeng knew that the two must have broken up in the end, and the relationship did not last long, otherwise this anecdote would have been written into the gossip news about Luo Tengfeng.

Luo Tengfeng’s expression was a little grim, and he seemed reluctant to recall the past: “Later… she passed away at the end of the same year…”

“What?”

Luo Tengfeng finally lit the cigarette he had been playing with in his hand, but did not put it in his mouth. Instead, he watched the cigarette slowly burn in his hand.

“I met her at a medical exchange conference. She was a medical student who suffered from severe hereditary diabetes, which had caused multiple complications. She was particularly interested in academic seminars on related topics. At that time, I told her that if RAN technology could be successfully developed, her disease might be cured.”

“This is also a wonderful fate.”

“But I didn’t expect that within three months of arriving in D City, without even finding a formal job, her condition would rapidly deteriorate, and she would eventually pass away from acute renal failure…”

“Even RAN technology couldn’t save her?”

Luo Tengfeng looked at the cigarette that was getting shorter and shorter. “At that time, RAN-1 had passed preliminary certification, and there were no problems with the mice test, but it had not yet entered the clinical trial stage. So I could only watch her slowly weaken and slowly lose her vitality…”

“Have you ever considered taking a risk?”

“Using unauthorized drugs under development is not only a violation of professional ethics, but also a crime. I would never use my girlfriend for such an experiment.” Luo Tengfeng raised his voice a little angrily.

“Sorry, we’ve gone off topic…” He originally just wanted to ask Luo Tengfeng why he kept going back and forth between C City and D City, but he didn’t expect it to bring up a sad story in his past.

“It’s okay, let’s get back to the topic.” Luo Tengfeng put out the cigarette that was about to burn out.

“Where were you on June 6th, the day Zhou Huansheng disappeared?”

“The police should have recorded my statement, right? I was at school that day and didn’t go anywhere.”

Lu Tianfeng looked at the records in the file. These routine questions had indeed been asked back then, and there was nothing suspicious about Luo Tengfeng’s answers.

The case that had no clues eight years ago was even more difficult to solve eight years later.

——No, there was another piece of information that was overlooked eight years ago!

“I want to ask, when did you meet Chen Nuolan?”

Luo Tengfeng’s hand, which was about to throw the cigarette butt into the ashtray, froze noticeably. Even though he hadn’t said anything, Lu Tianfeng had already realized that there must be something else going on.

“Mr. Luo, you already knew Chen Nuolan before she entered Feng Teng Gene… right?”

“Half right.”

Lu Tianfeng frowned, he didn’t understand what Luo Tengfeng meant.

“Actually, I first met Chen Nuolan when I was in college. One day, she came to sit in on Mr. Zhou’s class. I spotted her unique temperament in the crowd and I took a liking to her.”

Lu Tianfeng felt jealous, but on the surface he could only pretend nothing happened.

“And then you went and flirted with her?”

“No, I didn’t think much of it at the time. I just noticed her existence. Later I found out that she was a rare biology genius, and she was highly sought after by many prestigious universities both at home and abroad.”

Lu Tianfeng pressed on: “According to you, Chen Nuolan didn’t know you at that time?”

“Of course not. I guess she didn’t even notice my existence. After she went abroad to study, I still kept an eye on several major journals in the field. When I saw the papers she published, I knew that this talented young woman had truly achieved academic success. I have always hoped to collaborate with her one day.”

Knowing that his girlfriend had been silently “kept an eye on” by another man, Lu Tianfeng felt mixed emotions, but Luo Tengfeng did not do anything excessive, so he could not blame him.

“Does anyone know about your relationship with Chen Nuolan?”

“We didn’t even know each other, how could anyone know… But Teacher Zhou might have guessed it.”

“How did you guess that?”

“I saw a photo of Chen Nuolan in his house, so I asked a few more questions, hoping to find out more about her. But Teacher Zhou teased me and said I must have fallen for her.”

Lu Tianfeng felt that things were becoming increasingly complicated, but he also seemed to be getting closer to the truth. He casually picked up a piece of white paper and wrote down the relationships between the people involved in Zhou Huansheng’s disappearance that he knew so far.

At the very center of the relationship diagram was Chen Nuolan;

Chen Nuolan knew Zhou Huansheng and regarded him as a senior, and had attended his classes;

Chen Nuolan met Zhou Mingle in the United States and the two developed a romantic relationship. Later, she took the opportunity to return to China to meet Zhou Mingle’s father Zhou Huansheng.

Chen Nuolan was now Luo Tengfeng’s subordinate, and about ten years ago, Luo Tengfeng began to quietly pay attention to Chen Nuolan, whom he had only met once;

Zhou Huansheng and Luo Tengfeng once had a master-disciple relationship, but later they became enemies, with their academic philosophies diametrically opposed.

Zhou Mingle and Luo Tengfeng had no connection back then, but now, the fund company where Zhou Mingle works was interested in investing in Luo Tengfeng’s Feng Teng Gene, and it was Chen Nuolan who made the connection; Zhu Xiaoyue, Luo Tengfeng’s girlfriend back then, suffered from a chronic disease and died after her condition worsened and she fell in love with Luo Tengfeng for half a year.

Lu Tianfeng put a question mark next to Zhu Xiaoyue’s name. Now it seemed that she and Chen Nuolan were the only ones who had no direct contact.

“Is this… the heroine of a melodramatic TV series?” Luo Tengfeng looked at the name and connection on the paper. Although he couldn’t fully understand what Lu Tianfeng meant, he suddenly muttered thoughtfully.

“What?” Lu Tianfeng didn’t understand at first, but then he understood.

Chen Nuolan was what Luo Tengfeng called the “heroine”—she excelled academically, earning Zhou Huansheng’s admiration. While sitting in on classes at university, she drew Luo Tengfeng’s attention. While studying abroad, she became Zhou Mingle’s lover. Upon returning to China for career development, she encountered Luo Tengfeng again, becoming part of his Feng Teng Gene.

“I finally feel the power of the Six Degrees Theory. We seem to be completely unrelated, but in fact, we only need Chen Nuolan to connect us.”

Lu Tianfeng wasn’t thinking about the six degrees of separation theory at this moment. He stared blankly at a name on the paper, and various possibilities kept flashing through his mind.

According to the relationship diagram currently compiled, the only person who seemed out of place was undoubtedly Zhu Xiaoyue, who was no longer alive.

“Zhu Xiaoyue has nothing to do with this matter?” Lu Tianfeng’s fingers fell heavily on the paper.

“Probably not. Teacher Zhou doesn’t even know she existed… I was quite low-key when I was dating back then. Even my roommates had never seen Zhu Xiaoyue.”

“Isn’t that weird? Since you’re already boyfriend and girlfriend, you should introduce her to your classmates and friends!”

“Xiaoyue’s health was not good. Apart from professional academic exchange meetings, she rarely participated in social activities. Since arriving in D City, her health deteriorated. She looked pale all day long and was even more reluctant to go out and see people.”

There was always a big question mark lingering in Lu Tianfeng’s mind.

“I always feel that Zhu Xiaoyue’s condition deteriorated rapidly after arriving in D City. It’s a bit too coincidental. Could it be related to Zhou Huansheng?”

“Teacher Zhou?” Luo Tengfeng was a little stunned. “He disappeared in June, and Xiaoyue came to D City in September… How could the two be connected?”

“You know, we haven’t found Zhou Huansheng’s body yet. Is he really dead? What if this disappearance was just a play he staged?”

Luo Tengfeng asked in confusion: “Why would he do this?”

“He wants to hide his whereabouts and do something that absolutely cannot be exposed…”

“I don’t understand what you mean.” Luo Tengfeng frowned.

“Genetic technology can save lives, but it can also kill. Back then, you were one step ahead in research and development related to saving lives. Would Zhou Huansheng have taken a different path because of this?”

As soon as Lu Tianfeng finished speaking, he was stunned because he suddenly thought of a very terrifying possibility.

If Zhou Huansheng used genetic technology to kill people, wouldn’t Zhu Xiaoyue be an ideal experimental subject? Her physical condition was already poor, so even if her condition suddenly worsened, it wouldn’t arouse too much suspicion.

Luo Tengfeng probably thought of the same possibility. He frowned and said nothing.

After a long silence, Lu Tianfeng asked, “Is there really nothing suspicious about Zhu Xiaoyue’s condition at the time?”

Luo Tengfeng pressed his temples and shook his head slowly, saying, “No, but if someone used genetic technology to induce a rapid deterioration of her condition, then current technology wouldn’t be able to detect any suspicious traces.”

“Isn’t this the equivalent of a perfect crime?”

“Yes, for an outstanding biomedical expert, killing without leaving any trace is just child’s play.” Luo Tengfeng said.

“Do you think it’s possible that Zhou Huansheng is still alive?”

“I don’t know…” Luo Tengfeng said hesitantly.

“But I think that even if Zhou Huansheng is not dead, he would not be the one who planned the recent series of cases. Because with his professional ability, using a bomb to kill people is really a clumsy and risky method.” Lu Tianfeng felt that he had gone around in circles in reasoning, but in the end still got nothing.

“Just because Mr. Zhou wouldn’t use a bomb to kill people doesn’t mean his companions wouldn’t. If he were still alive, he couldn’t appear in public and would need a reliable companion to help him.”

“Companions?”

The only person who could continue this line of in depth investigation and who met the conditions to become Zhou Huansheng’s companion was the “heroine” at the center of the incident’s relationship network – Chen Nuolan.

The two men looked at each other tacitly, but did not say her name – Lu Tianfeng did not want to say it, and Luo Tengfeng felt it was unnecessary.

An awkward and strange silence hung in the room.

Luo Tengfeng coughed dryly and broke the deadlock, saying, “What should we do next?”

“I’ll go talk to Chen Nuolan. She might know something.” Lu Tianfeng regretted mentioning the concept of time loops to Chen Nuolan this afternoon. If Chen Nuolan was truly connected to the incident, he might have already alerted the enemy.

“Boss… there’s a problem on the rooftop of the banquet hall…” Yu Yongsheng’s voice suddenly came from the earpiece. The signal was a bit unstable, probably because the distance was a bit far.

“What’s going on?”

“My sister-in-law and Fan Minen had a conflict, and they almost came to blows.”

Lu Tianfeng’s face darkened and he ran out the door: “Got it. I’ll be there soon.”

CONTENT END 47

chapters.title: Chapter 48
chapters.content:
When Lu Tianfeng arrived at the rooftop, the conflict had ended. There was only one uniformed staff member on the rooftop, cleaning up the glass fragments on the ground.

“Yongsheng, where are they?”

“Uh, you were a minute late when you arrived just now.” Yu Yongsheng felt a little ashamed that his report was not timely enough.

“Tell me where Chen Nuolan is.” Lu Tianfeng turned and ran back into the banquet hall, a sense of foreboding growing stronger. He remembered that in the first iteration, the conflict between Chen Nuolan and Fan Minen occurred after the wedding banquet had officially begun, and they had only exchanged a few words before parting ways, without engaging in physical violence. But this time, not only had the conflict begun beforehand, but someone had even smashed a wine glass, spilling red wine all over the floor.

“Wait a moment, tracking…”

“Captain Lu, Fan Minen has returned to her seat, and Chen Nuolan is walking towards the hotel entrance because her skirt was stained by red wine.” Tong Yao interrupted in the communication channel. She was indeed better than Yu Yongsheng at controlling the overall situation through multiple cameras.

“Leave the hotel?” Lu Tianfeng became more and more puzzled. He quickly took out his cell phone and dialed her number.

“Sorry, the user you dialed is powered off.”

Lu Tianfeng ordered on the communication channel: “Yu Yongsheng, continue to keep an eye on Luo Tengfeng. Everyone else, immediately search and confirm Chen Nuolan’s current location for me.”

Huang Xuanxuan replied quickly: “Boss, Chen Nuolan has already left the hotel by taxi.”

“License plate number?”

“Local license plate, 87Q32.”

“Contact the traffic police, I need the real-time location of this taxi!”

“Clear!”

“Captain Lu, the protection mission here…” Tong Yao’s tone was a little stiff. She was obviously confused and embarrassed by Lu Tianfeng’s behavior of abandoning the mission to chase Chen Nuolan.

“The protection mission is left to you. Chen Nuolan may be an important clue, and I need to follow up.” Lu Tianfeng said quickly, giving everyone an explanation.

“I understand.” Tong Yao’s voice still sounded confused.

Lu Tianfeng hurriedly ran to the parking lot. He suddenly remembered that in the last cycle, he also rushed to Chen Nuolan’s dormitory in a hurry, but ended up making a wasted trip.

Did she just go home, or back to her dorm?

Lu Tianfeng didn’t have time to think about it. He stepped on the accelerator and the car roared out of the parking lot. Huang Xuanxuan quickly sent the information of the taxi Chen Nuolan was taking. Judging from the direction the car was going, she should be going back to the dormitory.

But Lu Tianfeng absolutely did not dare to take it lightly. If Zhou Huansheng was really not dead and Chen Nuolan was in contact with him, who knew what kind of conspiracy they were planning?

“Boss, do you need reinforcements?” Huang Xuanxuan asked with concern.

“Not for now. Just be careful at the scene.” Lu Tianfeng originally wanted to remind them to be careful of Qin Dazhi who was carrying a paper dagger, but he felt that it was better to have less trouble than more.

In order to keep a low profile, Lu Tianfeng did not sound the siren, and Chen Nuolan’s position was unsurprisingly getting closer and closer to her dormitory.

“Boss, Chen Nuolan has gotten off the taxi. I’ll send you the address.” The address Huang Xuanxuan sent was exactly downstairs from Chen Nuolan’s dormitory.

“I understand. Thank you for your hard work.”

Lu Tianfeng’s car arrived at the dormitory building about five minutes later than Chen Nuolan’s. He jumped out of the car and had no patience to wait for the elevator. He ran upstairs in big strides and came to Chen Nuolan’s dormitory door. He knocked on the door, but there was no response.

“Nuolan, Nuolan.” Lu Tianfeng’s heart sank gradually. Why wasn’t she at home?

Lu Tianfeng felt in his pocket, took out the spare key, and went to open the door. However, at the moment when Lu Tianfeng opened the door, Chen Nuolan, who was wearing pajamas, appeared at the door and almost bumped into the door panel.

“What’s going on?” Chen Nuolan looked at Lu Tianfeng in confusion.

“Are you… okay?” After Lu Tianfeng opened his mouth, he realized that what he originally wanted to say was not appropriate, so he finally changed it into a word of comfort.

“Me? Nothing, my clothes got dirty. I was planning to change into a skirt before rushing back, but then I thought better of it.” Chen Nuolan sat casually on the sofa and stretched. “Speaking of which, how could such a trivial matter alarm you?”

“Uh…” Lu Tianfeng was speechless for a moment.

“I guess it’s because I’m a big suspect now?” Chen Nuolan said lightly. She really knew her boyfriend very well.

“To put it another way, your current situation is quite delicate.” Lu Tianfeng took a deep breath. “I believe you are not the murderer, but the murderer may be someone you know.”

“That’s true. I know all the people you are currently suspecting, Fan Minen, Zhang Wenzhe, Gao Miaomiao… and even Zhou Mingle.” When she said the name “Zhou Mingle”, her tone seemed particularly cold.

Lu Tianfeng said slowly: “We have just found another important suspect related to the case.”

“Who is it?”

“Zhou Huansheng.”

“Teacher Zhou? Didn’t he already…” Chen Nuolan widened her eyes in shock.

“Although Zhou Huansheng has been missing for many years, his death has never been confirmed. I suspect he may still be alive and continuing to research genetic technology. Do you think genetic technology can be used to kill people?”

“Any medical technology can be used to kill people.” Chen Nuolan shook her head repeatedly. “But Professor Zhou is definitely not that kind of person. He is a kind-hearted scientist who only wants to develop gene therapies that can bring health to mankind.”

Lu Tianfeng disagreed: “You are acting purely on emotion.”

“I know you’re a rational person, so I want to know why you suddenly suspect someone we haven’t heard from in eight years? Did you discover some new evidence?”

No, it was just speculation, there was no evidence, but Lu Tianfeng couldn’t say that.

“This information needs to be kept confidential.”

“So… you followed me back, what exactly do you want to ask me?”

“Do you know Zhou Huansheng’s whereabouts?”

“I don’t know, and I don’t believe he’s still alive. Let me say it one last time, Teacher Zhou is a good person.” Chen Nuolan’s face showed an expression of impatience.

Lu Tianfeng was silent for a moment. Chen Nuolan’s performance was indeed impeccable, and it didn’t seem like she was hiding anything at all.

So he changed the subject: “Then I also want to know, what did Fan Minen say to you just now? Why did you two have a conflict?”

“She was deliberately trying to cause trouble for me and stir up trouble, hoping to get me to leave the wedding banquet.”

“Why?”

“Because I got promoted today and have the opportunity to enter the management and become a shareholder of the company in the future, Fan Minen feels I’m a real threat, so she started to target me,” said Chen Nuolan.

Lu Tianfeng finally figured it out. A wealthy family’s wedding banquet was actually an important social occasion. Since Fan Minen was full of hostility towards Chen Nuolan, she naturally didn’t want her to attend. Fan Minen must have deliberately spilled the glass of red wine on Chen Nuolan’s skirt to force her to go home and change clothes.

“I really didn’t expect that. Fan Minen is a wealthy lady after all. She doesn’t need to resort to such despicable means, right?”

Chen Nuolan smiled and said, “The business world is like a battlefield. If war really breaks out, of course, no matter the cost, any means will be used.”

“You are quite open-minded, but I was really angry when I saw my girlfriend being bullied.” Lu Tianfeng said indignantly.

“No matter how angry you are, you wouldn’t drop what you’re doing and come here, right?”

Lu Tianfeng scratched the back of his head a little embarrassedly. Now that they had a common “enemy” in Fan Minen, the atmosphere of conversation between the two seemed to become much more harmonious.

Chen Nuolan thought for a moment and said, “I’m fine here, why don’t you go back to the hotel?”

Lu Tianfeng thought about it and realized that it was rare for Chen Nuolan to be willing to have a good chat with him. He might as well ask her what she thought about the current situation of Feng Teng Gene. “I have a few more questions for you.”

“Okay, Mr. Policeman, you have so many questions.” Chen Nuolan said with a smile.

“Did you know that Fan Minen and Zhang Wenzhe are actually in the same group?”

“The same group meaning…” Chen Nuolan was a little confused.

“The two of them have been conspiring to jointly take over Feng Teng Gene. Of course, to realize their plan, the most critical prerequisite is that Fan Minen successfully inherits the shares held by Luo Tengfeng.”

“Inheritance? Are you saying that Fan Minen wants to kill her husband?”

“I’m just saying she has this motive, what do you think?”

Chen Nuolan tilted her head and thought for a moment before saying, “I don’t really understand these things, but if Luo Tengfeng died and Fan Minen was the biggest beneficiary, wouldn’t the police immediately list her as a key suspect?”

“Of course we would. So if she wants to kill someone, she has to use very sophisticated methods to avoid any suspicion. That’s why she partnered with Zhang Wenzhe.”

“Fan Minen and Zhang Wenzhe…” Chen Nuolan fell into deep thought. “These two people don’t seem to have much in common. It’s a bit surprising that they would join forces!”

“There are two other people who are also working together – Gao Miaomiao and Zhou Mingle. Their goal is also to gain control of the Feng Teng Gene.”

“What?” Chen Nuolan’s expression became even more confused. “What do these two have in common?”

Lu Tianfeng breathed a sigh of relief. He wasn’t just trying to get Chen Nuolan’s opinion; he was also trying to see if she knew any secrets. But it seemed Chen Nuolan hadn’t noticed the undercurrents swirling within the company.

“They are half-siblings with the same father.” Lu Tianfeng briefly explained the relationship between Zhou Huansheng and Gao Miaomiao.

“Oh my God…” Chen Nuolan could not say anything except sighing.

“So you’re actually an important bargaining chip in the three-way game. Once you decide to join one side, the balance will tilt. And today you chose to join Luo Tengfeng’s side, thus attracting the hatred of the other two sides.”

“Haha, I only now realize how important I am.”

“You are very important to Feng Teng Gene, and even more important to me.” Lu Tianfeng hesitated for a moment, and finally reached out and touched Chen Nuolan’s head affectionately.

Chen Nuolan stood there obediently, like a kitten, letting Lu Tianfeng ruffle her hair.

“I understand. I’ll be careful.” She promised in a low voice, with endless tenderness in her tone.

“Also, there’s an extremist organization called the Nifeng Club…”

“Oh, I know this organization. They are the main force behind smearing our company online.”

“They’re not just online… This afternoon, someone from this organization almost killed Luo Tengfeng.”

“Really?” Chen Nuolan looked shocked.

Lu Tianfeng nodded: “Now do you understand why I am so nervous?”

Chen Nuolan took a half step forward, burried her face on Lu Tianfeng’s chest, and put her arms around his waist: “Don’t worry, I will take good care of myself.”

“Nuolan…” Lu Tianfeng also hugged her.

The two of them hugged each other quietly without saying a word, but they seemed to understand each other’s feelings.

Lu Tianfeng’s cellphone suddenly rang at an inopportune time, breaking the romantic atmosphere. Chen Nuolan quickly let go, her cheeks flushed, and she looked a little shy.

Lu Tianfeng looked at the caller ID and saw it was Tong Yao.

“Tong Yao, what’s wrong?”

There was a lot of noise on the other end of the phone, with car horns, alarms, crying, calls for help, and the sound of something burning.

Lu Tianfeng’s heart was suddenly gripped.

Tong Yao tried her best to remain calm, but he could still hear tears in her voice: “Captain Lu, something happened…”

Lu Tianfeng’s blood seemed to freeze. Tong Yao was a calm person, and he had never heard her speak in such a tone before.

“What happened?”

“Luo Tengfeng’s car… exploded… Yu Yongsheng was also in the car at the time…”

“What? Where are you? I’ll be there right away!”

“And… Huang Xuanxuan was also seriously injured… the fire at the scene has not been put out yet…” Tong Yao spoke a little incoherently.

“Tong Yao, calm down. Where did the incident happen?”

As Lu Tianfeng was about to rush out the door, he noticed Chen Nuolan standing at the entrance, looking at him with a worried look on her face, holding an unopened express package in her hand.

“Right…outside the Tianfeng Xinghua Hotel…wuwu…Captain Lu…I…I’m sorry…”

“Are you injured too?”

“It’s so cold…” She stopped talking.

“Tong Yao! Tong Yao!” Lu Tianfeng was almost shouting.

But Tong Yao still did not respond. There was only a loud “boom” and the communication was interrupted.

Lu Tianfeng stood there blankly. His brain kept telling himself to hurry up, hurry back, but his body was like a stone, motionless.

“peak……”

X finally took action. At the last moment of this cycle, he carried out a practice attack and succeeded.

Lu Tianfeng knew very well that he had about two hours to investigate the explosion site and remember some key details so as to avoid a tragedy in the fifth cycle.

Luo Tengfeng, Yu Yongsheng, Huang Xuanxuan, Tong Yao… Even if they all died, they would be resurrected. This explosion did not really happen.

But Lu Tianfeng just didn’t have the courage to take a step forward. His feet seemed to be frozen, frozen in place.

“Feng, are you okay?”

“I… am fine… I’m going back to work…” Lu Tianfeng forced himself to walk out of this door and return to the scene. Even if the situation there was terrible, he had to face it bravely.

“You look very bad.”

“I’m really fine… What’s in that package?” Lu Tianfeng didn’t understand why he suddenly asked such a question.

“I don’t know. There’s no sender information on it.”

Installing various bombs was exactly what X was best at.

“Don’t open it! Call the police immediately!” A light seemed to flash in Lu Tianfeng’s mind, and he shouted subconsciously, which scared Chen Nuolan. She couldn’t hold the package firmly for a moment, and it fell to the floor.

At the moment the package fell to the ground, Lu Tianfeng seemed to see a strong light covering the entire world, and then the world began to spin and shatter.

Lu Tianfeng felt like he was flying out and hitting something heavily, but strangely, he didn’t feel much pain.

There was only darkness before his eyes. He could see nothing and hear nothing. The only thing he could feel was something wet and warm flowing on his face and the smell of blood.

“Nuolan…” He wanted to use his hands to feel around and search, but found that his hands were no longer under his control.

It hurt so much. Wave after wave of increasingly intense pain finally hit, rapidly devouring his consciousness.

“Where are you?”

At this moment, it seemed as if someone grabbed his hand. The hand was weak and cold.

“Is that you?”

There was no answer… the last bit of consciousness disappeared.

Then, the next second, Lu Tianfeng suddenly came to his senses and found himself sitting at his desk at home, with the clock just striking midnight. He certainly had no wounds on his body, but the excruciating pain of his near-death state was still lingering in his heart. Although the feeling of escaping death was great, it was also terrifying.

The real, final April 15th had begun.

This also proved that Lu Tianfeng died in the fourth cycle. He was killed in Chen Nuolan’s dormitory by a bomb disguised as a package.

Not only did X successfully kill Luo Tengfeng, he also prevented Lu Tianfeng from conducting an on-site investigation. Lu Tianfeng had to admit that after experiencing four time loops, his biggest gain was actually a full sense of frustration.

What happened this time would never be repeated. Time passed by minute by minute, and time became the most precious thing at the moment. Lu Tianfeng, who should have been racing against time to pursue the truth, sat there like a stone statue, motionless.

He was still recalling the shock and impact of the moment of death and could not calm down for a long time.

The endless night outside the window seemed darker than before.

CONTENT END 48

chapters.title: Chapter 49
chapters.content:
April 15th, fifth cycle, 1:15 am.

Lu Tianfeng finally stood up. He recalled every detail of the past four cycles over and over again, and finally made a desperate decision.

Tan Jiaqiang, Xu Lang, Qin Dazhi, Mo Rui, Zhou Mingle, Zhu Xiaoyue… In each time loop, the variables became more and more. In the end, Lu Tianfeng simply did not have enough time and energy to take into account all the variables, while X had already successfully planned two bombings and murders.

If Lu Tianfeng and X were required to fight according to the “time loop” rule, Lu Tianfeng would have been defeated miserably in the first four duels, and in the fifth and final duel, he still didn’t see any chance of winning.

So, was X really sure to win?

“There is one last way…” Lu Tianfeng muttered to himself, and suddenly, his eyes lit up.

If he couldn’t beat X under the rules of the “time loop” game, why not change the rules? Who said one had to rely on the superpower of sensing time loops to solve a case?

“This time, let’s play something different.”
