He knew that everything he did next would be extremely dangerous. Not only would it be on the edge of the law, it would also likely trigger a series of serious consequences.

But only in this way could the rules of the game be completely overturned and the huge advantages accumulated by X in the previous cycles be wiped out.

Three o’clock in the morning.

Lu Tianfeng parked his car on the side of the road a short distance from Chen Nuolan’s dorm, a spot perfectly blind to the surveillance cameras. As a matter of habit, Lu Tianfeng had already studied the surrounding surveillance layout and knew there were only two unavoidable cameras along the way from here to Chen Nuolan’s apartment. His solution was simple and drastic: he destroyed them with black spray paint.

At this point in time, it was almost impossible for anyone to notice his actions.

So he successfully sneaked into the dormitory building and opened the door with the spare key. The dormitory was very quiet, and the silvery moonlight seemed brighter than usual. When he tiptoed to open the bedroom door, he heard Chen Nuolan’s calm and even breathing.

Lu Tianfeng came to Chen Nuolan’s bed silently, his hands trembling slightly.

“I’m sorry, Nuolan.” This sentence was almost heard by only himself.

Lu Tianfeng slowly raised the syringe in his hand. The syringe was filled with the banned drug he had just stolen from the police laboratory. This kind of drug was often used by people with ulterior motives when hunting for beauties in bars. A few drops could make a person lose consciousness temporarily, and the amount in this syringe was enough to make a person sleep for more than ten hours, which was also very harmful to the body.

If there was any other choice, he would never do it.

But he decided to completely erase the variable Chen Nuolan from today’s time.

This was his only choice.

Lu Tianfeng took a deep breath, gritted his teeth, and inserted the syringe into Chen Nuolan’s snow-white neck.

“Hmm?” Chen Nuolan, who was in her sleep, seemed to sense something and hummed softly. Her eyelids twitched as if she wanted to open them. But as the liquid in the syringe gradually decreased, she quickly relaxed and fell into a deep sleep.

Lu Tianfeng stared blankly at the empty syringe and stood there for a few minutes before reaching out and patting Chen Nuolan’s cheek.

“Nuolan. Nuolan?”

She was still lying motionless on the bed.

“I’m sorry…” Lu Tianfeng apologized again, but she wouldn’t hear it anyway.

He dug out a coat from the closet and gently put it on her in her pajamas. Then he carefully searched through her handbag which she usually used when going out, took out her cell phone, threw it on the bedside table, and then took the bag with him.

In order to create the illusion that Chen Nuolan left on her own, Lu Tianfeng did not forget to put a pair of shoes on her feet, and then gently picked her up.

He strode out of the dormitory.

And the place he took her to was something most people would never think of.

The police had set up several safe houses in this city. These houses were prepared for emergencies, sometimes to protect witnesses, sometimes to facilitate undercover contacts, and sometimes for special police operations.

Most of the safe houses were idle on weekdays, but there were people in the police station who were responsible for regularly opening the windows to ventilate these houses, cleaning them, and storing dry food, because no one knew when one of them would be used.

Before heading to Chen Nuolan’s dorm, Lu Tianfeng visited the police station. Besides embezzling some potent drugs from the lab, he also specifically requested access to a safe house. Given his current rank, the staff managing the safe house didn’t question his reasoning; they simply filed the application with the system. Therefore, it would take at least 24 hours for anyone to notice he hadn’t been allowed to use the safe house.

By then, everything should be over. Either the case was over, or his police career was over.

In a safe house in the suburbs.

Lu Tianfeng carefully put Chen Nuolan on the bed and covered her with a quilt. Due to the effect of the medicine, she slept very deeply, and it even made people a little worried that she would never wake up again.

Lu Tianfeng once again inspected the house, confirming that the water and electricity were functioning properly, that the refrigerator and cabinets were stocked with food and drinking water, and that the first aid kit contained some common household remedies. The door had a special electronic lock, allowing Lu Tianfeng to enter a code from outside, ensuring that Chen Nuolan could not open the door from the inside. There was no telephone or internet connection in the safe house, effectively cutting off any contact with the outside world. The only concern was that the windows could still be opened. If Chen Nuolan opened them to call for help, it might alert nearby residents and passersby.

“Nuolan, the situation is urgent. I can only rely on this last resort. If you leave here, your life will be in danger! So no matter what happens, please trust me. Stay here until after midnight. I will come to pick you up and explain everything to you.”

Lu Tianfeng crumpled up the few notes he had written earlier and stuffed them into his trouser pocket, leaving only the last one and placing it next to Chen Nuolan’s pillow. As he leaned over, he gently touched her forehead.

The familiar yet somewhat unfamiliar fragrance penetrated his nostrils.

“Nuolan, wait until I come back.”

CONTENT END 49

chapters.title: Chapter 50
chapters.content:
April 15th, fifth cycle, 7:40 a.m.

At the ROOST Western Restaurant, Luo Tengfeng hesitated to pick up his knife and fork as he stared at his breakfast. He frequently glanced at his watch. Chen Nuolan was naturally punctual, unless there were unforeseen circumstances, she’d rarely be late. But today, not only was she late, but her phone remained unanswered.

Luo Tengfeng frowned. He liked to be in control of everything, and he seemed a little uneasy when faced with Chen Nuolan’s unexplained absence.

Lu Tianfeng walked forward and made a “don’t talk” gesture to Luo Tengfeng, then scanned Luo Tengfeng back and forth several times with a handheld device before making an “OK” gesture.

Luo Tengfeng was no longer surprised. Since the implementation of the protection mission, the police had been scanning and checking his anti-eavesdropping equipment every few days.

“The environment here is really nice!” Lu Tianfeng finished his inspection, pulled out the chair opposite Luo Tengfeng and sat down, “But the person you are waiting for won’t come.”

“What?” Luo Tengfeng’s expression was both surprised and a little unhappy. It seemed that he really didn’t like the feeling of being kept in the dark.

“Chen Nuolan won’t be coming. She has other plans today.”

“What happened? Why didn’t she tell me in person?” Luo Tengfeng was obviously full of suspicion, with a hint of anger in his eyes.

Lu Tianfeng deliberately lowered his voice: “Mr. Luo, the current situation is very urgent, please cooperate with us.”

“Go ahead.”

“We received a tip-off that X will attack you today, and one of the important reasons that prompted him to take action today is your promotion of Chen Nuolan.” Lu Tianfeng’s words were half true and half false, and sounded serious.

“I haven’t announced the appointment yet…how did you know?” Luo Tengfeng blinked unnaturally.

“Haha, many people knew this news in advance.” Lu Tianfeng cleverly avoided the question, “You should know that many people are eyeing your position as CEO.”

Luo Tengfeng thought for a moment and said, “Captain Lu’s intention is… to ask me to postpone promoting Chen Nuolan?”

“No, on the contrary, I hope you will announce this news in a high-profile manner. At the same time, keep Chen Nuolan’s whereabouts highly confidential so that your enemies can’t guess what you are up to.”

Luo Tengfeng laughed uncontrollably and said, “Even I don’t understand the meaning of such a mysterious trick, let alone my enemy.”

“That’s right, this is the effect we want.” Lu Tianfeng also smiled.

“It seems Team Lu is trying to lure the snake out of its hole. If that’s the case, you must protect me as bait!”

“Please rest assured, Mr. Luo. No matter what, your safety is absolutely the top priority.”

Luo Tengfeng finally started to work on the breakfast platter in front of him: “So do I need to hold a press conference to announce the promotion of Chen Nuolan?”

“A press conference is a bit exaggerated, but contacting the media and leaking the news in advance is feasible.”

“But I have one last question.” Luo Tengfeng easily cut the sandwich with a knife. “Where did Chen Nuolan go?”

“I’m sorry, but I have no comment at this time.”

“Excuse me, Captain Lu, how can I confirm that this is not a scam?” The smile on Luo Tengfeng’s face suddenly cooled.

It was only then that Lu Tianfeng realized the hidden meaning behind Luo Tengfeng’s words. As the head of Feng Teng Gene, Luo Tengfeng did not unconditionally trust the police officers who protected him, even when his own life was threatened.

Chen Nuolan and Lu Tianfeng were in a relationship. Who can guarantee that Lu Tianfeng was not forcing Luo Tengfeng to push Chen Nuolan to a high position under the pretext of X’s upcoming action?

Although Luo Tengfeng originally planned to use Chen Nuolan, that was his own choice. If someone forced him to promote Chen Nuolan, he would have completely different ideas.

Lu Tianfeng realized that his actions were a bit too reckless. He still underestimated Luo Tengfeng’s vigilance and mistakenly thought that Luo Tengfeng would definitely choose to cooperate with him.

“Mr. Luo, please believe me, I would never joke about these things…”

“Then why did you choose this moment to confront me?” Luo Tengfeng asked back.

Indeed, if this was an official action, Lu Tianfeng shouldn’t have chosen to communicate with Luo Tengfeng alone in a private room. The only reasonable explanation was that his actions must now be kept secret from his colleagues.

“Maybe there are problems within the police force.” Lu Tianfeng really didn’t want to say that, but in order to persuade Luo Tengfeng, he had no choice but to take the risk.

“Do you think there’s a mole among the people carrying out the protection mission?”

“All I can say is, it’s better to be careful.”

Luo Tengfeng looked at Lu Tianfeng, as if trying to assess how much of the officer’s words he could trust. Finally, he said, “How about this? I can spread the word that I’m planning to promote Chen Nuolan and have her join Feng Teng Gene’s management. I will remain silent to anyone who tries to find out where Chen Nuolan has gone. However, I won’t make any official announcements or sign any legally binding documents until I can speak with her face to face.”

“No problem, that’s enough.”

“In that case, let’s go back to the company after Captain Lu has breakfast.” Luo Tengfeng picked up his knife and fork again, intending to end the conversation. “The food here tastes pretty good, try it.”

“Yeah, it’s really good.” Lu Tianfeng replied casually.

“Have you ever eaten here before?”

Lu Tianfeng immediately reacted and quickly denied: “Of course not.”

Fortunately, Luo Tengfeng didn’t ask any further questions.

CONTENT END 50

chapters.title: Chapter 51
chapters.content:
April 15th, fifth cycle, 9:30 a.m.

Inside Feng Teng Gene’s conference room, the air was thick with the smell of gunpowder. Everyone present wore a solemn expression, puzzled as to why Luo Tengfeng had called the shareholders’ meeting, originally scheduled for 10:00, half an hour early. Was there some emergency that couldn’t even wait 30 minutes? Even stranger, even Luo Tengfeng’s bodyguard, Lu Tianfeng, was in attendance. This was unprecedented.

However, no one asked why Lu Tianfeng was there. They were all focused on their own plans.

“Good morning, everyone. I just received some good news and want to share it with you.” Luo Tengfeng stood in the middle of the conference room with a beaming smile on his face, his signature confident smile.

Zhang Wenzhe and Gao Miaomiao both lowered their heads, remained silent, and seemed to be lost in thought.

Seeing no one responding, Luo Tengfeng continued nonchalantly, “Early this morning, a top international venture capital firm expressed strong interest in investing in us, so I’ve agreed to begin negotiations.”

As he spoke, Gao Miaomiao’s eyes lit up and she raised her head quietly.

“By the way, this organization isn’t Volly, the one we had initial contact with before, but another one whose identity remains confidential for now.”

Lu Tianfeng noticed that Gao Miaomiao’s face was suddenly filled with confusion, while Zhang Wenzhe still kept his head down, scribbling on the notebook in front of him.

“And this time, Chen Nuolan will fully represent Feng Teng Gene in the negotiations.”

This was like a depth charge, forcing Zhang Wenzhe and Gao Miaomiao to no longer pretend to be indifferent.

Zhang Wenzhe simply threw down his pen and said with a hint of disdain, “Chen Nuolan? She’s just a researcher. Why should she represent the company in investment negotiations?”

Luo Tengfeng spread his hands and said, “Why? Because they designated her as their representative.”

“Is this reliable?” Zhang Wenzhe frowned.

“The specific terms are still being discussed, but the other party’s base price is $200 million for a 10% stake.”

After this price was announced, both Zhang Wenzhe and Gao Miaomiao gasped. Feng Teng Gene’s last round of financing, a year ago, had raised 100 million RMB, selling nearly 15% of its shares and valuing the company at over 600 million RMB. However, with the latest offer, the company’s valuation had skyrocketed to $2 billion, exceeding 13 billion RMB.

“How is this possible…” Zhang Wenzhe couldn’t believe his ears.

“Because the offer is so high, we will carefully consider any special conditions proposed by the other party, including appointing Chen Nuolan as the negotiation representative and appointing Chen Nuolan as Executive Vice President after the investment agreement is reached.”

“Let her be the Executive Vice President? What about me?” Zhang Wenzhe’s current position was Executive Vice President, so naturally he reacted very strongly.

“We’ll talk about it when the time comes.” Luo Tengfeng smiled faintly, as if this question was irrelevant.

“How can such a thing be decided so rashly? We still have other investors.”

“I’ll explain this to my father-in-law’s fund. After all, this is an investment with a valuation that’s increased twentyfold. I’m sure he’ll understand.” Luo Tengfeng remained confident. “Besides, the contract details haven’t been finalized yet, and everything is subject to change. There’s no need to make a fuss for now.”

Zhang Wenzhe blushed at what he said. With such a huge investment and Chen Nuolan leading the negotiations, the result would most likely dilute the shares held by him and Gao Miaomiao to the point where they would be dispensable, and then the two of them would no longer be able to influence the operation of Feng Teng Gene.

“Miaomiao, you haven’t said anything yet. Do you have any opinions?” Luo Tengfeng asked coldly.

Gao Miaomiao was stunned for a moment, then said softly, “No, I don’t have anything to say…”

Lu Tianfeng secretly admired her. If he hadn’t known that she had Zhou Mingle and Volly backing her up, he would have really thought that she was just a young girl who had no experience in the world.

Of course, Luo Tengfeng’s acting skills were even better. He made the story sound so convincing that he completely fooled Zhang Wenzhe and Gao Miaomiao.

“You two don’t have to worry about it. Whoever can increase the company’s valuation twenty times in one go is eligible for the same preferential treatment as Chen Nuolan. Whether it’s money, position, or shares, we can talk about it.” Luo Tengfeng did not forget to throw out a bait, which was also one of the strategies arranged by Lu Tianfeng.

After hearing this sudden news, what would Zhang Wenzhe and Gao Miaomiao do?

If X was related to one of them, would they take the risk and immediately launch an attack on Luo Tengfeng?

“Is Chen Nuolan negotiating with the other party?” Zhang Wenzhe asked tentatively.

“Yes.” Luo Tengfeng nodded.

“Can the results be out today?”

“I don’t know. I certainly hope the negotiations go smoothly.” Luo Tengfeng sat back in his seat, feeling relieved. “If there’s any new progress, I’ll let you know as soon as possible.”

Luo Tengfeng’s subtext was that today’s meeting was over. He didn’t need to consult everyone’s opinions at all, he was just here to inform and convey information.

Zhang Wenzhe couldn’t wait to lower his head and type quickly on the mobile phone screen. Luo Tengfeng saw it and smiled coldly.

Lu Tianfeng also typed on his phone: “From now on, fully monitor Zhang Wenzhe and Gao Miaomiao’s communication devices.”

The prey had fallen into the trap and was ready to be caught.

.

April 15th, fifth cycle, 10:00 a.m.

In Luo Tengfeng’s huge office, a luxurious large-sized desk was placed by the window. Postmodern decorations filled half of the desk, but the remaining desk space was enough for three or five people to work together.

Luo Tengfeng sat in the big chair in front of the desk, took out a cigarette, put it in his mouth, but did not light it.

“Captain Lu, my acting is pretty good, right?”

“You could have gone to the Oscars.”

“What should we do next?” Luo Tengfeng asked actively. Seeing that Zhang Wenzhe and Gao Miaomiao were completely intimidated by him, a smug look appeared on his face again.

“Wait a moment.” Lu Tianfeng took out the equipment for checking eavesdropping devices and carefully scanned the office. After confirming that there were no problems inside, he said, “We just need to wait quietly.”

“Waiting for what?”

“After hearing such shocking news, they will definitely take action.”

In fact, Lu Tianfeng was using a communications earpiece to receive the latest information from Tong Yao, but he felt there was no need to tell Luo Tengfeng every detail.

Zhang Wenzhe was the first to take action, and he didn’t try to hide it at all. He directly texted Fan Minen and asked her to come out for a meeting. However, Fan Minen’s attitude was more intriguing, and she didn’t agree to meet right away.

“The first person Zhang Wenzhe goes to might surprise you…”

“He went to find my wife?” Luo Tengfeng asked calmly.

“That’s right.”

“Very well, he will fail.”

“What?” Lu Tianfeng could hardly hide his surprise.

Luo Tengfeng tossed the unlit cigarette back onto the table and said confidently, “I’ve noticed the flirtations between Fan Minen and Zhang Wenzhe for a long time, but as long as Fan Minen can quietly play the role of ‘Luo Tengfeng’s wife,’ I won’t interfere too much in her private life. It’s just that Zhang Wenzhe’s tactics are rather ruthless. He hopes to win over Fan Minen and the foundation behind her father, along with the bank where Fan Minen’s idiotic ex-boyfriend Zheng Yuanzhi works, to raise funds to acquire a stake in Feng Teng Gene.”

“You know all these things?”

“I can’t say I’m 100% sure, but I can guess it’s pretty close.” Luo Tengfeng flashed a cunning smile like a fox. “Do you think the position of Feng Teng Gene CEO is so easy to hold?”

“And you just said that Zhang Wenzhe will fail.” While speaking, Lu Tianfeng was listening to Tong Yao’s latest feedback. Fan Minen did find an excuse to postpone the meeting, which was exactly the same as Luo Tengfeng’s prediction.

“Of course. Did you notice their reactions in the meeting? Zhang Wenzhe and Gao Miaomiao both looked listless. Why? Because they felt a strong sense of failure. Based on Feng Teng Gene’s last round of investment valuation and its development over the past year, the new round of investors should value the company between 1 billion and 2 billion RMB. A valuation of 3 billion RMB would be a very impressive figure. But the valuation I just told them is over 13 billion RMB, which is something they can’t achieve no matter what.”

“So they have no chance of winning?”

“Yes, when Fan Minen heard this, she immediately realized that it was pointless to stick with Zhang Wenzhe anymore. She only needed to be Mrs. Luo and her value would increase twentyfold. In this situation, would she still choose to betray me?”

Lu Tianfeng sighed, “So that’s how it is. I didn’t expect you could use this scene to attack your enemies.”

“It’s a pity that the lie will be exposed sooner or later. They will soon realize that this huge investment does not exist.” Luo Tengfeng sighed softly. “I think Fan Minen will not reject Zhang Wenzhe so quickly. Instead, he will find an excuse to delay a little.”

Lu Tianfeng had to admire Luo Tengfeng’s judgment. He analyzed Fan Minen’s mentality very accurately.

“As long as I can hide it for today, it’ll be fine.”

“It’s hard to say… This trap may fool Fan Minen and Zhang Wenzhe, but it may not fool Gao Miaomiao.” Luo Tengfeng’s eyes became extremely sharp. “This girl is very capable and should not be underestimated.”

This was the look a hunter has when he set his eyes on his target.

Lu Tianfeng also became alert. Zhang Wenzhe and Fan Minen immediately took action, indicating that they probably had no backup plan of “murder,” greatly reducing the possibility that they were connected to X. Conversely, Gao Miaomiao, who had remained inactive, became even more suspicious.

By almost eleven o’clock, there was still no news about Gao Miaomiao. Lu Tianfeng couldn’t help but ask, “Tong Yao, Xuanxuan… Has Gao Miaomiao not contacted anyone yet?”

Tong Yao replied: “Her mobile phone, telephone, and internet are all under surveillance. She has not contacted anyone.”

Lu Tianfeng thought for a moment and said, “Could she have another mobile phone number and use an anonymous phone card?”

“Even if she has another phone card, I’ve never seen her make a phone call!”

“I think there’s something wrong. How could Gao Miaomiao remain indifferent?” Lu Tianfeng glanced at Luo Tengfeng. “How about this? I’ll find an excuse to get Gao Miaomiao to leave her seat. Xuanxuan, go check everything on her seat carefully.”

“I understand.” Huang Xuanxuan replied.

“Boss Luo, I’m going to trouble you for your cooperation again.” Lu Tianfeng turned to Luo Tengfeng and said, “Please ask Gao Miaomiao to come to your office.”

“This… you have to find an excuse, right?”

“Just tell her about her brother.”

“She has a brother?”

“Volly’s Steve Chou, Zhou Mingle, is her half-brother.”

When he heard this name, Luo Tengfeng was obviously stunned: “Zhou Mingle… He is Teacher Zhou’s…”

“He is Zhou Huansheng’s son, and Gao Miaomiao is Zhou Huansheng’s daughter.”

Luo Tengfeng was silent for a while before he said quietly, “This world is really small.”

Five minutes later.

Gao Miaomiao stood in front of Luo Tengfeng, her fingers tangled together, still looking clueless and timid. Luo Tengfeng didn’t say anything, just looked at her quietly.

What’s interesting was that even though Luo Tengfeng was staring at her so intently, in this terribly awkward atmosphere, Gao Miaomiao did not behave too flustered or abnormally.

“If there is anything that is not convenient to say publicly, we can talk about it in private.” Luo Tengfeng spoke first.

For some reason, Lu Tianfeng remembered the sound of a bullet whizzing out of the gun barrel.

“Oh? I don’t have anything special to say…”

“What do you think about bringing in new investment?”

“I think it should be a good thing for the company. Actually, I don’t quite understand these things…” Gao Miaomiao remained calm but cleverly avoided the hunter’s bullets.

Luo Tengfeng waved his hand impatiently, interrupting Gao Miaomiao. “Do you remember the conditions I just mentioned? If you can successfully contact venture capitalists, you can also become a member of the management team.”

“But I don’t want to enter the management level!” If Gao Miaomiao wanted, she could directly enter the management level after inheriting her father’s shares without having to start from the grassroots level.

Luo Tengfeng changed the subject and said, “Someone told me that you and Volly’s Steve are siblings.”

Gao Miaomiao’s expression finally wavered, and a rare blush appeared on her face: “What… does this mean?”

“You are all Teacher Zhou’s children, right?”

Gao Miaomiao curled her lips and did not respond immediately, but Lu Tianfeng noticed that she straightened her back, expressing her inner nervousness and vigilance through body language.

“You think Feng Teng Gene belongs to your father, and I’m just a usurper, right?” Luo Tengfeng pressed on. “Do you think that as long as you and your brother join forces, you can seize the management rights of this company?”

Gao Miaomiao still didn’t say anything.

At this time, Lu Tianfeng received a message from Huang Xuanxuan.

“Boss, I found a smart desk lamp on Gao Miaomiao’s desk.”

What did that mean? Lu Tianfeng was not in a position to speak, so he could only send a question mark emoji via his mobile phone.

“This smart desk lamp is paired, and you can remotely control the light color of the other lamp via Wi-Fi. There are four different colors to choose from, so…”

Lu Tianfeng suddenly realized that Gao Miaomiao could send signals to Zhou Mingle in the distance by adjusting the color of the light, and could even send a long English message through coding methods such as Morse code.

In this case, Zhou Mingle may have already taken action.

At this moment, the internal landline phone on Luo Tengfeng’s desk rang. This was the dedicated line for his secretary to contact him. It was usually used when encountering special circumstances and the secretary needed to ask for instructions.

“What’s wrong?” Luo Tengfeng picked up the phone, and then a look of surprise flashed across his face. “Please ask him to come in.”

“What’s going on?” Lu Tianfeng asked.

“Steve Chou from Volly came to visit me suddenly and said he has something very urgent to discuss with me.” Luo Tengfeng’s mouth corners raised slightly, and his smile was a little weird.

Although Luo Tengfeng and Zhou Mingle had not yet met officially, the atmosphere of war had begun to spread in the office.

Lu Tianfeng’s heart was also wavering a little. He could no longer be certain that his choice was correct, because the developments before him had completely exceeded his expectations. Even more terrifying was that this was the last cycle of this day, and everything that happened would become true history.

But there was no turning back now.

CONTENT END 51

chapters.title: Chapter 52
chapters.content:
April 15th, fifth cycle, 11:10 a.m, in Luo Tengfeng’s office at Feng Teng Gene.

“Hello, I’m Steve.” Zhou Mingle seemed very enthusiastic and extended his hand to Luo Tengfeng as soon as he entered the door. “I just happened to be passing by your company and took the liberty to come and visit.”

“Hello, I’ve heard a lot about you. I’m looking forward to your guidance.” The two of them shook hands politely before taking a seat.

Zhou Mingle glanced over and noticed Lu Tianfeng and Gao Miaomiao standing quietly to the side, seemingly wanting to sit in on the proceedings. However, Luo Tengfeng hadn’t introduced them to him, clearly failing in etiquette. However, Zhou Mingle, having weathered many storms and come prepared, showed no surprise at all. He calmly said, “Mr. Luo, this meeting is a bit rushed, please excuse me.”

“Of course I’m not surprised. You’re the God of Wealth who came to my doorstep!”

“Your company’s profit prospects are so good, there must be a lot of companies willing to give money to you, right?” Zhou Mingle’s shoulders moved.

“There are quite a few companies that have expressed similar intentions, but not many have actually come forward.”

“That’s right, the money is real money only when it arrives in the account!”

It seemed that the two of them had even skipped the most basic greetings and courtesies. There were hidden meanings in every question and answer, and there were hidden meanings in every word.

Luo Tengfeng laughed heartily and clapped his hands: “Mr. Zhou is indeed a straightforward person. This time you brought us good news, right?”

Zhou Mingle still had a smile on his face and said calmly, “I heard that Mr. Luo just received a good offer?”

“Haha, sorry, this has to be kept secret for now.” Luo Tengfeng practiced Tai Chi.

“You have to know that the venture capital world is not that big. For a company valued at over $2 billion, not many people in the industry are qualified to participate in the project.”

This startled Lu Tianfeng. Logically, only Zhang Wenzhe and Gao Miaomiao knew about the offer, and both were under close surveillance. Gao Miaomiao’s ability to quietly inform Zhou Mingle and have him arrive at Feng Teng Gene within an hour was already astonishingly efficient. How could she have passed on a $200 million offer?

Lu Tianfeng turned his gaze to Gao Miaomiao, who remained silent, her fingers crossed in front of her. He remembered that her fingers had been making all sorts of small movements. At first, he thought it was just a sign of nervousness, but now, thinking back, it was probably a secret way for them to communicate with each other.

Luo Tengfeng hadn’t noticed Gao Miaomiao’s actions, and was naturally even more surprised when Zhou Mingle spoke out the price. However, he didn’t reveal his emotions at all, and said calmly, “It’s just a quote.”

“I’m curious, does this offer actually exist?” Zhou Mingle leaned forward slightly, looking ready to take the initiative. “I’ve asked my friends, and no company has made such an offer. Furthermore, among several top-tier international venture capital firms, I’m the only vice president currently in D City.”

Zhou Mingle’s meaning was self-evident. He believed that Feng Teng Gene had not received any offer for a $200 million investment at present, and all this was just a bluff by Luo Tengfeng.

Although there was no real smoke of war in the office, it still made people feel a little breathless.

Lu Tianfeng’s heart was nearly beating in his throat. He didn’t know much about business warfare; the entire scene was completely up to Luo Tengfeng. While it wouldn’t matter much if the scam was exposed, revealing the truth too early would still affect Lu Tianfeng’s plan to lure the snake out of its hole.

Luo Tengfeng’s face remained calm. He smiled and said, “No matter how well-informed Mr. Zhou is, he can’t possibly know everything, right? Besides, who said Chen Nuolan is in D City right now?”

Zhou Mingle was stunned when he heard this. He obviously didn’t expect Luo Tengfeng’s position to be so tough. The 200 million investment really didn’t seem like a cover.

“I believe you should have tried to contact Chen Nuolan, right?” Luo Tengfeng continued.

Of course, when Zhou Mingle called Chen Nuolan’s cell phone, he could only hear the prompt tone of “No one answered”. Except for Lu Tianfeng, no one knew where she was or what she was doing.

“Regardless of whether other companies have provided quotations or not, I am fully sincere.” As a business elite, Zhou Mingle did not continue to dwell on the issue of Chen Nuolan’s whereabouts, but took the initiative to bring the topic into the field that he could control.

“Could Volly’s valuation for us also be $2 billion?”

“Whether Feng Teng Gene is worth $2 billion at this moment is secondary. What Mr. Luo should be concerned about is whether this company can grow to a market value of $20 billion in a few years.”

“Well…” Luo Tengfeng paused. “I haven’t really thought about it.”

“If you choose to work with Volly, maybe it won’t be a dream.”

“The key is, who will be the CEO of Feng Teng Gene by then? You, me? Or your sister?”

Zhou Mingle blinked: “The competent ones take the position. Who knows what will happen in a few years?”

“You admit she’s your sister?”

“In fact, she is my sister.” Zhou Mingle was surprisingly frank.

Luo Tengfeng fell into a brief silence. He scratched his chin thoughtfully, looking at the man in front of him who was able to mobilize hundreds of millions of funds, as if he wanted to see through the other party’s intentions at a glance.

Zhou Mingle sat as steady as a rock, not caring at all about Luo Tengfeng’s questioning and inquiring gaze.

“Do you two, brother and sister, hope to grab the company that may have belonged to your father?”

“Boss Luo, the word ‘grab’ isn’t quite right. Everyone knows Feng Teng Gene is a hen that lays golden eggs.” Zhou Mingle said quietly, “I’m just like everyone else, I’ve taken a fancy to this hen.”

“Mr. Zhou, do you want to keep this hen all to yourself, or share it with me? Do you want to be my enemy, or my friend?”

“The difference between friend and enemy is just a thought away. Your friend today could be your enemy tomorrow.” Zhou Mingle spread out his palms. “At least, I won’t do anything bad behind your back.”

“Mr. Zhou, do you mean that someone is doing bad things behind my back?” Luo Tengfeng’s face turned cold.

“I heard that when two of the company’s executives were murdered, negative news kept coming out, and the company was in urgent need of a new round of financing, your wife quietly raised a large sum of money without telling you. I wonder what she’s up to!”

Luo Tengfeng’s eyes lit up: “I didn’t expect Mr. Zhou to be so well-informed!”

“But Mr. Luo didn’t seem surprised when he heard it?”

“How could anyone possibly hide the matter about Feng Teng Gene from me?”

The two men smiled at each other knowingly. Both men were scheming and had prepared various back-up plans. In this tit-for-tat confrontation, a sense of mutual understanding emerged. But they both knew that while they could share interests, they would never be friends.

At this moment, Lu Tianfeng felt a growing sense of crisis. After Luo Tengfeng announced the fabricated “$200 million investment agreement,” Fan Minen, Zhang Wenzhe, Gao Miaomiao, and Zhou Mingle all responded quickly, all using commercial methods. Common sense suggests that the likelihood of them being connected to X was relatively low.

Could it be that the mastermind behind the two explosions that occurred at the end of the fourth cycle was someone else?

Lu Tianfeng’s cellphone suddenly rang. His phone had been in vibrate mode, so the sound was not a ringtone, but an alarm used in the police’s internal communication system, indicating an emergency.

“What’s wrong?” Lu Tianfeng asked hurriedly.

Zhou Mingle couldn’t help but cast a curious look at Lu Tianfeng, because he knew very well that anyone who dared to interrupt the meeting casually in this place must be of extraordinary status.

Yu Yongsheng was the first to respond on the communication channel: “Boss, a suspicious package was found in the first floor lobby. It’s suspected to be an explosive. We are urgently cordoning off the area and evacuating everyone.”

“How was it delivered?”

“I don’t know. Mixed in with the normal express parcels, there was a box without any sender information…”

Lu Tianfeng suddenly remembered the mysterious package that Chen Nuolan received on the night of the fourth cycle.

“Xuanxuan, come to the CEO’s office and take over my shift. Yongsheng, control the scene, I’ll be down right away.” Lu Tianfeng gave the order decisively.

Luo Tengfeng frowned and asked in surprise, “What happened?”

“It seems there are dangerous goods in the lobby. I’ll go check it out.” Lu Tianfeng glanced at Zhou Mingle and Gao Miaomiao. “I’m sorry, but your business plans may have to be put on hold.”

The atmosphere in the office suddenly became solemn, with a faint sense of solemnity.

“What does dangerous goods mean?” Zhou Mingle was also confused.

“There is a bomb.” Lu Tianfeng simply said these words. Huang Xuanxuan happened to push the door in. Of course, she also heard everything in the communication channel, and her expression was inevitably a little nervous.

“Don’t worry, it’s okay.” Lu Tianfeng said to Huang Xuanxuan as they passed by, “This office is cleared and under martial law. Except for you and Luo Tengfeng, don’t let anyone in until I come back.”

“Understood!”

Even if Zhou Mingle and Gao Miaomiao were slow-witted, they could still sense that Lu Tianfeng’s say here was even greater than Luo Tengfeng’s. Moreover, they were not stupid at all and immediately guessed Lu Tianfeng’s identity.

“So he is a policeman…” Zhou Mingle muttered to himself.

Luo Tengfeng and Zhou Mingle looked at each other. The struggle between them over Feng Teng Gene had to come to a temporary end, but neither side wanted to show any particularly obvious emotions, so as not to be noticed and used by the other side.

“Let’s talk next time.”

“I believe there will be an opportunity soon.”

At 11:20, Lu Tianfeng hurried to the first-floor lobby. He saw a cordon around the entire lobby, and the explosive disposal team, dressed in bomb disposal suits, had already arrived. Some confused employees stood outside the cordon, peering in and talking among themselves, a sense of inexplicable anxiety spreading among the crowd.

“Tell me the details.” Lu Tianfeng said to Yu Yongsheng who was maintaining order at the scene.

“For ease of management, Feng Teng Gene always had the front desk staff on duty in the lobby collect all the company’s packages and distribute them to various departments. Just now, when receiving a new batch of express deliveries, the front desk staff noticed that one box had no sender’s name on it, nor was there a delivery slip attached. It only had ‘Personally addressed to Luo Tengfeng’ written in a sloppy handwriting.”

Lu Tianfeng’s intuition told him that this was very suspicious – it was not that there was something wrong with the package itself, but that the package was disguised too crudely and there was no way it could be delivered to Luo Tengfeng’s office.

“I happened to be passing by at the time and saw that the front desk staff looked uneasy, so I approached them to identify myself and ask them about it. But then I heard the ticking of an alarm clock coming from inside the box. I smelled a faint scent of gunpowder, so I quickly cordoned off the area and evacuated the crowd.”

Lu Tianfeng’s brows knitted together. How come he hadn’t heard of any bomb packages in the previous iterations? Luo Tengfeng had announced Chen Nuolan’s promotion over an hour ago, and preparing the box and blending it into the package would definitely take more time. This box couldn’t possibly have anything to do with Chen Nuolan’s promotion.

Unless this was an unexpected surprise from X, this clumsy way of installing the bomb was indeed completely different from X’s previous practices.

“I don’t think there is a bomb in this box, otherwise it would have been discovered long ago…” Lu Tianfeng said to himself.

“Huh?” Yu Yongsheng, who didn’t know the whole story, was naturally confused after hearing the conclusion.

Lu Tianfeng changed the subject and asked, “Yongsheng, do you think it’s possible for a box of unknown origin like this to be delivered to Luo Tengfeng?”

Yu Yongsheng thought for a moment and said, “That shouldn’t be possible. Wouldn’t it be impossible for it to even get past the front desk? Moreover, even if it was delivered to the CEO’s office, there’s still the secretary to go through. I don’t think Luo Tengfeng’s secretary would hand this thing over to the boss.”

“So, what was the intention of the person who sent the box…”

As the two were talking, the explosive disposal team successfully opened the box and signaled them that it was clear of danger. Lu Tianfeng quickly walked forward and saw that the box contained a few strings of ordinary firecrackers and an alarm clock.

Although it was just a false alarm, Lu Tianfeng’s expression became even more serious. He believed that this must be part of X’s plan, and that X deliberately let them discover the fake bomb.

Lure the tiger away from the mountain? This was the first possibility that came to Lu Tianfeng’s mind.

“Xuanxuan, is everything okay over there?”

“Everything is normal.” Huang Xuanxuan replied quickly.

Lu Tianfeng repeatedly told himself to stay calm. Even if he was trying to lure the tiger away from the mountain, he couldn’t get into the CEO’s office on the top floor simply by leaving a suspicious box in the lobby. Furthermore, if the extremely alert Yu Yongsheng hadn’t happened to pass by the front desk, perhaps such a big commotion wouldn’t have happened.

By chance… a gleam of light flashed in Lu Tianfeng’s eyes.

Yes, serendipity was the key!

“Quickly call the staff on duty at the front desk!” said Lu Tianfeng.

Not long after, Yu Yongsheng came over with a quiet, thin girl. She stepped forward timidly and said to Lu Tianfeng nervously, “Comrade police officer… I was the one who was responsible for receiving the express delivery just now…”

The first thing Lu Tianfeng did was to calm her down: “Don’t be nervous, speak slowly. I just want to ask, if someone other than my colleague happened to pass by and noticed something unusual about this box, what would you do?”

“I… I will report this to my superiors, and then… then I will follow the procedures… I should call the police immediately…” The girl not only stuttered and spoke incoherently, but her eyes were also wandering, and it was obvious that she had no confidence at all.

“Don’t worry, I’m just asking as a routine. No matter how you answer, it will definitely not affect your work.” Lu Tianfeng said softly to comfort her.

“Really?” The girl’s eyes widened a little.

“Of course. We’re police officers, and our job is to solve cases. Just tell the truth. If it helps solve the case, you’ll even receive a commendation from the police.”

The receptionist hesitated for a moment before finally speaking again, “Actually, similar strange packages have appeared before. We usually notify security and send someone here to open the package together. Once we confirm it’s a prank, we’ll deal with it ourselves without calling the police…mainly because we don’t want to cause too much trouble…”

“This is normal and completely understandable.” Lu Tianfeng continued to reassure her, “So where did the people from the security department come from?”

“If the patrolling security guards happen to be nearby, we will call them over. If the patrolling security guards are far away, then the security guards in the duty room will come to support us, because the duty room is also on the first floor.”

“The duty room is where the security guards usually watch the surveillance videos, right?” Lu Tianfeng finally pieced together the scattered fragments one by one – if the box was sent by X, then his real purpose was to get the security guards in the duty room to leave their posts temporarily, thereby gaining a precious time window.

X needed these few minutes to complete some “preparatory work” in the Feng Teng Gene building.

“Boss, is there any problem?” Yu Yongsheng asked.

“This should be part of X’s plan…”

“Then how should we respond?” Yu Yongsheng became more alert.

Lu Tianfeng glanced at the gradually dispersing crowd and said slowly: “We just need to wait and see what happens and not disrupt his deployment.”

Yu Yongsheng nodded as if he understood, he would never doubt Lu Tianfeng’s decision.

Before long, the lobby of Feng Teng Gene returned to its former tranquility, with employees hurrying in and out, as if no one cared about the bomb scare just now.

CONTENT END 52

chapters.title: Chapter 53
chapters.content:
April 15th, fifth cycle, 12 noon, in Luo Tengfeng’s office.

Huang Xuanxuan stood by the window with her hands crossed in front of her chest. She stared at Luo Tengfeng with a vigilant look. Luo Tengfeng seemed to completely ignore Huang Xuanxuan’s existence and just lowered his head to deal with work matters.

A stone guard statue and a metal working robot.

This was the first thought that popped into Lu Tianfeng’s mind when he walked into the office. He held two lunch boxes in his hands and handed one to Luo Tengfeng first, and then handed the other to Huang Xuanxuan.

“Leave this to me. Go eat and take a rest first.”

“Boss, have you eaten?” Huang Xuanxuan’s expression finally relaxed a little, and a smile appeared on her face.

“Well, I just ate something on the way.” Lu Tianfeng’s answer was a bit ambiguous, and his eyes drifted towards Luo Tengfeng.

Huang Xuanxuan, holding the lunch box, blinked and said, “Skipping lunch is bad for your health.”

Lu Tianfeng nodded: “Okay, I understand.”

Huang Xuanxuan took her leave and closed the office door. Luo Tengfeng smiled and said, “Captain Lu, your subordinates really care about you!”

Lu Tianfeng felt unhappy. Luo Tengfeng’s tone seemed to be teasing his relationship with Huang Xuanxuan. The ambiguous combination of a male boss and a female subordinate was exactly the same as the rumors about Luo Tengfeng and Chen Nuolan.

So Lu Tianfeng retorted, “I care about you too. This lunch box has been checked and there is absolutely no poison in it.”

Luo Tengfeng was about to put the food into his mouth, but he couldn’t help but stop when he heard this.

“I don’t know why, but after hearing this, I suddenly lost my appetite.” Luo Tengfeng put down his chopsticks.

“Mr. Luo, you should eat more now because our next task will be even more difficult.”

“Difficult? Isn’t my schedule this afternoon to go to D City University to participate in an event?” In Luo Tengfeng’s opinion, a campus event seemed to be the easiest thing.

“I strongly suggest you change your arrangements.”

“Why?”

“Because I found this on your car.” Lu Tianfeng showed a video he took with his mobile phone. It could be seen that a dim red light was flashing somewhere on the inside of the tire of Luo Tengfeng’s black car.

“What is that?”

“GPS tracking device. You should know that our colleagues perform security scans on your car every morning and evening to ensure that it has not been tampered with. This morning was no exception.”

“You mean, this tracker was installed in our company’s basement parking lot?”

“Yes, from this moment on, X can locate your car at any time.”

Luo Tengfeng felt uneasy about X’s blatant intrusion into his territory. He adjusted his uncomfortable sitting position, thought for a moment, and then asked in confusion, “Why don’t you just remove the tracker?”

“It’s simple. If we let X stay hidden, we’ll only become more and more passive, living in constant fear. Even the strongest nerves will eventually break.”

Luo Tengfeng asked seriously, “Captain Lu, what exactly are your plans?”

“I’m going to lure the snake out of its hole.”

“So I’m the bait?” Luo Tengfeng asked back without comment.

“I want to ask, has the rumor about Chen Nuolan’s upcoming promotion already spread online?” Lu Tianfeng suddenly changed the subject for some reason.

“Let me see, it should have spread…” Luo Tengfeng said as he operated his phone, then gave a bitter smile, “Yes, the internet is full of all kinds of unreliable speculation and groundless rumors.”

“If you suddenly lost contact at this time, what would everyone think?”

Luo Tengfeng was stunned for a moment, but soon understood what Lu Tianfeng meant.

“Those who don’t know the truth will probably think that Chen Nuolan and I went somewhere for a tryst, right? And for Zhang Wenzhe, Gao Miaomiao, and the others, they might think that I only came to negotiate in person because a new investment was finalized…”

“As a result, X will develop a strong sense of superiority, because the whole world is looking for you, and he is the only one who knows your whereabouts,” Lu Tianfeng said. “So he is likely to take advantage of this opportunity to make a move.”

“And then he will fall into the dragnet that the police have already set up?”

Lu Tianfeng shook his head: “There is no dragnet, I plan to act privately.”

“Act privately?”

“This is the only way to minimize the possibility of leaks. Besides, X is extremely alert; ordinary traps won’t be able to lure him in.”

Luo Tengfeng stood up, put his hands behind his back, and paced back and forth in front of the floor-to-ceiling window in annoyance, trying to hide the violent fluctuations in his heart.

Lu Tianfeng didn’t say anything. He knew that this was the most critical moment. Whether he could get Luo Tengfeng to accept this high-risk plan would directly determine whether he could successfully capture X today.

This may even be the best golden opportunity among the five time cycles.

The prerequisite was that Luo Tengfeng willingly chooses to cooperate fully without anyone forcing or persuading him.

“But if the police are short of manpower, wouldn’t I be in danger…” Luo Tengfeng spoke. As expected, his biggest concern was safety.

“Please rest assured, Mr. Luo. I have emphasized many times that your safety always comes first.” Lu Tianfeng shrugged, “I just need to borrow your car.”

Luo Tengfeng suddenly realized that he finally understood Lu Tianfeng’s true intention.

“Captain Lu hopes that X will mistakenly believe that Chen Nuolan and I are having a secret rendezvous somewhere, and then plot to capture him?”

“That’s right, that’s the idea.” Lu Tianfeng would never risk Luo Tengfeng’s life, but he had to create this dangerous atmosphere, and then retreat to advance, in order to gain Luo Tengfeng’s approval.

If you don’t want to risk your life, it should be okay to contribute your own private car, right?

Luo Tengfeng really relaxed a lot all of a sudden, and even laughed: “Speaking of this plan, I just thought of a good place.”

“Oh?”

“A suburban villa that is not registered in my name but actually belongs to me. Few people know about it.”

“Don’t even the company’s shareholders know?”

“Even my wife doesn’t know.”

“Very good.”

Lu Tianfeng did not ask Luo Tengfeng why he wanted to prepare such an unknown villa. He knew very well that everyone had their own secrets, and people like Luo Tengfeng had even more secrets to hide.

So he just repeated: “Very good.”

“So I can’t just hide here while I’m ‘missing’, right?” Luo Tengfeng asked again.

“I’ve already prepared a safe and comfortable place.” Lu Tianfeng took out the hotel room card he had prepared long ago. “It’s a super luxurious five-star hotel suite. Mr. Luo will definitely be satisfied.”

The room card was printed with the logo of Tianfeng Xinghua Hotel. Originally, in order to carry out the protection mission at night, the police reserved three guest rooms on different floors, high, medium and low. However, Lu Tianfeng used a little trick and applied for an extra room from the hotel.

“Satisfied, very satisfied.” Luo Tengfeng took the room card, thought for a moment and said, “Captain Lu, your preparations are really thorough!”

“It’s my duty.” Lu Tianfeng responded indifferently.

.

April 15th, fifth cycle, 2:30 p.m., in a villa in D City suburbs.

The workmanship of this villa was actually quite rough, and the interior design was not high-end at all. It looked like an ordinary rural house. No matter how one looked at it, it didn’t look like a property that a rich person like Luo Tengfeng would purchase.

But the main reason why Luo Tengfeng bought this place was probably something that no one else would think of.

Lu Tianfeng had been quietly waiting in this villa for almost two hours. He was lying on the sofa, his eyes half-closed, occasionally glancing at his phone and taking a sip of the iced Coke in front of him.

He seemed relaxed, but in fact, this kind of waiting full of unknowns was the most painful torture for him.

If a mission officer lost contact for more than ten minutes without cause, they were placed on an emergency search list. Lu Tianfeng had already left his original cellphone and communicator at Feng Teng Gene and replaced them with a temporary phone and an anonymous SIM card, preventing the police from tracking him through conventional means. On the way here, he had covered the license plate with a red cloth. This meant that locating the car would require visual inspection of traffic surveillance footage, gradually narrowing the search area, which could take two to three hours.

Lu Tianfeng tried every possible way to buy himself more time, because he was not sure whether X would come here, let alone when X would appear. Time passed by every second, and he needed to do his best to keep a calm mind.

Looking back now, he strongly suspected that the car bomb in the fourth cycle was planted while Luo Tengfeng was attending an event at D City University. Because the D City University parking lot was just an open space, there were no security measures in place. If this suspicion was correct, X would likely have chosen the afternoon to plant the bomb today.

At this moment, what was displayed on Lu Tianfeng’s mobile phone screen was the surveillance footage of the villa garage. He had installed a miniature camera there, so if X appeared, he would know it immediately.

But as time passed, Lu Tianfeng’s heart began to waver. He was worried that his judgment was wrong and that every second, which was more precious than gold, would be wasted.

What if the locator under the car was not installed by X?

What if X had originally planned to plant the bomb in the evening?

What if X hadn’t noticed the rumors circulating online about the simultaneous disappearance of Luo Tengfeng and Chen Nuolan?

Also, what should he do if Yu Yongsheng and Huang Xuanxuan guessed his plan and came to him in advance?

if–

In a trance, Lu Tianfeng saw a slight snow interference in the monitoring signal on his mobile phone, but it returned to normal in the blink of an eye. However, he did not take it lightly and immediately jumped up.

The interference signal appeared again, and Lu Tianfeng was almost certain that someone was playing tricks on him.

X finally arrived. He must have been worried about surveillance systems, so he’d prepared jammers. Ironically, the house lacked even the most basic security system; the only surveillance camera was a makeshift one Lu Tianfeng had installed in the garage. X’s seemingly cautious approach actually became a vulnerability that exposed his whereabouts.

The video signal on Lu Tianfeng’s phone quickly returned to normal, and the suspect finally appeared on screen. It was a man in sportswear and a baseball cap, but his features were unclear.

Finally, the opportunity for a real face-to-face duel arrived, and Lu Tianfeng felt his blood boiling. He warned himself that the more times were like this, the more he had to stay calm.

The man walked into the garage cautiously, shrugged his shoulders, and put down the heavy-looking backpack. There must be a bomb in the backpack, right?

A subtle sense of disharmony suddenly arose in Lu Tianfeng’s heart, but he couldn’t explain what was going on.

Seeing the man squatting beside the car, struggling for something, Lu Tianfeng calmed himself down, tiptoed softly towards the garage. The garage had two doors, one large and one small. The large door was the same roller shutter that X had walked in through, and there was another small door that led to the villa’s living room.

Lu Tianfeng quietly walked to the small door of the garage, squatted against the wall, and pressed the remote control in his hand.

“Hualala–” the rolling shutter door began to slowly descend. At this time, the man in the garage immediately stood up alertly. He only had two choices: to retreat through the main gate or to enter the villa through the small door.

Just at this moment, a siren suddenly sounded at the gate, so the man rushed to the small door of the garage without hesitation, reached out to try, and found that the door was not locked.

Little did he know that this was exactly the situation carefully arranged by Lu Tianfeng. He wanted to force X to escape into the house.

As soon as the man stepped into the living room, something hard hit the back of his head.

“Don’t move. Put down what you’re holding.” Lu Tianfeng said coldly. Victory was in sight, but he didn’t dare to relax even a little bit, and his tone remained calm.

The man was stunned. He couldn’t imagine that this was a trap.

“Who are you!” he shouted.

“I repeat, put down what’s in your hand.” Lu Tianfeng grabbed the man’s backpack with a grappling motion without hesitation, then pushed him against the wall and took off his hat.

That ordinary face actually belonged to the second-rate supporting actor Mo Rui!

The feeling of disharmony in Lu Tianfeng’s heart became even stronger.

The right hand holding the pistol was trembling slightly. Lu Tianfeng took a deep breath to hide his inner hesitation.

Mo Rui obviously didn’t recognize Lu Tianfeng, and continued to say viciously, “Are you Luo Tengfeng’s lackey? Let him get out of here on his own. Don’t be such a coward!”

Lu Tianfeng took a deep breath and asked, “Don’t you know me?”

“Why should I know you!” Mo Rui’s expression was ferocious and his eyes were murderous. It didn’t look like he was acting at all.

Of course, an 18th-tier actor was still an actor after all. Lu Tianfeng did not take it lightly. After taking out handcuffs and cuffing Mo Rui’s hands, he showed his police officer ID.

“Lu Tianfeng from the Criminal Police Brigade, I’m going to ask you a few questions now. Please answer honestly.”

Mo Rui snorted coldly and turned his face away without even looking at the ID card.

“Mo Rui, I have already checked your background, so don’t make any unnecessary denials.” Lu Tianfeng also emphasized his tone.

Unexpectedly, Mo Rui laughed even more brazenly after hearing this: “Brother Police Officer, you’ve arrested the wrong person.”

“What?”

“My name is not Mo Rui, my name is Zhu Shiming.”

“Zhu Shiming?” This unheard-of name made Lu Tianfeng stunned.

Mo Rui, or Zhu Shiming, raised his head, shook his shoulders, and said with disdain, “I don’t want to talk to you. You’d better call your boss out and let me have a chat with him.”

Lu Tianfeng knew that the “boss” Zhu Shiming was referring to was Luo Tengfeng, so he shook his head and said, “Mr. Luo is not here. Since you are unwilling to cooperate, I have no choice but to ask you to go back to the police station.”

“Police station? Are you really a police officer?”

“Of course.”

“Luo Tengfeng is really not here?”

“He’s not here.” In fact, Lu Tianfeng was very puzzled. Zhu Shiming didn’t seem to care much about being arrested, but was particularly concerned about whether Luo Tengfeng was at the scene.

Moreover, the man in front of him seemed to have no memory of the previous four cycles. His questions and answers with Lu Tianfeng were completely like a conversation between strangers.

Lu Tianfeng had to bitterly admit that the answer he had gone through so much trouble to find was probably wrong.

But he could only cling to this life-saving straw in front of him.

Zhu Shiming seemed to have finally accepted the fact that he was arrested by the police. His face gradually turned pale and the corners of his mouth kept twitching, as if he had suffered a great blow.

“Impossible… Impossible…”

“How so?” Lu Tianfeng asked, suppressing his disappointment.

Zhu Shiming immediately shut his mouth and kept it a secret, but from his expression one could tell that he was in torment.

Lu Tianfeng didn’t want to waste any more time, so he went straight over and opened Zhu Shiming’s backpack to check. It did contain a remote control, a timer, and other electronic components, but no bomb. He’d probably already planted it in the car. This time, he’d finally caught the perpetrator red-handed, with irrefutable evidence.

“You’re X, right? You were responsible for the Zhang Hanlin and Gao Junjie cases?” Lu Tianfeng spread out the electronic components in front of Zhu Shiming. “Now you want to kill Luo Tengfeng too, right?”

“Yes, I did it all.” Zhu Shiming unexpectedly admitted it.

“No, you are not the real X.” What was even more surprising was that Lu Tianfeng immediately rejected his testimony.

Zhu Shiming bit his lip and said, “It’s me. I planted all the bombs. I want to destroy Feng Teng Gene!”

“You don’t have that ability.”

“I did. I did blasting work on the crew.”

“No, that’s not the ability I’m talking about.” Lu Tianfeng became more and more certain that the man in front of him had no idea that time loops existed in this world, let alone X.

“What on earth are you talking about?”

“Don’t you understand? That’s right.” Lu Tianfeng finally smiled. Although Zhu Shiming was not the real X, he could find X through him. “Tell me, who is the mastermind behind you?”

For a moment, a trace of collapse flashed in Zhu Shiming’s eyes, but he held it back.

“I don’t want to say anything.” He said through gritted teeth.

“I suddenly remembered a girl named Zhu, Zhu Xiaoyue.” In fact, Lu Tianfeng was secretly annoyed in his heart. If he could send someone to investigate Zhu Xiaoyue’s situation in advance, then the subsequent communication might be much smoother.

But even though the information in his hands was limited, Lu Tianfeng knew that he had to do his best to obtain intelligence.

“Are you her older brother or younger brother?”

Zhu Shiming burst into laughter, his laughter filled with madness: “That’s right, I am Xiaoyue’s brother. I want to destroy Feng Teng Gene and avenge my sister!”

“Are you blaming Luo Tengfeng for not using the immature RAN technology to save your sister?”

Zhu Shiming was stunned for a moment, then laughed even more exaggeratedly, and even tears flowed down his face: “Comrade police officer, did you make a mistake?”

“You mean…” Lu Tianfeng now did not feel the joy of being close to victory at all, but more and more mysteries formed in his heart.

“Xiaoyue signed a secret agreement with Luo Tengfeng, and then conducted live experiments on her using RAN technology! She was Luo Tengfeng’s guinea pig!”

Lu Tianfeng was shocked. This was completely different from the version Luo Tengfeng told him.

“This…”

“After Xiaoyue received the RAN treatment, she quickly became critically ill from multiple organ failure. When I rushed to the hospital, all I saw was her cold body… Luo Tengfeng produced the agreement, claiming that Xiaoyue had volunteered to be a subject. But I have a feeling he exploited Xiaoyue’s feelings and trust in him to trick her into signing this fatal agreement…”

Of course, this is just Zhu Shiming’s one-sided statement. It may also be that he was too sad and angry after losing his sister, so he vented all his resentment on Luo Tengfeng.

So, did Zhu Xiaoyue receive RAN technology treatment? Lu Tianfeng found that there was too much information he didn’t know.

“Then you should just seek revenge on Luo Tengfeng. Why involve innocent people?”

“What a joke! This company packaged a dangerous technology that could kill people as a panacea and made a fortune from it. None of the company’s executives are innocent!” Zhu Shiming’s eyes were red and he became more and more agitated. This outrageous remark reminded Lu Tianfeng of another person – Teacher Tan Jiaqiang from D City University.

“So you changed your name to ‘Mo Rui’ and lived in this city under another identity, waiting for an opportunity to take revenge?”

“You can’t understand what I do at all.” Zhu Shiming said disdainfully.

Lu Tianfeng guessed the whole story: “I can understand. You needed to find more like-minded people to oppose Luo Tengfeng with you, so you joined the Nifeng Club.”

Just by looking at the shocked expression on Zhu Shiming’s face, Lu Tianfeng knew that he had guessed right again.

“Let me tell you, the other members of the Nifeng Club, such as Tan Jiaqiang and Xu Lang, will not be able to escape either.”

These two names obviously stimulated Zhu Shiming. His pupils dilated involuntarily, and his body sat straighter, putting on a nervous and alert posture.

Lu Tianfeng continued to press forward, “When the police have rounded up all of you, whoever confesses first will receive a lighter sentence.”

Zhu Shiming said nothing and silently looked down at the tip of his shoes.

“Did you notice that I was the only one involved in this arrest?”

Zhu Shiming raised his head and looked at Lu Tianfeng in confusion: “What do you mean?”

“What I mean is that there’s ample room for negotiation between us now,” Lu Tianfeng said earnestly. “As long as you reveal who directed you to plant the bomb, I’ll definitely fight for the largest possible sentence reduction for you.”

Zhu Shiming touched the cold handcuffs and said softly, “Really? I installed the bombs myself…”

“But if you can help us catch the mastermind behind this, you’ll be rewarded for your merit.” Lu Tianfeng paused and played the emotional card again. “You don’t want your sister in heaven to watch you go down a path of no return, do you?”

Zhu Shiming hesitated. At this time, Lu Tianfeng stopped pressing him and gave him some time to think.

After a long pause, Zhu Shiming finally spoke slowly, “Indeed, someone secretly instructed me to install the bomb, which is why I was able to successfully kill Zhang Hanlin and Gao Junjie…”

“Who is this person?”

“I… don’t know. He has been using an alias to contact me online.”

“He’s just a person you’ve never met. How could you completely believe his words and kill people according to his instructions?” Lu Tianfeng asked a little incredulously.

Zhu Shiming looked embarrassed. “That man… claimed to be a ‘prophet’ and had the ability to predict the future.”

“Prophet?” Lu Tianfeng’s mind worked quickly and he understood in an instant that the real X had taken advantage of the characteristics of the time loop, pretending to be a prophet and deceiving Zhu Shiming’s trust.

Lu Tianfeng felt a chill on his back, and his intuition told him that some danger was approaching.

“Yes, he can really predict the future.” Zhu Shiming chattered on and on about several examples. Lu Tianfeng was a little uneasy and had to nod in agreement.

“I see. That’s why you obeyed him and went to the designated time and place to plant the bomb.”

“Not only that, he also told me how to avoid leaving any evidence and evade the police…”

“How did you contact the ‘prophet’?”

“We use encrypted online chat software, which makes it difficult to track… By the way, every time I take action, I will wear the watch he prepared for me. In case of an emergency, he can contact me in real time through this watch.” Zhu Shiming said as he raised his hands to show Lu Tianfeng the electronic watch on his wrist.

“Is this… a child safety watch?” Lu Tianfeng’s heart trembled, finally realizing the impending crisis. This electronic watch not only has a positioning function, but also can actively monitor. If X was monitoring Zhu Shiming at this moment, then X would have heard everything they had just said.

Lu Tianfeng remembered the explosion at the last moment of the fourth cycle, and quickly took out his phone and typed in the memo: “Don’t talk, follow me.”

Zhu Shiming was stunned, a little confused.

“Take me to see the bomb in the garage.” Lu Tianfeng said this, but another sentence was displayed on the mobile phone screen.

“Someone is monitoring, leave immediately.”

“Oh, okay.” Zhu Shiming nodded.

Lu Tianfeng led Zhu Shiming out of the house and asked as they walked, “Has the bomb been installed?”

“Well, it’s hidden inside the tire. It won’t be noticed unless you look closely…”

“It won’t explode suddenly, right?”

“How is it possible…” Zhu Shiming’s face turned pale in an instant, as if he suddenly realized something.

Of course, the bomb could be detonated remotely, and the person who had the ability to detonate it, besides Zhu Shiming, was the “prophet” hiding behind the scenes.

At this time, the two men had already arrived at the door of the villa. Lu Tianfeng was still worried, so he asked Zhu Shiming to follow him a little further. Then he raised his voice and said, “Go and point out the location where the bomb is installed. Don’t play tricks.”

At the same time, Lu Tianfeng typed the message on his phone: “Get down, it could explode at any time!”

“This…” Zhu Shiming didn’t know what to do.

“Go quickly!” Lu Tianfeng said deliberately viciously.

“I understand…” Zhu Shiming said as he squatted down with his head in his hands, and Lu Tianfeng also squatted down beside him.

At this moment, a loud noise was heard from the villa’s garage, and flames shot up into the sky. The “prophet” had indeed detonated the bomb. He had been waiting for this opportunity to silence Zhu Shiming and Lu Tianfeng together!

Even though Lu Tianfeng was prepared, he was still knocked to the ground by the blast. However, he quickly got up, made sure he was not injured, and then helped Zhu Shiming up. He immediately took off the electronic watch on Zhu Shiming’s wrist and turned it off immediately, creating the illusion that the watch was also destroyed in the explosion and the signal was interrupted.

“Are you okay?” Lu Tianfeng asked after confirming that the other party could no longer hear what was being said.

“I… I…” Zhu Shiming’s face was as pale as a piece of paper, and his lips kept trembling. It was unknown whether he was frightened.

“I’ll call 110, you call 119,” said Lu Tianfeng.

“No…” Zhu Shiming whimpered and fell to the ground. Lu Tianfeng held him under the armpits and immediately noticed a large pool of blood on Zhu Shiming’s abdomen.

There was a hole in his stomach and blood was gushing out.

This can’t be the wound caused by the explosion just now!

“What’s going on?”

“The waist bag… the prophet… gave it to me…” Zhu Shiming squeezed out these words with difficulty, his eyes slowly froze.

Lu Tianfeng felt a strong chill rising from the bottom of his heart. He thought he had successfully misled X to detonate the bomb and saved the key witness Zhu Shiming. He didn’t expect X to be so cold-blooded and cruel that he had installed another small bomb in Zhu Shiming’s waist bag early in the morning.

It seemed that X would definitely not let Zhu Shiming survive today.

“Who is the prophet? What else do you know?” Lu Tianfeng shouted anxiously. He knew that Zhu Shiming didn’t have much time left.

Zhu Shiming’s lips were still trembling, but he could not make any sound, and his eyes gradually lost focus.

“Zhu Shiming, hold on, for your sister, hold on!”

Zhu Shiming’s eyes lit up, perhaps the word “sister” gave him a little strength, but this strength was fleeting. He died with his eyes open.

As Zhu Shiming’s body collapsed, another clue was completely cut off. The puzzle that had been gradually being put together in Lu Tianfeng’s mind also shattered into pieces again.

In the end, X was the smartest one.

Lu Tianfeng sat quietly on the ground, looking at the fire and smoke not far away, and then looked at the man in front of him who died with his eyes open. After a long time, he regained his composure, took out his mobile phone and dialed a number.

“Yongsheng, where are you?” Lu Tianfeng’s tone was tired.

“Boss!” Yu Yongsheng on the other end of the phone seemed very excited. “What happened? We couldn’t contact you…”

“There’s no time to explain, Yongsheng. Bring people here as soon as possible to do the cleanup work.” Lu Tianfeng reported the address in a calm tone. At the same time, he heard the alarm tone coming from Yu Yongsheng’s communicator on the other end of the phone.

“Boss…” Yu Yongsheng’s tone was full of confusion and embarrassment, “I just received news that our mission has been canceled.”

“The mission is cancelled?” Lu Tianfeng asked in surprise.

“Uh, wait a moment…” Yu Yongsheng must have pressed the mute button on the phone, and the noisy voices on the other end of the phone suddenly disappeared, but this silence was even more torturous.

Lu Tianfeng held the microphone and could only hear the terrible crackling sound of the flames burning not far away. One guess after another kept flashing through his mind, but he still couldn’t figure out what was going on.

The line finally picked up, and Yu Yongsheng on the other end said anxiously, “Boss, I just received news that Luo Tengfeng claims you designed to put him under house arrest in the Tianfeng Xinghua Hotel. He didn’t notice anything at first, but gradually realized something was amiss, so he contacted our director and confirmed that your actions were not approved by our superiors…”

“You must be joking!” Lu Tianfeng almost yelled, “This is a plan that Luo Tengfeng and I worked out together…”

“But that’s not what he told the director… Anyway, Xuanxuan and I have been temporarily transferred from our posts. Also, that…”

“Just say what you want to say.” Lu Tianfeng knew very well that Yu Yongsheng was a straightforward person. In other words, if he hesitated, it would definitely be bad news.

“The director has issued a warrant for your arrest…”

“Wanted? Me?” Lu Tianfeng was at a loss whether to laugh or cry. “I understand, Yongsheng, you need to report our conversation to our superiors.”

“Boss, do you think I’m such an ungrateful person?”

“Don’t misunderstand me. I need your help. Report my location quickly and send someone to investigate.”

“What’s going on over there?”

“I caught the person who planted the bomb, but an explosion occurred at the scene, and the murderer died on the spot. There must be someone behind this, it’s not that simple, I have to continue investigating.”

“How can you investigate alone…”

Lu Tianfeng hung up the phone in a hurry without waiting for Yu Yongsheng to finish speaking, then removed the SIM card in his phone and replaced it with another one, which was also the last spare SIM card he had in stock.

The sky was gray and a drizzle began to fall from the air, while the sirens of fire trucks could be heard in the distance.

A flash of lightning streaked across the sky, and Lu Tianfeng seemed to have received some kind of revelation, his chaotic thoughts suddenly becoming clear. However, the answer that popped into his mind was a bit terrifying.

Just like the thunder that came immediately afterwards, it made people’s hearts tremble.

CONTENT END 53

chapters.title: Chapter 54
chapters.content:
April 15th, fifth cycle, 3:00 p.m.

Lu Tianfeng sat in the back seat of the taxi, lost in thought, staring at the raindrops on the window. Although it wasn’t rush hour, there had probably been an accident up ahead, and traffic was slow. Their car was stuck in a long queue.

The driver pounded the steering wheel impatiently, cursing the damn traffic conditions.

Lu Tianfeng didn’t say anything. He slowly moved his face closer to the glass. The closer he got, the clearer he could see the raindrops in front of him, but he could no longer see the rain outside the window.

He suddenly realized that the Feng Teng Gene case was the same principle.

He was too deeply involved. He wanted to grasp every detail and grasp the role of every variable in the repeated time cycles. It was like wanting to see every drop of water clearly first and then piece together the entire picture of the rain scene. Was this possible?

Each drop of water slid, merged, and split on the glass, transforming into a different pattern every second, making it impossible to see clearly. Only by looking further away and no longer focusing on the raindrops could he see the true rain scene.

He still remembered what Cheng Tuo had told him: to solve a case, one should not rely too much on informants, but should go back to the root of the case – motivation and interests.

In the recent series of cases involving Feng Teng Gene, wasn’t the most fundamental interest point the company whose valuation had increased tenfold in a year and was like a cash cow?

Before the case happened, Luo Tengfeng occupied a dominant position in the company, forming a three-way balance of power with Zhang Hanlin and Gao Junjie. Then Zhang Hanlin and Gao Junjie were both killed. Wasn’t Luo Tengfeng the real biggest beneficiary?

Although Zhang Wenzhe and Gao Miaomiao became shareholders as heirs after the death of the two executives, how could two young people with little experience compete with the experienced Luo Tengfeng?

In the end, Luo Tengfeng was the one who reaped the benefits.

Lu Tianfeng felt that he had finally walked out of the foggy quagmire step by step, but what appeared before him was not a smooth road, but a bottomless cliff.

The clearer the truth, the closer it was to danger.

At this time, the taxi driver turned on the radio out of boredom. A male and a female host were talking about the latest local news, and the topic happened to be about Feng Teng Gene.

“Feng Teng Gene’s CEO, Luo Tengfeng, suddenly lost contact at noon today. The police haven’t commented on the matter. Some netizens suspect his disappearance may be related to two previous criminal cases involving the company…”

“Feng Teng Gene researcher Chen Nuolan, who was previously rumored to be having an affair with Luo Tengfeng, is also out of contact, which has led to a lot of speculation…”

“What’s even more intriguing is that this morning there was a rumor circulating online claiming that Feng Teng Gene is very likely to bring in a new investor, a massive international venture capital…”

“I’m so fed up!” The driver, already irritated by the traffic jam, suddenly turned off the radio. “You keep talking about this kind of crap all day long.”

“Sir, have you also heard about Feng Teng Gene?” Lu Tianfeng asked casually.

“Of course. The recent case has caused quite a stir in the city!”

“Why can’t the police solve the case? I heard that it was done by a professional killer.” Lu Tianfeng deliberately led the topic to the direction that the taxi drivers talked about most.

The driver waved his hand. “In my opinion, this case is very simple. The police must’ve been misled.”

“Oh?”

“Think about it, why are people so busy all day long? Either for fame or for profit, and Feng Teng Gene represents both fame and fortune. It’s not surprising that they kill for this.” The driver slapped the steering wheel excitedly, with a momentum of pointing out the way forward and inspiring words.

“What you mean is…” Lu Tianfeng couldn’t help but sigh secretly. Why couldn’t he see through something that an ordinary driver could think of?

“Didn’t the company originally have three big bosses? Two of them are dead, so the remaining one, Luo Somefeng, must be the mastermind behind all this!”

This was true, if the third threatening letter had not appeared, Luo Tengfeng should have been the biggest suspect in the first two cases. Most people didn’t know that Luo Tengfeng also received a threatening letter, so they would naturally continue to suspect him.

But if Luo Tengfeng was X, he could certainly write a threatening letter to himself to reduce suspicion. He could even arrange for Zhu Shiming to blow himself up in the last cycle, so that Lu Tianfeng, who had the ability to experience time loops, would believe it without a doubt.

When thinking of this, Lu Tianfeng felt a little shudder. Having “died” once before, he knew very well how painful this experience was.

The timing of Luo Tengfeng’s contact with the police was too coincidental. He appeared almost immediately after Zhu Shiming’s bomb exploded, breaking the secret agreement between him and Lu Tianfeng. This could only mean that Luo Tengfeng believed that Lu Tianfeng had died in the explosion along with Zhu Shiming, making him the only person who knew about the incident.

But Luo Tengfeng never expected that Zhu Shiming was indeed dead, while Lu Tianfeng was still alive.

Lu Tianfeng closed his eyes, gently rubbed his temples with his fingers, and forced himself to calm down.
