The current situation had become clear. Luo Tengfeng was very likely the “prophet” mentioned by Zhu Shiming and the mastermind X behind all the cases. However, apart from his fantastic reasoning, Lu Tianfeng had no substantial evidence to prove him.

However, Lu Tianfeng also had a key trump card in his hand – Luo Tengfeng now mistakenly believed that he was dead, and may relax his vigilance a little, revealing flaws in his words and actions. This was his greatest hope of turning the tide.

At this moment, the taxi finally struggled to the most congested intersection. A large truck had overturned, stranded across the central green belt, its cargo spilling across both lanes. After passing the accident site, the taxi began to speed smoothly. The rain outside the window intensified. Through the hazy curtain of rain, Lu Tianfeng gazed at the fifty-story building in the distance.

Tianfeng Xinghua Hotel was the destination of Lu Tianfeng’s trip.

Lu Tianfeng arranged for Luo Tengfeng to hide here after careful consideration. On the one hand, it was because he had already understood the layout and various facilities of this hotel in the previous cycles, and had more sufficient and flexible means of response; on the other hand, due to work needs, Lu Tianfeng also prepared the hotel’s universal room card and work permit, which could enable him to enter and exit the hotel through the employee passage and enter some areas that ordinary customers could not enter.

Of course, after Luo Tengfeng contacted the police to “report the crime,” he might have left the hotel and gone to the police station for questioning. However, given Lu Tianfeng’s current condition, it was impossible for him to run back to the police station and fall into their trap. Therefore, Lu Tianfeng decided to wait here. He believed that Luo Tengfeng would not miss the Bai Mansion wedding banquet tonight.

However, as soon as Lu Tianfeng walked into the hotel doors, he knew that he didn’t need to wait that long.

Zhou Mingle was standing by a pillar in the lobby, his brow furrowed as he chatted excitedly on the phone. Lu Tianfeng didn’t know who he was talking to or what they were talking about, but there was only one possible reason for him to come here.

At that moment, Lu Tianfeng seemed to see the Goddess of Luck smiling at him.

.

3:30 p.m., Tianfeng Xinghua Hotel, first floor lobby.

Zhou Mingle, dressed in a neat suit, sat at a coffee shop. The heat from the cup of coffee in front of him had slowly dissipated, but he hadn’t even taken a sip. He just silently lowered his head and looked at the tablet in his hand, looking like he was worried about something.

“Sorry, I’m late.” Luo Tengfeng walked over with a cheerful face and said to the waiter, “A cup of iced Americano coffee, thank you.”

“It’s okay, I just arrived too.” Zhou Mingle put down the tablet.

Luo Tengfeng pointed to the cup of coffee on the table that was no longer steaming and said bluntly: “It doesn’t look like it just arrived.”

Zhou Mingle looked up in surprise and glanced at Luo Tengfeng. He keenly noticed that the tone of their conversation was completely different from what it had been a few hours ago at Feng Teng Gene. Luo Tengfeng had suddenly become more aggressive, his eyes brimming with confidence. In comparison, Zhou Mingle’s aura seemed much weaker.

Zhou Mingle could only shrug his shoulders disapprovingly and said tactfully, “Every good project is worth waiting for.”

“Feng Teng Gene is certainly a good project.” Luo Tengfeng smiled brightly.

“We have already reached a consensus on this point.” Zhou Mingle subconsciously touched the coffee cup. He felt that he was losing control of the situation.

Luo Tengfeng suddenly put away his smile and said seriously, “The next thing we need to discuss is the specific price.”

“As for the specific price…” Zhou Mingle raised his cup and drank most of the completely cooled coffee in one gulp. “There’s nothing to discuss. Whatever Mr. Luo says is fine.”

A hint of surprise flashed across Luo Tengfeng’s face.

“I don’t quite understand what you mean.”

Zhou Mingle continued slowly, “Isn’t there a competitor now? We’ll match their offer. However, I can only find out their price through Mr. Luo, so the price you tell us is the key.”

The corners of Luo Tengfeng’s mouth twitched involuntarily. It turned out that this was Zhou Mingle’s counterattack. Since the situation was already very passive, he might as well give up the initiative and retreat on the defensive.

Luo Tengfeng thought for a moment and asked, “Aren’t you afraid that I might inflate the price?”

Zhou Mingle put down his coffee cup and smiled softly: “I don’t care.”

“No cares at all?”

“I don’t even care whether this competitor exists or not, Mr. Luo, am I right?” Zhou Mingle’s eyes flashed with a cunning light.

At this moment, the two men reached a tacit consensus on certain things.

Luo Tengfeng’s expression relaxed again, and he said, “I didn’t expect that a top venture capital firm like Volly would make such a hasty decision.”

“Precisely because we are top-tier, we would rather make a wrong investment than miss out.” What Zhou Mingle said is one of the golden rules of venture capital institutions.

“How interesting!” Luo Tengfeng rubbed his hands. “So you used Volly’s funds to realize your wish?”

“Our wish has come true.” Zhou Mingle handed the tablet to Luo Tengfeng. “This is the electronic version of the letter of intent for investment. Please take a look. Speaking of which, if it weren’t for the sudden changes today, this deal wouldn’t have been so easy to close.”

Luo Tengfeng took the tablet: “Haha, it seems I have to thank you…”

“Me?” Lu Tianfeng, wearing a waiter uniform, brought a cup of iced coffee to the table for the two.

Luo Tengfeng looked up in surprise, his eyes wide and a look of disbelief on his face. His hands were shaking unconsciously, and he almost couldn’t hold the tablet steady.

Lu Tianfeng pointed to the earphones hanging on his ears, implying that he had heard the entire conversation. Zhou Mingle also recognized the policeman he had met that morning, but he had no idea why he suddenly appeared here.

“Mr. Luo, the situation is urgent. Please follow me and leave here immediately.” Lu Tianfeng deliberately spoke in a voice that Zhou Mingle could hear. He calculated that Luo Tengfeng would never show any abnormality in front of Zhou Mingle.

“What’s going on?” Luo Tengfeng frowned. He certainly didn’t want to go with Lu Tianfeng, but he couldn’t lose his temper on the spot. He had to hope that the police nearby were watching him and would notice that something was wrong.

Lu Tianfeng patted Luo Tengfeng’s shoulder with his left hand, touched his waist with his right hand, and said in a low voice: “Don’t delay, follow me immediately.”

“I understand.” Luo Tengfeng’s expression remained calm. He handed the tablet back to Zhou Mingle, took a sip of coffee, and then stood up with ease. “It’s a pity that both of our meetings today were unexpectedly interrupted.”

“It doesn’t matter. Good things come to those who wait.” Zhou Mingle’s eyes moved rapidly, as if he was thinking of a countermeasure.

“I believe that things never happen in threes…”

“Time is running out, let’s go!” Lu Tianfeng, fearing Luo Tengfeng was up to something, quickly interrupted him and practically dragged him out of the cafe. Zhou Mingle was puzzled, but since the other party was a police officer after all, he had no idea Lu Tianfeng was already wanted by the police. He just watched the two of them leave.

Almost there again.

Zhou Mingle was so frustrated that he almost wanted to smash the tablet in his hand. He knew very well that the longer things were delayed, the more variables there would be.

But he had no choice.

After Lu Tianfeng and Luo Tengfeng entered the elevator together, they pressed the “29” button.

“Captain Lu, where are we going?” There were only two of them in the elevator, and Luo Tengfeng suddenly became nervous.

Lu Tianfeng replied coldly: “Just looking for a place to chat.”

“Maybe there is some misunderstanding between us?” Luo Tengfeng still looked innocent.

“Then this is a good opportunity to make things clear.” Lu Tianfeng always held a coat in his right hand, and used the hard object hidden under the coat to press against Luo Tengfeng’s waist, which made Luo Tengfeng dare not act rashly even though he was under the surveillance camera of the elevator.

“We’re here.”

Luo Tengfeng reluctantly followed Lu Tianfeng out of the elevator, and the two turned into the stairwell. Lu Tianfeng took out the staff’s universal card and opened a door marked “Do not open unless in an emergency.” Unexpectedly, behind the door was an entire empty floor with extremely simple decoration and even the walls were not painted.

“What is this place?” Luo Tengfeng asked in surprise. The scene in front of him should not belong to this super luxurious hotel at all.

“Fire refuge floor.”

Few people knew that buildings over 100 meters tall in China typically featured a special fire refuge floor, inaccessible by elevator and accessible only via fire escapes. The Tianfeng Xinghua Hotel’s fire refuge floor was located between the 29th and 30th floors. In fact, a closer look revealed a floor in the middle of the building with noticeably different decor than the other floors.

However, things like this that were right in front of everyone and could be seen with a closer look were often overlooked.

“Captain Lu, you really know how to choose a place.” Luo Tengfeng rubbed the soles of his shoes back and forth on the ground which was only covered with a layer of cement, trying to hide the uneasiness in his heart.

On this floor, the two men could only confront each other face to face, with no room to maneuver.

Lu Tianfeng stood silently, sizing up Luo Tengfeng with a gaze as sharp as a knife. He didn’t need to speak, and couldn’t speak. Silence was the only weapon he had at this moment.

Luo Tengfeng also stared into Lu Tianfeng’s eyes without saying a word. In the silent space, the only sound left was the faint breathing of each other.

Whoever dodges first loses.

In the end, Luo Tengfeng couldn’t help but look away first.

“Captain Lu, what on earth do you want to do?”

“I just want to ask one question, are you X?” Lu Tianfeng took off the coat that had been covering his right hand, revealing what was in his hand.

“A rolling pin?”

“I just took it from the kitchen. What do you think?” Lu Tianfeng smiled. He didn’t have a gun on him at all.

Luo Tengfeng’s expression suddenly turned grim. If he had known this would happen, he would have desperately tried to make some noise in public. Lu Tianfeng, who was already considered a fugitive by the police, would definitely not want to alert the hotel security. However, the situation was completely different now. In this deserted fire shelter, no matter how much noise he made, no one would intervene.

Luo Tengfeng felt the powerlessness and frustration of having his momentum completely suppressed.

“I have no idea what you’re talking about…” He chose to deny it outright, even though it sounded weak.

“Really? We clearly agreed on a plan to lure him out, so why did you suddenly change your mind and call the police to report that I was holding you under house arrest?”

“Captain Lu, please bear with me. I’ve been alone in my room, my mind racing. I’m also worried that your private actions might cause trouble and affect my reputation, so I decided to talk to your director.” Luo Tengfeng lied without batting an eyelid. “I can give him another call to clear things up for you…”

Lu Tianfeng mercilessly interrupted Luo Tengfeng: “Mr. Luo, the timing of your call to the police is too subtle, isn’t it?”

“Really? I don’t understand what you mean…”

“Inside your villa, I caught the man who planted the bomb. His name is Zhu Shiming, and he’s Zhu Xiaoyue’s brother.”

“Oh, I see…” Luo Tengfeng didn’t seem too surprised by the appearance of the name Zhu Shiming.

“However, not long after I caught him, the bomb he had installed in the car and another bomb he was carrying exploded simultaneously. It was almost the perfect timing to detonate them. He could have killed two birds with one stone and killed me as well.” Lu Tianfeng said coldly, “The one who detonated the bomb was you, right?”

Faced with such direct questioning, Luo Tengfeng could only respond with an awkward smile: “Captain Lu, this joke of yours is a bit too much, isn’t it? How could I possibly kill someone?”

Lu Tianfeng shook his head slowly and said, “You’ve been covering it up very well, but unfortunately, you were exposed at the last moment. You thought you had successfully killed Zhu Shiming and me, and no one would know what you had done. So you let down your guard and immediately contacted the police, claiming you were under house arrest. If you hadn’t been monitoring the situation at the villa, how could you have controlled the timing so accurately?”

Luo Tengfeng’s expression gradually froze, but he still said calmly: “This is purely a coincidence. I don’t know anything about the bomb…”

“You used your ability to perceive time loops to plan two perfect crimes. In today’s third crime, you could have perfectly eliminated Zhu Shiming and made him your scapegoat, but unfortunately you fell just a little short.”

Lu Tianfeng held up the electronic watch component in his hand and spoke slowly.

“Although you succeeded in killing Zhu Shiming, you failed to destroy this thing. It contains the call records between Zhu Shiming and the organizer behind the scenes. We only need to investigate the phone number to confirm the other party’s identity. Although I believe you would not use your own mobile phone number for this, even if it is a specially prepared anonymous mobile phone number, the police can still track and identify the user…”

Luo Tengfeng stared straight at the thing in Lu Tianfeng’s hand, his lips twitched, but he didn’t say anything.

“We’ll soon find out who’s behind this.” Lu Tianfeng put the electronic watch into his pocket. “Before that, you still have time to surrender yourself.”

Luo Tengfeng sneered, “Captain Lu’s accusations are nothing but fairy tales. I don’t have the ability to perceive time loops…”

“Mr. Luo, you let something slip again.” Lu Tianfeng shook his head slowly. “A normal person’s first reaction would be that they have no idea what a time loop is. By saying this, won’t anyone assume you know that time loops exist in the world?”

Luo Tengfeng was stunned for a moment, then laughed self-deprecatingly: “When it comes to talking, I’m really not as good as you.”

“You’re also quite eloquent. Your lecture at D City University won a standing ovation. Now I finally understand why you were able to remain so calm when you witnessed the bloodshed during the third cycle lecture. It’s because you know everything will return to zero and the cycle will start over again. You’ve become accustomed to it.”

Luo Tengfeng seemed to be wearing a gray mask, the blood color on his face gradually faded, and his expression was wooden.

Lu Tianfeng knew that Luo Tengfeng was on the verge of collapse – he simply couldn’t imagine what the correct reaction of an ordinary person should be at this moment, because he was not an ordinary person.

“Luo Tengfeng, you and I can sense the existence of time loops.” Lu Tianfeng stated his conclusion and dealt Luo Tengfeng the final blow.

Luo Tengfeng’s shoulders were shaking more and more violently, and then he finally couldn’t hold it back anymore and burst into wild laughter.

“Hahahaha, you finally thought of this!”

Luo Tengfeng laughed so hard that tears came out of his eyes. This sentence was equivalent to admitting that he was also a perceiver of the time loop, but Lu Tianfeng felt mixed emotions when he saw his crazy laughter.

Even though the truth was right in front of him, Lu Tianfeng still felt that everything was a mirage. He didn’t have that feeling of “I finally caught you” at all. Why?

Because he knew very well that he did not have the real key evidence in his hands.

What made him even more desperate was that Luo Tengfeng was obviously also well aware of this.

Even the words just now, which undoubtedly sounded like a confession to Lu Tianfeng, were not considered valid testimony in the eyes of others.

“As far as I know, with current technology, the tracking of mobile phone signals can only lock a range at best, and cannot confirm the identity of the number 100%.” Luo Tengfeng finally stopped laughing, but there was still a sneer between his eyebrows.

“Unless I can find the SIM card on you that was used to contact Zhu Shiming.”

“But you can’t find it.” Luo Tengfeng thought for a moment and added, “How can you find something that doesn’t exist at all?”

Luo Tengfeng’s eyes were full of confidence, as well as his unique persistence and enthusiasm.

“You always do things cleanly and efficiently.” Lu Tianfeng had to admit that the possibility that Luo Tengfeng did not destroy the SIM card in time was almost zero. After all, he had plenty of time.

“So now, what should we do? Change places and sit down to have a good talk?” Luo Tengfeng spread his hands and put on a provocative smile.

Lu Tianfeng sighed frequently, “It turns out you’ve had the absolute upper hand from the beginning to the end. I once thought Chen Nuolan was the key variable in the time loop, but actually… she’s completely insignificant.”

“Ordinary people are not qualified to influence the course of fate.” Luo Tengfeng said proudly.

“So the real key variable is you.” Lu Tianfeng recalled the beginning of the second cycle. When he suggested that Luo Tengfeng cancel his morning exercise, he had already exposed his identity and fell into a passive situation.

At the beginning of the third cycle, all events deviated from the original track and underwent earth-shaking changes. It was because Luo Tengfeng took the initiative to change his schedule first, which triggered a chain reaction.

The answers to all questions were so simple, so simple that they didn’t seem like correct answers.

That’s why Lu Tianfeng took so many detours.

“However, today, the key variable is you.” Luo Tengfeng gave Lu Tianfeng a thumbs-up. “No matter what, I sincerely thank you for everything you have done for me.”

Lu Tianfeng felt a chill in his heart. He hadn’t expected that after he took Chen Nuolan away, Luo Tengfeng would be able to make a prompt decision and immediately formulate a new response plan. This achieved multiple goals with one stroke. Not only did it solve the investment problem and successfully suppress potential competitors in the company, it also successfully completed the original goal and cleanly eliminated the biggest threat, Zhu Shiming.

“How did you do this? There was no chance to rehearse what happened today.” Lu Tianfeng knew in his heart that he shouldn’t ask this question, but he just couldn’t control himself.

Luo Tengfeng’s expression was like that of an experienced old veteran who was asked a naive question by a newbie in the industry. He was a little reluctant to answer, but he still patiently gave his answer.

“Don’t forget, life shouldn’t be rehearsed in advance.”

“Yeah, it shouldn’t be…” Lu Tianfeng sighed. It seemed that he was still one step behind.

Wouldn’t he be able to solve the case successfully without relying on the power of sensing time loops?

“Well, it’s time for me to go back. There are still billions worth of contracts waiting for me to sign.” Luo Tengfeng shrugged casually and took a step to leave.

“Wait a moment.” Lu Tianfeng pressed Luo Tengfeng’s shoulder and said, “Mr. Luo, please come back to the police station with me first.”

“Police station?” Luo Tengfeng’s eyes widened, his facial muscles twitching as he looked like he couldn’t help but laugh. “Captain Lu, don’t you think we have a better option?”

“Really?” Lu Tianfeng asked in a raised voice.

“You, me, and Chen Nuolan, we can work together to change the world.” Luo Tengfeng patted Lu Tianfeng’s arm and moved his hand away from his shoulder. “We should be friends, not enemies.”

“I’m sorry, I’m a policeman.” Lu Tianfeng refused coldly.

“You used to be a police officer, but you don’t have to be one for life. What’s more—” Luo Tengfeng took the initiative to step forward and whispered mysteriously in Lu Tianfeng’s ear, “Do you think we are the only two people in this world who can perceive the time loop?”

Lu Tianfeng almost blurted out: “What do you mean?”

“In fact, there are more perceivers in this world. It is said that there is a mysterious organization behind it that is studying the phenomenon of time loop. Don’t you want to find them? Now, you just need to choose to cooperate with me-” Luo Tengfeng deliberately kept the secret and didn’t say anything else.

Lu Tianfeng was stunned. Over the years, he had asked himself, why did the time loop occur? Was he the only one who could sense it? Would he ever be able to return to being an ordinary person? He had countless questions. It wasn’t that he didn’t want to know the answers, but he felt that with his limited power, he simply couldn’t find the answers.

Therefore, facing Luo Tengfeng’s invitation, Lu Tianfeng was moved for a moment, but before he could answer, he heard a slight electronic ticking sound coming from not far away.

Although the sound was very faint, it was particularly abrupt and harsh in this quiet floor.

That was the sound of the security door leading to the stairwell being unlocked.

Luo Tengfeng immediately showed a look of joy, and Lu Tianfeng flashed behind Luo Tengfeng at the fastest speed, put one hand around Luo Tengfeng’s neck, and used his body as a shield.

Lu Tianfeng knew very well that he could only fight alone now, so no matter who came, he would definitely not be his helper.

The security door was slowly pushed open, and the person who appeared at the door was Tong Yao holding a pistol.

Lu Tianfeng was not surprised by this. He even thought in his heart that although Yu Yongsheng and Huang Xuanxuan knew him better, the only person who could find his whereabouts so quickly was Tong Yao.

“Don’t move, put down your weapons!” she shouted.

“I don’t have a weapon.” Lu Tianfeng said this, and his right hand tightened around Luo Tengfeng’s neck.

“Captain Lu, stop struggling and come back to the bureau with me.” Tong Yao aimed the gun steadily at Lu Tianfeng.

“Tong Yao, listen to me, Luo Tengfeng is the mastermind behind these cases.”

Before Tong Yao could say anything, Luo Tengfeng started yelling exaggeratedly: “Officer Tong, help! Lu Tianfeng is really crazy——”

“Shut up!” Lu Tianfeng exerted force suddenly, holding Luo Tengfeng so that he could not speak anymore. Then the two of them moved back step by step. He believed that Tong Yao would not shoot rashly, and continued to retreat about ten meters. There was another safe door that could leave the shelter.

Tong Yao adjusted her breathing and slowly took two steps forward, the gun in her hand as steady as a rock.

“How did you find me?” Lu Tianfeng asked as he retreated, his attention focused on Tong Yao’s right shoulder. If Tong Yao really wanted to shoot, her right shoulder would give him a signal in advance.

She replied calmly, “The temporary phone cards you used were distributed by the bureau last year. I checked them one by one and finally found that one of them was activated near the suburban villa where the explosion occurred. The latest location is here.”

As they spoke, Tong Yao continued to move forward, and Lu Tianfeng took a few steps back, maintaining a delicate balance in the distance between them.

“You are worthy of being our new generation of information expert.” Lu Tianfeng was getting closer and closer to the exit.

Even though Tong Yao knew Lu Tianfeng’s intention to escape, she did not dare to act rashly and could only follow him closely.

“Captain Lu, stop.”

“Tong Yao, you can’t just shoot in this situation: first, I’m holding a hostage; second, we’re too far apart; third, I’m not using any high-risk weapons, and I’m not a dangerous criminal.”

“I know the rules very well and don’t need your reminder.”

“That’s great.” Lu Tianfeng had already retreated to another safe door.

Tong Yao seemed a little helpless. She really didn’t have enough reason to shoot, and she couldn’t bear to pull the trigger on her colleague. Unexpectedly, at this moment, Luo Tengfeng’s body suddenly twitched, his legs weakened, and he seemed to be completely unable to stand and was about to fall to the ground.

“Don’t play tricks!” Lu Tianfeng warned fiercely, trying to pull Luo Tengfeng up.

However, Luo Tengfeng’s limbs continued to twitch, and his whole body collapsed into a puddle of mud, kneeling on the ground. At this time, Luo Tengfeng could no longer serve as a shield for Lu Tianfeng, and Tong Yao could shoot at any time.

Lu Tianfeng had cold sweat on his forehead, smiled bitterly, and looked at Tong Yao sincerely.

“I didn’t do anything.”

Tong Yao hesitated for a moment, as if she wanted to pull the trigger, but the muzzle of the gun finally dropped and pointed at the ground.

“Save the person first.”

Lu Tianfeng was surprised. This was the first time he’d seen Tong Yao act in a manner inconsistent with police protocol. He didn’t have time to lament, though. He quickly squatted to check on Luo Tengfeng. He saw that the man, so high-spirited just moments ago, had a vacant look in his eyes, foam at the corners of his mouth, and a distorted expression. He was breathing heavily, not inhaling.

“What’s going on!” Lu Tianfeng was anxious and puzzled, almost roaring, “Luo Tengfeng, tell me, what’s going on!”

Luo Tengfeng’s eyes were filled with despair and fear. His lips, which had begun to turn purple, trembled as he squeezed out a few words hoarsely from the depths of his throat.

“…Chen Nuolan…is in danger…”

“What did you say?”

“…organization…secret…” Luo Tengfeng’s voice was almost inaudible, his eyes had lost focus, and after a strange cracking sound came from his throat, he gently exhaled his last breath.

What did he want to say in his last moments?

Tong Yao also rushed forward and felt Luo Tengfeng’s pulse. She knew that this once invincible man was beyond saving.

“What on earth have you done?” she demanded sharply.

“I didn’t do anything, call an ambulance.”

“Lu Tianfeng, you are suspected of illegal detention and intentional injury to others. You are now arrested according to law!” Tong Yao said as she took out handcuffs.

Lu Tianfeng seemed to be stunned and let Tong Yao grab his right hand. However, just as the handcuffs were about to be fastened, he retracted his right hand and then slammed his left elbow into Tong Yao’s face.

Tong Yao’s reaction was also extremely fast. She tilted her head back to avoid Lu Tianfeng’s elbow strike, and at the same time raised her right leg and struck Lu Tianfeng’s crotch with her knee. This was a standard fighting move. Tong Yao’s only mistake was that her response was too “standard”.

Lu Tianfeng slipped and seemed to be about to fall down, but while avoiding Tong Yao’s attack, he clamped Tong Yao’s calf tightly with his armpit.

Snap——

Tong Yao and Lu Tianfeng lost their balance and fell to the ground together. The difference was that Lu Tianfeng was prepared, but Tong Yao was caught off guard and hit the ground with the back of her head. She felt dizzy and lost consciousness for a short time.

After defeating Tong Yao with this almost street-thug-like move, Lu Tianfeng immediately handcuffed her hands and said in a calm tone, “I really didn’t do it.”

“There are only three of us here.” Tong Yao shook her dizzy head and said coldly.

“I have no motive to kill him. Also, I want to remind you that Luo Tengfeng drank a cup of coffee in the cafe in the hotel lobby fifteen minutes ago.”

“I watched the surveillance video before coming here. You were the one who handed him the cup of coffee while pretending to be a waiter.” Tong Yao had even investigated all this.

“But the coffee was taken out from the kitchen, and I…” Lu Tianfeng then remembered that he did not notice the appearance of the employee hiding in the kitchen to prepare coffee.

That person seemed to be avoiding him deliberately.

Why? Was it someone he knew?

A thought flashed through Lu Tianfeng’s mind, but when he tried to capture it, the thought disappeared without a trace.

“Do you remember anything?” Tong Yao asked.

Lu Tianfeng shook his head vigorously. Now he could only think of the rare plant toxin extracted by Tan Jiaqiang – delayed effect, quickly fatal. However, everything that happened today had nothing to do with D City University. How could the poison appear in Luo Tengfeng’s cup?

Unless there were other perceivers.

Lu Tianfeng suddenly understood Luo Tengfeng’s last words.

“Chen Nuolan is in danger. She knows the organization’s secrets.”

Lu Tianfeng stood up suddenly and clenched his fists. Leaving the unconscious Chen Nuolan alone in the safe house might be the biggest mistake he had ever made in his life!

“Captain Lu, you absolutely cannot leave here!” Tong Yao sensed Lu Tianfeng’s intention and quickly stopped him. “Fleeing from justice will only aggravate the charges.”

“I’m sorry, I haven’t committed any crime, so I’m not a fugitive.” Lu Tianfeng reached into Tong Yao’s trouser pocket, pulled out her phone, and punched in a long number. “I believe you’re so smart, you’ll be able to figure out a way to get out of this quickly.”

“Where are you going? Uncuff the handcuffs quickly!” Tong Yao had a bad feeling.

Lu Tianfeng threw away his phone, whose number had been exposed, and said with a wry smile: “You just need to believe me, I am definitely not the murderer.”

“Captain Lu, you’ll be wanted by the whole city if you do this!”

“Tong Yao, I trust you.” After Lu Tianfeng said this inexplicable sentence, he left without looking back.

Tong Yao sat there blankly, thinking about Lu Tianfeng’s words, and for a moment she even forgot that she should find a way to get out as soon as possible.

The empty floor became deathly silent again.

CONTENT END 54

chapters.title: Chapter 55
chapters.content:
April 15th, fifth cycle, 4:40 p.m.

Lu Tianfeng kept urging the taxi driver along the way, and even showed his police officer ID, asking the driver to run through several red lights and rush to the safe house where Chen Nuolan was as quickly as possible.

But he still felt that he was too slow.

“Nuolan, I’m here.”

The police would soon track him down from the Tianfeng Xinghua Hotel, and his record of applying for a safe house might be exposed in advance. What worried him even more was Luo Tengfeng’s last-minute warning.

What key secret did Chen Nuolan hold in her hands? Would the “Organization” take action to eliminate her?

An unknown enemy was the most terrifying.

The moment he pushed open the door of the safe house, Lu Tianfeng immediately noticed that something was wrong – it was a very strange feeling. He knew that this door had been opened by someone before, because the air in a house where the doors and windows had not been opened all day should be more stuffy and turbid.

But there was no sign that anything in the house had been moved, which proved that the person who came was definitely cautious and well prepared.

Lu Tianfeng was worried that Chen Nuolan had been forcibly taken away. When he slowly walked into the room, he saw that she was still lying peacefully on the bed, breathing evenly.

Lu Tianfeng did not feel relieved, but became even more nervous. It was absolutely impossible for the enemy to come here and not do anything.

What on earth did they do to feel comfortable leaving Chen Nuolan there?

At this moment, Lu Tianfeng’s heart seemed to be pulled hard by an invisible big hand, and he felt extremely uncomfortable.

“Nuolan, Nuolan!”

He rushed forward, bent down, and gently patted her cheek, trying to wake her up.

But Chen Nuolan, lying on the bed, did not react at all.

“Nuolan!”

Lu Tianfeng opened Chen Nuolan’s eyelids. Her eyes were completely glazed, unresponsive to the light, proving she was still in a deep coma. It had been over twelve hours since the injection of the drug, and the effects should have worn off. Even if she was still asleep, it shouldn’t have been so deep.

At this time, Lu Tianfeng finally noticed a faintly visible small pinhole on Chen Nuolan’s neck.

Someone gave her a shot.

Lu Tianfeng gasped. He knew all too well the consequences of an overdose of this drug. He’d previously handled a case where two thugs had gotten a woman drunk with intent to commit adultery. Fearing she’d wake up mid-sentence, they injected her with a full syringe of the drug, ultimately resulting in brain death.

“Who was it? Who was it…” He tried to stand up straight and looked around, trying to find some clues, but he only felt dizzy.

Heartbroken, bitter, helpless, and lost. He felt as if he had been torn into countless pieces. His limbs, torso, and head no longer belonged to him.

“You can’t just give up like this!”

Lu Tianfeng forced himself to take several deep breaths to let the dizziness dissipate and gradually regain his composure. The first thing that came to his mind was that the needle hole on Chen Nuolan’s neck had not yet disappeared, proving that the needle had just been injected and the person who did it should not have gone far.

Secondly, this was the police safe house, and not many people could come here, let alone sneak into the house without leaving a trace and give Chen Nuolan an injection in the neck.

At this moment, Lu Tianfeng suddenly realized why the other party did not take Chen Nuolan away directly, but only injected her with an overdose of drugs – they wanted Lu Tianfeng to take the blame for “manslaughter”, killing two birds with one stone.

Only someone inside the police force could have planned and implemented all this. It turned out that the most dangerous enemy had been hiding beside him.

Countless fragments of thoughts swirled in Lu Tianfeng’s mind, gradually forming a clear face –

A lecture at D City University, she was wearing a fiery red dress and waving at him from the back row of the auditorium;

In the biology department office, she arrested Tan Jiaqiang on the spot and found plant toxins;

In the airport cafe, she dressed as a waitress, mixing Americano coffee methodically;

The girl who had specifically applied to be his subordinate and always loved to sniff out all kinds of gossip;

She was used to looking at him with admiration, her eyes seemed to speak;

…

Was it really her?

Click—the door of the safe house opened.

Lu Tianfeng watched the entrance with full vigilance. The person who showed up at this critical moment was most likely here to deliver the final blow.

Huang Xuanxuan, with a murderous look on her face, strode into the house with a pistol in her hand.

“It’s you!” Lu Tianfeng said with a wry smile.

“Don’t move, raise your hands above your head!” Huang Xuanxuan turned a deaf ear to Lu Tianfeng’s words and pointed the gun at his head.

Lu Tianfeng slowly raised his hands above his head with a sarcastic smile on his lips.

“You don’t even show any mercy…”

Huang Xuanxuan pursed her lips and walked forward a few steps silently. Her face seemed covered with a veil, and no emotion could be seen.

The distance between the two was getting closer and closer, and the muzzle of the gun was almost touching Lu Tianfeng’s forehead.

“Someone who can quickly find the location of the safe house, someone who can go to D City University to get Tan Jiaqiang’s homemade toxin, someone who can pretend to be a waiter and poison the coffee… The only person who meets all the conditions is you.” When he was close to death, Lu Tianfeng’s analysis was calmer than usual.

Huang Xuanxuan’s mouth twitched, and she snorted, but she remained silent. Her features and expression were completely different from her usual self, a coldness that seemed to keep people at a distance.

“Oh, by the way, you can also install a tracker on Luo Tengfeng to know his movements at any time, because you had the opportunity to contact him privately in his office this morning.” Lu Tianfeng was unmoved and continued to speak slowly.

“Have you said enough?” Huang Xuanxuan’s voice sounded like a different person, cold and emotionless.

Lu Tianfeng said to himself, “I just want to know why you did this? Luo Tengfeng is fine, but you even didn’t let Chen Nuolan and me go?”

Huang Xuanxuan’s hand holding the gun began to tremble slightly.

Lu Tianfeng stared straight into Huang Xuanxuan’s eyes: “Xuanxuan, how do I treat you on a daily basis?”

“Very good.” She avoided Lu Tianfeng’s direct gaze.

“Then tell me, why do you do this?”

Huang Xuanxuan blinked, and the hesitation and wavering she had just shown disappeared. Her eyes were filled with murderous intent again: “I didn’t do anything. I just caught a wanted criminal with my own hands.”

Her finger was firmly on the trigger, and the muzzle stopped shaking.

Lu Tianfeng smiled sadly: “Okay, then you shoot.”

“What did you say?” Huang Xuanxuan frowned, feeling something was amiss. Everything was going so smoothly, and Lu Tianfeng didn’t seem to have the slightest thought of resisting.

“You planned this whole thing so you could arrest me and then shoot me for resisting arrest, didn’t you?”

Huang Xuanxuan looked at Lu Tianfeng suspiciously, unable to figure out what he was planning.

“If you only wanted to arrest me, why did you act alone? There’s absolutely no need for you to take risks alone against a wanted criminal like me.” Lu Tianfeng sighed, “Shoot.”

Huang Xuanxuan actually took half a step back.

“You step back too!” she shouted.

“Okay, I’ll step back…” Lu Tianfeng opened his arms and slowly backed away. “Why don’t you shoot?”

“Back off! Back off to the window!”

Lu Tianfeng slowly retreated. He quickly understood that Huang Xuanxuan hadn’t fired immediately to avoid having to explain later what had happened with this unconventional, close-range shooting. But as long as he retreated to the window, creating a certain distance between them, she would have ample reason to fire.

“Xuanxuan, you are very smart.” Lu Tianfeng sighed helplessly, “It’s a pity that you went astray.”

He had reached the closed window.

“Boss… I’m sorry, I have no choice. This is my mission…” It was the first time that Huang Xuanxuan called Lu Tianfeng “Boss” after entering the safe house.

What a kind and familiar name, but to Lu Tianfeng it sounded like irony.

“Xuanxuan, are you from the ‘Organization’?…”

“Open the curtains and open the windows.” Huang Xuanxuan did not answer, but gave orders coldly.

“Do you really want to kill me? Do you dare look me in the eyes and tell me that you really want to kill me?” Lu Tianfeng pulled open the gray-blue curtains and looked at his once loyal subordinate with a sigh.

Huang Xuanxuan’s eyes seemed to be filled with tears, but she did not avoid Lu Tianfeng’s gaze and said coldly and ruthlessly: “Lu Tianfeng, I will kill you.”

“Click.”

That was the sound of the pistol safety being released.

Although Lu Tianfeng had been a policeman for many years, he still felt overwhelmed every time he heard this sound.

This sound represented the imminent destruction of evil and the coming of justice, but this time, the clicking sound indicated that he was walking on the edge of life and death.

Huang Xuanxuan took a deep breath and aimed the gun at Lu Tianfeng’s forehead.

“Goodbye, Boss.”

At the last moment of his life, Lu Tianfeng was not thinking about himself or Chen Nuolan, but wondering why Huang Xuanxuan still called him “boss”.

Lu Tianfeng closed his eyes, so he couldn’t see Huang Xuanxuan’s tears slowly flowing, nor could he see her biting her lips tightly, even to the extent that blood slowly oozed out.

He was neither afraid nor regretful, just a little bit regretful. He thought how great it would be if he could still survive.

“puff–“

This was the sound of bullets piercing flesh. This was a sound the dead shouldn’t have to hear.

Lu Tianfeng opened his eyes.

“Huh—Huh—”

This was the sound of breathing, the sound of Lu Tianfeng himself breathing.

That’s right, Lu Tianfeng was still alive, but Huang Xuanxuan had collapsed. Her eyes were wide open, staring blankly at the ceiling, with an expression of disbelief on her face.

There was a small hole in the window, where a sniper bullet had passed through the glass. At the same time, a small hole had appeared on Huang Xuanxuan’s forehead. Blood was slowly flowing out of the hole, forming a growing stain on the floor. Huang Xuanxuan’s mouth opened into an O shape, as if she wanted to say something.

But in fact, the bullet penetrated the head and took Huang Xuanxuan’s life almost in an instant.

Lu Tianfeng didn’t feel the slightest bit of joy from escaping death. The sight of the corpse before him made him feel sick and nauseous. Chen Nuolan, lying in bed suffering innocently, was in a state of uncertainty, and he wanted to rush her to the hospital for emergency treatment.

But Lu Tianfeng found that he couldn’t even take a step. His physical strength was severely overdrawn and his spirit was extremely tired. The scene in front of him was spinning and darkening.

“I can’t hold on any longer…”

At this time, someone else rushed in.

“Boss, are you okay?” The voice belonged to Yu Yongsheng, but Lu Tianfeng could no longer see his face.

“I’m fine…” He managed to squeeze out a sentence.

“Xuanxuan! This…what is going on…” Yu Yongsheng’s voice changed.

“Captain Lu…” A voice that could make Lu Tianfeng feel at ease suddenly sounded, it belonged to Tong Yao.

Ambulance.

Processing site.

In-depth investigation.

Report to the leader.

Request support.

Lu Tianfeng had so many things he wanted to say, but he couldn’t utter a single word. His eyes went dark and he passed out.

Finally… He could take a break…

.

April 15th, fifth cycle, 5:00 PM.

Lu Tianfeng slowly opened his eyes and found himself lying on a hospital bed, all he saw was white.

“Captain Lu, are you awake?” He didn’t expect that Tong Yao had been by his side all the time, and she was the only one there.

Lu Tianfeng shook his head gently to quickly gather his scattered thoughts.

“Are you okay?” Tong Yao asked with concern, handing him a glass of warm water.

“How’s Feng Teng Gene doing?” Lu Tianfeng took the glass and asked without even drinking the water.

Tong Yao was stunned. She probably didn’t expect that Lu Tianfeng didn’t even care about his own health and the first question he asked was this.

“They held an emergency press conference half an hour ago, where Fan Minen announced she would replace Luo Tengfeng as the new CEO. At the same time, Fan Minen also announced an investment agreement with Volly.”

“The grand plan that Luo Tengfeng built with the blood and lives of others has been reduced to ashes just like that…” Lu Tianfeng couldn’t help but sigh at the cruelty of this world, where life and death, success and failure were just a matter of a moment.

“Preliminary testing of the explosives recovered from Zhu Shiming’s death scene confirmed they were derived from the same ingredients as those used in the Zhang Hanlin and Gao Junjie cases.” Tong Yao paused, then added, “But we haven’t found any evidence that Luo Tengfeng directed Zhu Shiming to commit the crime.”

“What’s the point of finding evidence when the person is dead?” Lu Tianfeng spoke in a way that a police officer shouldn’t have said.

“However, I completely cannot understand why Huang Xuanxuan poisoned and killed Luo Tengfeng, and then harmed you and Chen Nuolan.”

Lu Tianfeng suddenly turned his gaze to the incandescent light on the ceiling and stopped talking.

“Captain Lu?”

Lu Tianfeng was silent for a long time before he said, “I don’t want to implicate you.”

“But I have heard your incomprehensible words…”

“Which sentence?” Lu Tianfeng thought he had been careful enough and tried not to leak any key information.

“You were questioning whether Huang Xuanxuan is part of an organization. What kind of organization is that?”

Lu Tianfeng sighed and pulled out a small electronic component from his pocket. This was the key prop that Luo Tengfeng used to kill Zhu Shiming remotely, and it was also Lu Tianfeng’s lifeline.

The entire conversation between Lu Tianfeng and Huang Xuanxuan just now was transmitted to Tong Yao’s ears through this thing.

“I didn’t expect that this thing saved me, but it might hurt you.”

“Captain Lu, when you entered that unfamiliar 11-digit number into my phone, I was completely confused and had no idea what you were trying to do, but I still subconsciously tracked and monitored the number.”

“I knew you were monitoring us, so I deliberately tricked her into talking more. Unfortunately, I still couldn’t get any more information out of her.”

But Lu Tianfeng still successfully induced Huang Xuanxuan to say the most fatal words.

“Lu Tianfeng, I’m going to kill you!”

It was this sentence that gave Tong Yao enough reason to order the sniper to shoot.

“But why didn’t you say it directly? What if I didn’t understand what you meant? What if I couldn’t track the signal and get to the scene in time? What if I didn’t arrange a sniper in advance?” Tong Yao asked in rapid succession.

If Tong Yao’s response strategy had had even the slightest flaw, Lu Tianfeng would have been a corpse.

Lu Tianfeng turned his gaze to the window. “The situation was urgent at the time, and I didn’t have time to explain too much, but I believe you will adopt the most correct method to handle it. Tong Yao, I said, I trust you.”

Tong Yao’s face seemed to turn red: “You are too kind.”

“As a police officer, you have successfully completed your mission.” Lu Tianfeng sighed secretly, “What happens next is too dangerous. I don’t want to involve more unrelated people…”

“Captain Lu, I’m not some irrelevant person.” Something seemed to be burning in Tong Yao’s eyes. “I will not abandon my superiors, and I will not abandon my friends.”

Lu Tianfeng patted her shoulder gratefully: “What I am going to say next may sound like the plot of a science fiction movie, but I am definitely not kidding you.”

“Yeah, I understand.”

“In our world, time loops occur from time to time…” Lu Tianfeng introduced the laws of time loops to Tong Yao in the briefest language.

After listening to this, Tong Yao just nodded silently.

“Do you believe it?”

“Since ordinary people cannot confirm or deny the existence of time loops, I will choose to believe it for the time being.” Tong Yao’s answer surprised Lu Tianfeng.

“Now I suspect that there is an organization behind Huang Xuanxuan. They want to kill all those who can perceive the time loop and those who are related and know the truth.” Lu Tianfeng expressed his judgment seriously.

Tong Yao tilted her head, thought for a moment, and then said, “This… doesn’t seem to make sense…”

“What’s wrong with that?”

“According to what you said, Luo Tengfeng is a perceiver, so of course he will be eliminated, but what about Chen Nuolan? She shouldn’t have the ability to perceive time loops, right?”

“Hmm…” After saying this, Lu Tianfeng realized that his thinking had fallen into a misunderstanding.

“Another strange thing is, why didn’t Huang Xuanxuan get rid of Luo Tengfeng sooner? In fact, as a member of the personal guard, she had plenty of opportunities to take action. Why did she have to wait until today?”

A word awakened Lu Tianfeng from his dream, and he suddenly understood.

“Because something happened today, it triggered the organization’s murderous intent.”

“What is it?”

“Feng Teng Gene has received investment from Volly. Luo Tengfeng will have the opportunity to take sole control and work with Chen Nuolan to develop new RAN technology. This is a situation that the organization cannot accept.”

Tong Yao couldn’t help but frown: “In that case, Feng Teng Gene and RAN technology itself are full of secrets.”

“The key to unlocking all the secrets lies with Chen Nuolan.” Lu Tianfeng’s voice suddenly became hoarse. “I hope she can wake up soon…”

“She definitely will.” Tong Yao thought for a long time before she uttered this feeble consolation.

But many times, people only needed a meaningless word of comfort to persevere.

“Tong Yao, please remember, this is a secret between the two of us.”

Tong Yao nodded slowly and firmly.

“Please handle the discharge procedures for me. I still have a lot of things to do…”

CONTENT END 55

chapters.title: Chapter 56
chapters.content:
April 15th, late at night, in the police interrogation room.

Cheng Tuo’s eyes were bloodshot as he stared at the transcript in front of him in a daze.

“Is that all you have to say?” Cheng Tuo finally asked.

“Well, yes.”

“The instigator of this series of crimes was Luo Tengfeng. He orchestrated and instructed Zhu Shiming, using the alias ‘Mo Rui’, to carry out at least two murders—the two of them killed Zhang Hanlin and Gao Junjie. Zhu Shiming thought this would destroy Feng Teng Gene and exact revenge on Luo Tengfeng, but in reality, it only helped Luo Tengfeng gain absolute control of Feng Teng Gene. After completing his plan, Luo Tengfeng used a small bomb to silence Zhu Shiming.”

“That’s right, Captain Cheng summarized it very well.”

Cheng Tuo frowned. “But there are still many questions and loopholes. How did Luo Tengfeng come up with such a perfect murder plan?”

“Maybe he’s just incredibly lucky.”

“Why did Huang Xuanxuan poison Luo Tengfeng to death?”

“I have no idea.”

Cheng Tuo was silent for a moment before he said, “Why did you hide Chen Nuolan in the safe house from everyone?”

“I was worried that X would attack Chen Nuolan, but it turned out that I was wrong.”

“Then what was the reason for taking Luo Tengfeng away without permission?”

“It’s my fault, too. Captain Cheng, I know I made too many mistakes during this mission, and I’m willing to bear all the consequences.”

“This isn’t something where you can just admit your mistakes.”

“I have applied for suspension and am under investigation.”

Cheng Tuo sighed. He knew that Lu Tianfeng had concealed a lot of things, but he didn’t know what they were.

“Tianfeng, can you tell me the truth?” Cheng Tuo put down the pen and paper in his hand.

Lu Tianfeng was silent for a long time before he said, “Captain Cheng, this is the truth we need.”

“What’s the real truth?”

“There has never been any real truth.” Lu Tianfeng said while shaking his head.

Cheng Tuo knocked on the table lightly, smiled bitterly and left.

Lu Tianfeng sat quietly for a while, then looked up at the clock on the wall. It was finally approaching midnight. This day was truly incredibly long.

Time passed by every second.

No matter how long the day was, it would eventually pass.

Lu Tianfeng closed his eyes, opened them again, and said softly, “Hello, new day.”

CONTENT END 56

chapters.title: Chapter 57
chapters.content:
April 16th, 8:00 p.m.

Suddenly, a scream was heard in the quiet hospital corridor.

“Doctor, nurse! Come quickly, the patient is awake!”

The doctor and nurse on duty hurried to the single ward, only to see Lu Tianfeng standing beside the bed, tightly holding Chen Nuolan’s right hand. Chen Nuolan, who had been in a coma for almost two days, opened her eyes, with a dazed expression on her pale face.

“Nuolan, are you okay?”

“I… I’m fine…” Chen Nuolan’s voice was very hoarse.

“Family members, please move aside. We need to do an examination.” The doctor patted Lu Tianfeng on the shoulder and motioned him to step aside.

“Nuolan, I’ll be waiting for you outside, don’t worry!” Lu Tianfeng let go of her hand reluctantly.

Chen Nuolan blinked her large, lifeless eyes and asked word by word, “Who… are you?”

“What?” Lu Tianfeng was stunned.

“Who am I…” Chen Nuolan looked down at her arm, which was full of IV tubes. “Where… is this…”

“Go out for a while!” The doctor saw that Lu Tianfeng looked unwell and pushed him out of the door. “Don’t worry, temporary amnesia is very common. Just let her rest for a while and she’ll be fine.”

Lu Tianfeng walked out of the ward woodenly and stood there in a daze.

In the ward, doctors and nurses began to busy themselves with examining Chen Nuolan.

Chen Nuolan quietly opened her palm and looked at the four words written on it: Pretend to have amnesia.

She didn’t know why Lu Tianfeng reminded her like this, but she just trusted him unconditionally and trusted everything he said.

So she clenched her fist again and slowly wiped away the writing on her hand with sweat…

CONTENT END 57

chapters.title: Chapter 58
chapters.content:
April 17th, 9:00 p.m., in the CEO’s Office of Feng Teng Gene.

Fan Minen threw the folder in her hand onto the table, looked at the mountain of information, and couldn’t help but yawn.

“There are so many things. When will I be able to finish seeing them all?”

At this time, Gao Miaomiao walked in with a thick stack of information.

Fan Minen spoke first: “Oh my God, don’t tell me there is some important information that I must read.”

“Ms. Fan, this is indeed a very important thing… and it’s very strange…” Gao Miaomiao said hesitantly.

“Strange?”

“In the technical document database, I found a folder for a research and development project codenamed ‘RAN-X,’ but the contents were completely encrypted and unavailable for viewing. I asked throughout the R&D department, but no one knew of the project’s existence, let alone the password.”

“RAN-X? I haven’t heard of it either!”

“What on earth is going on?”

Fan Minen thought for a moment and said, “Obviously you haven’t asked everyone in the R&D department yet.”

“Chen Nuolan?” Gao Miaomiao immediately came to her senses.

“Once she wakes up, go and confirm this immediately.”

“What if… she never wakes up?” Gao Miaomiao chose her words carefully.

Fan Minen said coldly, “Is there any code in this world that cannot be cracked? As the head of the R&D department, you will definitely find a way to solve this problem for me, right?”

Gao Miaomiao’s face turned red and white, but she still replied humbly, “I understand, Ms. Fan.”

CONTENT END 58

chapters.title: Chapter 59
chapters.content:
April 18th, early morning.

In a corner of this city, two figures stood in a dark alley.

“Is this matter over for now?” A cold male voice asked.

“Yes, after Luo Tengfeng’s death, no one knows the secret of RAN-X anymore.” The answer came from another slightly hoarse male voice.

“Where’s Chen Nuolan?”

“Chen Nuolan originally didn’t know that the true purpose of the RAN-X project was to create a time-loop perceiver through genetic technology. Moreover, she has now lost her memory, and whether she can recover her memory is still unknown.”

“However, her boyfriend is a Perceiver that is beyond our control.”

The hoarse male voice hesitated for a few seconds before saying, “Lu Tianfeng shouldn’t pose a threat to us. Now he might even lose his job as a police officer…”

The man with a cold tone snorted: “You’d better help him keep this job.”

“Why?” The hoarse-voiced man looked up in surprise. The streetlight illuminated his handsome profile—it was Cheng Tuo, Lu Tianfeng’s boss. “Aren’t you worried that Lu Tianfeng will use police resources to investigate us?”

“In comparison, I’m more worried that he might use unconventional means to deal with us, so let him continue to be a police officer.”

“But…”

“Are you questioning my decision?”

Cheng Tuo stopped arguing and said with his head down, “I absolutely wouldn’t dare. I know what to do.”

The man sighed and said, “I’ll leave the police department to you.”

“Good.”

The street light above Cheng Tuo went out, and a street light not far away lit up.

The man who made Cheng Tuo obey his orders turned out to be an already gray-haired man with an indifferent expression of weathered years on his face, and a pair of eyes that were like a bottomless pool of water.

Zhou Huansheng.

“Eight years, the world must have forgotten me…” He looked up at the moon in the sky, feeling a surge of emotion.

At this moment, who else was looking up at the same bright moon?

This is the end of Book 1

CONTENT END 59

chapters.title: Chapter 60
chapters.content:
Lu Tianfeng

An elite criminal police officer. At seventeen, he discovered the ability to relive the same day five times at random intervals, and used this ability to solve several major cases. During his suspension, he was involved in a restaurant robbery. The robbers, using the life of his girlfriend, Chen Nuolan, as leverage, demanded that Lu Tianfeng travel back two days to save a death row inmate.

Chen Nuolan

A young and promising biologist, and also Lu Tianfeng’s girlfriend. Upon learning that Lu Tianfeng wants to save her in two days, she accepts his protection while using her wisdom and knowledge to help him find the mastermind.

Zhang Zhiqi

A criminal profiler and detective known as “Hound,” he excels at all investigative techniques, accurately predicting a person’s psychology and actions, claiming there’s no one he can’t find. While seemingly lazy, he possesses a calm and meticulous mind when working. He’s commissioned by Lu Tianfeng to help him complete a mission.

Tong Yao

A rising detective in the police station who is proficient in Internet technology works with Lu Tianfeng to investigate the truth behind the scenes and determines that there is a “traitor” in the police force.

Yu Yongsheng

Lu Tianfeng’s right-hand man in the police station, straightforward and with strong execution ability.

Wang Donglin

A cold-blooded murderer with an antisocial personality, the very person Lu Tianfeng needs to rescue when he travels back two days. His dark past has shaped his character. During his escape with Lu Tianfeng, he battles wits and strength, using any means necessary. He harbors the secret of reversing time.

Yuan Chengren

A criminal psychology expert, university professor, and former teacher of Zhang Zhiqi, he provided some help and guidance to Zhang Zhiqi during his investigation.

Cheng Tuo

Lu Tianfeng’s superior in the police station. He knows Lu Tianfeng’s secret and is secretly investigating.

Director Luo

The head of the police station took command personally after learning that Wang Donglin was rescued by Lu Tianfeng.

Yan Jin

The captain of the criminal police detachment and the main person in charge of the Wang Donglin case was pushed to the front line again after Wang Donglin disappeared.

Dai Chunhua

He is an experienced police officer who is in charge of leading the newly added information analysis department of the criminal police team.

Zhou Huansheng

Chen Nuolan’s former teacher. He holds many secrets of the “reversal of time” practice and influences everything behind the scenes.

CONTENT END 60

chapters.title: Chapter 61
chapters.content:
“Officer Lu, what are you still hesitating about?”

Extreme anger made Lu Tianfeng’s vision blurred and his hands trembled slightly.

“Drink it, everything will be fine.” The man smirked, his voice sharp and dry.

Lu Tianfeng forced himself to concentrate and take a closer look at the strange liquid in the test tube—it was almost transparent, with a faint pink tint. It also smelled a bit like alcohol.

“Feng! Don’t agree to him…” At this time, he heard Chen Nuolan’s pleading.

“Shhh…”

“Click,” that was the sound of the gun safety lock opening.

The man raised the gun and put the muzzle against Chen Nuolan’s temple.

“Don’t hurt her!” Lu Tianfeng shouted sternly.

“Drink it quickly!” the man urged Lu Tianfeng and moved his finger to the trigger.

“I’ll drink it. I’ll agree to all the conditions you propose, as long as you stop hurting other people.” Lu Tianfeng gritted his teeth, held his breath, closed his eyes, and poured all the liquid in the test tube into his throat in one breath.

Unexpectedly, this thing was not difficult to drink. The taste was similar to some kind of cocktail. Maybe it really contained alcohol.

“Very good. It will take about ten minutes for the drug to fully take effect. Before that, I want to prove something to you.”

“What’s that?” Lu Tianfeng finally swallowed the last drop and slowly opened his eyes.

“There’s no turning back.”

After the man said this coldly, he pulled the trigger without hesitation.

“Bang!”

“Nuolan—”

The world in front of Lu Tianfeng suddenly turned black and white, and the sound disappeared all of a sudden.

In addition to black and white, there was also a glaring red.

Then the red color gradually turned black, and Chen Nuolan fell into the darkness, like an innocent person swallowed by the darkness.

CONTENT END 61

chapters.title: Chapter 62
chapters.content:
“Nuolan—” Lu Tianfeng woke up from his dream and sat up suddenly. It took him a while to come back to his senses. He found that his palms and back were all damp with sweat, and even his T-shirt was soaked.

A warm and slender hand stretched out from under the quilt and gently embraced his waist.

“Feng, are you having a nightmare again?” Chen Nuolan asked in a half-asleep state, her words unclear.

After Lu Tianfeng took several deep breaths, he said, “I’m fine, go to sleep.”

Chen Nuolan didn’t respond. Lu Tianfeng looked down and saw that she hadn’t fully woken up yet and had quickly fallen asleep again. Lu Tianfeng closed his eyes, and a variety of chaotic scenes kept flashing through his mind: speeding cars, explosions, chases, gunfights…

The Feng Teng Gene case was over, but the impact of the incident was still ongoing – Lu Tianfeng was suspended indefinitely and was undergoing an internal police investigation; Chen Nuolan pretended to have lost her memory and was unemployed at home, temporarily avoiding returning to work at Feng Teng Gene.

But escaping was not the solution to the problem. Although Chen Nuolan had never complained in person, she had asked indirectly several times when she could return to work, even if she had to find another job.

However, Lu Tianfeng was unable to answer this question directly every time. There were too many things and he didn’t know where to start explaining, so he had to make excuses.

Since the two of them were “passively unemployed”, they had been spending more time together, but their communication had not become smoother. The invisible barrier between them seemed to be getting harder and harder to break.

Chen Nuolan could naturally see that Lu Tianfeng was hiding something important from her, but she was unwilling to expose it because she trusted her boyfriend’s decision. And it was this unconditional trust that put Lu Tianfeng under great pressure.

“I’ll give you an answer…”

Lu Tianfeng looked up at the clock on the wall. It was June 2nd, 3:10 in the morning.

Tonight was when he decided to confess everything to her.

Because this day was the anniversary of their acquaintance. Two years ago today, Lu Tianfeng rescued Chen Nuolan from the Tianma Jewelry Center robbery that shocked the whole city, and the two quickly became lovers.

So on this memorable day, accomplish something extremely difficult.

Thinking of this, Lu Tianfeng finally relaxed and laid back on the bed. Chen Nuolan, who was in her sleep, seemed to sense something and leaned into his arms. Lu Tianfeng held her with one arm and gently stroked her hair with the other. Soon, he also fell into a sweet dream.

At seven in the morning, the alarm clock rang.

Although neither of them had to go to work, they still maintained good work and rest habits. They got up on time every day, took turns to be responsible for breakfast, and then went about their own business after breakfast.

Today it was Lu Tianfeng’s turn to prepare breakfast. While he was frying eggs in the kitchen, Chen Nuolan slowly changed her clothes, sat at the dining table, and drank warm milk.

“Are we still going to the library today?” Lu Tianfeng asked without turning his head, flipping the fried egg expertly. No matter how gentle Chen Nuolan’s movements were, they couldn’t be hidden from his ears.

“Yes, shopping is boring. I might as well go look for some information while there are fewer people.”

“Oh, then I’ll make you a pot of chrysanthemum tea later. Take it with you.” Lu Tianfeng put the fried eggs he had just made into a plate.

Chen Nuolan took a big sip of milk and asked, “What about you? Where are you going to exercise today?”

“I’m going to go for a run this morning, and then go back to the police station.”

“Police station?” Chen Nuolan paused. This was the first time she had heard him mention this word in the past month.

“Well, yes, there seems to be some progress in reinstatement.” Lu Tianfeng brought out fried eggs and slightly toasted bread slices from the kitchen and placed them on the dining table.

Chen Nuolan said calmly, “Can you go back to work now? That’s great.”

“I don’t know the specific situation yet, I need to find out more first.”

Chen Nuolan ate the bread silently, looking thoughtful. Lu Tianfeng naturally understood what she meant and said at the right time: “Nuolan, let’s go out for dinner tonight!”

“Oh? To celebrate your reinstatement?”

“No, it’s to celebrate our anniversary, June 2nd…”

“I thought you forgot.” Chen Nuolan’s expression was still unpredictable.

“How could I forget? I’ve already made a reservation at the Tianshu Western Restaurant.”

“Ah? That internet-famous western restaurant decorated like a bookstore? Isn’t it said to be difficult to make a reservation?” Chen Nuolan’s frown finally relaxed.

Tianshu Western Restaurant was a high-end restaurant that opened this year. Located on the top floor of the Skyline Building in a bustling area of D City, it was an excellent place to enjoy the night view. In addition, the interior decoration of the restaurant was literary and artistic, full of unique charm. In just a few months, it had become a favorite dating spot for couples in the city.

“No matter how difficult it is, I can do it for you.” Lu Tianfeng smiled and picked up the perfectly fried egg and placed it in front of Chen Nuolan, “For example, fried eggs.”

“Then, can you share your secret with me?” Chen Nuolan asked calmly.

Lu Tianfeng answered without hesitation: “Okay, I will tell you everything tonight.”

This straightforward answer actually made Chen Nuolan stunned.

“Let’s have breakfast first.” Lu Tianfeng sat down and started to work on his bread and egg sandwich.

Chen Nuolan blinked, then nodded obediently.

The sunlight outside the window shone on the white dining table, and a beautiful day started here.

CONTENT END 62

chapters.title: Chapter 63
chapters.content:
At 10:30 a.m., inside the D City Police Department office building.

“Director Luo, I’m here.” Lu Tianfeng pushed open the office door with a bit of restraint. As a frontline criminal police officer, he didn’t usually have many opportunities to interact directly with the director, so he was inevitably a little nervous.

“Xiaolu, come sit down!” Director Luo responded with a smile. Having been in the police force for over thirty years, he now looked like an ordinary, slightly overweight old man. Only his eagle-like eyes reminded everyone that he was not to be trifled with.

“Director Luo, do you have any instructions for me to come here today?” Lu Tianfeng carefully chose his words so as not to appear too abrupt.

“Don’t be nervous. I know your situation very well. And I also know what kind of police officer you are. It’s time for you to return to work.” Director Luo went straight to the point and directly pointed out the issue that Lu Tianfeng was most concerned about.

“Thank you, Director Luo.” Lu Tianfeng hurriedly expressed his gratitude.

“However, there are indeed many problems in the process of solving the Feng Teng Gene case. Several important suspects died during the investigation, and someone needs to be held accountable for this.”

“Director Luo, I am the commander on the scene and I have no choice but to take responsibility.”

Director Luo smiled and drummed his knuckles on the folder on his desk. “So, some people within the police station think you’re no longer fit to be a frontline detective. They suggest I transfer you to the logistics department.”

“This…” Lu Tianfeng’s expression became serious.

Everyone knew that transferring Lu Tianfeng, who was in his prime, to the logistics department was tantamount to ruining his career as a criminal police officer.

“Don’t worry. I know talent is hard to come by, and I definitely won’t transfer you from the Criminal Investigation Team.” Director Luo paused, then added, “It’s just that, given your current condition, you do need some room for adjustment.”

“What do you mean?”

“Recently, our superiors have been carrying out organizational reforms. We have added an Information Analysis Department within the Criminal Investigation Team. I would like you to serve as the deputy head of this department.”

“Deputy? Who’s in charge of this department?”

“Dai Chunhua, formerly of the Fourth Detachment.”

Lu Tianfeng was stunned. Dai Chunhua was an experienced policeman, but in the past two years, due to poor health and approaching retirement age, he rarely participated in front line criminal investigation work.

It was very reasonable for Dai Chunhua to take up an idle position in the bureau, but Lu Tianfeng, who was in his prime, did not need such an arrangement at all.

“Director Luo…”

Director Luo raised his hand, gently pressed down with his palm facing outward, signaling Lu Tianfeng not to worry.

“Xiaolu, you should be well aware that reinstating you directly would attract considerable criticism, making it difficult to carry out normal work. However, this new position is organized within the Criminal Investigation Division. While its responsibilities may appear to focus on information analysis and behind-the-scenes support, it can actually be deployed to the front lines at any time. It’s like being able to attack when advancing or defend when retreating.”

Lu Tianfeng finally understood what Director Luo meant. He was indeed an old fox. He had calculated all the internal relationships and possible conflicts clearly and chose this compromise plan that would not offend anyone.

“Besides, Old Dai is not young anymore and will retire in two years. Sooner or later, the top position in the Information Analysis Department will fall on your shoulders. Doesn’t that mean a promotion?” Director Luo calmly threw out the next “bait”.

Lu Tianfeng smiled bitterly. It seemed that Director Luo had already made up his mind. He came here just to go through the motions and just follow the leader’s instructions. Besides, Director Luo’s plan did not treat him unfairly.

“Thank you, Director Luo, Lu Tianfeng obeys the organization’s arrangements!”

“Very good. Old Dai and his men have been busy handling a case for the past two days. They’ve been working non-stop for forty-eight hours. They were only allowed to go back home to rest early this morning. So please come back tomorrow to complete the reinstatement procedures.”

Lu Tianfeng asked curiously: “What case is it?”

Director Luo’s brows furrowed involuntarily. “The case itself isn’t complicated, it’s just that the online media has paid too much attention to it…”

Lu Tianfeng immediately recalled the incident that had been extensively reported by all major media outlets since yesterday—a serial killer was identified as mentally ill and escaped legal punishment, but died in a car accident on the way to a psychiatric hospital.

“Director Luo, are you talking about the car accident from the day before yesterday?”

“Car accident?” Director Luo gave a helpless smile. “Car accident was just a propaganda tactic. In reality… it was a blatant robbery and murder.”

Director Luo lowered his voice when he said the last half sentence, but Lu Tianfeng was still frightened.

“Robbery and murder… is that serious?”

“Well, the perpetrators first blew up the tires of the prison van, then exchanged fire with the escorts, resulting in one death and three serious injuries among the four escorts. Finally, the perps pried open the prison van and fired several rounds of bullets into it, riddling the prisoners inside. Honestly, I have no idea what they were trying to do. There are simpler and more direct ways to kill people. There’s no need for such a head-on confrontation!”

Lu Tianfeng pondered for a moment and asked, “Is there any progress in the case now?”

“Not yet. How about you take advantage of this afternoon to familiarize yourself with the basic facts of the case? That way, you can get right to work tomorrow and be more efficient.”

“Yes, sir!” Lu Tianfeng was still a little excited. Being able to participate in investigation work again was at least much better than staying at home.

Director Luo naturally saw through Lu Tianfeng’s thoughts. He laughed and said, “Don’t worry, Xiaolu. Even if you change your job position, you can still use your strengths to the fullest.”

“I will definitely do my best and not let my leader down!”

Director Luo nodded with satisfaction. He knew very well that Lu Tianfeng was a double-edged sword. If not handled properly, he might trigger a series of adverse reactions; but on the other hand, Lu Tianfeng was still the main force in the police station who could solve difficult cases.

He believed that the case before him would definitely arouse Lu Tianfeng’s interest.

CONTENT END 63

chapters.title: Chapter 64
chapters.content:
6:30 in the evening.

Chen Nuolan, wearing a royal blue dress, walked into the Tianshu Western Restaurant on the 80th floor of the Skyline Building.

“Hello! Do you have an appointment?” A waiter in a suit hurried forward to greet him, bent down and asked politely.

“Mr. Lu reserved a seat.”

“I understand. Please follow me.”

The waiter respectfully led Chen Nuolan to a seat by the window, and thoughtfully brought her a menu, snacks, and a brand new book with a faint scent of ink. The title of the book was “The Best Years.”

Chen Nuolan asked in surprise, “Why is there another book?”

“This is a gift Mr. Lu prepared for you in advance. In addition to providing catering services, our shop is also happy to share excellent books with everyone.” The waiter replied with some pride.

“Thank you.” Chen Nuolan smiled slightly. It happened that she came early today and could read a book to kill time.

Lu Tianfeng and Chen Nuolan agreed to meet at 7 p.m. Normally, Chen Nuolan was never late, but she also didn’t arrive too early, as she wanted to ensure Lu Tianfeng was the first one there. This prevented him from feeling pressured by the thought of being late, and also made him feel respected by arriving on time.

Today, however, Chen Nuolan couldn’t contain her anxiety and arrived a full half hour early. She’d been distracted all day, constantly wondering what secret Lu Tianfeng was about to confess to her tonight. Could she still stay at Feng Teng Gene and continue doing the job she loved? Was Lu Tianfeng going to be reinstated as a criminal police officer? If he could go back to being a criminal police officer, why couldn’t she be a researcher?

Chen Nuolan’s mind was full of these things, and she couldn’t concentrate on reading in the library. She simply left the library at noon, went out to buy some new clothes, got her hair done, and then went home to dress up and go to the appointment with a brand new look.

Chen Nuolan casually flipped through the book out of boredom. The few words printed on the title page touched the softest part of her heart——

I used to think I was lucky.

I am glad to meet you in my best years.

Now looking back on the past,

Only then did I realize that it was you who made time.

It became our best years.

“Lu Tianfeng, you are a straight man who likes to play this kind of sour and earthy romance.” Chen Nuolan complained in a low voice, but the corners of her mouth couldn’t help but curl up slightly.

At this time, Chen Nuolan received a message on her mobile phone. She looked down and saw that it was from Lu Tianfeng.

“Sorry, I was delayed by something. I might be a little late.”

Chen Nuolan was about to type a reply when a loud noise suddenly came from behind her, causing her eardrum to ache slightly.

Chen Nuolan was not unfamiliar with this sound; it was the sound of gunfire.

On this day two years ago, Chen Nuolan and Lu Tianfeng met and got to know each other amid the sound of gunfire.

The restaurant suddenly became chaotic, with screams and cries for help echoing one after another. Soon, a second gunshot rang out.

“Bang!”

A gruff man wearing a pig-head mask stood in the middle of the restaurant, holding a gun and yelling, “Everyone, be quiet. Sit down and put your phones down!”

Next to the man with the pig head mask, there were four people wearing dog head masks, each holding a gun in his hand.

Just like a scene in a movie, Chen Nuolan immediately threw down her phone. She didn’t want to get into any trouble.

However, the girl sitting next to her, dressed in fashionable clothes, seemed to be petrified, holding the phone tightly in her hand. What’s more, her phone was in active use.

The pig-head masked man also noticed the girl. He turned the gun towards her and shouted, “Damn it, are you looking for death?”

The girl kept shaking her head, but her trembling right hand still subconsciously clenched the phone.

“You’re turning a deaf ear to my words?” the man said viciously and pulled the trigger.

“Bang!”

The bullet pierced the girl’s neck. She finally dropped the damn phone and covered her wound with both hands, but still couldn’t stop the blood from spurting out. Soon, she collapsed to the ground and didn’t move.

This sudden change made the customers who were shouting and yelling suddenly quiet down, because at this moment, they could truly feel that death was hovering around them.

“If you don’t obey again, this will be your fate!” The Pig-Head Mask swept the crowd with the muzzle of his gun and said, “Everyone gather together. No personal belongings are allowed. Stand in a circle and squat on the ground. Where are the waiters?”

“Yes…” The waiter who had just welcomed Chen Nuolan to the table responded timidly.

“Close the door and don’t let anyone in. We’re going to plant a bomb on it. Is there any other entrance or exit to this place?”

“Yes, yes… there is an employee passage, and… a fire escape…” The waiter turned pale with fear when he heard the word “bomb”.

“Seal it all off.” Pig-Head Mask gave orders to his men, and then asked, “How many people are there in the restaurant now?”

“Staff plus customers…about forty people?”

“There are too many hostages. We need to reduce them a bit so we can operate more smoothly.” Pig-Head Mask said with a half-smile, “What rules do you think should be followed to reduce the number of hostages?”

“I… I don’t know…” While answering, the waiter looked at the smoking muzzle of the gun and his body trembled constantly.

“Get out of here and stop anyone who tries to approach or enter the restaurant from outside the door. Tell them there’s a bomb here and it will explode as soon as the door is opened.”

“Yes… yes…” the waiter agreed, but his legs seemed to be rooted and he couldn’t move.

“Get out of here!” Pig-Head Mask kicked the waiter hard. The waiter suddenly woke up and realized that he had saved his life. He crawled out of the restaurant.

“Send two people to control the kitchen, then block all entrances and exits, and proceed according to the plan.” Pig-Head Mask directed his subordinates in an orderly manner. While speaking, he also glanced at Chen Nuolan deliberately.

Although the mask blocked the man’s gaze, Chen Nuolan still shuddered.

CONTENT END 64

chapters.title: Chapter 65
chapters.content:
